name.en: Born Anew: Files of False Idols

summary.en: The Luddic Church's inner secrets: the Files of False Idols and the man called Ulmus Pond.
summary.zh: 路德教会的内部秘辛：伪神档案，以及那个被称为 Ulmus Pond 的男人。

briefing.en: Pick up Jethro Bornanew from Gilead.
briefing.zh: 从 Gilead 接走 Jethro Bornanew。

briefing.en: Go to Olinadu and contact Menes Yaribay, the planetary administrator.
briefing.zh: 前往 Olinadu 并与行星管理员 Menes Yaribay 取得联系。

briefing.en: Go to Kazeron and talk to Horus Yaribay about his cousin Menes.
briefing.zh: 前往 Kazeron 与 Horus Yaribay 商讨关于他表亲 Menes 的事宜。

briefing.en: Attend Menes Yaribay's 'gathering' on Olinadu and find a way to steal the false relic.
briefing.zh: 前往 Olinadu 参加 Menes Yaribay 的 '聚会' 并设法窃取那件伪造遗物。

briefing.en: Attend Menes Yaribay's 'gathering' on Olinadu with Horus Yaribay, the patriarch of Gens Yaribay.
briefing.zh: 与 Yaribay 氏族的族长 Horus Yaribay 一同前往 Olinadu 参加 Menes Yaribay 的 '聚会'。

briefing.en: Attend Menes Yaribay's 'gathering' on Olinadu and acquire the false relic.
briefing.zh: 前往 Olinadu 参加 Menes Yaribay 的 '聚会' 并获取那件伪造遗物。

briefing.en: Bring the false relic to Asher so that a nanoforge engineer in the employ of the Church can examine it.
briefing.zh: 将伪造遗物带去 Asher，以便让一位受雇于教会的纳米锻炉工程师对其进行检查。

briefing.en: Go to Olinadu and confront Ulmus Pond to get a confession.
briefing.zh: 前往 Olinadu 与 Ulmus Pond 对质，以获取其供词。

briefing.en: Go to Chalcedon and use Bornanew's intel to track down where Ulmus Pond is hiding.
briefing.zh: 前往 Chalcedon，利用 Bornanew 提供的情报追踪 Ulmus Pond 的藏身之处。

briefing.en: and investigate. Find where the glove came from and how it was made. Ensure no more will be created.
briefing.zh: 并进行调查。查明那只手套的来源与制造方式。确保不会有更多此类物品被制造出来。

briefing.en: Go to the Cathedral of Holy Exodus, on Tartessus, and arrest Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith.
briefing.zh: 前往位于 Tartessus 的 Exodus 神圣大教堂，并逮捕助理祭司 Cedra Keepfaith。

briefing.en: Deliver Cedra Keepfaith to the Knights of Ludd on Hesperus to face their justice.
briefing.zh: 将 Cedra Keepfaith 交给 Hesperus 的卢德骑士团，让她接受他们的审判。

options.en: I understand that you're a collector of interesting objects.
options.zh: 我听说你是一位有趣物品的收藏家。

texts.en:
A tap confirms that Bornanew is receiving a split of the comms feed.

"Indeed!" Menes says, perking up. "In truth, I consider myself something of an antiquarian. It provides me with a... a connection to the great individuals who have come before and changed the worlds for," he pauses for drama, "...good or ill."

"If I may, if I may," he says, growing more excited by the moment, "I did peek at your dossier before accepting the comm link. I'm given to understand you're something of an adventurer? Perhaps you've stumbled on historical objects of interest in your travels?"
texts.zh:
你轻触平板，确认 Bornanew 正在接收分流的通讯信号。

"的确如此！" Menes 说着，精神一振。"实际上，我自认为是个古董爱好者。它为我提供了一种...一种与那些改变了世界的前人们的联系，" 他为了营造戏剧效果而故意顿了一下，"...无论是好是坏。"

"如果可以，如果可以的话，" 他越说越兴奋，"在接受通讯链接前我稍微看了一下你的档案。我听说你是个冒险家？或许你在旅途中偶遇过什么有历史价值的物品？"

texts.en:
A tap confirms that Bornanew is receiving a split of the comms feed.

"Indeed!" Menes says, perking up. "I consider myself something of an antiquarian. It provides a... a connection to the great individuals who have come before and changed the worlds for," he pauses for drama, "...good or ill."

"If I may, if I may," he says, more excited by the moment, "I did peek at your dossier before accepting the comm link. You've made some people very angry, haven't you. How... disreputable."

You're not sure you've seen someone's eyes twinkle before, but you swear that his just did.
texts.zh:
你轻触平板，确认 Bornanew 正在接收分流的通讯信号。

"的确如此！" Menes 说着，精神一振。"我自认为是个古董爱好者。它提供了一种...一种与那些改变了世界的前人们的联系，" 为了营造戏剧效果而故意顿了一下，"...无论是好是坏。"

"如果可以，如果可以的话，" 他越说越兴奋，"在接受通讯链接前，我偷看了你的档案。你惹恼了一些人，对吧。真是...声名狼藉。"

你不确定自己以前有没有见过别人眼中光芒闪烁，但你发誓他刚刚就是这样。

options.en: What I've experienced in the depths of the starry sea would drive lesser minds to madness.
options.zh: 我在星海深处的经历足以让心智脆弱者陷入疯狂。

options.en: I took my ship to reach the stars.... but I've gone much, much farther than that.
options.zh: 我驾船驶向群星...但我所抵达的远方远不止于此。

options.en: I've seen things you wouldn't believe. Attack ships on fire off the Orion-Perseus abyss...
options.zh: 我见过你们难以相信的景象。攻击舰在 猎户-英仙座深渊 外燃烧...

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Splendid!" Menes gushes, "Absolutely splendid!"

"You simply must join one of my little weekly gatherings. Just a little get together of what few cultured minds may be found in this ghastly backwater. We'd adore hearing about your adventures. Oh, a legitimate spacer captain would lend some spice to the event! I am excited."
texts.zh:
"太棒了！" Menes 滔滔不绝，"简直太棒了！"

"你一定要来参加我每周一次的小聚会，这不过是在这处穷山恶水里为数不多文化人的小聚会。我们很想听听你的冒险故事。喔，一位真正的太空舰长会给这次活动增色不少的！我很激动。"

options.en: May I bring a guest?
options.zh: 我可以带个客人吗？

texts.en: "And I'll have to make sure to invite-" Menes is smiling, distracted by his own party planning. "-ah, a guest? I'm sure it'd be no bother. Who did you have in mind?"
texts.zh: "而且我得确保邀请 ——" Menes 微笑着，被自己的派对计划分了心。"—— 啊，一位客人？我觉得没问题。你打算带谁来？"

options.en: A hardened criminal who changed his name and became a Knight of Ludd.
options.zh: 一个改名换姓并当上卢德骑士的大罪之人。

options.en: A man who broke his Knightly vows only to hide among terrorists and become a hermit.
options.zh: 一个违背了骑士誓言，躲进恐怖分子中成为隐士的人。

options.en: A Knight who lost his way - but never his faith - now seeking absolution by way of epic quest.
options.zh: 一个虽迷失了方向，却从未失去信仰，现在正通过史诗般的任务寻求赦免的骑士。

texts.en:
"Oh!" Menes claps his hands together in delight. "That would be just the perfect, perfect thing!"

"Bring your friend," a mischievous look grows on his face. "I have an object in my special collection," his eyebrows bounce, "that'll launch his tabard directly into orbit! You'll see, you'll see. Oh, this is so perfect."
texts.zh:
"哦！" Menes 高兴地拍着手。"太完美了，那真是太完美了！"

"带上你的朋友，" 他脸上露出恶作剧般的神情，"我的特别收藏里有一件物品，" 他的眉毛跳了跳，"能让他的教袍直接飞到轨道上去！你会看到的，你就期待着吧。哦，太完美了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Menes, still grinning and rattling on about his plans, sends you credentials to allow the docking of a shuttle at his private complex on the surface of Olinadu.
texts.zh: Menes 依旧咧嘴笑着，喋喋不休地谈论着他的计划，并向你发送了凭证，允许一架穿梭机在他位于 Olinadu 地表的私人庄园中降落。

options.en: We'll meet you before long, I'm sure.
options.zh: 我们很快就会碰面的，我确定。

texts.en: You close the comms, then summon Bornanew to a briefing room to discuss the next phase of the plan.
texts.zh: 你关闭了通讯，然后把 Bornanew 叫到简报室讨论计划的下一阶段。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew's head is lowered as he enters, carrying his paper notebook as well as an off-brand datapad.

The notebook slaps onto the table a little harder than would be considered strictly polite.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 进来时低着头，手里拿着他的纸质笔记本和一个杂牌数据平板。

笔记本拍在桌子上的声音比严格意义上礼貌的程度要响一些。

texts.en: "-I'd hardly describe myself as a 'hardened' criminal, and although technically a Knight of Ludd, I'm merely a novice - and one in poor standing at that."
texts.zh: "—— 我没想过把自己说成是个 '大' 罪之人，而且虽然严格意义上是卢德骑士，但我只是个新晋骑士 —— 而且还声名不佳。"

texts.en: "I think it is uncharitable to the point of slander to describe the people of Mazalot as 'terrorists' so easily. And although it was a remote farming community, I was hardly hermit, to say nothing of-" He stops mid-rebuttal and looks up.
texts.zh: "我认为，轻易地将 Mazalot 上的居民描述为 '恐怖分子'，这不厚道到了近乎诽谤的程度。而且虽然那是个偏远的农耕社区，我也算不上是隐士，更别说 ——" 他反驳到一半就停了下来，抬起头。

texts.en: "Although technically a Knight of Ludd, I'm merely a novice - and one in poor standing at that. As for this 'epic quest' you describe, it's more of-" He stops speaking and looks up at you.
texts.zh: "虽然严格意义上是卢德骑士，但我只是个新晋骑士 —— 而且还声名不佳。至于你描述的这个 '史诗般的任务'，它更像是一种 ——" 他停了下来，抬头看着你。

options.en: Relax, $global.jethroName. We're just making you more exciting for Menes.
options.zh: 放松点，$global.jethroName。我们只是想让 Menes 觉得你更有趣。

options.en: You knew what this would entail. Think of the good it will accomplish.
options.zh: 你知道我这么说的目的。想想它带来的好处。

texts.en: "Yes," he sighs. "A barefaced ruse, I understand."
texts.zh: "好吧，" 他叹了口气，"一个赤裸裸的骗局，我明白。"

texts.en: "Nevertheless, that went well. Very well."
texts.zh: "不管怎么说，事情进行得很顺利。非常顺利。"

options.en: We should steal the glove.
options.zh: 我们应该偷走那个手套。

options.en: Let's discuss the heist option again.
options.zh: 我们再讨论一下抢劫的方案吧。

options.en: I'll pretend to be a collector looking to buy a unique item.
options.zh: 我会假装成想购买独特物品的收藏家。

options.en: I could pretend to have a relic to sell. Any ideas?
options.zh: 我可以假装有件圣物要卖。有什么主意吗？

options.en: Let's discuss me posing as a buyer again.
options.zh: 我们再讨论一下我扮成买家的事情吧。

options.en: I should invite Horus Yaribay to this 'gathering'.
options.zh: 我应该邀请 Horus Yaribay 参加这个 '聚会'。

options.en: Let's discuss inviting Horus Yaribay to this party.
options.zh: 我们讨论一下邀请 Horus Yaribay 参加这个派对的事吧。

options.en: I'll simply send my marines in to seize the relic.
options.zh: 我会直接派遣陆战队员夺取圣物。

options.en: Let's discuss the raid option again.
options.zh: 我们再讨论一下劫掠的方案吧。

texts.en:
You can tell he doesn't like the idea.

"That seems... it would be a blunt approach," he says. "And risky."
texts.zh:
你能看出来他不喜欢这个主意。

"那听上去...是种粗暴的做法，" 他说。"而且有风险。"

texts.en:
Your tactical officer has already spearheaded an effort to discreetly collect what public information is available on Menes Yaribay's compound. Sensors has arranged passive scans to correlate with on-record plans of the structure. Comms found a PR puff-piece holo in which Menes gives a personal tour of part of his 'collection'.

All you really need to do is get yourself invited into the inner sanctum.
texts.zh:
你的战术军官已经带头谨慎地收集了关于 Menes Yaribay 庄园的公开信息。传感器技官进行了被动扫描，来与记录在案的建筑平面图进行核对。通讯军官则找到了一份公关宣传全息影像，其中 Menes 亲自带领参观了他的部分 '收藏品'。

你所需要做的，就是让自己被邀请进入那个内部密室。

texts.en:
A holo of the complex spins in ghostly form in the shared visual workspace.

Your tools are multitude. All you really need to do is get yourself invited into the inner sanctum.
texts.zh:
庄园的全息影像在共享视觉工作区中如幽灵般旋转着。

你有很多工具。你所需要做的就是让自己被邀请进入那个内部密室。

options.en: I often find the direct approach the most effective.
options.zh: 我发现直截了当的方法常常最有效。

options.en: Don't tell me you've never stolen before, $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 别告诉我你从没偷过东西，$global.jethroName。

options.en: I've got the tools and the intel. I'll steal that glove.
options.zh: 我手头上有工具和情报。让我来偷走那个手套。

options.en: Let's discuss other options.
options.zh: 我们讨论一下其他方案吧。

options.en: It's decided. I'll steal that glove.
options.zh: 就这么定了。我来偷走那个手套。

options.en: Let's discuss other options.
options.zh: 我们讨论一下其他方案吧。

texts.en:
He looks at you, and you see that he knows he has no argument for you.

Bornanew sighs. "Nonetheless, theft is a sin. And I did swear a sacred oath that I would never steal again."
texts.zh:
他看着你，你知道他无法反驳。

Bornanew 叹了口气。"尽管如此，盗窃是罪。而且我曾发过神圣的誓，我再也不会行窃了。"

options.en: Then I'll steal it. You can just show up and be yourself.
options.zh: 那我来偷。你只需要露面，当好你自己就行了。

texts.en: "But I, I-" he stutters to a halt. "I suppose, in the strictest sense this is... captain, I do not like it. Is there no alternative?"
texts.zh: "但我，我 ——" 他结结巴巴，有点说不下去了。"我觉得，从最严格的意义上说，这...舰长，我不喜欢这样。没有别的选择了吗？"

options.en: No one gets hurt. And it's a fake which they stole from your people in the first place.
options.zh: 没人会受伤。而且那是个赝品，是他们先从你们那里偷来的。

options.en: I could send a marine raid in to steal it so we don't have to.
options.zh: 我可以发动陆战队劫掠来把它弄到手，这样我们就没必要自己上了。

options.en: I could threaten to bombard the planet until Menes surrenders the relic.
options.zh: 我可以威胁要轰炸这颗星球，直到 Menes 交出遗物。

options.en: Fine. Let's think of something else.
options.zh: 好吧。我们想点别的办法。

texts.en: Bornanew nods, still looking displeased.
texts.zh: Bornanew 点点头，看起来仍然不太高兴。

texts.en:
Your tactical officer has already spearheaded an effort to discreetly collect what public information is available on Menes Yaribay's compound. Sensors has arranged passive scans to correlate with on-record plans of the structure. Comms found a PR puff-piece holo in which Menes gives a personal tour of part of his 'collection'.

All you really need to do is get yourself invited into the inner sanctum.
texts.zh:
你的战术军官已经带头谨慎地收集了关于 Menes Yaribay 庄园的公开信息。传感器技官进行了被动扫描，来与记录在案的建筑平面图进行核对。通讯军官则找到了一份公关宣传全息影像，其中 Menes 亲自带领参观了他的部分 '收藏品'。

你所需要做的，就是让自己被邀请进入那个内部密室。

options.en: Then it's decided. I'll have tools, it'll be fine.
options.zh: 那就这么定了。我会带上工具，没问题的。

options.en: Let's discuss other options before deciding.
options.zh: 在决定之前，我们先讨论一下其他方案。

texts.en:
Sometimes acquiring something is as simple as taking it.

Both you and Bornanew - who is unenthusiastic, but professional throughout - are outfitted with an inconspicuous set of tools: a sheet-diamond rated cutter, EM glitcher, lockbreakers.

Bornanew sets aside some of the bulkier accoutrement with a shake of his head.
texts.zh:
有时候，想获取某个东西，就和直接把它拿走一样简单。

你和 Bornanew —— 他虽然不情愿，但全程都很专业 —— 都配备了一套不显眼的工具：一张金刚石切割薄片、电磁干扰器、开锁器。

Bornanew 摇了摇头，把一些比较笨重的装备放在一边。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Your tech officer installs a schematic of Menes' complex and a suite of scramblers on your datapad, a remote interfacer is hidden inside a fashionable stylus.

You perform the operation of various gadgets with your armorer, and review the choreography of the heist with your tactical officer. It is not a perfect plan, but with a combination of initiative, redundancy, and exceptional access...

Bornanew is standing very still, his fist against his jaw.
texts.zh:
你的技术军官在你的数据平板上载入了 Menes 庄园的示意图和一套干扰器，远程接口隐藏在一支很潮的触控笔里。

你和你的军械员一起操作各种装置，并和你的战术军官一起复核了这次抢劫的流程。这并非天衣无缝的计划，但凭借主动出击、多重保障以及绝佳的渠道...

Bornanew 一动不动地站着，拳头抵着下巴。

options.en: Yes? What is it?
options.zh: 怎么了？出了什么事吗？

texts.en:
"It won't work," he says.

"With all due respect, your tactician is no thief. And neither are you. It must be me."
texts.zh:
"这行不通，" 他说。

"恕我直言，你的战术军官不是小偷。你也不是。得让我来。"

options.en: Aren't you opposed to theft? You swore an oath.
options.zh: 你不是反对偷窃吗？你发过誓的。

options.en: It's a pretty good plan. And I have the tools.
options.zh: 这是个相当不错的计划。而且我有工具。

options.en: I, too, have my faith. Is that nothing?
options.zh: 我也有我的信仰。那难道不算什么吗？

options.en: Tell me what your plan is.
options.zh: 告诉我你的计划是什么。

options.en: You're not going to let this go, are you.
options.zh: 你不会就这么算了的，是吧。

options.en: If you insist, then.
options.zh: 如果你坚持的话，那行吧。

texts.en: "I am. I did," he says. "But more necessary than my conscience is our success. I shall bear my burden."
texts.zh: "是。我发过誓，" 他说道，"但比我的良心更重要的是我们的成功。我将承下这份重担。"

texts.en:
"Why should Menes leave you alone with the relic, or at all?" He looks over at you.

"I am a Knight of Ludd, devoted and taciturn. I shall simply... display the power of my faith."
texts.zh:
"为什么 Menes 会让你单独和圣物待在一起，或者让你单独留下？" 他看着你。

"我是个卢德骑士，虔诚而沉默寡言。我只需要...展现我信仰的力量。"

texts.en:
"Pray forgive me, captain; I do no question your faith." He presses his hands together.

"But Menes Yaribay cannot see into your soul. He will see your uniform, and my robes. That will be enough."
texts.zh:
"请原谅我，舰长；我没有质疑你的信仰。" 他双手合十。

"但是 Menes Yaribay 看不透你的灵魂。他只会看到你的制服和我的教袍。那就足够了。"

texts.en:
"We attend Menes' party. Be interesting. Be yourself. Get Menes to show off the glove."

"I know this trade, captain. Have faith." He pauses for a moment, acknowledging some irony in his own words. "It works best if you act natural."
texts.zh:
"我们直接参加 Menes 的派对，表现得有趣些。做好你自己，让 Menes 炫耀那个手套。"

"我懂该怎么做这笔买卖，舰长，要有信心。" 他顿了一下，承认了自己话中的某种讽刺意味，"如果你能表现得自然些，效果就最好。"

texts.en: He crosses his arms. "I am not."
texts.zh: 他双手抱胸。"我不会。"

texts.en:
Later, in the briefing room, you find Bornanew standing over a detailed schematic of Menes' complex. It rotates slowly in the shared display volume, gradually shadowing and illuminating his face.

It takes a moment, but you see that his eyes are closed and his lips are moving.

A prayer, you suspect.
texts.zh:
之后，在简报室里，你发现 Bornanew 站在 Menes 庄园的详细结构图前。结构图在共享显示屏中缓缓旋转，交错的光影让他的脸庞明暗不定。

过了一会儿你才发现，他的双眼紧闭，嘴唇微动。

你猜，那是在祷告。

texts.en:
Bornanew nods, putting his hand back on his book as if drawing knowledge from it.
OR
"Of course, captain," Bornanew says.
OR
Bornanew looks down at his notebook and turns a page, then turns it back. "Of course, yes."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 点点头，把手放回他的书上，好像在从中汲取知识。
OR
"当然，舰长，" Bornanew说。
OR
Bornanew 低头看着他的笔记本，翻了一页，然后又翻了回来。"好，当然。"

texts.en: Bornanew gives you a distraught look.
texts.zh: Bornanew 露出了心烦意乱的表情。

texts.en:
Bornanew gives you a distraught look.

"I pray that is merely a joke in poor taste."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 露出了心烦意乱的表情。

"我祈祷这只是个品味低劣的玩笑。"

texts.en: Bornanew nods, still looking a bit as though he's eaten something foul.
texts.zh: Bornanew 点点头，看起来还是像吃了什么难吃的东西。

texts.en:
"Yes, I- That's not-"

He exhales sharply. "Not only is theft a sin. I did also swear a sacred oath that I would never steal again."
texts.zh:
"是的，我 —— 那不是 ——"

他猛地呼出一口气。"不仅盗窃是罪。我还曾发过神圣的誓，我再也不会行窃了。"

options.en: Then I'll steal it. You can just show up and be yourself.
options.zh: 那我来偷。你只需要露面，当好你自己就行了。

texts.en:
"Well. Menes likes you," he says. "He likes people who are rich and exciting, and important. He wants you to like him. He wants to be associated with people who are like what he imagines you are."

"Offering to buy his 'relic'... he would like that, I think."
texts.zh:
"好的。Menes 喜欢你，" 他说。"他喜欢有钱、经历刺激、身份重要的人。他也希望你喜欢他。他希望能和他想象中的你这样的人搞好关系。"

"你提出要买他的 '圣物'...他会喜欢的，我觉得。"

texts.en: "If you have the credits," Bornanew says, "Or if you can leverage existing assets and status, perhaps you can simply buy the glove from Menes."
texts.zh: "如果你星币够多，" Bornanew 说，"或者如果你能利用现有的资产和地位，也许你可以直接从 Menes 那里买下手套。"

options.en: It could be expensive, however.
options.zh: 不过这可能会很贵。

texts.en: "It could be," he says. "And before you ask, the Church will not approve additional funding. The Reverend Archcurate herself has spent her covert budget too freely on my case already."
texts.zh: "可能会，" 他说。"而且我得提前说明一下，教会是不会批准额外拨款的。宗师大人已经在我的事情上太过随便地花费了她的秘密预算。"

options.en: Are you... proposing that I cheat Menes Yaribay?
options.zh: 你是在...建议我哄骗 Menes Yaribay 吗？

options.en: If the Church isn't paying... you're asking me to pay.
options.zh: 如果教会不付钱...你是要我付钱。

options.en: I am not exactly overflowing with credits at the moment.
options.zh: 我现在手头并不是特别宽裕。

options.en: I may be rich, but you intend to destroy the glove, right?
options.zh: 我也许有钱，但你是打算毁掉那个手套的，对吧？

options.en: It sounds like we should just steal the glove.
options.zh: 听起来我们应该直接偷走那个手套。

options.en: I may not have credits, but I do operate an independent colony...
options.zh: 我也许没那么多星币，但我确实运营着一个独立的殖民地...

options.en: I may not have credits, but I am a member of the Persean League...
options.zh: 我也许没那么多星币，但我是 英仙座联盟 的成员...

options.en: I do happen to know someone extremely rich. Rayan Arroyo.
options.zh: 我碰巧认识一个极其有钱的人。Rayan Arroyo。

options.en: Let's do it. I'll pretend that I want to buy a 'genuine' relic.
options.zh: 就这么办。我会假装我想买一件 '真正的' 圣物。

options.en: Let's discuss other options first.
options.zh: 我们先讨论一下其他方案吧。

texts.en:
"I'm, uh..." Bornanew turns red.

"I... in the due course of investigation... if - no, not if - when we prove that the glove is a fake we demonstrate that the deal was made on invalid terms. But we need the glove first for physical evidence. It's... yes, it does involve a conscious deception... please don't look at me like that, captain," he says, almost indignant.

"It doesn't involve any killing, at least. I do pray it won't come to that."
texts.zh:
"我，呃..." Bornanew 脸一红。

"我...在调查的过程中...如果 —— 不，不是如果 —— 等我们证明手套是假的，也就同时证明了这笔交易的基本条款无效。但我们首先需要手套作为物证。这...对，这确实是一种刻意的欺骗...请别用那种眼神看我，舰长，" 他说着，语气似乎带着愤慨。

"至少这不涉及杀戮。我曾真诚祈祷过事情不发展到那一步。"

options.en: I'm just surprised. It's a good idea, $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 我只是很惊讶。这是个好主意，$global.jethroName。

options.en: I too.
options.zh: 我也是。

options.en: I too. (lie)
options.zh: 我也是。 (说谎)

texts.en: He sighs. "I beg you spare me praise in this particular instance."
texts.zh: 他叹了口气。"我求你别在这种特殊情况下夸我。"

texts.en: He presses his hands together and nods.
texts.zh: 他双手合十，点了点头。

texts.en: He presses his hands together, though gives you a brief, suspicious look.
texts.zh: 他双手合十，但向你投来了短暂的怀疑眼神。

texts.en:
You can see the inner conflict on Bornanew's face.

He knows he is asking far, far too much. But he wants to. If he had the credits, he would give them to the cause of the Church without a second thought. But he is a Knight of Ludd, sworn to poverty but for the allowance granted to him by his order - or by the indulgence of the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis.

He sees that you see all of this. And, knowing that words can only do harm, he makes the barest movement toward a shrug. A way of saying, you know who I am; what I am; what I need ask. Your choice is yours.
texts.zh:
你可以从 Bornanew 的脸上看出他内心的挣扎。

他知道他要求得实在太多了，但他需要这些。如果他有星币，他会毫不犹豫地把它们贡献给教会的事业。但他是一名卢德骑士，发誓安贫乐道，除了因被指派任务而领到的资金，以及因大祭司 Jaspis 的宽容而得到的津贴外，他一无所有。

他清楚你对这些事情十分了解。而且，他知道言语只会造成伤害，于是只轻微地耸了耸肩。意思是，你知道我是谁；我是什么；我需要什么。选择权在你的手上。

texts.en:
"That is a problem," Bornanew admits.

"I don't believe Menes will take an offer seriously unless you demonstrate that you possess immense wealth. A half million credits, at least. To be safe." He taps his book, "Though if you could talk him into accepting payment in the form of installments, you'd only have to pay a fraction of the full price to take possession of the glove..."
texts.zh:
"这是个问题，" Bornanew 承认道。

"除非你能证明你拥有巨额财产，否则我不觉得 Menes 会认真对待报价。保险起见，至少得有五十万星币。" 他敲了敲他的书，"不过如果你能说服他接受分期付款，你可能只需要支付全价的一小部分就能拿到手套..."

texts.en:
"Yes," Bornanew admits.

"I don't believe Menes will take an offer seriously unless you can demonstrate that you possess immense wealth. A half million credits, at least. To be safe." He taps his book, "Though if you could talk him into accepting payment in the form of installments, you might only have to pay a fraction of the full price to take possession..."
texts.zh:
"是的，" Bornanew 承认道。

"除非你能证明你拥有巨额财产，否则我不觉得 Menes 会认真对待报价。保险起见，至少得有五十万星币。" 他敲了敲他的书，"不过，如果你能说服他接受分期付款，你可能只需要支付全价的一小部分就能拿到..."

texts.en: "That's true," Bornanew says. "You might be able to talk Menes into accepting payment in the form of smaller installments. Then if we can resolve the entire matter of the glove quickly, perhaps you would only have to pay the initial deposit..."
texts.zh: "那确实，" Bornanew 说。"你或许能说服 Menes 接受分期付款。那么如果我们能迅速完全解决手套的问题，也许你就只需要支付首期定金..."

texts.en:
"An excellent point," Bornanew says, looking hopeful.

"This gives you exceptional credibility with Menes -- after all, you're a fellow demarch! I would wonder if you couldn't defer payment entirely, or convince him to accept a small percentage as a deposit to be paid later. And then if we resolve the matter of the glove quickly..."
texts.zh:
"这是个很好的切入点，" Bornanew 说，看起来颇有信心。

"这让你在 Menes 面前有了极大的信誉 —— 毕竟，你是一位民选统领！我甚至在想你是不是可以完全推迟付款，或者说服他先接受一小部分作为稍后支付的定金。然后如果我们能迅速解决手套的问题..."

texts.en: Bornanew looks up. "Do you think he would assist us in this matter?"
texts.zh: Bornanew 抬起头。"你觉得他会在这件事上帮我们吗？"

options.en: Not likely.
options.zh: 不太可能。

options.en: Absolutely not.
options.zh: 绝对不会。

options.en: No.
options.zh: 不。

options.en: He'd hate everything about this scheme.
options.zh: 他会讨厌关于这个计划的一切。

texts.en: "I see," he says. "Perhaps we should consider a different option."
texts.zh: "我明白了，" 他说道，"也许我们应该考虑其它方案。"

texts.en: "I see," he says. "Perhaps we should consider a different option."
texts.zh: "我明白了，" 他说道，"也许我们应该考虑其它方案。"

texts.en: "I see," he says. "Perhaps we should consider a different option."
texts.zh: "我明白了，" 他说道，"也许我们应该考虑其它方案。"

texts.en: "I see," he says. "Perhaps we should consider a different option."
texts.zh: "我明白了，" 他说道，"也许我们应该考虑其它方案。"

texts.en: Bornanew bows his head in thanks, his relief palpable, his hands clasped together.
texts.zh: Bornanew 感激地低下头，双手紧握在一起，他松了一口气的样子显而易见。

texts.en:
"To what end? We want Menes to reveal from whom he acquired the duplicate." He taps his notebook, thinking. Then looks back at you.

"What if you were a buyer."
texts.zh:
"这是为了什么？我们要的是让 Menes 透露他从谁的手里弄到了那个复制品。" 他敲了敲笔记本，思考着。然后又抬头看向你。

"如果你是个买家呢。"

options.en: What if I was?
options.zh: 如果我是买家？

texts.en: "Menes likes you," he says. "He likes people who are rich and exciting. He wants you to like him. I suspect he could be persuaded to reveal his source. Or, if not, we could discover it if we had possession of the false relic..."
texts.zh: "Menes 喜欢你，" 他说。"他喜欢有钱而且经历刺激的人。他也希望你喜欢他。我猜你可以说服他透露他的渠道。或者，如果这行不通，但假如我们得到了那件假圣物，我们就能自己搞明白..."

options.en: Buy the relic from Menes? That could be expensive.
options.zh: 从 Menes 那里买下圣物？那可能会很贵。

texts.en:
Bornanew looks at you for a long moment.

"Do you think Horus Yaribay will help?"
texts.zh:
Bornanew 看了你好一会儿。

"你认为 Horus Yaribay 会帮忙吗？"

texts.en:
"If you can persuade Horus to intervene in the situation before it gets out of hand-" Bornanew sighs loudly, catching himself. "Forgive my choice of word; jocularity is not my intent."

He begins again, "If Horus sees it in his interest to force Menes to surrender the glove - and its source - then all might be resolved peaceably."
texts.zh:
"如果你能说服 Horus 在事情脱手之前介入 ——" Bornanew 大声叹了口气，回过神来，"请原谅我的措辞；我无意开玩笑。"

他接着说道，"如果 Horus 认为强迫 Menes 交出手套 —— 并解释其来源 —— 符合他的利益，那么一切都可能和平解决。"

options.en: He wants to appease the Hegemony. And Luddics are a significant demographic...
options.zh: 他想与 霸主 和解。而卢德信众是非常重要的群体...

options.en: Then it's decided. I'll speak with Horus first.
options.zh: 那就这么定了。我会先和 Horus 谈谈。

options.en: Let's discuss other options.
options.zh: 我们讨论一下其他方案吧。

texts.en:
He nods as you lay out your reasoning. The Hegemony wants a stable Luddic population. Horus wants a stable Hegemony in order to negotiate a peaceful settlement.

"If Horus intervenes to defuse the situation before a greater conflict is fomented... Horus the peace-maker..." Bornanew drums his fingers on his notebook.

"Which is exactly what he wants to be, if what you say is true. This could be over quickly. And quietly." He closes his eyes and holds his hands together as if saying a quiet prayer.
texts.zh:
在你陈述理由时，他点了点头。霸主 需要安定的卢德信徒。而 Horus 需要安定的 霸主，以便协商和平解决方案。

"如果 Horus 在冲突被煽动得更剧烈之前介入，化解了局势...和平缔造者 Horus..." Bornanew 用手指敲打着他的笔记本。

"如果你说的是真话，这正是他想要的。这件事可能很快就可以了结。而且悄无声息。" 他闭上眼睛，双手合十，像是在默默祈祷。

options.en: Then it's decided. I'll speak with Horus first.
options.zh: 那就这么定了。我会先和 Horus 谈谈。

options.en: Let's discuss other options.
options.zh: 我们讨论一下其他方案吧。

texts.en: "To Kazeron." He smiles easily as he pockets his notebook, then says "I've never been."
texts.zh: "去 Kazeron。" 他轻松地笑了，把笔记本放进口袋，然后说，"我从没去过那儿。"

texts.en:
"Captain, I must remind you that an interfactional incident must be avoided." He says this more evenly than you might have expected.

Bornanew looks down at this notebook, then up, "And I myself pray," he says in a low and quiet voice, "that I might avoid the shedding of innocent blood in this, this which is meant to be part of my act of penance."
texts.zh:
"舰长，我必须提醒你，必须避免势力间的冲突。" 他的语气比你预想的要平静。

Bornanew 低头看着他的笔记本，然后抬起头，"而我本人祈祷着，" 他的声音低沉而安定，"在这件事上，我能避免滥杀无辜，这本应是我赎罪的一部分。"

options.en: Does not a Knight use violence to stop from greater violence?
options.zh: 难道骑士不是用暴力来阻止更大的暴力的吗？

texts.en:
"Ah," Bornanew meets your eyes knowingly. "I see where the arc of your rhetoric leads, and I cannot deny its endpoint. A Knight of Ludd does employ violence."

"'To protect the faith, to protect the faithful...'" He is quoting something - his oath?
texts.zh:
"啊，" Bornanew 会意地看着你的眼睛。"我明白你言辞的走向，我也无法否认其终点。卢德骑士确实会使用暴力。"

"'为了保护信仰，为了保护信徒...'" 他引用起了一些东西 —— 这是他的誓言？

options.en: Exactly. Like Ludd, righteous with hammer and sword in hand!
options.zh: 正是。就像卢德一样，手持锤与剑，伸张正义！

texts.en: "Yes, well. The sword is a symbol, an image, captain. Imagine waving a sword around in this age." He shakes his head.
texts.zh: "是的，嗯。剑是一种象征，一个意象，舰长。想象一下，在这个时代挥舞一把剑的样子。" 他摇了摇头。

texts.en: You think to yourself that this isn't the time to bring up your experience at the Rao compound on Eventide.
texts.zh: 你心想，现在不是提起你在 Eventide 上 Rao 家庄园里的经历的时候。

texts.en: You think to yourself that this isn't the time to bring up your experience at the Rao compound on Eventide.
texts.zh: 你心想，现在不是提起你在 Eventide 上 Rao 家庄园里的经历的时候。

texts.en:
"Nonetheless, if you insist, then I shall be forced to concede," Bornanew says.

"If we... if you can execute a raid; if you can do it without implicating the Church; if seizing this fake relic quickly and quietly will lead us to its maker and thereafter to a swift conclusion of the whole matter... then maybe the Church can avoid schism and disaster."

"If, and only if, it is necessary," he concludes.
texts.zh:
"尽管如此，如果你坚持，那么我也不得不让步，" Bornanew 说。

"如果我们...如果你能发动一次劫掠；如果你能在不牵连教会的情况下做到；如果迅速而神不知鬼不觉地夺取这个假圣物能引导我们找到它的制造者，从而迅速结束整件事...那么也许教会就能避免分裂和灾难。"

"如果，而且仅如果，这是必要的，" 他总结道。

options.en: It is necessary. I shall make the arrangements.
options.zh: 这是必要的。我会安排好。

options.en: Let's discuss other options before deciding.
options.zh: 在决定之前，我们先讨论一下其他方案。

texts.en:
Bornanew bows his head to your words. His expression is grim.

Menes has not been discreet. As a celebration of his first cycle as the new demarchon of Olinadu, he invited a holodoc team for a puff-piece interview and viewing of his 'collection'. Your tactical team reviews the holos, constructing schematic of the interior of Menes' complex, inferring layout and defenses from this and other publicly available information.
texts.zh:
听到你的话，Bornanew 低下了头，表情严峻。

Menes 并没有谨慎行事。为了庆祝他担任 Olinadu 新统领满一个星历年，他邀请一个全息纪录片团队进行了宣传性的采访，并展示了他的 '藏品'。你的战术团队检视了这些全息影像，构建了 Menes 庄园内部的示意图，并根据这些和其他公开信息推断出布局和防御。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
It is estimated that roughly 100 marines will be required to pull off the operation.

Your marines will be equipped with an eclectic mix of equipment to allow them to pose as high-level pirates. They will be secretly infiltrated into Olinadu as, variously, spacer crew on shore-leave, contract technicians, and ne'er-do-wells looking to spend ill-gotten gains somewhere away from heavy law enforcement.

It goes without saying that you shall need to approach Olinadu with your $shipOrFleet's transponder off. Menes' overly charitable outlook on your character and generalized inattention to his official duties should allow you to join his 'party' with little oversight about how you actually got there.
texts.zh:
据估计，大约需要{100 名陆战队员}才能完成这次任务。

你的陆战队员将配备乱七八糟的装备来冒充高级海盗。他们将以各种身份秘密渗透到 Olinadu 上，比如上岸休假的太空船员、合同制技术员，以及想在远离严密执法的地方挥霍不义之财的无赖。

不用说，你需要在$shipOrFleet{应答器关闭}的情况下接近 Olinadu。Menes 对你身份的过分慷慨和他对公务的普遍疏忽，应该能让你几乎不受监督地加入他的 '派对'，并且不会让人在意你是怎么去到那里的。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
To avert suspicion and ensure optimal timing, you and Bornanew will personally attend Menes' party when the raid is executed.

The raid will commence when two of a series of randomly generated time-slots are passed without receiving a stand-down signal. This signal will be, by all appearances, a routine status query to your $shipOrFleet, and appear to be perfectly routine behaviour for a justifiably neurotic independent $shipOrFleet operator.

Bornanew is watchful throughout the planning process, only occasionally advocating for lower-force protocols when a particularly bloodthirsty marine squad leader expresses more enthusiasm than strictly required for certain tactical details.
texts.zh:
为了避免怀疑并掌握最佳时机，你和 Bornanew 将在劫掠进行时亲自参加 Menes 的派对。

在一系列随机生成的时段中，如果中止信号连续两个时段未被发出，那么劫掠行动就将会启动。无论从何种角度看，这个中止信号都只是你对自己$shipOrFleet的例行状态查询，对于一个有理由时刻保持警惕的独立$shipOrFleet指挥官来说，这种行为再正常不过了。

Bornanew 在整个制定计划的过程中都保持慎言，只是偶尔在某个特别嗜血的陆战队长对一些战术细节展现出超出必要限度的热情时，他才主张采用较低强度的方案。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew frowns.

"If this raid can be executed without implicating the Church, and if seizing this false relic quickly and quietly will lead us to its maker and a swift conclusion to the whole matter... then it may be a worthwhile path."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 皱了皱眉。

"如果这次劫掠可以在不牵连教会的情况下执行，并且如果迅速而神不知鬼不觉地夺取这个假圣物能引导我们找到它的制造者，从而迅速结束整件事...那么这条路也许值得一试。"

options.en: It is necessary. I shall make the arrangements.
options.zh: 这是必要的。我会安排好。

options.en: Let's discuss other options before deciding.
options.zh: 在决定之前，我们先讨论一下其他方案。

texts.en: "Yes," he sighs. "I shall hold that thought as dearest comfort."
texts.zh: "好吧，" 他叹了口气，"我会把这个想法当作最亲切的安慰。"

texts.en:
"I'm given to understand you're something of an adventurer," he continues. "A rogue element, if you will. You play by your own rules. I like to think I'm of like mind," he says with a wink.

"Perhaps you've stumbled on historical objects of interest in your... adventures?"
texts.zh:
"我听说你是个冒险家，" 他继续说。"一个特立独行的人，如果你接受这个评价的话。你按自己的规矩行事。我觉得我也是同道中人，" 他眨了眨眼。

"或许你在你的...冒险中偶遇过什么有历史价值的物品？"

options.en: What I've experienced in the depths of the starry sea would drive lesser minds to madness.
options.zh: 我在星海深处的经历足以让心智脆弱者陷入疯狂。

options.en: I took my ship to reach the stars.... but I've gone much, much farther than that.
options.zh: 我驾船驶向群星...但我所抵达的远方远不止于此。

options.en: I've seen things you wouldn't believe. Attack ships on fire off the Orion-Perseus abyss...
options.zh: 我见过你们难以相信的景象。攻击舰在 猎户-英仙座深渊 外燃烧...

texts.en:
It takes longer than before to open the link.

Menes' image flickers into pseudoreality and is still but for the occasional wave of algorithmic correction.

"Captain, oh captain," he says finally, his voice more brittle than before. There are dark circles under his eyes. "Things have not been well."
texts.zh:
建立链接的时间比以前长。

Menes 的影像闪烁着，凝成了一幅伪现实的画面。影像基本静止，只是偶尔会因算法修正而泛起一阵波动。

"舰长，哦舰长，" 他终于开口了，声音比之前要脆弱。还顶着一对黑眼圈。"情况不太好。"

options.en: I was nearly killed at your 'party', Menes. We were both there.
options.zh: 我差点死在你的 '派对' 上，Menes。我们当时可都在那。

options.en: I'm truly sorry to hear that. I wanted to check in...
options.zh: 真的很抱歉听到这样的消息。我只是想来看看情况...

options.en: Is this about losing the... relic?
options.zh: 是因为丢了...圣物的事吗？

options.en: Perhaps I should comms another time...
options.zh: 也许我该换个时间再和你联系...

options.en: You wouldn't happen to know where I could find Ulmus Pond, would you?
options.zh: 你不会刚好知道我得去哪里才能找到 Ulmus Pond，对吧？

texts.en:
A joyless smirk flits over his face.

"But you were not. The raiders were careful, very careful. Careful." He stares at you for a long moment, breathing heavily. Into his drink, perhaps?
texts.zh:
他脸上掠过一丝毫无喜悦的假笑。

"但你没死。那些袭击者很小心、非常小心。小心。" 他盯着你看了好一会，呼吸沉重。也许是把气呼到了酒里？

texts.en: "My security chief suspects an inside job. Betrayal, captain, is what that means."
texts.zh: "我的安全主管怀疑是内鬼干的。这意味着背叛，舰长。"

options.en: (gasp and look shocked)
options.zh: (倒抽一口气，故作震惊)

options.en: Your chief could be covering for their own massive security failure.
options.zh: 你的主管可能只是在掩盖他们的重大安保失误。

options.en: Now that you mention it, that Ulmus Pond seemed a little off...
options.zh: 你这么一说，那个 Ulmus Pond 确实有点不对劲...

texts.en: He watches you, looking more sad than anything. Then shakes his head.
texts.zh: 他看着你，那表情比起别的，更像是悲伤。随后他摇了摇头。

texts.en: A long pause. "Have you heard from Ulmus?" he asks. "Ulmus Pond. You recall him, surely."
texts.zh: 通讯频道陷入了长久的沉默。"你有 Ulmus 的消息吗？" 他问道。"Ulmus Pond。你肯定记得他。"

options.en: I haven't seen him since your party.
options.zh: 离开你的派对之后我就没见过他。

options.en: I haven't seen him since your party. (lie)
options.zh: 离开你的派对之后我就没见过他。 (说谎)

options.en: He's dead. On Chalcedon. A Pather called Sedge shot him.
options.zh: 他死了。死在 Chalcedon 上。一个叫 Sedge 的左径分子枪杀了他。

options.en: I caught him. He promised to confess everything to you.
options.zh: 我抓到他了。他保证会向你坦白一切。

options.en: I caught him on Chalcedon. He sold you a fake relic. The Knights hold him now.
options.zh: 我在 Chalcedon 抓到他了。他卖给你的圣物是假的。骑士团现在关押着他。

options.en: I caught him on Chalcedon. He sold you a fake relic. The Path has him now.
options.zh: 我在 Chalcedon 抓到他了。他卖给你的圣物是假的。现在他落到了左径手里。

texts.en:
Menes is uncharacteristically quiet for a long moment.

"I see," he says, looking away. "Tell me if you find him. I have... questions."

His face is blank, his eyes watery. The silence stretches long.
texts.zh:
Menes 反常地沉默了很长一段时间。

"我明白了，" 他移开了目光。"如果你能找到他，请和我说一声。我有...问题要问。"

他面无表情，眼眶湿润。沉默不断弥漫着。

options.en: Of course. I'll, um, let you go now. (Cut the link)
options.zh: 当然。我，呃，先不打扰你了。 (切断通讯)

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en: You cut the comm link.
texts.zh: 你切断了通讯链接。

texts.en:
Menes is uncharacteristically quiet for a long moment.

"I see," he says, looking away. "Tell me if you find him. I have... questions."

His face is blank, his eyes watery. The silence stretches long.
texts.zh:
Menes 反常地沉默了很长一段时间。

"我明白了，" 他移开了目光。"如果你能找到他，请和我说一声。我有...问题要问。"

他面无表情，眼眶湿润。沉默不断弥漫着。

options.en: I'll do that. And I'll, um, let you go now. (Cut the link)
options.zh: 我会的。那我，呃，先不打扰你了。 (切断通讯)

texts.en:
You explain the crimes of Ulmus Pond, and his fate.

Menes is uncharacteristically quiet when you finish.

"I see," he says, looking away. His face is blank, his eyes watery.

The silence stretches long.
texts.zh:
你解释了 Ulmus Pond 的罪行，以及他的下场。

你说完后，Menes 反常地保持着安静。

"我明白了，" 他移开视线。面无表情，眼眶湿润。

沉默不断弥漫着。

options.en: I'll... let you go now. (Cut the comm link)
options.zh: 我...先不打扰你了。 (切断通讯链接)

texts.en:
Menes says nothing for a long moment. It is unsettlingly uncharacteristic of him.

Finally, he sighs, and looks away. "And he did. I suppose you've confirmed his story."
texts.zh:
Menes 沉默了许久，这对他来说太反常了，令人不安。

最后，他叹了口气，移开了目光。"这样啊。那我猜你已经证实了他的说辞。"

texts.en: "Ha, yes. So it could be." He doesn't sound convinced, but carries on. "Betrayal in another form, perhaps?"
texts.zh: "哈，是的。也许是这样。" 他听起来并不信服，但还是继续说着。"也许算是，另一种形式的背叛？"

texts.en: His eyes go wide, and his arm grabs at the side of his desk, pulling him to a more formal sitting position.
texts.zh: 他睁大眼睛，伸手抓住桌子边缘把自己拉起来，摆出了一副更正式的坐姿。

texts.en: "What do you know of Ulmus Pond?" he asks fiercely.
texts.zh: "你知道什么和 Ulmus Pond 有关的事？" 他厉声问道。

texts.en:
A troubled look crosses his face.

"Your concern is..." he looks away, and the moment draws longer. He's breathing heavily. Into his drink, perhaps?
texts.zh:
他脸上掠过一丝忧虑的神情。

"你的关心很..." 他移开视线，沉默使这瞬间显得格外漫长。他呼吸沉重。也许是，把气呼到了酒里？

texts.en:
"So you heard," his eyebrows raise. A spark of suspicion.

"The glove is not the point, my dear captain." He frowns. "My sanctuary was violated. My things stolen. My... friends assaulted." He stares at you for a long moment, breathing heavily. Into his drink, perhaps?
texts.zh:
"看来你听说了，" 他扬起眉毛。眼中闪过一丝怀疑。

"手套不是重点，我亲爱的舰长。" 他皱起眉头。"我的密室被弄坏了。我的东西被偷了。我的...朋友们遭到了袭击。" 他盯着你看了好一会，呼吸沉重。也许是，把气呼到了酒里？

texts.en:
"So you heard," his eyebrows raise. A spark of suspicion.

"The glove is not the point, my dear captain." He frowns. "My sanctuary was violated. My things stolen." He stares at you for a long moment, breathing heavily. Into his drink, perhaps?
texts.zh:
"看来你听说了，" 他扬起眉毛。眼中闪过一丝怀疑。

"手套不是重点，我亲爱的舰长。" 他皱起眉头。"我的密室被弄坏了。我的东西被偷了。" 他盯着你看了好一会，呼吸沉重。也许是，把气呼到了酒里？

texts.en:
"No!" he says too-loudly, and upon realizing it, corrects himself, "No. Now is good. We must speak, you and I."

Menes is breathing heavily. Into his drink, perhaps.
texts.zh:
"不！" 他说得太大声了，意识到之后，又镇静了一些，"不。现在就很好。我们必须谈谈，就你和我。"

Menes 呼吸沉重。也许是，把气呼到了酒里？

texts.en: "What do you know of Ulmus Pond?" he asks fiercely.
texts.zh: "你知道什么和 Ulmus Pond 有关的事？" 他厉声问道。

texts.en:
The comms connect to a holding pattern, the crest of Gens Yaribay. And wait.

It soon becomes clear that Menes Yaribay is ignoring your request.
texts.zh:
通讯接入了一个等候界面，屏幕上有个 Yaribay 氏族的徽标。随后开始等待。

很快你就意识到 Menes Yaribay 无视了你的请求。

options.en: Cut the comm link
options.zh: 切断通讯链接

options.en: I'd like to discuss a matter involving Menes Yaribay.
options.zh: 我想讨论一件与 Menes Yaribay 有关的事。

texts.en:
"Cousin Menes," he says, and sighs.

"What is it he's done this time?"
texts.zh:
"Menes 堂弟，" 他说着，叹了口气。

"他又干什么了？"

options.en: He might spark a religious conflict that could tear the Sector apart.
options.zh: 他可能会引发一场宗教冲突，足以将整个星域撕裂。

options.en: He bought a sacred Luddic relic for his personal collection.
options.zh: 他买了一件神圣的卢德遗物作为自己的收藏品。

options.en: How do you get on with Menes? Not well?
options.zh: 你和 Menes 的关系怎么样？不太好？

texts.en:
Horus blinks, and turns his head aside as if he didn't hear you correctly. His eyes snap back to yours through the comm-link.

"Elaborate upon your statement, if you would be so kind."

A harsh note enters his tone, despite ostensibly polite words.
texts.zh:
Horus 眨了眨眼，把头转向一边，仿佛没有听清你的话。然后他透过通讯链接猛地对上了你的目光。

"请详细解释一下你刚刚说的事，如果你愿意的话。"

尽管表面上的措辞很客气，但他的语调里已经带上了一丝严厉。

texts.en:
Horus takes this in, looking into the middle distance, processing for a moment. He takes a slow breath.

"You are certain? Do the Luddics know about it?"
texts.zh:
Horus 听完之后看向远方，花了些时间来消化这个消息。接着他缓缓地吸了一口气。

"你确定？卢德教徒们知道这件事吗？"

options.en: Oh, they know. They hired me to... handle it.
options.zh: 哦，他们知道。他们雇我来...处理这件事。

texts.en:
He closes his eyes and rubs his temples. After a moment, a mutter emerges, "Good grief."

He takes several more long breaths.
texts.zh:
他闭上眼睛，揉了揉太阳穴。片刻之后，他咕哝了一句，"我的天啊。"

然后他又深呼吸了好几次。

options.en: Menes invited me to some kind of party to view this relic.
options.zh: Menes 邀请我参加派对，去鉴赏这件圣物。

texts.en:
"He did," Horus stares at you.

"It appears as though I am going to have to become involved," he says. "Personally."

"Again." His jaw is clenched. It looks uncomfortable.
texts.zh:
"他邀请了你，" Horus 盯着你。

"看来我不得不介入了，" 他说，"亲自介入。"

"又一次。" 他咬紧牙关。看起来非常不舒服。

options.en: Say nothing.
options.zh: 保持沉默。

options.en: Again?
options.zh: 又一次？

options.en: You need to keep better track of your cousin's schemes, huh.
options.zh: 看来你得更留心你堂弟的那些计划了，是吧。

texts.en:
"I shall make my own way to Olinadu, thank you. Have your people coordinate with my people."

"We'll sort out Menes' indiscretion and set things right with the Church," he says brusquely, then turns away.

"After all I've done for that ungrateful-"

The comms cut.
texts.zh:
"我会自己去 Olinadu 的，谢谢。让你的人和我这边的人协调一下。"

"我们会处理好 Menes 的轻率行为，把教会的事情办好，" 他唐突地说，然后转过身去。

"毕竟我已经做得够多了，为了那个不知感激 ——"

通讯中断了。

options.en: Cut the comms
options.zh: 切断通讯

texts.en: Now you have a party to attend - with an uninvited guest of honor.
texts.zh: 现在你该去参加派对了 —— 和一位不请自来的贵客一起。

texts.en:
"The past matters of my gens do not oblige discussion with outsiders, $playerSirOrMadam," he says stiffly.

"However. I do appreciate your... consideration in bringing the current matter to my attention."
texts.zh:
"我们氏族的陈年旧事，我没义务和外人讨论这些，$playerSirOrMadam，" 他语气僵硬。

"不过，对你...考虑把这件事告诉我这一点，我很感谢。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Thank-you captain, that is fabulous advice," Horus says in a tone demonstrating very little appreciation for your input.
texts.zh: "多谢，舰长，这提议真是太棒了，" 对你的建议，Horus 的语气中毫无感激。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "He is family." Horus gives you a flinty look. "State your meaning."
texts.zh: "他是我的家人。" Horus 目光冷峻地看着你。"把话说明白些。"

options.en: Accept Menes Yaribay's invitation and shuttle to his complex
options.zh: 接受 Menes Yaribay 的邀请，搭乘穿梭机前往他的庄园

texts.en:
Menes' invitation provides you with a flight path and Demarch-level traffic control override codes.

It's probably a violation of Persean League ethical guidelines for you to be using these to attend a personal party, but from what you can overhear of the pilot's comms, the locals have a casual attitude toward the arrangement.
texts.zh:
Menes 的邀请函为你提供了一条飞行路线，和统领级别的交通管制覆盖代码。

用这些代码去参加一个私人派对，很可能违反了 英仙座联盟 的道德准则，但从你无意间听到的驾驶员通讯来看，当地人对这种安排的态度很随意。

texts.en:
You and Bornanew make an 'undocumented' arrival on Olinadu then transfer to a private shuttle service in order to attend Menes' party.

Your hired pilot gives a shrug as she shows you a flight path blocked out with red DENIED tags - until you apply the key attached to your invitation, which turns out to be a Demarch-level override code.

It's probably a violation of Persean League ethical guidelines for you to be using these to attend a personal party, but the pilot simply smiles and proceeds. This sort of thing isn't unusual under Menes' administration, it appears.
texts.zh:
你和 Bornanew 在 Olinadu 进行了一次 "未记录" 的着陆，然后换乘私人穿梭机去参加 Menes 的派对。

你雇用的驾驶员耸了耸肩，向你展示了一条标有红色 "拒绝" 标签的飞行路线 —— 直到你使用邀请函附带的密钥，那竟然是一个统领级别的覆盖代码。

用这些代码去参加一个私人派对，很可能违反了 英仙座联盟 的道德准则，但驾驶员只是笑了笑，然后启航。看来在 Menes 的管辖下，这种事并不罕见。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Menes Yaribay's compound is a scrubbed-looking slab of trendy architecture set on a bluff overlooking Olinadu's primary habitation cluster.

A smattering of outbuildings and hangars, attached by fat trunks of conduit and glowing walktubes, sprawl across the less-fashionable view-angles of the compound toward the refineries and holding tanks of the planet's industrial center.
texts.zh:
Menes Yaribay 的庄园是一片经过精心打理的时尚建筑群，坐落在一处悬崖上，俯瞰着 Olinadu 的主要居住区。

一些附属建筑和机库零零散散地分布在庄园不太显眼的角落里，粗大的管道和发光步道连接着它们，并且一直延伸向行星工业中心的冶炼厂和储油罐。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
One set of hangar bay doors dutifully open, and your shuttle descends through the glowing atmo-field. Such gadgetry is an ostentatious addition to a personal residence, but it avoids the bother of visitors (and their shuttles) having to undergo pressure-cycling.

An enthusiastic Menes is already approaching your shuttle's access ramp as it sets itself down and signals the all-clear.

Bornanew exchanges a look with you, then rises to disembark.
texts.zh:
一扇机库门应声打开，你的穿梭机穿过闪耀的气场缓缓降落。这种装置对于私人住宅来说显得过于奢华，但它省去了访客 (和他们的穿梭机) 必须经历气压调节的麻烦。

当你的穿梭机降落并发出一切正常的信号时，热情的 Menes 已经走近了穿梭机的舷梯。

Bornanew 和你交换了眼神，然后起身下机。

options.en: Meet Menes Yaribay
options.zh: 与 Menes Yaribay 会面

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName," Menes crosses his chest with one arm, hand on heart, the other held behind, giving a small bow. "Allow me to welcome you to my home."

"And you've brought your fascinating friend!" he exclaims, as if it was a surprise. "This must be...?"
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长，" Menes 一只手臂横在胸前，手按在心口，另一只手背在身后，微微鞠躬。"欢迎你来到我家。"

"你还带来了这位有趣的朋友！" 他惊呼道，仿佛这是一个惊喜。"这位想必是...？"

options.en: This is $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 这位是 $global.jethroName。

options.en: Jethro Bornanew, a novice of the Knights of Ludd.
options.zh: Jethro Bornanew，卢德骑士团的一名新晋骑士。

texts.en: "Jethro Bornanew," he adds quickly. "Novice Bornanew of the Knights of Ludd, at your service. May this day be blessed by Providence."
texts.zh: "Jethro Bornanew，" 他迅速补充道。"卢德骑士团的新晋骑士 Bornanew，为你效劳。愿神意祝福今日。"

texts.en:
Bornanew nods, not quite a bow, with his hands held together. Perhaps to avoid Menes' much-ringed hands from grabbing his. You are not so lucky, and must endure an overlong handshake.

Menes is delighted at all of this, eyes flashing with something akin to greed.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 点了点头，双手合十，但还不到鞠躬的程度。也许是为了避免被 Menes 戴满戒指的手抓住。你可就没那么幸运了，不得不忍受一次过长的握手。

Menes 对这一切感到非常高兴，眼中闪烁着近乎贪婪的光芒。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Menes leads you past gilded statues posed to guard the portal to the main complex; the forms are evocative of splashes of molten gold frozen by happenstance into sensual humanoid figures.

You endure a rolling barrage of patter from Menes about the expense of renovations, the acquisition of artworks, the exclusivity of access to particular artists and engineering firms who have contributed to his home, his manor, and its collection.

Occasionally a robotic or human servitor appears to offer drinks or nibbles, and you've a growing feeling that Menes has picked up a glass from one only to place it back on the tray of another without ever taking a sip between the two.

A fresh glass in hand, delicate amber liquid fizzing away, Menes leads you into what can only be his prize entertaining space.
texts.zh:
Menes 领着你走过了几尊守在主建筑入口前的鎏金雕像。雕像的造型宛如飞溅的熔金在机缘巧合之间凝成了千姿百态的性感人形。

Menes 一直喋喋不休，犹如徐进弹幕轰了你一身。从装潢的高昂开销和画作的搜罗过程，到那些为他的府邸与藏品操刀的顶级艺术家与工程公司究竟有多难请到。

偶尔会有机器人或人类侍者出现，呈上饮品或小吃。但你越发觉得 Menes 纯粹只是从托盘上拿起一杯酒，而后又放到另一个托盘上，自始至终一口都没喝过。

手中又换了一杯正在冒泡的精致琥珀色烈酒后，Menes 领着你走进了那处显然是他最引以为傲的主招待厅。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The space is at once cavernous and intimate; the sightlines and carved, wrought, and woven details calculated to replicate the appearance of cozy warmth like the den of some thoughtful patron of art, history, and literature.

A double handful of well-dressed remoras mill about, interrupting their conversations to smile and lift a glass as Menes enters. They look to be a collection of industrialists, financiers, distant gens-relatives, and at least one officer from atop the local military detachment who appears a little worse for his drink. Most nod to you and Bornanew, eyes not lingering to the point of impoliteness.

One skinny man in a finely embroidered suit has no such compunction, and rushes to greet your party, eyes agog at the newest additions to Menes' collection.
texts.zh:
这个区域宽敞又温馨；视线、雕刻、锻造和编织的细节都经过精心计算，营造出一种温馨舒适的氛围，仿佛是某个热爱艺术、历史和文学的有识之士的书房。

一群衣着光鲜的宾客四处走动，当 Menes 现身时，他们纷纷停下交谈，微笑着向他举杯致意。这些人看起来像是工业家、金融家、远房亲戚，还有至少一名来自当地驻军的军官，后者似乎已经有点醉意了。大多数人向你和 Bornanew 点头致意，目光没有停留太久，以免显得失礼。

一位身材瘦削、身着精美刺绣服饰的男子则毫无顾忌，急匆匆地前来迎接你们一行人，两眼瞪得大大的，对 Menes 收藏的新品充满好奇。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He nearly trips over himself to speak. "The great Captain $playerName! If half of what Menes has said is true... why, half the Sector must tremble at the appearance of your $shipOrFleet!"

"We'll have to ask Navarch Atreus over there what he thinks of your combat record," the man grins wickedly, "If he hasn't had too many of these, of course; with all thanks to our kind host, a true gentleman and scholar." He lifts his glass approvingly at Menes, and you see his eyes slide toward Bornanew.

"And Jethro Bornanew, I believe? A Knight of Ludd?"
texts.zh:
他急着要说话，都差点把自己绊倒了。"伟大的 $playerName 舰长！如果 Menes 说的话有一半是真的...那么，半个星域的人看到你的$shipOrFleet，恐怕都要胆战心惊！"

"咱们得问问那边的 Atreus 将军对你的战绩有什么看法，" 那人狡黠地咧嘴一笑，"当然，前提是他还没喝太多；这一切都多亏了我们慷慨的主人，一位真正的绅士和学者。" 他赞许地向 Menes 举杯，接着你看到他的目光滑向了 Bornanew。

"还有 Jethro Bornanew，我没说错吧？一位卢德骑士？"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "I don't recall an introduction," Bornanew says, his hands still held piously together, allowing him to deniably reject both drink and the touch of the present company.
texts.zh: "我不记得有人介绍过我们，" Bornanew 说，他的双手仍然虔诚地合在一起，这让他可以名正言顺地拒绝饮料和在场众人的触碰。

options.en: Pleased to meet you...?
options.zh: 很高兴认识你...?

options.en: Say nothing
options.zh: 保持沉默

options.en: No need to be prickly, $global.jethroName, the man is being friendly.
options.zh: 别这么挑剔，$global.jethroName，这位先生很友好。

texts.en:
Menes laughs heartily.

"Let me introduce Ulmus Pond," he says. "Now he'll claim to be a mere commodities trader," Menes winks as if you are in on a shared joke, "but I daresay he knows everyone of any importance in the Kumari Kandam system. And if you need anything." He lowers his voice, "Anything at all. He's your man."

Pond, grinning widely, makes a brushing-off gesture as if to dismiss Menes' words - but not so assertively as to deny them.
texts.zh:
Menes 开怀大笑。

"让我给你们介绍一下 Ulmus Pond，" 他说，"现在他可能会自称只是个商品交易商，" Menes 眨了眨眼，仿佛你们俩心照不宣地在开个玩笑，"但我敢说，他认识 Kumari Kandam 星系里所有重要人物。而且如果你需要任何东西，" 他压低了声音，"无论什么，他都能帮你。"

Pond 咧嘴笑着，摆出一个挥手的动作，仿佛要将 Menes 的话拂去 —— 但又没有那么坚决。

options.en: Charmed, I'm sure.
options.zh: 当然，真是荣幸。

options.en: Everyone, you say? Does that include the Luddic Path?
options.zh: 所有人，你确定？包括 卢德左径 吗？

options.en: So, Ulmus was it? How do you know $global.jethroName?
options.zh: 所以，是叫 Ulmus 对吧？你怎么会认识 $global.jethroName？

options.en: Anything, you say? We'll have to talk later, Mister Pond.
options.zh: 任何东西，你确定？我们稍后得聊聊，Pond 先生。

options.en: Menes, I believe you had something special to show me?
options.zh: Menes，我想你有什么特别的东西要给我看吧？

options.en: I'm certain this party will be absolutely unforgettable.
options.zh: 我确信，这场派对绝对会令人难忘。

texts.en: Pond grins wider, and begins to speak. "The feeling, I'm sure-"
texts.zh: Pond 笑得更灿烂了，开口道。"我也同感 ——"

texts.en:
Menes slaps a hand on Pond's shoulder, causing him to nearly spill his drink.

"Ulmus, Ulmus! You'll have plenty of time to speak with the good captain later. I did promise a surprise, a private showing for $playerHimOrHer and $playerHisOrHer noble Knight. You might know the piece, my friend," he winks again, this time to Pond.

"Come along, come along!" Menes says, grabbing your arm. Ulmus Pond's eyes follow you, fawning oozingly.
texts.zh:
Menes 一巴掌拍在 Pond 的肩膀上，差点把他酒杯里的酒都拍出来。

"Ulmus，Ulmus！你会有大把时间跟这位好舰长聊天的。我确实承诺过要给$playerHimOrHer和$playerHisOrHer那高尚的骑士朋友一个惊喜，一次私人鉴赏。你可能知道那件东西，我的朋友，" 他又眨了眨眼，这次是对 Pond。

"快来，快来！"Menes 说着，抓住了你的手臂。Ulmus Pond 的目光紧随着你，谄媚之情溢于言表。

options.en: Allow Menes to pull you along
options.zh: 让 Menes 拉着你走

texts.en:
Menes leads you and Bornanew to his inner sanctum, flashing a grin as he operates a series of obtrusive biometric checks.

The air cools by a degree, perhaps two, the armored mass of the walls felt as a dullness through your feet. The subdued lighting, drapery, and framing of the space suggest the interior of a bank vault or a shrine, though not to the praise of any Luddic virtue.

Quite the contrary, depending on one's outlook.
texts.zh:
Menes 带着你和 Bornanew 来到了他的内部密室，他操作着一系列引人注目的生物识别检查装置，脸上闪过一丝得意的笑容。

空气的温度降低了一两度，厚重装甲墙壁的质量化作一股沉闷的质感从你的脚下传来。幽暗的灯光、帷幔以及整个空间的布局，让人联想到银行金库，或圣地的内部 —— 当然，这圣地并非是为了颂扬卢德主义的美德。

它与那完全相反，不过如何看待这一切，就见仁见智了。

options.en: Enter the vault
options.zh: 进入密室

texts.en: On a pedestal of carved wood, in a spot of light like holy revelation, a single glove is upthrust. It's fingers appear frozen in the midst of just starting to curl back toward a relaxed state after giving you a little wave.
texts.zh: 在木质雕花基座上，一束如同神启般的光芒中，一只手套赫然挺立。它的手指似乎凝固在刚刚向你挥了挥手后，正要蜷回放松状态的瞬间。

texts.en: On a pedestal of carved wood, in a spot of light like holy revelation, a single glove is upthrust. It's fingers appear frozen in the midst of just starting to curl back toward a relaxed state after giving you a little wave.
texts.zh: 在木质雕花基座上，一束如同神启般的光芒中，一只手套赫然挺立。它的手指似乎凝固在刚刚向你挥了挥手后，正要蜷回放松状态的瞬间。

texts.en: On a pedestal of carved wood, in a spot of light like holy revelation, a single glove is upthrust. Its fingers appear frozen in the midst of just starting to curl back toward a relaxed state after giving you a little wave.
texts.zh: 在木质雕花基座上，一束如同神启般的光芒中，一只手套赫然挺立。它的手指似乎凝固在刚刚向你挥了挥手后，正要蜷回放松状态的瞬间。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Do you know what this is?" Menes whispers to you.

"The Right-Hand Glove of Blessed Ludd," Bornanew answers, stepping forward, voice filled with trembling reverence.

"Removed by the Blessed Ludd, whereupon that prophet fell to the sacred Earth of Gilead to kiss that holy ground. Blessings be upon Ludd; Good is the Word; By the Holy Pneuma; By the Divine Light which illuminates the righteous Path through the Garden of Temptation..."
texts.zh:
"你知道这是什么吗？" Menes 向你低声问道。

"圣卢德的右手手套，" Bornanew 回答道，向前迈了一步，声音中充满了颤抖的敬畏之情。

"由那位圣卢德亲手摘下，随即那位先知俯下身躯，亲吻 Gilead 的神圣土地。福泽归于卢德；圣言至善；凭那圣灵；凭那照亮了穿越诱惑花园的正道之圣光..."

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew himself falls to his knees, half-whispering, half-sobbing in prayer, rocking back and forth, his eyes wide and focus vague.

This is a display you have never seen from $global.jethroName, completely at odds with his usual air of reserve.

Menes steps back with you, looking somehow appalled and delighted at the same time. He stares at Bornanew like a voyeur.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 跪倒在地，半是低语半是啜泣地祈祷着，前后摇晃，双眼圆睁，目光涣散。

这是你从未在 $global.jethroName 身上见过的模样，与他平时沉稳的作风截然不同。

Menes 和你一同退后，看起来既震惊又欣喜。他像个偷窥者一样盯着 Bornanew。

options.en: Wait a bit
options.zh: 稍等一会儿

options.en: He's overwhelmed... you must understand, Menes.
options.zh: 他被震撼到了...还请你理解，Menes。

texts.en:
Bornanew keeps at it, absolutely rapt upon his prayer toward the glove, tears and phlegm running down his face. It is, truly, a pathetic and uncomfortably intimate sight.

Menes keeps staring, an open half-smile on his lips.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 继续着，完全沉浸在对手套的祈祷中，泪水和鼻涕顺着他的脸淌下来。这景象让人同情，也令人感到不适和尴尬。

Menes 一直盯着他，嘴角挂着若有若无的微笑。

options.en: Menes. We should let him be for a moment, don't you think? Menes?
options.zh: Menes。我们应该让他一个人待一会，你不觉得吗？Menes？

texts.en: "Hmm? Oh. Oh yes. Of course, captain," he says, still watching.
texts.zh: "嗯？哦。对的。当然，舰长，" 他说着，眼睛却还一直盯着看。

options.en: Gently pull Menes' away and ask about other items in the collection
options.zh: 轻轻把 Menes 拉走，询问他收藏的其他物品

texts.en:
It takes a slightly more than polite tug to overcome Menes' inertia, but finally he's dislodged from Bornanew's spectacle toward another of the handful of chambers making up this 'inner sanctum'.

Menes keeps glancing back toward Bornanew as he explains the story of one or another object: A captain's uniform of the Fourteenth Battlegroup, sword and all, from the period of the Cold Passage; a bottle of spirits from some core Domain star system near Old Earth; a pistol once owned by the Warlord Leonis; the crystalline xenocoral of a species extinct for half a billion years collected by the Exploraria.
texts.zh:
要让 Menes 动起来，你使的劲有些超出了有礼的范畴，不过最终还是成功把他从 Bornanew 的演出里拉走，带到了 '内部密室' 中的另外一个房间里。

Menes 讲述着一件件物品的故事，一边不时回头看看 Bornanew：藏品中有 第十四战斗群 冷寂远航 期间的一套指挥官制服，连佩剑都在；有产自旧地球附近某个 人之领 核心星系的酒瓶；有曾属于军阀 Leonis 的手枪；还有 探险队 收集的、已灭绝五亿年的异星珊瑚晶体。

options.en: Astounding. Makes one think how we would handle the Cold Passage. Menes?
options.zh: 太惊人了。让人不禁思考我们要怎么应对 冷寂远航。Menes？

options.en: Incredible. What would it take to persuade you to hold a tasting? Menes?
options.zh: 难以置信。得付出什么才能让你办一场品酒会呢？Menes？

options.en: Fascinating. Do you think Leonis shot anyone with this, Menes?
options.zh: 真有意思。你觉得 Leonis 用这把枪射杀过什么人吗，Menes？

options.en: Intriguing. I wonder if I might find more such xenolife on the fringe. Menes?
options.zh: 真奇妙。不知道我能不能在边缘星区找到更多这样的异种生命。Menes？

texts.en: "Huh? Oh yes, naturally I've ruminated often upon how my own character might be tested by such hardship. I admit, my life has been one of relative ease, but I like to think that I identify with certain qualities of those early heroic figures whose steadfastness effected the..."
texts.zh: "嗯？哦是的，我当然常常思考，如果遭遇那样的艰难困苦，自己的品格会受到怎样的考验。我承认我的生活相对安逸，但我相信，我与那些早年间的英雄人物有着一些相通的品质，正是他们的坚定不移促成了..."

options.en: Smile and nod
options.zh: 微笑并点头

texts.en:
He rambles, and you make a good show of asking for additional details, drawing his attention toward the object at hand and away from whatever in Ludd's name Bornanew is doing.

A piercing alarm interrupts Menes mid-thought. His eyes go wide and snap toward the central atrium which holds the glove- and Bornanew. He takes off at a run.
texts.zh:
他滔滔不绝，你则装出一副饶有兴趣的样子，追问更多细节，把他的注意力引向眼前的物品，让他无暇顾及 Bornanew 到底以卢德的名义做什么事。

一阵刺耳的警报声打断了 Menes 的思绪。他双眼圆睁，猛地转向存放手套 —— 以及 Bornanew 所在 —— 的中庭。他立马朝那里飞奔起来。

options.en: Follow Menes
options.zh: 跟随 Menes

texts.en:
You both find Bornanew, still on his knees, with one hand stretched out to touch the glove - one finger upon it - lips still moving, eyes still blankly huge as if overcome by religious mania.

Menes gives out a wordless cry of alarm, and begins lifting his cuff to call security.

Your off-hand instinctively curls around a control interface for one of the clever little thieves-tools you have hidden about your uniform.
texts.zh:
你俩发现 Bornanew 还跪在地上，手伸向手套 —— 一根手指搭在上面 —— 嘴唇微动，双眼依旧空洞地圆睁着，就好像已经被宗教狂热所吞噬。

Menes 无言地惊叫起来，抬起袖口呼叫安保人员。

你下意识地摸向了制服里的控制接口，那是你藏在身上的精巧偷窃工具。

options.en: $global.jethroName! Restrain yourself, man!
options.zh: $global.jethroName！控制好自己，哥们！

options.en: He's only touched it, no need for-
options.zh: 他只是碰了一下，没必要 ——

texts.en:
Menes hesitates as you speak, then barks a codeword into his comms.

You freeze, understanding what this sort of protocol looks like. The lights flare into harsh illumination and a trio of gun turrets pop from subtle cupolas - one each tracks instantly to you and Bornanew while the third spins in a slow covering pattern.

The human guards arrive a moment later, uniforms bright-white, boots squeaking on the floor. Menes breathes heavily, watching the security net tighten.

Bornanew, meanwhile, has not moved but to turn his head toward you and Menes.
texts.zh:
在你说话时，Menes 犹豫了一下，然后对着通讯器吼出了一个口令。

你僵住了，你明白这种程序意味着什么。灯光骤然亮起，刺眼夺目，三座炮塔从隐蔽的炮座中弹出 —— 其中两座立刻分别锁定了你和 Bornanew，第三座则缓慢旋转进行掩护。

人类卫兵没一会就赶到了，他们身穿亮白色的制服，靴子在地板上吱吱作响。Menes 喘着粗气，看着安保包围圈收紧。

而 Bornanew，他除了把头转向你和 Menes 之外，一动未动。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "Menes, Yaribay sir. I pray your forgiveness. I- I was overcome by... I had to..." Bornanew trails off, pathetically.
texts.zh: "Menes，Yaribay 先生。我请求你的原谅。我 —— 我一时情难自已...我不得不..." Bornanew 声音渐弱，显得十分可怜。

options.en: Say nothing
options.zh: 什么也不说

options.en: (whisper) "This'll make a great story."
options.zh: (低语) "这会是个很棒的故事。"

texts.en:
It takes a second, but Menes starts to laugh.

And laugh, and laugh deep in his belly, almost a shout. He suddenly throws an arm over your shoulder, putting you off balance, as he struggles to contain himself.
texts.zh:
沉寂片刻后，Menes 大笑起来。

他笑得前仰后合，笑声发自肺腑，都快变成呐喊了。然后他突然把胳膊搭在你的肩膀上，让你踉跄了一下，他则努力控制着自己的笑声。

options.en: Try to remain standing
options.zh: 努力站稳

texts.en: "You're right!" he shouts, "Captain, by the stars, you are right."
texts.zh: "你说得对！" 他喊道，"舰长，群星啊，你说得太对了。"

texts.en:
"You there," Menes calls out, "Knight $global.jethroName, get yourself off the floor. Come wash your face, you look absolutely disgusting. Back to the party! Drinks are on me, ha-ha!"

As almost an afterthought he calls to the security team, "You lot, clean this up and get out of here... ruining the mood."
texts.zh:
"你，" Menes 喊道，" $global.jethroName 骑士，快起来。去洗把脸，你这模样太恶心了。回派对去！酒我请，哈哈！"

他就像事后才想起来一样，对安保团队喊道，"你们几个，把这里收拾干净，然后滚蛋...净破坏气氛。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You and Bornanew, he given a basin and washcloth by a servitor, are hauled back into the party, and the entire crowd regaled with the story of Bornanew being overcome with awe at the relic and then caught setting off the security alarm.

Menes seems to find it more hilarious with every telling - and each additional round of drinks. His dutiful entourage joins in the laughter each time. The skinny man, Ulmus Pond, has a particularly manic, piercing laugh.

It is some time before you are able to get a quiet word in with $global.jethroName.
texts.zh:
在侍从为 Bornanew 递上了脸盆和毛巾后，你们二人被拉回了派对中，然后整个聚会的人都听说了 Bornanew 因为敬畏圣物而开始发癫，结果触发安全警报的故事。

Menes 似乎每讲一次都觉得这事越发好笑 —— 而且每喝一轮，他的笑点还会更低。他那些忠实的随从们也每次都跟着大笑。那个瘦骨嶙峋的男人，Ulmus Pond，他的笑声尤其疯狂而刺耳。

过了好一会儿，你才找到机会和 $global.jethroName 悄悄说上几句话。

options.en: What in Ludd's seven hells was that?
options.zh: 看在卢德七大狱的份上，你到底在干啥？

options.en: What went wrong?
options.zh: 哪里出岔子了？

texts.en:
"I beg pardon for your blasphemy, captain," Bornanew says with a hint of strain in his voice. "Ludd's conception of hell was, so much as the Word reveals, a description of mortal torment in a Domain without God."

"But I do have the glove. What remains is-" an almost malicious smile briefly appears, "a fake."
texts.zh:
"舰长，我原谅你的亵渎之言，" Bornanew 的声音带着一丝勉强，"据圣言所示，卢德对地狱的构想，是凡人在一个没有神明的 人之领 中所受的折磨。"

"但我确实拿到手套了。现在还在那里的 ——" 他的脸上短暂浮现出一个近乎恶意的微笑，"是个赝品。"

texts.en: He lifts a finger to his lips, and with his other hand pats a fold in his Knight's robes.
texts.zh: 他竖起一根手指放到唇边，另一只手拍了拍骑士长袍上的一个褶皱。

options.en: You had a fake glove? This whole time?
options.zh: 你有个假手套？还一直都带着？

options.en: Good work, $global.jethroName. Great work, in fact.
options.zh: 干得好，$global.jethroName。真的，非常漂亮。

options.en: Next time, be sure to let me in on your plan.
options.zh: 下次，务必先把计划告诉我。

options.en: ... Praise Ludd.
options.zh: ...赞美卢德。

texts.en:
His eyes keep watch on Menes as he replies.

"It's just a glove, captain. The color matches. I didn't think Menes would notice." His mouth quirks. "He didn't."

"He will notice eventually, however. We should... become distant from this place."
texts.zh:
他一直盯着 Menes，开口回答道。

"这只是一只手套而已，舰长。不过是颜色对得上。我不觉得 Menes 会注意到。" 他嘴角抽动。"他也确实没注意到。"

"不过他早晚会发现的。我们该...有多远跑多远了。"

texts.en:
* * *

It is a feat of diplomacy that you manage to extract yourself and Bornanew as quickly as you are able.

A faked containment failure alert from your chief engineer merely opens the door. Passing through requires shaking everyone's hand, exchanging pleasant words, and going through the motions of good-byes several times over - then each time the ritual is interrupted by some tangent or anecdote from Menes, he ensures that it is begun again from the start.

At last you find yourself back in your shuttle, a half-full glass still in your hand.
texts.zh:
* * *

你能这么快就带着 Bornanew 脱身，实属一项外交壮举。

你的总工程师伪造的收容失效警报只是为你打开了脱身的门。要穿过它，还得和每个人都握手，说些客套话，一遍又一遍地走完告别的流程 —— 然后每当这个仪式被 Menes 讲的题外话或趣闻打断，他都要让仪式从头再来。

最后你终于回到了自己的穿梭机上，手里还拿着半杯酒。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew places the glove carefully into a clear-sided containment vessel, the kind used by salvors to take biological samples. Illuminated by the vessel's interior glowstrips, the glove seems to be held in a reliquary shining with holy light.

"Mere evidence," Bornanew says, seeing your look. "Now the question is, where did this come from?"
texts.zh:
Bornanew 小心地将手套放进了一个透明的密封容器里，就是那种打捞员用来采集生物样本的容器。在容器内部发光条的照耀下，这手套仿佛被供奉在闪耀着圣光的圣物匣中。

"只是个证据而已，" Bornanew 注意到你的眼神后说道。"现在的问题是，这东西是哪来的？"

texts.en:
At last you find yourself back in your shuttle.

Bornanew sets a drinking bulb of cold water in your hand, then places a clear-sided containment vessel, the kind used by salvors to take biological samples, in the seat next to you. Illuminated by the vessel's interior embedded glowstrips, the glove seems to be held in a reliquary shining with holy light.

"Physical evidence," Bornanew says, seeing your look. "Nothing more."
texts.zh:
你终于回到了自己的穿梭机上。

Bornanew 递给你一个装有冷水的饮水球，然后把一个透明的密封容器放在你旁边的座位上，就是那种打捞员用来采集生物样本的容器。在容器内部嵌入式发光条的照耀下，这手套仿佛被供奉在闪耀着圣光的圣物匣中。

"物证，" Bornanew 注意到你的眼神后说道。"仅此而已。"

texts.en:
"He's a Pather agent," Bornanew says as if it were the most obvious thing in the world. He meets your look.

"We spoke briefly," he explains. "The circumstantial evidence is convincing enough, but it was his heretical understanding of theology which I found truly damning."

"He may be connected, but first we should ask the glove." He looks back down at the glove in its containment vessel.
texts.zh:
"他是个左径特工。" Bornanew 迎上你的目光，口中说得好像这是世界上最显而易见的事一样。

"我们简短地聊了几句。" 他解释道，"间接证据已经够有说服力了，但看他对神学的异端理解，我觉得真的可以锤死。"

"他可能和这事有关，但我们得先查查这只手套。" 他又低头看向容器里的手套。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"A nanoforge engineer could tell us where this came from," he says. "Who made it. When, and where. By that truth, we can judge the answers we receive from those we... interview." His last word is muted by the shuttle's maneuverings.

"The Church operates a nanoforge on the planet Asher, in the Canaan system. The engineers there will cooperate with the authority I bear, and despite mostly being nonbelievers, their discretion is already paid for by the Church. Our inquiry will be safe."

He pauses, and looks away. "So far as anything is, in the Church."
texts.zh:
"纳米锻炉工程师能告诉我们这东西是哪来的，" 他说，"具体来说是谁造的。什么时候造的，在哪造的。通过这些事实，我们就能判断出我们从那些... 被采访的人那里得到的答案信不信得过了。" 他说 "采访" 时，声音被穿梭机的颠簸声盖了过去。

"教会的纳米锻炉在 Canaan 星系的 Asher 上。那里的技术人员会配合我所代表的授权。虽然说他们大多是无信者，但教会已经付过钱让他们保密了。我们的调查会很安全。"

他顿了一下，移开了视线，"至少，在教会所能做到的范围内很安全。"

options.en: I feel like we've worn out our welcome here anyway.
options.zh: 反正我觉得我们在这待得够久了，是时候走了。

options.en: I feel like we've worn out our welcome here anyway.
options.zh: 反正我觉得我们在这待得够久了，是时候走了。

options.en: We should confirm our hard evidence before Menes starts asking questions.
options.zh: 我们得在 Menes 开始问问题之前，把事情实锤了。

texts.en:
Bornanew nods agreement.

The shuttle approaches your flagship and prepares to dock.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 点头同意。

穿梭机靠近了你的旗舰，准备停泊。

texts.en:
Bornanew raises an eyebrow at you. "I wouldn't suppose, no."

He looks back to the glove in its containment vessel. "The glove might answer our questions, however."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 对你扬了扬眉毛。"我猜也是，没法问。"

他回头看着容器里的手套。"不过，这手套也许能回答我们的问题。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

"We spoke briefly," he explains. "The circumstantial evidence is convincing enough, but it was his heretical understanding of theology which I found truly damning."

"He's also a liar. So." He looks down at the glove once more.

"他还是个骗子。所以。" 他又低头看了看那只手套。

texts.en: "Little, but for the monotony of my humiliation, however justly earned," Bornanew says with a hint of strain in his voice. "But I do have the glove. What remains is a-" an almost malicious smile very briefly appears, "fake."
texts.zh: "没什么，不过他们对我的嘲讽也太没劲了，尽管我罪有应得，" Bornanew 的声音有些紧张。"但我确实拿到手套了。现在还在那里的 ——" 他的脸上短暂浮现出一个近乎恶意的微笑，"是个赝品。"

texts.en: "Ah? Oh yes, I cannot deny the temptation to open it for some appropriate event, given an appropriately appreciative audience- my dear cousin Horus for instance; I considered his marriage to Asherah, but I thought- no, not yet. I wonder at times if the delight of it is held by the anticipation, the thought..."
texts.zh: "啊？哦没错，在某些恰当的场合我确实会忍不住想打开它，当然，还得有懂得欣赏的观众才行 —— 比如我亲爱的堂兄 Horus；我曾考虑过在他和 Asherah 结婚时打开，但又觉得 —— 不，还不是时候。有时我会想，它的乐趣是不是就在于期待，在于想象..."

options.en: Smile and nod
options.zh: 微笑并点头

texts.en: "Oh? Oh, well, I do have a story for you! During negotiations with the buyer I thought, let us have a firearms expert examine this, and wouldn't you know that I happened to be hosting a wealthy financier who's done some work with Tri-Tachyon - and say what you will for the Company, they are good at what they do - and she happened to have a brother with an interest in a firm..."
texts.zh: "哦？哦，好吧，我正好有个故事要讲给你听！在和卖家谈判时，我想，咱们要不找个枪械专家来鉴定一下，你猜后来怎样，我当时正好招待了一位和 速子科技 有合作的富有的金融家 —— 不管你怎么评价那公司，他们在自己的领域里确实很专业 —— 而她碰巧有个兄弟在一家公司里有股份..."

options.en: Smile and nod
options.zh: 微笑并点头

texts.en: "Eh? Ah! Well I daresay, it is you who might answer that question fully, though I've always considered myself something of a naturalist, or xeno-naturalist if you will ha-ha, and so what if I were to finance an expedition of discovery of sorts? 'Menes Yaribay, patron of knowledge'; I like the sound of that. Imagine, to explore new worlds, encounter unknown lifeforms, seek out and explore the far fringes..."
texts.zh: "呃？啊！好吧，我得说，这个问题还得你自己才答得出来，虽然我一直自认为是个自然学家，或者说异星自然学家，哈哈，那么如果我资助一次某种形式的探索之旅呢？'Menes Yaribay，知识的赞助人'；听起来不错。想象一下，去探索新的世界，邂逅未知的生命形态，寻找、探索遥远的边疆..."

options.en: Smile and nod
options.zh: 微笑并点头

texts.en: "Yes, yes," he replies under his breath.
texts.zh: "对，对，" 他低声回答道。

texts.en:
"Do you know what this is?" Menes whispers to you.

"It looks like a glove, demarch," Bornanew answers in feigned misunderstanding, stepping forward.
texts.zh:
"知道这是什么吗？" Menes 低声问你。

"这看起来像一只手套，统领。" Bornanew 走上前，就像没听懂似的回答道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Not any glove," Menes says with more than a hint of vexation.

He begins again in a reverent whisper, "The glove worn by Ludd upon stepping upon the sacred Earth of Gilead. Ludd removed the glove and kissed the ground, according to the Luddic religion. Isn't that right, sir Knight? And this... is it."

Bornanew looks at you, his eyebrows rising slightly as if to give a cue. "This would be a most impressive find," he says. "If it is as you say."
texts.zh:
"这可不是别的手套。" Menes 颇为恼火地说。

他又开始虔诚地低语，"这是卢德踏上 Gilead 的圣土时所戴着手套。根据卢德教的说法，卢德 当时脱下手套亲吻了大地。对不对，骑士先生？而这...就是那只手套。"

Bornanew 看着你，眉毛微微扬起，好像在暗示你什么。"如果你说的是真话，" 他说，"那这个发现可够惊人的。"

options.en: Well I'm impressed, Menes. A relic from a pivotal moment of the Sector's history!
options.zh: 我真是大吃一惊，Menes。这可是来自星域历史中一个关键时刻的圣物！

texts.en:
"Thank-you captain!" Menes says, relieved and more than a little pleased that someone appreciates his trinket.

"Setting aside its purely religious significance," he gives an annoyed glance at Bornanew, "it represents a, a heralding of the changing tide of history! The ebbing influence of the Domain-era megacorporations, the rising of what some call - not my words of course, sir Knight - an atavistic populism. Truly, it is this small piece of the vastness of the story of Humanity which called to me when it was first described to me..."
texts.zh:
"多谢，舰长！" Menes 说道，松了口气的同时，还因为有人欣赏他的小玩意儿而高兴起来。

"先不说纯粹的宗教内涵，" 他恼怒地瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，"它还代表着...代表着历史潮流的转变！人之领时代巨型企业的势力在衰退，而一些人所谓的返祖式民粹主义正在抬头 —— 这可不是我说的，骑士先生。说真的，当我第一次听到这样的描述时，我有感觉到，自己在被这人类浩瀚故事中的小小碎片呼唤着..."

options.en: I, too, feel its call. Would you consider selling the piece?
options.zh: 我也感觉它在呼唤我。你考虑出售这件藏品吗？

texts.en:
"Oh, captain." Menes chuckles approvingly. "I couldn't possibly sell this, the prize of my collection. Nothing can compare!"

"-Although," he quibbles with himself, "I do possess a captain's uniform of the Fourteenth Battlegroup in excellent condition, and indeed a pistol once owned by the Warlord Leonis which I believe was used to execute prisoners at... well, you understand my point of course."
texts.zh:
"喔，舰长。" Menes 赞许般轻笑起来。"我不可能卖，这是我收藏中的珍品。没什么能和它比了！"

"—— 虽然说，" 他自言自语地狡辩道，"我确实还有一套保存完好的 第十四战斗群 舰长制服，还有一把曾经属于军阀 Leonis 的手枪，我敢说，以前那把枪被他用来处决过犯人，在...嗯，你懂我意思。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Of course," Bornanew says from behind Menes, who has fully turned his back to the Knight. "If it is indeed the real glove of Ludd."

You maintain your composure while watching the look that crosses Menes' face.
texts.zh:
"那当然。" 已经被 Menes 以背身相待的 Bornanew，就这么在他身后开口道。"如果这的的确确是卢德的那个手套的话。"

你保持镇定，留意着掠过 Menes 脸上的神情。

options.en: The Knight has a point, Menes. I couldn't make an offer without verification.
options.zh: 骑士说的有道理，Menes。没检验过的话，我可没法开价。

texts.en:
Menes laugh is more than a little strained.

"Now now, captain, I have not said I was offering the glove for any kind of sale. And," he glances back at Bornanew, "a lesser man than I might take offense at your implications, sir. My source has impeccable standards, and I assure you the provenance of the piece is most distinguished."
texts.zh:
Menes 勉为其难地笑了笑。

"别这样，舰长，我可没说这手套是要拿去卖的。还有，" 他回头瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，"换个气量比我再小点的人，你的暗示怕不是就要把他弄急了，这位先生。我的货源标准肯定没问题，我给你打包票，这东西的来历可是相当显赫。"

options.en: Let's discuss veracity. I need... reassurance.
options.zh: 来聊聊真实性吧。我得...要点担保。

options.en: Considering my offer, I require full confidence in the item.
options.zh: 考虑到我能给的报价，我得对这东西彻底放心才行。

options.en: Let's discuss credits. Would a half-million open the question of a sale?
options.zh: 来聊聊出钱的事吧。50 万星币有得谈吗？

options.en: Let's discuss credits. Would 700k open the question of a sale?
options.zh: 来聊聊出钱的事吧。70 万星币有得谈吗？

options.en: Let's not waste time. One million credits.
options.zh: 我就不啰嗦了，一百万星币。

texts.en:
"Veracity?" An annoyed look crosses Menes face.

"I have nothing to prove; the good name of Yaribay speaks for itself. Besides, we are not even discussing a sale."
texts.zh:
"真实性？" Menes 的脸上闪过一丝恼怒。

"我没什么要证明的；Yaribay 氏族的好声誉就够了。再说了，我又没和你聊要卖这东西的事。"

texts.en: "Veracity. Hmm." Menes doesn't look pleased, but he doesn't look as annoyed as before.
texts.zh: "真实性。唔。" Menes 看起来不太高兴，但也没之前那么恼火了。

texts.en:
"I can see you are a practical dealer. Skeptical, even," he says. "This is understandable in a spacer. I know well of the sorts of figures you must deal with- corrupt Hegemony officers, pirates, ... treacherous, blood-thirsty Pather fanatics," he gives a quick glance at Bornanew to see if he's pierced the Knight's shell.

$global.jethroName is serenely pondering the glove, only half-listening by all appearances.
texts.zh:
"我看明白了，你这买家很务实。甚至说得上多疑。" 他说，"不过你是个宇宙民，可以理解。我懂你都得和什么人来往 —— 腐败的 霸主 军官、海盗...狡诈嗜血的左径狂信徒。" 他迅速瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，想看看自己有没有戳穿这骑士的伪装。

$global.jethroName 心平气和地端详着手套，看起来没怎么在认真听。

options.en: Who sold you the glove?
options.zh: 是谁把这手套卖给你的？

options.en: Ulmus Pond sold you the glove, didn't he.
options.zh: Ulmus Pond 把这手套卖给你的，对吧。

options.en: I'll need to have the glove tested.
options.zh: 我得先检测一下这手套。

texts.en: "I'm afraid I could not reveal my source just now," Menes says haughtily. "They are very exclusive, and, and... sensitive."
texts.zh: "我怕是现在还不能透露货源。" Menes 一脸傲慢。"他们非常排外，而且非常...谨慎。"

texts.en:
"No, n- it's not- you can't-" Menes sputters for a moment, then crosses his arms. "I cannot confirm or deny your statement."

"And even if Ulmus did," he continues, "I trust you to act honorably and not reveal this information. There are fanatics out there, you understand, who would do terribly unkind things to him if they found out."

"Why do you think I only do private showings? There's no telling what idea some Luddie might get." He sniffs, taking in Bornanew once more, "You know what I mean. A proper Luddic who actually believes in anything with real passion."

Bornanew presses his hands together and gives a little nod.
texts.zh:
"不 —— 那不是 —— 你不能 ——" Menes 语无伦次了一会儿，然后双手抱胸，"我没法确认，也没法否认你的说法。"

"而且就算真是 Ulmus，" 他继续说着，"你那么正直，肯定不会泄露这个消息的吧。你也懂，外面有狂信徒，他们要是知道了，会对他做一些残忍的事。"

"你觉得我为什么只私人展示？鬼知道那些卢德佬会冒出什么念头。" 他抽抽鼻子，又看了 Bornanew 一眼，"作为一个真的、对一切都抱有热情的正派卢德信徒，你知道我什么意思。"

Bornanew 双手合十，微微点头。

texts.en: "Tested," Menes says, the word apparently putting a bad taste in his mouth. "What would this entail, some technician coming in for a visit?"
texts.zh: "检测。" Menes 重复着，显然这个词弄得他有点难受。"你想干什么？拉个技术员过来一趟？"

options.en: That wouldn't be quite sufficient...
options.zh: 感觉那还不够...

texts.en:
"The captain will need to take the glove as a... temporary loan." Bornanew speaks, startling Menes. The Knight had moved silently to a position behind you and Menes.

"Nanoforge facilities provide the means to determine the date and manufacture of the glove. It would ensure that it matches the correct era, age, and style. The Church has records, you see. Detailed records."
texts.zh:
"舰长得把手套...暂时借走。" Bornanew 一开口就吓了 Menes 一跳。他不知何时来到了你和 Menes 后面。

"纳米锻炉可以识别出手套的制造日期和工艺。这样，我们就能确定它的制造时代、年份和风格是不是对的了。你看，教会对这些都有记录，很详细的。"

options.en: Precisely. Well put, $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 说得不错，$global.jethroName。

texts.en:
"Inconceivable," Menes says, scowling. "This is a unique relic of immense value. I can't let you simply walk away with it."

"Besides, this is completely unnecessary," he continues. "Gens Yaribay has a reputation for honest dealing going back generations!"
texts.zh:
"你们也太敢说了。" Menes 皱着眉头，"这圣物独一无二、价值连城。我可不能让你们就这么把它带走。"

"而且根本就没必要。" 他继续道。"Yaribay 氏族世世代代都是以诚信经营闻名的！"

texts.en: Menes will need convincing. If you made a few good arguments, he will surely fold.
texts.zh: 你得说服 Menes。如果你能给出几个有力的理由，他肯定可以让步。

texts.en: Menes still needs convincing. A couple more good points should do it.
texts.zh: 你需要继续说服 Menes。再来几个理由应该就可以了。

texts.en: Menes looks almost convinced. One more solid point should do it.
texts.zh: Menes 看起来快被说动了，再来一个理由就行。

texts.en: "Well, I suppose that does it!" Menes claps his hands together.
texts.zh: "好，那这事就这么定了！" Menes 拍了拍手。

options.en: I'll provide a quarter deposit, right now, of 200,000 credits.
options.zh: 我现在就付四分之一的定金，200,000 星币。

options.en: I'll provide a quarter deposit, right now, of 225,000 credits.
options.zh: 我现在就付四分之一的定金，225,000 星币。

options.en: I'll provide a quarter deposit, right now, of 250,000 credits.
options.zh: 我现在就付四分之一的定金，250,000 星币。

options.en: Surely my status as a fellow demarchon of the League means something.
options.zh: 我也是联盟的民选统领，这个身份肯定有点分量吧。

options.en: It may not be part of the League, but as a fellow executive of an independent colony...
options.zh: 虽然不是联盟的一份子，但我经营着独立殖民地，也算得上是一位民选领导人...

options.en: My commissioned status with the Persean League must count for something.
options.zh: 我受雇于 英仙座联盟，这个身份肯定有点分量吧。

options.en: Your cousin Horus Yaribay trusted me with his diplomatic credentials...
options.zh: 你的堂兄 Horus Yaribay 给过我他的外交凭证...

options.en: $global.jethroName, will you explain why this is necessary?
options.zh: $global.jethroName，你来解释解释为什么做检测很有必要？

options.en: I have a financial backer, Rayan Arroyo... (lie)
options.zh: 我有个资助人，Rayan Arroyo... (说谎)

options.en: In fact, the Church is backing my purchase. (lie)
options.zh: 事实上，教会在资助我买下这东西。 (说谎)

options.en: Sorry, more spacer humor. The Church truly is backing my bid. (commit)
options.zh: 抱歉，不过又是个宇宙民的冷笑话。教会确实在资助我。 (坚持说谎)

texts.en: Menes smirks, and holds out his TriPad, ready to accept your transfer code. Perhaps he feels like he's calling your bluff.
texts.zh: Menes 得意地笑着，递出他的 TriPad，准备接收你的转账代码。也许他觉得这样可以试探你是不是在虚张声势。

texts.en:
You tap your TriPad to his and it gives a happy little ping.

"Ah," Menes looks down to confirm. "So you are serious. I must admit, your decisiveness is impressive. Most spacer captains, they're all talk. You," he lifts his eyebrows like a conspirator, "mean business."
texts.zh:
你用你的 TriPad 碰了一下他的，设备欢快地发出一声轻响。

"啊，" Menes 低头确认。"原来你是认真的。不得不说，你的果断惊艳到我了。大多数太空舰长，他们就只会动动嘴皮子。但你，" 他扬起眉毛，像个同谋一样，"你是会动真格的。"

texts.en: Menes smirks, and holds out his TriPad, ready to accept your transfer code. Perhaps he feels like he's calling your bluff.
texts.zh: Menes 得意地笑着，递出他的 TriPad，准备接收你的转账代码。也许他觉得这样可以试探你是不是在虚张声势。

texts.en: Menes smirks, and holds out his TriPad, ready to accept your transfer code. Perhaps he feels like he's calling your bluff.
texts.zh: Menes 得意地笑着，递出他的 TriPad，准备接收你的转账代码。也许他觉得这样可以试探你是不是在虚张声势。

texts.en:
"But of course," Menes says, pouring on a gracious act. "Silly me, so caught up in your reputation as a space captain... having a respectable title - you must understand - it is simply unexpected."
