"We're the League!" He slaps a hand across your back. "We have to stick together, you know. Or the Hegemony will get us - or, precious Ludd, the Church might roll in to force us all to pray night and day, ha!" He looks toward Bornanew, "Ha-ha! A joke, friend, a joke."
texts.zh:
"那当然。" Menes 说着，摆出了一副亲切的样子。"我突然犯蠢，就记着你是个太空舰长了...你得理解我一下，你能有个体面的名号，实在有点出人意料。"

"我们是联盟的人！" 他拍了拍你的后背。"要知道，我们得团结一致，不然 霸主 就会来收拾我们 —— 又或者教会可能会冲进来，逼着我们日夜祈祷，卢德在上！" 他望向 Bornanew，"哈哈！说个笑话而已，朋友，开个玩笑。"

texts.en:
"But of course," Menes says, pouring on a gracious act. "Silly me, so caught up in your reputation as just a space captain... having a respectable title - you must understand - it is simply unexpected."

"Well, I'm sure you'll join the League soon enough!" He slaps a hand across your back. "We have to stick together, you know. Or the Hegemony will get us - or, precious Ludd, the Church might roll in to force us all to pray night and day, ha!" He looks toward Bornanew, "Ha-ha! A joke, friend, a joke."
texts.zh:
"那当然。" Menes 说着，摆出了一副亲切的样子。"我突然犯蠢，就记着你不过是个太空佬了...你得理解我一下，你能有个体面的名号，实在有点出人意料。"

"嗯，我相信你很快就会加入联盟的！" 他拍了拍你的后背。"要知道，我们得团结一致，不然 霸主 就会来收拾我们 —— 又或者教会可能会冲进来，逼着我们日夜祈祷，卢德在上！" 他望向 Bornanew，"哈哈！说个笑话而已，朋友，开个玩笑。"

texts.en:
"No doubt!" Menes exclaims, "Why, I should have commended you earlier for your service to the League. I was so caught up in your reputation as a spacer - you know, adventures and schemes and the like - it completely slipped my mind that you're on our side."

He slaps a hand across your back. "We appreciate your work, you know. Imagine if the Hegemony came for us - or, precious Ludd, imagine if the Church rolled in to force us all to pray night and day, ha!" He looks toward Bornanew, "Ha-ha! A joke, friend, a joke."
texts.zh:
"那没问题。" Menes 惊呼起来。"哎，我早该夸夸你为联盟所做的贡献了。我就记着你是个太空佬了，你懂的，冒险啊阴谋之类的太吸引人，搞得我忘记你是我们这边的了。"

他拍了拍你的后背。"我们很感谢你所付出的一切。想想看，要是 霸主 来收拾我们 —— 又或者，想想教会冲进来逼着我们日夜祈祷的样子，卢德在上！" 他望向 Bornanew，"哈哈！说个笑话而已，朋友，开个玩笑。"

texts.en:
You draw your TriPad and demonstrate.

"By the stars, he did," Menes says, eyes wide. "I knew I recognized your name from somewhere! There must have been a comms sent to the upper gens about this ploy Horus was running. That's cousin Horus for you, isn't it? Always pushing his little projects."

"Well," he looks as if he's reappraising you, "If you're good enough for cousin Horus, I suppose I could be convinced to make certain allowances."
texts.zh:
你拿出 TriPad 展示给他看。

"我靠，他真给了。" Menes 瞪大了眼睛，"我就说我好像在哪听过你的名字！肯定有人和氏族上层说过 Horus 在搞的这个计划。Horus 堂兄就是这样的，不对吗？他总是在捣鼓一些小项目。"

"嗯，" 他似乎在重新审视你，"既然你能让 Horus 堂兄满意，我想我也可以做点让步。"

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName trusts you implicitly," Bornanew explains, "So as $playerHisOrHer advisor, I must act the skeptic. I assure you, Demarchon Yaribay, it brings me no pleasure to appear to question and besmirch your fine reputation."

He speaks with such sincerity, for just a moment you can almost believe $global.jethroName isn't lying.

"Consider it a policy of 'trust, but verify'. We trust you, of course. But what of your source? We would never wish to see you cheated, but alas, I know too well that sin which lives in the human heart... If anything, I believe your only weakness is being too kind a spirit, too generous a benefactor."
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长其实很相信你。" Bornanew 解释道，"所以作为$playerHisOrHer的顾问，我必须得当好质疑者的角色。我和你保证，Yaribay 统领，质疑又或者玷污你的良好声誉，并不能给我带来任何乐趣。"

他讲得很真诚，有那么一瞬间，你都要觉得 $global.jethroName 没在撒谎了。

"你就把这当作 '信任，但要核实' 的流程吧。我们当然信你。但你的货源呢？我们肯定不希望看到你被人骗，但，唉，我太了解人心底的那些罪恶了...要说你有什么弱点的话，你唯一的弱点就是心肠太好，给赞助的时候太慷慨了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Menes begins to nod, especially as Bornanew hits the last part of his 'explanation'.

"Yes," he exhales, "I suppose you're right. I am, if anything, too giving. This was so true on Kazeron, where the resentful and dishonest sought to tear me down and entrap me in one scandal after another."

"Out here, the social environment is more rarified, more, dare I say it? Honest. Even if it is a hopeless backwater, I do try to illuminate the locals with the light of Kazeronian culture..."
texts.zh:
Menes 开始点头，尤其是在 Bornanew "解释" 到最后一部分时。

"嗯。" 他呼了口气，"你说得对，要说我的缺点，那就是我太乐于付出了。特别是在 Kazeron 那时，一群心怀怨恨、不诚实的人就总想着把我拉下马，搞出一桩又一桩丑闻来陷害我。"

"在这里的话，社会环境就更纯粹，人们也更...我能说质朴诚实吗？但就算这穷乡僻壤已经无可救药，我还是努力用 Kazeron 的文化之光来照亮这里的人..."

texts.en:
"Rayan Arroyo, you say?" Menes perks up. "Yes, I do believe I've met the man. An honest dealer. No-nonsense. Good head on his shoulders. Fantastic taste... have you met his tailor? Stars above, a wonder! I should have them cloned."

"Well," he nods to himself, "I admit this does change my perspective. You should have mentioned him before!"
texts.zh:
"你说 Rayan Arroyo？" Menes 精神一振。"对，我记得我见过那个人。他是个诚实的商人。做事干脆，头脑聪明...你见过他的裁缝吗？我的天，那可是个奇才！我真该把那人给克隆了。"

"嗯，" 他自顾自地点点头，"我承认，这确实改变了我的看法。你早该提到他的！"

texts.en:
He doesn't see the shock on Bornanew's face. "Is that so?" Menes asks, sounding pleased.

Bornanew quickly shakes his head, no, and makes a little cut-off motion with his hand.
texts.zh:
"是这样吗？" Menes 问道，他看上去很高兴，不过没注意到 Bornanew 脸上的震惊。

Bornanew 飞快地摇头，并且用手比了个 "不" 的手势，他想要制止你。

options.en: Absolutely. I wasn't supposed to tell, but it's why I'm here. (commit)
options.zh: 当然。我其实不应该告诉你的，但这就是我来这里的原因。 (坚持说谎)

options.en: No, no, just a little joke. My apologies. (back off)
options.zh: 不，不，开玩笑而已，抱歉啊。 (退让)

texts.en:
As you commit to the lie, Bornanew gives you a look of absolute weariness.

Menes turns to him, "This is true? This is why you're here, isn't it. The backing of the Church, of course!"

"Yes," Bornanew says robotically, his attempt at a pleasant countenance looks like an appalling mask of pain.

Even Menes seems to sense something is off. "Are you feeling well, Knight?" he asks. "Perhaps you aren't used to the quality of drink I serve."
texts.zh:
你坚持要说这个谎，Bornanew 则投来了极其疲惫的眼神。

Menes 转向他，"这是真的？所以你才会来，对吧。教会当然会支持了！"

"是的。" Bornanew 机械式地回应着，他试图挤出的愉快表情，看起来就像一张骇人的痛苦面具。

就连 Menes 也察觉到有点不对劲。"你不舒服吗，骑士？" 他问道。"难道是喝不太惯我准备的饮料？"

texts.en:
Bornanew closes his eyes, and you hear his sigh of relief.

Menes glances at him, giving a funny look, then back at you. "Ah, of course. Ha-ha." He clears his throat. "Odd folk, you spacers," he says as if to himself.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 闭上眼睛，你听到他如释重负地叹了口气。

Menes 瞥了他一眼，神情古怪，然后转回来看你。"啊，当然。哈哈。" 他清了清嗓子，自言自语一样地说道。"你们这些宇宙民啊，真是怪人。"

options.en: It does?
options.zh: 定了吗？

texts.en:
"Certainly! I'll have my secretary make the arrangements. But first - a toast to the start of what I am sure will be a bountiful partnership! Back to the party!"

"Even you," he slaps a hand on Bornanew's shoulder, pulling him along, "Surely you know how to celebrate a deal, my dour unbeliever? Perhaps not, so I'll show you!"
texts.zh:
"当然了！我会让我的秘书来安排。但，首先 —— 来为即将开启的、我确信会成果丰硕的合作干杯！回派对去吧！"

"就连你，" 他把手拍在 Bornanew 的肩膀上，拉着他往前走，"肯定也懂要怎么庆祝一笔交易吧，严肃的无神论者？可能你不懂，那我来教你！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You and Bornanew are hauled back into the party, and the small crowd regaled with insinuations about a 'large purchase' by an unnamed 'wealthy spacer captain'.

Menes grows less discreet, winking and nudging with each retelling - and with each additional round of drinks. His dutiful entourage joins in to toast a 'new business deal' and theorize about extensions to Menes' complex.

You can see the skinny man, Ulmus Pond, watching you. He has a particularly manic, piercing laugh.

It is some time before you are able to get a quiet word in with $global.jethroName.
texts.zh:
你和 Bornanew 被拉回派对上，一小群人被关于未透露姓名的 "富有太空舰长" 进行 "巨额采购" 的暗示给逗乐了。

Menes 越来越不拘小节，每次讲这事都挤眉弄眼、推推搡搡 —— 而且每喝一轮，他还会更张扬。他忠实的随从们也跟着起哄，为一笔 "新生意" 干杯，并猜测着 Menes 的庄园扩建计划。

你可以看到那个瘦骨嶙峋的男人，Ulmus Pond，他也盯着你，还发出了尤其疯狂且刺耳的笑声。

过了好一会儿，你才找到机会和 $global.jethroName 悄悄说上几句话。

options.en: What's your read on Pond?
options.zh: 你怎么看 Pond？

options.en: $global.jethroName. $global.jethroName, can you finish my drink? I can't.
options.zh: $global.jethroName，$global.jethroName，你能帮我喝完这杯吗？我喝不下了。

texts.en:
"He's a Pather agent," Bornanew says as if it were the most obvious thing in the world. He meets your look.

"We spoke briefly," he explains. "The circumstantial evidence is convincing enough, but it was his heretical understanding of theology which I found truly damning."

"I propose we retire from this, ah, celebration as soon as we can with the glove. Then investigate Pond."
texts.zh:
"他是个左径特工。" Bornanew 迎上你的目光，口中说得好像这是世界上最显而易见的事一样。

"我们简短地聊了几句。" 他解释道，"间接证据已经够有说服力了，但看他对神学的异端理解，我觉得真的可以锤死。"

"我觉得我们该赶快带着手套从这，嗯，庆祝活动中脱身。然后去调查 Pond。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
* * *

It is a feat of diplomacy that Bornanew manages to extract you as quickly as he does.

You have little difficulty playing up a state of stumbling drunkenness as Bornanew makes excuses, explaining that he will "pray for the captain's intemperance", much to the amusement of Menes' guests.

It is not your most dignified moment, but it ensures you can avoid the ritual of shaking everyone's hand, exchanging pleasant words, and going through the motions of good-byes.
texts.zh:
* * *

Bornanew 能这么快就把你捞出来，实属一项外交壮举。

你装都不用装就能走出步履蹒跚的醉态，Bornanew 则在为你找借口，解释说他会 "为舰长的酗酒祈祷"，把 Menes 的客人们都整乐了。

这大概算不上你最光彩的时刻，但它确实让你免了和每个人握手、寒暄以及走告别过场的仪式。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Um," Bornanew shifts uncomfortably.

"I... Yes, I can take that for you, captain." He carefully takes your drink from you without spilling, and then gently places it on a protruding piece of architecture.

"Did you bring any anti-inebriants? Perhaps we should get you back to your flagship. Here, just take my arm..."
texts.zh:
"呃。" Bornanew 不自在地动了动。

"我...行吧，舰长，我来帮你拿着。" 他小心翼翼地接过了你的酒杯，一点也没洒，然后轻轻地把它放到了旁边的一块建筑凸起上。

"你带解酒药没？我们该送你回旗舰了。来，扶着我的胳膊..."

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He scoffs. "What do you take me for, a simpleton Luddie farmer from Chalcedon?"

His eyes dart at Bornanew to see if this one landed. $global.jethroName appears to be looking toward another display in one of the side-rooms.

Menes turns back to you, his brow furrowed at Bornanew's impassiveness. "Come now, captain, I was told you're a serious spacer. Ruthless in battle and savvy in trade. Was I so misinformed?"
texts.zh:
他嗤之以鼻。"你把我当什么了？Chalcedon 上头脑简单的卢德佬农民吗？"

他瞟了一眼 Bornanew，想看看这话有没有效果。然而 $global.jethroName 一副正看着某个侧厅里另一件展品的样子。

Menes 转了回来，Bornanew 的无动于衷让他皱起眉头。"得了吧，舰长，我可听说你是个正经宇宙民。打仗勇猛，经商精明。难道我的情报出错了？"

texts.en: Something shines in Menes' eyes. "I speak hypothetically, of course," he says, "but I wouldn't begin to think of a sale for anything less than a million credits."
texts.zh: Menes 眼中亮起精光。"先说好，我只是假设一下，" 他说，"但如果不到一百万星币，我根本不会考虑把它卖掉。"

options.en: Outrageous. I couldn't imagine it's worth more than 800,000.
options.zh: 太离谱了。我怎么想都不觉得这东西能超过 80 万。

options.en: I'll consider a million. But only if it's real.
options.zh: 如果它是真货，那我会考虑出一百万。

texts.en: Menes sighs dramatically, "I suppose - and this is because I'm feeling charitable - I would entertain the notion of a mere 900,000 credits." He looks at you sharply, "And that's only because you're a fellow demarch."
texts.zh: Menes 夸张地叹了口气，"那我想 —— 这还是我突然想做慈善啊 —— 我可以考虑一下 90 万，区区 90 万。" 他目光锐利，"而且还因为你也是一位民选统领。"

texts.en: Menes sighs dramatically, "I suppose - and this is because I'm feeling generous - I would entertain the notion of a mere 900,000 credits." He looks at you sharply, "And that's only because you've a League commission. It's practically charity!"
texts.zh: Menes 夸张地叹了口气，"那我想 —— 这还是我突然想慷慨些 —— 我可以考虑一下 90 万，区区 90 万。" 他目光锐利，"而且还是因为你受雇于联盟。我已经是在做慈善了！"

texts.en:
Menes sighs dramatically. "What am I, a charity?"

"I suppose," he muses, "I suppose I'm in an oddly generous mood to even be discussing this."
texts.zh:
Menes 夸张地叹了口气。"你把我当什么了？慈善机构？"

"我觉得，" 他若有所思，"我觉得我今天真是够大方的，竟然会和你聊这个。"

options.en: You're practically a saint. Now the matter of veracity...
options.zh: 你可真是个圣人。那现在就是真实性的问题了...

options.en: You're practically a saint. Now the matter of veracity...
options.zh: 你可真是个圣人。那现在就是真实性的问题了...

options.en: You're practically a saint. Now the matter of veracity...
options.zh: 你可真是个圣人。那现在就是真实性的问题了...

texts.en: You think you hear a snort from Bornanew, but perhaps he just scuffed the floor.
texts.zh: 你好像听到 Bornanew 哼了一声，但也可能他只是用脚蹭了蹭地板。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "One million credits." Menes can't help but allow a glowing smile to break across his face.
texts.zh: "一百万星币。" Menes 没忍住，脸上露出了灿烂的笑容。

texts.en:
"Do you know what this is?" Menes whispers to you.

"It looks like a glove, demarch," Bornanew answers in feigned misunderstanding, stepping forward.
texts.zh:
"知道这是什么吗？" Menes 低声问你。

"这看起来像一只手套，统领。" Bornanew 走上前，就像没听懂似的回答道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Not any glove," Menes says with more than a hint of vexation.

He begins again in a reverent whisper, "The glove worn by Ludd upon stepping upon the sacred Earth of Gilead. Ludd removed the glove and kissed the ground, according to the Luddic religion. Isn't that right, sir Knight? And this... is it."

Bornanew looks at you, his eyebrows rising. "Could it be?" he asks, allowing some melodrama to enter his voice.
texts.zh:
"这可不是别的手套。" Menes 颇为恼火地说。

他又开始虔诚地低语，"这是 卢德 踏上 Gilead 的圣土时戴着手套。根据 卢德教 的说法，卢德 当时脱下手套亲吻了大地。对不对，骑士先生？而这...就是那只手套。"

Bornanew 看着你，眉毛微微扬起。"真的吗？" 他问道，声音里带上了一丝戏剧腔。

options.en: I'm impressed, Menes. A relic from a pivotal moment of the Sector's history!
options.zh: 我真是大吃一惊，Menes。这可是来自星域历史中一个关键时刻的圣物！

options.en: Call in the raid
options.zh: 呼叫劫掠

texts.en:
"Precisely my reaction upon first hearing word of this unique artifact!" Menes beams, more than a little pleased that someone appreciates his trinket.

"Setting aside its purely religious significance," he gives a glance at Bornanew, "it represents a, a heralding of the changing tides of history! The ebbing influence of the Domain-era megacorporations, the rising of what some call - not my words of course, sir Knight - an atavistic populism. Truly, it is this small piece of the vastness of the story of Humanity which called to me when it was first described to me..."

Menes seems prepared to continue this for quite some time.
texts.zh:
"我第一次听说这件独一无二的艺术品时，反应和你一模一样！" Menes 面露喜色，为有人欣赏他的小玩意儿而高兴起来。

"先不说纯粹的宗教内涵，" 他瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，"它还代表着...代表着历史潮流的转变！人之领时代 巨型企业的势力在衰退，而一些人所谓的返祖式民粹主义正在抬头 —— 这可不是我说的，骑士先生。说真的，当我第一次听到这样的描述时，我有感觉到，自己在被这人类浩瀚故事中的小小碎片呼唤着..."

Menes 似乎准备就这个话题滔滔不绝地说下去。

options.en: Call in the raid
options.zh: 呼叫劫掠

texts.en:
You glance at your comms. Everything has been planned ahead of time, and care taken to hide tactical teams among the general population of offworld crew taking a bit of shore-leave. Signal discipline has been unerring.

The coded response, hidden in routine status reports, shows all teams are prepped and ready to move.
texts.zh:
你瞥了一眼通讯设备。一切都提前计划好了，战术小队已经小心地混入了正在休假的外来船员中。信号纪律一直准确无误。

隐藏在例行的状态报告中的加密回应显示，所有小队都准备就绪，随时可以行动。
effects: AddRaidObjective genericIcon "Take the relic from Menes' compound" MEDIUM 3000 BFFIattendPartyRaidFinishedA true

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Pond laughs too loudly. "Dear Menes, where did you find such a fantastic character? Without you, I'm certain we'd all die of boredom out here."
texts.zh: Pond 笑得非常大声。"尊敬的 Menes，你从哪找来了这么有趣的人？没有你，我们肯定都会无聊死的。"

texts.en: Pond laughs a little too loudly. "Of course we've just met, but dear Menes spoke of a Knight from some unseemly background, and it's a tale which can't but seize the imagination, am I wrong?"
texts.zh: Pond 笑得有点太大声了。"我们当然是刚认识，但尊敬的 Menes 提到过一位出身不太体面的骑士，这个故事不由得让人浮想联翩，我说错了吗？"

texts.en: Pond's grin widens. "My thoughts are the same, and you know what they say about great-"
texts.zh: Pond 的笑容更灿烂了。"我的想法和你一样，你知道，人们常说英雄所见 ——"

texts.en: Pond's grin hardens ever so slightly. "I'm sure I'd be delighted to speak more later about-"
texts.zh: Pond 的笑容变得有些僵硬。"我很乐意稍后再多谈谈关于 ——"

texts.en: Pond laughs too loudly. "How odd! Dear Menes, where did you find such a fantastic character? I, for one, cannot wait to discover what this evening has in store."
texts.zh: Pond 笑得太大声了。"真奇怪！尊敬的 Menes，你从哪找来了这么有趣的人？就我个人而言，我迫不及待地想知道今晚要有什么好戏看了。"

texts.en:
Bornanew forces out the equivalent of a smile.

"Of course, captain." He turns to the man. "Pray forgive me, sir, my forgotten manners," he says.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 勉强挤出一个类似微笑的表情。

"当然，舰长。" 他转向那个男人，"先生，请原谅我，是我忘了礼数，" 他说。

texts.en: "May this day be blessed by Providence," he says.
texts.zh: "愿今日得上天赐福，" 他说道。

options.en: Shuttle down with Horus Yaribay to Menes' compound.
options.zh: 与 Horus Yaribay 一起搭乘穿梭机前往 Menes 的庄园。

texts.en:
Horus transfers to your $shipOrFleet in orbit, greeting you and Bornanew tersely then making little in the way of conversation.

Menes' invitation provides you with a flight path and Demarch-level traffic control override codes. Horus would certainly receive similar treatment had he declared his presence openly.

As it is, it's probably a violation of Persean League ethical guidelines for you to be using these to attend a personal party, but from what you can overhear of the pilot's comms, the locals have a casual attitude toward the arrangement.
texts.zh:
Horus 来到了你停泊在轨道$shipOrFleet中，简短地向你和 Bornanew 打了个招呼，然后就没怎么说话。

Menes 的邀请函为你提供了一条飞行路线，和统领级别的交通管制覆盖代码。如果 Horus 公开来访，他也能享受到类似的待遇。

就目前而言，你用这些代码去参加一个私人派对，很可能违反了 英仙座联盟 的道德准则，但从你无意间听到的驾驶员通讯来看，当地人对这种安排的态度很随意。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Menes Yaribay's compound is a scrubbed-looking slab of trendy architecture set on a bluff overlooking Olinadu's primary habitation cluster.

A smattering of outbuildings and hangars, attached by fat trunks of conduit and glowing walktubes, sprawl across the less-fashionable view-angles of the compound toward the refineries and holding tanks of the planet's industrial center.
texts.zh:
Menes Yaribay 的庄园是一片经过精心打理的时尚建筑群，坐落在一处悬崖上，俯瞰着 Olinadu 的主要居住区。

一些附属建筑和机库零零散散地分布在庄园不太显眼的角落里，粗大的管道和发光步道连接着它们，并且一直延伸向行星工业中心的冶炼厂和储油罐。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
One set of hangar bay doors dutifully open, and your shuttle descends through the glowing atmo-field. Such gadgetry is an ostentatious addition to a personal residence, but it avoids the bother of visitors (and their shuttles) having to undergo pressure-cycling.

An enthusiastic Menes is already approaching your shuttle's access ramp as it sets itself down and signals the all-clear.

Horus Yaribay puts out his hand in a 'you first' gesture.
texts.zh:
一扇机库门应声打开，你的穿梭机穿过闪耀的气场缓缓降落。这种装置对于私人住宅来说显得过于奢华，但它省去了访客 (和他们的穿梭机) 必须经历气压调节的麻烦。

当你的穿梭机降落并发出一切正常的信号时，热情的 Menes 已经走近了穿梭机的舷梯。

Horus Yaribay 伸出手，示意 "你先请"。

options.en: Meet Menes Yaribay
options.zh: 与 Menes Yaribay 会面

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName - with your Knight of Ludd! Let me welcome you both to my humble..."

As Menes sees Horus step off the shuttle his face contorts through a fascinating sequence of expressions before settling into an alarmed rictus of welcome.

"C-cousin Horus. What an unexpected surprise!"

Menes' eyes, watery with a minor aspect of terror, dart to yours then away before the accusation fully solidifies.
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长 —— 还有你的卢德骑士！欢迎你们光临寒..."

接着 Menes 就看到了走下穿梭机的 Horus，他的脸先是闪过一系列耐人寻味的表情，最后定格成了惊恐的僵笑来迎接他。

"H-Horus 堂兄。真是意外之喜！"

Menes 的眼睛因轻微的恐惧而湿润，他飞快地瞥向你，又在眼中那份指责成型前，匆忙移开了视线。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Horus' smile in return is cool as he steps forward to the offered hands with only one of his own. "Menes. Where has the last cycle gone? It feels as though your inaugural flight to Olinadu was just yesterday."

Menes manages to respond with an obliging laugh.

Bornanew, quite forgotten, follows you and the Yaribays.
texts.zh:
Horus 回以冷淡的微笑，他走上前，只用一只手去回应对方伸出的双手。"Menes。这年过得可真快啊，感觉你第一次动身来到 Olinadu 还是昨天。"

Menes 勉强挤出讨好的笑声作为回应。

完全被遗忘掉的 Bornanew，则跟在你和 Yaribay 氏族的两人后面。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Menes leads your party past gilded statues guarding the portal to the main complex; the forms are evocative of splashes of molten gold frozen by happenstance into sensual humanoid figures.

You watch as Horus, lean and intense as some small predator, endures the patter from Menes, a man of more generous form and character. Menes plays down the 'frontier quality' of renovations, the poor selection of artworks, the difficulty of accessing the best artists and engineering firms to contribute to his home in 'all but exile'.

Occasionally a robotic or human servitor appears to offer drinks or nibbles, and you've a growing feeling that Menes has picked up a glass from one only to place it back on the tray of another without ever taking a sip.

A fresh glass in hand, Menes tentatively leads Horus into what can only be his prize entertaining space.
texts.zh:
Menes 领着你们一行人走过了几尊守在主建筑入口前的鎏金雕像。雕像的造型宛如飞溅的熔金在机缘巧合之间凝成了千姿百态的性感人形。

你看着精干而凌厉的 Horus 就像一只小型猛兽一般，忍受着心宽体胖的 Menes 一直喋喋不休。Menes 轻描淡写地嫌弃着自家 "边陲质感" 的装潢和品味匮乏的艺术品，以及在他这 "形同流放" 的家里，想请到顶尖艺术家和工程公司相助是多么困难。

偶尔会有机器人或人类侍者出现，呈上饮品或小吃。但你越看越觉得 Menes 纯粹只是从托盘上拿起一杯酒，而后又放到另一个托盘上，自始至终一口都没喝过。

手中又换了一杯新酒后，Menes 试着将 Horus 领进他最引以为傲的主招待厅。

options.en: Follow
options.zh: 跟上

texts.en:
The space is at once cavernous and intimate; the sightlines and carved, wrought, or woven details calculated to replicate a feeling of cozy warmth like the den of some thoughtful patron of art, history, and literature.

A double handful of well-dressed remoras mill about, interrupting their conversations to turn as Menes enters. They look to be a collection of industrialists, financiers, distant gens-relatives, and at least one officer from atop the local military detachment who appears a little worse for his drink.
texts.zh:
这处空间既深邃又私密；无论是整体景致，还是雕刻、金工与织物的细节，无不历经考究，刻意营造出一种私密书房般的温馨舒适氛围，仿佛这的主人是某位在艺术、历史与文学上都造诣颇深的雅士。

十来个衣着光鲜的附庸四处走动，当 Menes 现身时，这些人纷纷停下交谈，转身相迎。他们看起来像是实业家、金融家、远房宗亲，以及至少一名来自当地驻军高层的军官，不过那位似乎已经有点醉意了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Most start to give a politic nod and wave of acknowledgement at Menes' entrance, but stop and stare as they recognize Horus at his side. Few eyes linger on you and Bornanew, who steps apart as though he were a mere assistant or servitor.

One skinny man in a finely embroidered suit is not put off by Horus' entrance, and rushes to greet your party, eyes agog mostly at the gens patriarch, but sparing a glance at least for the newest additions to Menes' collection.
texts.zh:
Menes 进来时，大多数人开始礼貌地点头挥手致意，但当他们认出他身旁的 Horus 时，就都停下了动作，转而直勾勾地看着他们。很少有目光停留在你和 Bornanew 身上，而后者只要往旁边一站，就仿佛只是个助理或侍者。

一个穿着精致刺绣西装的瘦高男人并没有被 Horus 的到来吓着，他冲过来迎接你们一行人，两眼放光，主要盯着氏族的族长，不过也瞥了一眼 Menes 的新藏品。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He nearly trips over himself to speak. "The great Horus Yaribay! Your reputation precedes you, if half of what-"

Horus holds up a hand, silencing the man, and turns aside. "Menes, what is this?"

"Ha- ha, ah, this is Ulmus Pond," Menes replies quickly, his drinkless off-hand waving to shoo Pond away. "Ulmus, not now. Perhaps see that Captain $playerLastName's Luddic friend here has a fresh drink? Thank-you."

"Now, cousin Horus, I must offer a thousand apologies." Menes himself turns, also cutting Pond out of the conversation. "Had you signalled ahead we could have arranged for a proper reception..."
texts.zh:
他急着要说话，都差点把自己绊倒了。"伟大的 Horus Yaribay！您的大名如雷贯耳，如果传闻有一半 ——"

Horus 抬手让那人安静下来，然后转向身侧。"Menes，这是怎么回事？"

"哈 —— 哈，啊，这是 Ulmus Pond。" Menes 赶紧回答，他挥了挥没拿酒杯的另一只手，想把 Pond 赶走。"Ulmus，现在不是时候。你可以先看看 $playerLastName 舰长的这位卢德朋友需不需要来杯喝的？谢谢你了。"

"好了，Horus 堂兄，我万分抱歉。" Menes 自己也转过身，同样把 Pond 排除在了对话之外。"如果你提前说一声，我们就能安排一场正式的招待会..."

options.en: Watch the fallout
options.zh: 静观其变

texts.en:
"Never mind that," Horus says, looking around with a displeased curl to his lip. His gaze slips over Pond like he's nothing.

Ulmus Pond, for his part, hides the evil look that crossed his face in that moment to slink after Bornanew.
texts.zh:
"别纠结那些了。" Horus 不满地撇撇嘴，环顾四周。他的目光从 Pond 身上扫过，仿佛他什么都不是。

Ulmus Pond 则强压下了那一瞬间掠过他脸上的邪恶神情，随后悄悄跟在 Bornanew 后面溜走了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName shall attend," Horus adds quietly. "So that we might fully resolve this matter."

"Of course, cousin, of course!" Menes, sweating, puts on a fragile grin in order to distribute reassuring nods to his extended entourage.

Menes leads you and Horus into his inner sanctum, flashing a grimace as he operates a series of obtrusive and, to your eyes, largely ornamental biometric checks.
texts.zh:
"$playerLastName 舰长也得出席。" Horus 轻声补充道。"这样我们才能彻底解决这件事。"

"当然，堂兄，当然！" Menes 汗流浃背，勉强挤出一丝笑容，以便他在向那庞大的随从队伍点头示意的时候，让他们安心下来。

Menes 带着你和 Horus 进入了他的密室，在操作那一系列繁琐、且在你看来很大程度上是装饰性的生物识别检查装置时，他面露苦涩。

options.en: Follow
options.zh: 跟上

texts.en:
The air cools by a degree, perhaps two, the armored mass of the walls felt as a dullness through your feet. The subdued lighting, drapery, and framing of the space suggest the interior of a bank vault or a shrine, though not to the praise of any Luddic virtue.

Quite the contrary, depending on one's outlook.
texts.zh:
空气的温度降低了一两度，厚重装甲墙壁的质量化作一股沉闷的质感从你的脚下传来。幽暗的灯光、帷幔以及整个空间的布局，让人联想到银行金库，或圣地的内部 —— 当然，这圣地并非是为了颂扬卢德主义的美德。

它与那完全相反，不过如何看待这一切，就见仁见智了。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
On a pedestal of carved wood, in a spot of light like holy revelation, a single glove is upthrust. Its fingers appear frozen in the midst of beginning to curl back toward a relaxed state after giving you a little wave.

After an appropriate pause, Menes speaks up, hopeful. "What do you think, cousin?"
texts.zh:
在木质雕花基座上，一束如同神启般的光芒中，一只手套赫然挺立。它的手指似乎凝固在刚刚向你挥了挥手后，正要蜷回放松状态的瞬间。

经过适当的停顿后，Menes 满怀希望地开口了，"你觉得如何，堂兄？"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"What's this supposed to be," says Horus, deadpan.

Menes clears his throat, then begins in a low, dramatic voice, "The glove worn by Ludd when stepping upon the sacred Earth of Gilead. Ludd removed the glove and kissed the ground, according to the Luddic's religion."
texts.zh:
"这是什么玩意儿？" Horus 面无表情地说道。

Menes 清了清嗓子，然后用低沉而浮夸的声音开口道，"这是卢德踏上 Gilead 的圣土时戴着的手套。根据 卢德教会 的说法，卢德当时脱下手套并亲吻了大地。"

options.en: And it's almost certainly a fake.
options.zh: 而这几乎可以肯定是假的。

texts.en:
Menes looks shocked.

Horus gives you a look of his own. "Of course it is," he says. "And here I thought only a Luddie would be foolish enough to believe in this sort of thing."

"Cousin!" Menes exclaims, appalled.

"Do not 'cousin' me!" Horus shouts, now, after an icy restraint held for so long.

"Remember how I saved you last time? The promises you made? And here, you've wasted stars-know how many credits on more nonsense, a bomb waiting to explode under the gens!"
texts.zh:
Menes 看上去很震惊。

Horus 别有深意地看了你一眼。"这当然是假的。" 他说。"我还以为只有卢德佬会傻到相信这种东西。"

"堂兄！" Menes 惊骇地喊道。

"别叫我 '堂兄'！" Horus 在顶着冰冷的表情克制了一路后，终于吼了回去。

"还记得我上次救了你的事吗？你做的保证呢？现在，你又为更蠢的事浪费了天知道多少星币，就弄回来了一颗埋在氏族脚底下的定时炸弹！"

options.en: Keep your mouth shut, for now
options.zh: 暂时闭上嘴巴

texts.en:
"What would Reynard Hannan do if he knew what you were up to here, do you think?"

Menes shakes his head, speechless.

"He would loose the Church on us! And their bloody-minded Pathers! Think, think for once, 'cousin'." Horus spits the word poisonously. "Think of anyone in the Sector aside from yourself. Think of your gens!"

"The Chu- Path?" Menes sputters pathetically. "If Captain $playerLastName said it's a fake, it shouldn't be-"

"Oh, so now it's a fake?" Horus cuts him off. "Enough! Here is what will happen."
texts.zh:
"你觉得，如果 Reynard Hannan 知道你在这里搞什么鬼，他会干出什么事来？"

Menes 摇了摇头，哑口无言。

"他会唆使教会来对付我们！还有他们那些丧心病狂的左径分子！你想想，你好好思考一次，'堂弟'。" Horus 恶毒地吐出这个词。"想想星域里除了你自己以外的任何人。想想你的族人！"

"教 —— 左径？" Menes 可怜地结巴道。"如果 $playerLastName 舰长说它是假的，那应该就没 ——"

"哦，你愿意承认它是假货了？" Horus 打断了他。"够了！接下来该这样做。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Captain $playerLastName and $playerHisOrHer pet Knight of Ludd shall take possession of the damnable trinket. Immediately. As a sign of good faith to our Luddic 'friends' in the Church of Galactic Redemption."

He gives you a look, "See that they appreciate what I've done for them."

Back to Menes. "From now on I am taking personal control of your accounts. No frivolities without approval from my office."

Menes begins to make a sound of objection but is cut off as Horus raises a single finger. A Reaper torpedo, armed and ready to launch into the unshielded breach.

"You and I," Horus says, "Shall continue our conversation in private." He doesn't turn to you again. "Captain, if you would kindly?"
texts.zh:
"$playerLastName 舰长和$playerHisOrHer的卢德骑士小跟班会马上拿走这个该死的玩意。来表达我们对 银河救赎教会 的卢德 '朋友们' 的诚意。"

他看了你一眼，"务必让他们懂得感激我为他们所做的一切。"

然后他又看向 Menes。"从现在开始，我要亲自控制你的账户。没有我办公室的批准，不得有任何不正经的开支。"

Menes 刚要出言反对，但 Horus 竖起一根手指就打断了他。就像一枚已经填装完毕的死神鱼雷，随时准备着射向护盾的缺口。

"你和我。" Horus 说，"我们得私下谈谈。" 他没有再看向你。"舰长，还请你回避。"

options.en: Take the glove
options.zh: 带走手套

texts.en:
Despite knowing what it is - or, rather, isn't - it feels almost like sacrilege to simply reach over to touch this object of such presumed expense and such evident disgrace. A vessel assigned such power and import, faith and violence, despite its reified deceit.

It is the glowing prize at the center of this temple, this shrine to the ego of Menes Yaribay bought with the lucre of the Kazeronian empire, fueled by faith and blood from over two hundred cycles since someone who took the name Ludd did something, probably, half-remembered then gilded in glorious myth on a planet named Gilead.
texts.zh:
尽管知道它是什么 —— 或者更确切地说，知道它不是什么 —— 但伸手去触碰这件已经蒙羞，只是仍被认为价值连城的物件，却依然像是亵渎神明。它承载着的能量和意义、信仰与暴力就是如此强大，哪怕它早已被物化，沦为了骗局。

它是这座神殿中心熠熠生辉的奖杯，这圣地供奉着 Menes Yaribay 的自负，由 Kazeron 帝国的财富铸就，而浇灌了它两百多星历年的信仰和鲜血，则来自于一个名为卢德的人在名为 Gilead 的星球上的所行之事，其记载大概已残缺不全，却在后来被镀上了辉煌的神话色彩。

options.en: Just take the glove already
options.zh: 直接带走手套

options.en: Hesitate
options.zh: 犹豫

texts.en:
As you touch it, a piercing alarm shatters the stillness of the treasury. Menes' hand slaps his other wrist with surprising speed. He raises it to his mouth to mumble a stand-down order to his security.

The alarm stops, leaving a painful echo in your ears.
texts.zh:
就在你摸到它的一瞬间，刺耳的警报声打破了密室的寂静。Menes 速度惊人，抬手拍向另一侧的手腕。然后他将手腕抬到嘴边，咕哝着向安保人员下令取消警报。

警报停止了，刺耳的余音在你耳中回荡着。

options.en: Tuck the glove into a pocket
options.zh: 把手套塞进袋子里

options.en: Carry it openly back to the party
options.zh: 光明正大地拿着它回到派对上

texts.en:
The cousins of Gens Yaribay watch you leave.

Horus' eyes are black. Menes's are red with betrayal.
texts.zh:
Yaribay 氏族的堂兄弟目送着你离开。

Horus 目光阴沉。Menes 则因遭到背叛而眼睛发红。

options.en: Make your way back to the party to find Bornanew and leave
options.zh: 回到派对，找到 Bornanew 然后离开

texts.en:
Everyone turns and the conversation goes silent as you return to the main room. Alone.

You spot Bornanew, cornered by the man Ulmus Pond whose voice rings out for two words over-loudly as he realizes the fact of your entrance a moment later than the others.

His eyes are huge and bulging, like a fish.
texts.zh:
你独自一人回到主厅，所有人都转过身来，谈话声戛然而止。

你发现了 Bornanew，他被那个叫 Ulmus Pond 的人堵在角落里。Pond 比其他人晚了一拍意识到你的出现，随即声音格外响亮地喊出了两个词。

他的眼睛又大又凸，就像条鱼。

texts.en:
Everyone turns to stare at you as the conversation goes silent the instant you return to the main room. Alone.

You spot Bornanew, cornered by the man Ulmus Pond whose voice rings out for two words over-loudly because he realized the fact of your entrance a moment later than everyone else. His eyes are huge and bulging, like a fish.

They seem to widen even more as Pond sees that you are simply holding Menes' prize relic. Bornanew, even, struggles to maintain his composure as he realizes what you have in your hands.
texts.zh:
你独自一人回到主厅，所有人都转头盯着你看，谈话声则戛然而止。

你发现了 Bornanew，他被那个叫 Ulmus Pond 的人堵在角落里。Pond 比其他人晚了一拍意识到你的出现，于是声音格外响亮地喊出了两个词。他的眼睛又大又凸，就像条鱼。

当 Pond 看到你就这么把 Menes 的宝贝圣物拿在手里时，他的眼睛好像睁得更大了。就连 Bornanew，也在意识到你手里拿着什么东西之后有些不淡定了。

options.en: Hello $global.jethroName. I think we should go now.
options.zh: 你好啊，$global.jethroName。我觉得我们该走了。

options.en: Hello $global.jethroName. I think we should go now.
options.zh: 你好啊，$global.jethroName。我觉得我们该走了。

texts.en:
Pond gapes, enhancing the piscine effect.

Bornanew places an untouched drink of something fizzy and golden into Pond's hand, then walks with you back toward the shuttle bay.

"I presume you have... it?" he asks quietly, eyes forward.
texts.zh:
Pond 瞠目结舌，显得更像条鱼了。

Bornanew 把一杯原封未动的金黄色气泡饮料塞进 Pond 手里，然后和你一起返回穿梭机泊位。

"你应该拿到了...那东西？" 他目视前方，轻声问道。

texts.en:
Pond gapes at you, furthering the piscine effect.

Bornanew places an untouched drink of something fizzy and golden into Pond's hand, then walks with you back to the shuttle bay.

"I think, perhaps," he says quietly, eyes forward, "that you should have put the glove somewhere out of sight."
texts.zh:
Pond 瞠目结舌，显得更像条鱼了。

Bornanew 把一杯原封未动的金黄色气泡饮料塞进 Pond 手里，然后和你一起返回穿梭机泊位。

"我觉得，大概，" 他目视前方，轻声说道，"你该把那只手套藏起来的。"

options.en: Yes.
options.zh: 对。

options.en: Yup. Have a look for yourself. (give him the glove)
options.zh: 是啊，你自己看看吧。 (把手套给他)

options.en: I do. Did you see their faces, $global.jethroName?
options.zh: 我拿到了，你看到他们的表情没，$global.jethroName？

options.en: Here, you take it.
options.zh: 来，给你拿着。

options.en: Perhaps you're right.
options.zh: 也许你是对的。

options.en: Maybe. But did you see their faces, $global.jethroName?
options.zh: 或许吧，但你看到他们的表情没，$global.jethroName？

texts.en: He simply nods, placing his hands together. He doesn't do anything more, but you swear he's praying.
texts.zh: 他只是点点头，双手合十。他没做别的动作，但你敢肯定他是在祈祷。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He accepts the glove, taking only a split second to suppress his look of shock. Bornanew quickly disappears the glove to some hidden pocket of his robes.

"I think, perhaps," he says in a whisper, "that should have remained hidden."
texts.zh:
他接过手套，只一瞬间就掩饰住了震惊的表情。Bornanew 迅速把它放进了长袍的某个隐秘口袋里。

"我觉得，大概，" 他低声说，"你该一直藏着它的。"

options.en: Perhaps you're right.
options.zh: 或许你是对的。

options.en: Don't worry. Menes is going to be on his best good behavior from here on out.
options.zh: 别担心，Menes 从今往后肯定会老实做人的。

texts.en: Bornanew spares you a single rueful look.
texts.zh: Bornanew 向你投来了一个怅然的眼神。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "I did," he says ruefully.
texts.zh: "我看到了。" 他怅然地说道。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: He accepts the glove, a little surprised, quickly placing it within some hidden pocket of his robes.
texts.zh: 他带着一丝惊讶接过了手套，然后迅速把它放进了长袍的某个隐秘口袋里。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The cousins of Gens Yaribay watch you leave.

Horus' eyes are cool, unblinking. Menes' are red with betrayal.
texts.zh:
Yaribay 氏族的堂兄弟目送着你离开。

Horus 目光冰冷，眼睛一眨不眨。Menes 则因遭到背叛而眼睛发红。

options.en: Make your way back to the party to find Bornanew
options.zh: 回到派对，找到 Bornanew

texts.en: The quiet of the air circulation looms. Horus clears his throat.
texts.zh: 寂静的弥漫让空气的流通声也清晰可闻，Horus 随即清了清嗓子。

options.en: Take the glove
options.zh: 带走手套

texts.en:
Horus snaps his fingers, summoning a tray, and selects something effervescent. He takes a slow sip, not allowing his expression to display any sort of pleasure in the act. It seems to him more like a necessary palate-cleanser.

"Show it to me," he says to Menes. An order.
texts.zh:
Horus 打了个响指，有人应声端上一个托盘，让他挑了一杯有气泡的饮品。他缓缓地抿了一口，并且没让任何愉悦的表情出现在脸上。对他来说，这更像是种必要的漱口水。

"让我看看那东西。" 他对 Menes 说，语气如下令一般。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
It takes longer than before to open the link. Menes' image flickers into being.

"Oh, Captain $playerName." He sets down a glass. "Have you quite completed your assessment of the... item?"
texts.zh:
建立链接的时间比以前长。Menes 的影像闪烁着成型了。

"哦，$playerName 舰长。" 他放下手中的杯子。"你检测完那个...物品了吗？"

texts.en:
It takes longer than before to open the link. Menes' image flickers into being.

"Captain $playerName," he pauses, looking down. "Don't let me delay your... assessment. I've entrusted you with quite a treasure."
texts.zh:
建立链接的时间比以前长。Menes 的影像闪烁着成型了。

"$playerName 舰长，" 他顿了一下，低下头。"别让我耽误了你的...检测。我可把那件珍宝托付你了。"

options.en: I'm still consulting with experts. Top experts.
options.zh: 我还在咨询专家。顶尖专家。

texts.en:
"Indeed? I suppose an object of such quality and... value," he emphasizes the word, "requires very careful examination."

He pauses, glancing down for a moment.

"I... I should hate to delay you. Though I am in no rush for the full payment of course, ha-ha." He laugh is unconvincing.
texts.zh:
"真的吗？我想，这样一个品质上乘而且...价值不菲的物件，" 他强调了这个词，"确实需要非常仔细的检查。"

他顿了一下，低头看了一眼。

"我...我可不想耽误你。当然，我也不急着要全款，哈哈。" 他的笑声很没说服力。

options.en: You wouldn't happen to know where I could find Ulmus Pond, would you?
options.zh: 你不会刚好知道我得去哪里才能找到 Ulmus Pond，对吧？

options.en: Use Bornanew's authority to meet with a nanoforge engineer
options.zh: 借 Bornanew 的权限面见纳米锻炉技师

texts.en:
Bornanew assists your comms officer in navigating through various levels of Church bureaucracy.

Before long, you have the senior nanoforge engineer of Asher on a comms-link.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 协助你的通讯军官，在教会的层层官僚机构中斡旋推进。

没过多久，你便通过通讯链接联系上了 Asher 的一位资深纳米锻炉技师。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Yes, hello? Uh, good day? I was told there was an investigation."

She seems to examine you through the link. "You don't look much like a Knight of Ludd."
texts.zh:
"喂？你好？呃... 日安？我听说这边正在进行一项调查。"

她似乎正透过通讯链接打量着你。"你看起来可不太像一名卢德骑士。"

options.en: I need an object analyzed. Very closely.
options.zh: 我需要对一件物品进行分析，要极其细致的那种。

texts.en:
"I see." $PersonName takes a moment more to examine you, humming to herself.

"Forensic material analysis. Skilled work." $HeOrShe frowns. "It won't be cheap."

She looks at some other display and starts tapping at an input. "You'll have to bring the sample down, of course."
texts.zh:
"明白了。" $PersonName 又打量了你片刻，嘴里轻轻哼着调子。

"法医级材料分析，这可是技术活。" $HeOrShe皱起眉头，"收费可不低。"

她看向另一个显示屏，开始在输入设备上操作起来。"当然，你得把样本送过来才行。"

options.en: Shuttle to the engineer's laboratory
options.zh: 前往工程师实验室的穿梭机

texts.en:
Bornanew's authority - that of the Archcurate Sophronia Jaspis, in truth - is as good with the local traffic authority as it is with the Manufactoria Guild bureaucrats.

Your shuttle descends into the atmosphere of Asher. The view shades toward a warm, murky gray as you descend through the stratospheric fines perpetually refreshed by towering dust storms. The display blots out entirely and switches to a false-rendering as you enter the lower atmosphere.

There is no hazard; the storms are impressive in scale but low in mass due to the deathly thin atmosphere.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 的权限 —— 说穿了，就是大祭司 Sophronia Jaspis 的权限 —— 在当地交通管理部门与制造业公会的官僚机构那里足以通行无阻。

你的穿梭机缓缓驶入 Asher 的大气层。随着穿越那片由巨型沙尘暴常年补给的平流层尘雾，窗外的景致渐渐晕染成一片温暖而浑浊的灰蒙之色。当进入低空大气层时，显示屏彻底黑屏，随即切换为模拟成像模式。

这并非什么危险状况。那些风暴虽然声势浩大，但因这颗星球的大气稀薄至极，其物质密度其实很低。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Senior Engineer Tanaica places the glove and its containment vessel onto a shelf which retracts into the towering white casing of the analysis suite. Transparent panes, probably diamond-matrix, reveal arcane inner workings.

She hits a command to evacuate the atmo from the sample slot, and sets a manipulator to extract the glove and place it on the scanning bed. All of this she performs with a casual ease born of practice. She speaks as she taps away at the control interface.

"If it came from a high-quality nanoforge like what the Heggies or League's got, this might not tell us much."

Some kind of protective barrier shunts down, hiding the glove from view. A holo of the glove emerges from a display unit, gaining resolution until a doppelganger rotates in the air before you.
texts.zh:
高级工程师 Tanaica 将手套及其密封容器放置在一个置物架上，置物架随即缩进了分析设备高耸的白色外壳中。几块透明面板，大概是金刚石方窗，展示出其精密的内部结构。

她按下指令，抽干了样本槽内的空气，又操控机械臂取出手套，将其放置到扫描台上。这一系列操作，她做得行云流水，显然是经验使然。她一边在控制界面上快速操作，一边开口说道：

"要是这手套出自像 霸主 或 英仙座联盟 那样的高质量纳米锻炉，这台设备可能也查不出什么名堂。"

一道防护屏障应声降下，将手套完全遮蔽。与此同时，一块显示屏投射出手套的全息影像，影像的清晰度不断提升，最终，一个与手套一模一样的立体投影在你眼前缓缓旋转。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Hm. Good output, this. But I'm thinking not good-perfect. Ludd...ics," her eyes dart at Bornanew, "No offense, but they don't go in for training much native talent. S'why you lot pay me."

"Anyway, when you get into really delicate products, your forge quality starts to matter. A work-rated vac-glove though?" She rolls her eyes. "This better be good."

The analysis suite is making some kind of humming sound, and there's a clunk. The engineer doesn't react, so neither do you. Her display erupts with numbers and icons, then something she does pulls a cutaway from the holo-glove, which scales as the rest of it disappears.

Another segmentation of scale iterates, then another.
texts.zh:
"嗯。分析结果不错，不过还不算完美无缺。卢德...教会，" 她飞快地瞥了 Bornanew 一眼，又补充道，"无意冒犯，但他们向来不怎么注重培养本土人才。这也是你们这些人花钱雇我的原因。"

"话说回来，要是分析那些真正高精尖的产品，锻炉的工艺水准就很关键了。可这玩意儿不过是一只工业级的真空手套？" 她翻了个白眼，"希望这东西值得我费这番功夫。"

分析设备发出一阵嗡嗡声，随即传来 "咔嗒" 一声。工程师对此毫无反应，你便也不动声色。她面前的显示屏瞬间被密密麻麻的数字和图标铺满，紧接着，她操作了一番，手套的全息投影上便浮现出剖面视图；随着投影的其他部分逐渐隐去，这个剖面的比例也随之放大。

投影的剖面缩放与分割又进行了一次，紧接着是新一轮的迭代。

options.en: Watch closely
options.zh: 靠近观察

texts.en:
"We can see signs of what we call 'drift' here," she says. A colored indicator ring flashes around an orderly pattern of small-scale structures deep within the glove, the representation of individual atoms, perhaps, just visible like the grain of sandstone.

"These defects are unique to the faults in an individual nanoforge. More or less."

"Like a fingerprint," Bornanew says.

"No." The engineer shrugs. "But sure, if you like."
texts.zh:
"我们能在这儿观测到我们所说的 '偏移痕迹'。" 她说道。手套内部深处，一片排列规整的微结构外围，一圈彩色指示环正不停闪烁；这些微结构大概就是单个原子的映射，如同砂岩的颗粒一般，隐约可见。

"这些缺陷应当是专属某台缺陷纳米锻炉的特征。"

"就像指纹一样。" Bornanew 说道。

"不一样。" 工程师耸耸肩，"不过嘛，你要这么理解也无妨。"

options.en: What's this tell us?
options.zh: 这说明了什么？

texts.en:
"Someone's been naughty," she says, sounding more delighted than upset. "The glove is new, but the model is old. A closed-source pre-Collapse template. There are fabrication-rights codes embedded in its structure."

With a tap, another colored indicator ring flashes on a sheared-square section of material containing a complex pattern. "Tells the forge not to make unauthorized copies."

"Closed products from the Domain-era tend to be far higher quality than forges running post-Collapse hacks." She smiles, "This isn't that, but it's close. Tells us two things."
texts.zh:
"有人从中捣鬼了嘛。" 她语气里的愉快多过不悦。"这手套是新的，但型号早就过时了。是 大崩塌 前的闭源模板。它的结构里还嵌着制造授权码呢。"

她轻轻一点，在一块带有复杂纹路的方形裁切材料上，又一圈彩色指示环亮了起来。"这是用来避免锻炉进行未授权复制的。"

"大崩塌前 人之领 的闭源产品，质量可比大崩塌后那些靠破解程序运行的锻炉造出来的东西好得多。" 她笑了笑，"这玩意儿虽然比不上那些正品，但也差不多了。这也说明了两件事。"

options.en: Which are?
options.zh: 具体点？

texts.en:
"One, this was made by an industrial-grade Domain-era forge. Heavy industry stuff. Bit of a waste to use it to make a glove," she glances at you, "If you ask me."

"Two, either this forge is loaded with valid fabrication rights and it's damaged, or it's been hacked to bypass the embedded copy protections. And it's damaged. I mean, stars and ruin, look at this mess," she zooms in on the 'drift' patterns while making a disgusted look.

$global.jethroName speaks up now, "Three, we're dealing with a sophisticated forgery operation."

The engineer shoots a look back at him, "Neat."
texts.zh:
"第一，这东西出自一台旧的人之领时期的工业级锻炉。妥妥的重工业设备。用它来造一只手套，多少有点大材小用了，" 她瞥了你一眼，补充道，"反正我是这么觉得的。"

"第二，这台锻炉要么是内置了合法制造授权，只是本身已经损坏；要么就是被人破解了，强行绕过了预装的防复制保护机制。但不管怎样，它肯定是坏了。不是我夸张，你瞧瞧这乱七八糟的样子。" 她一边放大那些 "偏移痕迹" 的纹路，一边露出嫌恶的表情。

$global.jethroName 这时开口说道，"第三，我们这是遇上了一桩手法高超的造假案。"

工程师回头瞥了他一眼，只淡淡说了句，"还不赖。"

options.en: What forge made this? Where's it from?
options.zh: 这是哪台锻炉造的？它出自哪里？

texts.en:
"Right," she manipulates the interface again.

The drift-pattern from the glove remains locked, and she brings up similar - but distinct - examples of patterns in an expanding grid. Small labels show a string of glyphs, most of which contain the names of industrial combines, shipyards, and polities known to you. Some you recognize as dating to the Collapse. Others are unfamiliar.

"This is the drift library we've got here on Asher. Useful stuff, but other factions got better."
texts.zh:
"当然，" 她再次操作起界面。

保持锁定着手套上的偏移纹路，她又调出了一系列相似却又截然不同的纹路样本，如网格般不断铺开出去。每个样本旁的小型标签显示着一串符号，其中绝大多数标注的都是你熟知的工业联合体、船厂与政权的名称。有些轨迹你一眼便能认出，可追溯至大崩塌时期；还有些则从未见过。

"这是 Asher 的偏移纹路数据库。虽说内容还算实用，但其他势力手里的资料可比这强多了。"

options.en: So you can match the 'drift' to the forge.
options.zh: 所以你能把这些 '偏移痕迹' 和对应的锻炉对上号？

texts.en: "Exactly," she's pleased that you put it together. "Got bad news though, cap. Your glove doesn't match anything in this library."
texts.zh: "正是如此。" 见你反应过来，她面露喜色，"不过有个坏消息要告诉你，舰长。你那只手套和资料库中的任何记录都对不上。"

options.en: Can drift be obscured, faked?
options.zh: 偏移痕迹能否被隐藏、伪造？

options.en: So it's not a known forge.
options.zh: 这么说，这并非出自某个已知的锻炉。

texts.en: "Could be," she admits. "Takes a clever setup and a talented operator though. If this is fake drift, then it goes real high up. Don't know who'd be capable of it that'd waste that kind of effort on a glove."
texts.zh: "有这个可能。" 她坦言，"但这需要精密的设备和经验老道的操作人员。如果这个偏移痕迹是伪造的，那幕后之人的来头可不小。我实在想不通，究竟是谁会不惜耗费这般心力，在一只手套上大做文章。"

options.en: Can drift be obscured, faked?
options.zh: 偏移痕迹能否被隐藏、伪造？

options.en: So it's not a known forge.
options.zh: 这么说，这并非出自某个已知的锻炉。

options.en: Anything else?
options.zh: 还有其它线索么？

texts.en:
"Maybe, maybe not," she says.

"The Church doesn't put much into material analysis. What you'd do, ideally, is collect statistically significant samples, run scans on every new product that shows up, put anything interesting through a detailed scan like this, build a library. It's not cheap," she says wistfully.

"But here they're mostly interested in making sure their hyperdrives work to min-spec. The Church of No-fun." She looks at Bornanew, "Sorry."

He nods, untroubled.
texts.zh:
"有可能，也可能没有。" 她说道。

"教会在物质分析方面投入甚少。理想情况下，你应该收集具有统计学意义的样本，对每一款新问世的产品进行扫描检测，将所有可疑物品都拿来做这种精细扫描，进而建立起一套完备的资料库。这法子可一点都不便宜。" 她不无怅惘地补充道。

"但在这儿，他们关心的多半只是确保超光速引擎能达到最低性能标准。无趣的教会。" 她看向Bornanew，补了一句："抱歉。"

Bornanew点了点头，神色淡然，并未介怀。

texts.en:
"That's all I got, captain," she says, reversing the specimen insertion procedure and returning your containment vessel. "Good mystery. Hope it doesn't get you shot."

She hands the vessel to Bornanew, then claps her hands together. "That'll be 10,000 credits."
texts.zh:
"我这边能查到的就这些了，舰长。" 她说着，将样本取出装置恢复至初始状态，随即将你的密封容器递了回来。"这案子可真是够离奇的。但愿你别因此惹祸上身，落得个被灭口的下场。"

她把容器交给 Bornanew，随后拍了拍手。"承惠 10000 星币。"

options.en: $global.jethroName?
options.zh: $global.jethroName?

options.en: Uh...
Of course. (pay)
options.zh: 好的。 (付钱)

options.en: You serve the Church. Is this not corruption, $jethroName?
options.zh: 你效力于教会，这难道不算是腐败吗，$jethroName？

texts.en:
He recovers quickly. "I, of course," he awkwardly hands the ersatz reliquary to you then draws an off-brand datapad from his robes. Engineer $personLastName blinks at it.

"I can pay from the, uh, accounts of The Reverend Archcurate Sophronia Jaspis... here."
texts.zh:
他很快镇定下来。"当然，由我来付。" 他略显局促地将那件仿制圣物匣递给你，随即从长袍里掏出一个杂牌数据平板。工程师 $personLastName 见状，不由得眨了眨眼。

"我可以... 呃，从宗师大人 Sophronia Jaspis 的账户里支取，喏，这样。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You return to your shuttle.

Bornanew's attention is uncharacteristically focused on his datapad. He's making his 'thinking face'.
texts.zh:
你回到了自己的穿梭机上。

Bornanew 一反常态地盯着他的数据平板，脸上挂着那副标志性的 '沉思表情'。

options.en: Out with it, $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 有话直说，$global.jethroName。

texts.en:
"Ulmus Pond," he says. Then looks up at you.

"That strange little man from Menes Yaribay's party. Obviously an agent for the Luddic Path. That the Path would have eyes and influence on Menes is no surprise. But if he's the one that supplied the glove..."

"We need to get to him," he says. "Confront him. Compel him to talk."
texts.zh:
"Ulmus Pond。" 他开口道，随即抬眼望向你。

"就是 Menes Yaribay 团队里那个古怪的小个子男人。他显然是 卢德左径 的特工。卢德左径 能在 Menes 的地盘安插眼线、培植势力，这一点并不奇怪。但如果那只手套是他提供的..."

"我们必须找到他，"他语气笃定，"当面对质，逼他开口。"

texts.en:
"Ulmus Pond," he says. Then looks up at you. "He's a Pather agent," Bornanew says as if it were the most obvious thing in the world.

"We spoke briefly at Menes' party," he explains. "The circumstantial evidence is convincing enough, but it was his heretical understanding of theology which I found truly damning."

"We need to get to him," he says. "Confront him. Compel him to talk."
texts.zh:
"Ulmus Pond。" 他开口道，随即将目光投向你。"他是 卢德左径 的特工。" Bornanew 的语气，仿佛是在说一件再显然不过的事。

"我们在 Menes 的宴会上有过短暂交谈。" 他解释道，"种种旁证本就足以令人信服，但真正让我确定他有罪的，是他那套离经叛道的神学谬论。"

"我们必须找到他。" 他语气坚决，"当面对质，逼他开口。"

options.en: Guess we're going back to Olinadu.
options.zh: 我猜我们得回趟 Olinadu 了。

options.en: Guess we're going back to Olinadu.
options.zh: 我猜我们得回趟 Olinadu 了。

texts.en:
"Guess so," he replies. "We may not wish to draw any attention from Menes, of course..."

The shuttle docks with your flagship.
texts.zh:
"我想可以，"他回答道。"我们可不想引起 Menes 的注意..."

穿梭机与你的旗舰对接。

texts.en:
"Guess so," he replies. "But perhaps... Menes' might not be pleased to see us show up."

The shuttle docks with your flagship.
texts.zh:
"我想可以，"他回答道。"只是...Menes 见到我们估计不会给我们好脸色。"

穿梭机与你的旗舰对接。

options.en: I'll handle it. I can be very discreet.
options.zh: 我来接手。我会谨慎行事。

options.en: I'll handle it. I can be very persuasive.
options.zh: 我来接手。我向来擅长说服别人。

texts.en: You step off the shuttle.
texts.zh: 你走出穿梭机。

texts.en:
She looks between you and Bornanew.

"Didn't you tell your captain about the fee?" She asks.

You'd swear, Bornanew is almost blushing.
texts.zh:
她的目光在你和 Bornanew 之间游移。

"你没跟你们舰长说费用的事吗？" 她开口问道。

你敢肯定，Bornanew 这会儿脸在泛红了。

texts.en:
You transfer the credits to Senior Engineer Tanaica's accounts while $global.jethroName holds the vessel.

Presumably she'll forward payment for lab expenses to the Church-approved Manufactoria Guild.
texts.zh:
在 $global.jethroName 保管容器的间隙，你将星币转入了高级工程师 Tanaica 的账户。

想必她会把这笔实验收入转交给教会认可的制造业公会。

texts.en:
You transfer the credits to Senior Engineer Tanaica's accounts while $global.jethroName holds the vessel.

Presumably she'll forward payment for lab expenses to the Church-approved Manufactoria Guild. Or not.
texts.zh:
在$global.jethroName 保管容器的间隙，你将星币转入了高级工程师 Tanaica 的账户。

想必她会把这笔实验收入转交给教会认可的制造业公会。或许吧。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
His neutral expression flickers.

"I... yes, the captain is correct. You are paid to serve the Church, and this," he hefts the ersatz reliquary, "is business of the Church."

"Right you are," says Senior Engineer Tanaica through a tight smile. "Good day, captain."

Her eyes flick at Bornanew. "Novice."
texts.zh:
他面无表情的神色掠过一丝波动。

"我...没错，舰长说得对。你领受薪俸，本就是为教会效力，而这个，" 他掂了掂那件仿制圣物匣，"正是教会的公事。"

"说得对。" 高级工程师 Tanaica 笑容紧绷地应道，"日安，舰长。"

她的目光扫过 Bornanew，吐出几个字："见习修士。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew's tone was righteous, but without heart. You suspect he was not going to make an issue of the 'payment' until you brought it up.

As you return to your shuttle he gives you a look- guilt?

"Such things are not uncommon even in the shadow of the Church," he says. "And elsewhere. I'm sure you well know."

Bornanew returns his attention to his datapad. He's making his 'thinking face'."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 的语气听似义正词严，实则毫无诚意。你暗自揣测，若不是你主动提起，他根本不打算就这笔 '酬金' 的事多说一个字。

你们返回穿梭机的途中，他投来一道复杂的目光 —— 是愧疚吗？

"即便是在教会的眼皮子底下，这类勾当也算不上稀罕事，" 他开口说道，"放眼其他地方更是屡见不鲜。我相信你对此心知肚明。"

说罢，Bornanew 便将注意力重新落回数据平板上，脸上摆出了他那副标志性的 '沉思神情'。

options.en: Out with it, $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 有话直说，$global.jethroName。

texts.en:
The comms signal hits a holding signal and waits. And waits. You have your comms officer take over to watch the link and make a few inquiries.

Within minutes, a comms request alert appears. It's Bornanew on an internal link.
texts.zh:
通讯信号接入等待信道，陷入漫长的等待。你吩咐通讯军官接手监控链路，并去询问相关情况。

短短几分钟后，一则通讯请求提示弹了出来。是 Bornanew 通过内部链路发来的。

options.en: Open the comm link
options.zh: 打开通讯链接

texts.en:
"Captain," he says. "I apologize for the interruption."

"Ulmus Pond is not on Olinadu."
texts.zh:
"舰长，" 他开口道，"抱歉打扰你。"

"Ulmus Pond 不在 Olinadu。"

options.en: You're sure. How do you know this?
options.zh: 你确定？你是如何得知此事的？

texts.en: "The Knights have... sources," he says carefully. "I am sworn not to reveal them."
texts.zh: "骑士团自有...渠道。" 他措辞谨慎，"我发过誓，绝不会泄露这些秘密。"

options.en: Your oath. Of course.
options.zh: 你的誓言。难怪。

texts.en:
"Yes." Bornanew clears his throat.

"The word is that he has fled to Chalcedon on a tramp freighter, a smuggler, known to move materiel for the Luddic Path."
texts.zh:
"没错。" Bornanew 清了清嗓子。

"情报显示他已搭乘一艘走私货船逃往 Chalcedon，那艘船负责为 卢德左径 运送物资。"

options.en: Does an innocent man run?
options.zh: 清白的人怎么会逃跑？

options.en: Then we follow.
options.zh: 那我们就追。

texts.en: He turns his head. "He might, if he had to. But I suspect that Ulmus is not an innocent man."
texts.zh: 他转过头来。"若是迫不得已，他或许会这么做。但我怀疑 Ulmus 并不无辜。"

texts.en: "I pray that if we move quickly, we can find him on Chalcedon."
texts.zh: "但愿我们动作够快，能在 Chalcedon 找到他。"

options.en: Nav, set a course.
options.zh: 领航官，设定航线。

options.en: What's Ulmus Pond's role? What does finding him do for us?
options.zh: Ulmus Pond 扮演了什么角色？找到他对我们有什么用？

options.en: What if these are pirates, or a major faction misleading us?
options.zh: 要是这些是海盗，或者是某个主要势力在误导我们呢？

options.en: Before we act, let us speak of your Knights' 'sources'.
options.zh: 动手之前，咱们先说说你们骑士的 '资源'。

options.en: Could your queries have revealed our intentions?
options.zh: 你的那些打探会不会已经暴露了我们的意图？

texts.en:
Nav responds instantly to your orders.

Bornanew's image flickers with compression-grain from his cheap datapad.

"I pray that Ulmus Pond's hasty flight has not unwittingly forewarned heretic militants..."
texts.zh:
导航系统即刻响应了你的指令。

Bornanew 的影像因他那台廉价数据平板的压缩而失真，不断闪烁着噪点。

"希望 Ulmus Pond 这次仓促出逃没有在无意间惊动那些异端武装..."

options.en: If we're quick, we won't need to pray. (cut the link)
options.zh: 要是动作够快，我们就不需要 '但愿' 了。 (切断通讯)

texts.en: "He would be - have been - well placed as a bridge for some element of the Luddic Path to influence Menes Yaribay. He would be the source of the relic."
texts.zh: "他能够 —— 或者已经成为 —— 卢德左径 中某些人影响 Menes Yaribay 的绝佳桥梁。他就是那件圣物的源头。"

texts.en: "It could be either." Bornanew folds his hands together. "But we must look first where the light of truth shines brightest, dim though it may be, or known only by distinction against the shadow of deceit."
texts.zh: "两种情况都有可能。" Bornanew 双手交握，"但我们必须先看向真相之光最亮的地方 —— 即便它微弱不堪，或是只能在欺骗的阴影衬托下才显露出轮廓。"

texts.en:
"I cannot," he says. "But I assure you they are as reliable as any heretic, guilty soul, or criminal." His look softens, "Do trust that I am not simply asking around a spacer bar for a lead."

A moment, then he gives a nod, almost a bow. "Um. I do not condemn your methods. Your directness has oft proven effectual."
texts.zh:
"我不能保证，" 他说道，"但我可以告诉你，这些资源，和任何异端或是罪犯一样可靠。" 他的语气缓和下来，"你放心，我可不是在太空酒吧里随便打听线索。"

顿了顿，他微微点头，近乎躬身致意："呃，我不是要指责你的做法。你这种直来直去的方式，向来都很管用。"

texts.en:
"It is always possible." Bornanew meets your eyes, steady. "The Knights pursue heretics and criminals as routine, and my inquiries were worded to imply my interest lay not upon Ulmus Pond himself, nor the Menes situation. Though, of course, you and I are already known to be associated with both."

"Expediency anticipates risk. I beg you trust my judgment in this matter."
texts.zh:
"这种可能性一直存在。" Bornanew 目光坚定地与你对视，"骑士追捕异端和罪犯本就是例行公事，我提问时特意措辞，让人觉得我的关注点既不在 Ulmus Pond 本人身上，也不在 Menes 的事态上。但你我与这两者的关联，显然早已是人尽皆知。"

"想要高效行事必须考虑风险。还请你相信我在这件事上的判断。"

options.en: Find where Ulmus Pond is hiding
options.zh: 寻找 Ulmus Pond 正藏在哪儿

texts.en:
Chalcedon rotates in the primary display before you.

Bornanew is at your side, tapping at his off-brand datapad, looking for all the worlds like a toy in his large hands.

"My sources indicate that a man matching the description of Ulmus Pond is almost certainly in a safehouse... here."

A highlighted point appears on the globe, some logistical center in the scablands trailing like a stain from the primary spaceport.
texts.zh:
Chalcedon 在你面前的显示屏上缓缓转动。

Bornanew 就站在你旁边，手指在他那台杂牌数据平板上不停操作，这玩意儿在他宽大的手掌里，看着活脱脱就是个小玩具。

"我的渠道查到，有个和 Ulmus Pond 长相吻合的人，大概率藏在一处安全屋里... 喏，就在这儿。"

星图上立刻跳出一个高亮标记点，位置在痂地荒原的一处后勤中心 —— 这片荒原从核心空港外蔓延开，看着就像块甩不掉的污渍。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew watches the point as the globe obligingly comes to a gentle stop. The highlighted section detaches from the globe, which collapses away, and spreads into a tactical overview.

"He acts like a man drowning, grasping for help without concern for his rescuers." He turns from the globe toward you, "In OPSEC terms, of course. He could have easily disappeared."

A bitter smile appears, "As once I did."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 注视着那个标记点，星图随即很配合地缓缓停了下来。高亮区域从星图上分离出来，星图则随之隐去，展开成一幅战术总览图。

"他现在的样子就像个溺水的家伙，只顾着拼命去抓救命稻草，根本不管伸手拉他的人是谁。" 他从星图前转过身面向你，补充道，"当然，从 OPSEC 的角度来说，他本可以轻轻松松就销声匿迹的。"

一丝自嘲的笑意浮现在他脸上，"就像我当年一样。"

options.en: Tactical, prep a shuttle. Let's have a chat with Ulmus Pond.
options.zh: 战术军官，准备一艘穿梭机。我们去会会 Ulmus Pond。

texts.en:
Bornanew has his notebook and cheap old datapad packed in a satchel made of what looks like leather. You've heard of the primitive process the Luddics are said to use to produce the material; the skin of an animal is stripped then stewed, somehow, with its own waste products. It sounded unbearably primitive when described. Anti-Luddic misinformation, perhaps, because you don't detect the smell of feces at all.

"How shall we approach this?" Bornanew asks. "Like in MuniSec dramas- one of us is friendly to the subject, the other hostile?"
texts.zh:
Bornanew 把他的笔记本和一台廉价的旧数据平板，都装进了一个看似皮质面料的挎包里。你曾听说过 卢德教会 制造这种材料的原始工艺：他们会剥下兽皮，再用某种方式将兽皮与动物自身的排泄物一同熬煮。当初听到这种说法时，只觉得这工艺粗陋得令人难以忍受。不过这或许是反卢德派的不实传言，因为你此刻丝毫没有闻到粪便的臭味。

"我们该从哪着手？" Bornanew开口问道，"就像地方安全部的剧里演的那样，一个唱红脸，一个唱白脸？"

options.en: I'll be the bad guy.
options.zh: 我来唱白脸。

options.en: You be the bad guy.
options.zh: 你去唱白脸。

texts.en: Bornanew nods. Perhaps you're imagining it, but is that relief in the set of his eyes?
texts.zh: Bornanew 点了点头。或许只是你的错觉，但他的神情里，是不是藏着一丝释然？

texts.en: Your personal security team has been briefed, and are dressed as a mix of common spacers, local techs, and Luddic laborers. Their arsenal is multitude and well-concealed.
texts.zh: 你的私人安保小队已经接受过任务指示，队员们的装扮各不相同，有的扮成普通太空船员，有的化身本地技术员，还有的则伪装成卢德教派的劳工。他们携带的武器种类繁多，且都藏匿得十分隐蔽。

texts.en: Your own hand finds your trusty sidearm, a matte polycarbonate pistol. An ideal firearm for use in tight spaces, its mass rests securely in your holster.
texts.zh: 你伸手握住腰间那把得心应手的随身武器 —— 一把哑光聚碳酸酯材质的手枪。这枪特别适合在狭窄空间内使用，此刻正稳稳地嵌在枪套里。

texts.en: You, of course, have your clutch of devilish little grenades built to resist milliradar detection. Fearful and unexpected, they trigger with a practiced twitch from your hand.
texts.zh: 当然，你还揣着几枚小巧却致命的特制手雷，这种手雷能躲开毫米波雷达的探测。只需你手指熟练一动，它们便会出其不意地引爆，叫人防不胜防。

texts.en: And you have hidden a vicious ceramic vibroknife on your person. It is not a tool to be underestimated, for when deployed by surprise it can even disable light power-armored opponents.
texts.zh: 你身上还藏着一把锋利无比的高周波陶瓷匕首。这绝非一把可以小觑的武器 —— 一旦出其不意地用出，即便是身着轻型动力装甲的对手，也能被它一击制伏。

texts.en: You are protected by a subtler weapon, a tiny capsule of spray-poison within your cuff. Hold your breath as it is deployed with a casual wave, and the target next to you will simply die as if of a massive, unexpected heart-attack.
texts.zh: 你还藏着一件更隐蔽的武器 —— 袖口处的一个微型毒液喷雾胶囊。只需不动声色地挥下手，同时屏住呼吸，身旁的目标便会当场毙命，仿佛死于一场突发的急性心脏病。

texts.en: You, of course, have a monomolecular wire hidden in a false fingertip, ready to deploy into an invisible cutting edge with but a short, sharp twist. It is a venerable weapon favored by assassins of a certain class.
texts.zh: 当然，你的仿生指尖里还藏着一根单分子丝 —— 只需短促而用力地一转，它就能伸展开来，化作一道无形的利刃。这是一件备受刺客青睐的经典武器。

texts.en: You, of course, need trust nothing more than your limbs. Starship combat is mass and energy applied at scale; absurdly reduced to the scale of the human body, the mechanics applied are not completely dissimilar.
texts.zh: 当然，你最该信任的，莫过于自己的四肢。星舰的战斗，本质是宏观层面的质量与能量运用；而将这套运作机制缩小到人类躯体的尺度，二者的原理也并非全然不同。

texts.en: Your hand finds the hilt of your officers' sword at your side, the mass of a steel blade a comfort shared with warriors dating to the primitive conflicts of Old Earth.
texts.zh: 你伸手握住腰间的军官佩剑剑柄，钢制剑身沉甸甸的分量，恰似一份自旧地球原始冲突起，便为历代战士所共有的慰藉。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You stand with Bornanew in an uncomfortably narrow alley. The sky above sends nasty rivulets of fluid down the conduits and moldy canopies that diffuse the light into a flattening murk.

Your security team is invisible, discreet in nearby alcoves and rooftops.

$global.jethroName runs his hands over a door, as if feeling under it's moisture-warped surface for a clue.
texts.zh:
你与 Bornanew 站在一条狭窄得令人不适的巷道里。顶上的天空将污浊的流体沿管道与霉变的雨棚滴落，将光线散射成一片单调的昏蒙。

你的安保小队隐没在附近的壁龛与屋顶，悄无声息。

$global.jethroName 双手抚过一扇门，仿佛是在潮湿变形的表面之下探寻线索。

texts.en: "Ready, captain?" he asks. "Remember, you're the good guy."
texts.zh: "准备好了，舰长？" 他问。"记得，你是唱红脸的。"

texts.en: "Ready, captain?" he asks. "Remember, you're the bad guy."
texts.zh: "准备好了，舰长？" 他问。"记住，你是唱白脸的。"

options.en: I'm ready.
options.zh: 我准备好了。

options.en: You're sure he's here?
options.zh: 你确定他在这儿？

options.en: Don't you forget it.
options.zh: 你可别忘了。

options.en: You're sure he's here?
options.zh: 你确定他在这儿？

texts.en: Bornanew takes a step back then slams a powerful leg into a worn spot, about waist-high. With a sharp crack, the entire door falls inward, crumbling hinges and locking mechanism still attached.
texts.zh: Bornanew 后退一步，随即以强劲的腿力猛踹门上一处约齐腰高的磨损部位。随着刺耳的碎裂声，整扇门向内倒塌，铰链与锁具仍残留在崩毁的门框上。

options.en: Follow
options.zh: 跟上

texts.en:
Bornanew charges inside. You follow his steps through an entryway, plastic rain cloaks mildewing, through a prefab kitchen and wash unit stained the yellow of old teeth. A sitting area, chair toppled. There's a muffled thump from above.

Bornanew glances at you, his eyes giving a bounce upwards. Ulmus Pond.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 冲进屋内。你随他穿过门廊，塑料的雨披已生霉斑，你们经过预制厨房与泛着旧牙般黄渍的洗漱单元，来到椅子翻倒的起居区，楼上随即传来闷响。

Bornanew 瞥向你，眼神向上一挑。Ulmus Pond。

options.en: Find a way upstairs
options.zh: 寻找上楼的路

texts.en:
A moment of frantic search reveals the narrow stairwell behind a loose wall-panel.

Bornanew pounds up the stairs, and you follow.

In his half-second lead, Bornanew has caught Ulmus Pond in a bearhug, Pond's skinny arms still grabbing at the loosened attachment-points of a sheet of translucent plastic which lies between him and the lightwell; escape. Pond loses his grip with a cry of despair as Bornanew pulls him away.

The window panel snaps back into place.
texts.zh:
片刻急促搜索后，你们发现松动的墙板后藏着狭窄的楼梯井。

Bornanew 冲上楼梯，你紧随其后。

他抢先半秒，已用熊抱擒住 Ulmus Pond，后者瘦削的双臂仍抓着那片半透明塑料板的松动接合处，塑料板横在他与采光井之间，那是逃生通道。当 Bornanew 将他拖离时，Pond 在绝望的哭喊中松脱了手。

窗板 '啪' 地弹回原位。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Ulmus Pond," Bornanew roars with overbearing gusto, "This is no season to be opening a window!"

"Sit, I insist, before you hurt yourself! We are doubly blessed to find you so well. You must understand our fear- no answer to comms, rumors of kidnappings... Menes has been worried sick about his very good friend."

The bear-hug has turned into something like a side-grab as Bornanew sets Pond bodily onto the cot beside him. You're not sure if the creaking is from the cheap furniture or Pond' ribs.
texts.zh:
"Ulmus Pond，" Bornanew 放肆地大吼道，"这可不是开窗透气的时候！"

"听我的，赶紧坐下，别伤着自己！能看到你安然无恙，我们真是喜出望外。你得理解我们的担心 —— 通讯彻底失联，绑架的流言满天飞...Menes 都快为他最好的朋友担心坏了。"

方才的熊抱渐渐变成了侧身挟持，Bornanew 硬是把 Pond 按到身旁的行军床上。你听着那咯吱作响的动静，说不清这声音是廉价家具在呻吟，还是 Pond 的肋骨在响。

texts.en:
"Are you man, or a bit of vermin slipping out the window?" Bornanew bellows as he lifts Pond bodily, setting him on a sagging cot. You're not sure if the creak is the cheap furniture or Pond's ribs.

"The Knights have sent me a long way," his voice lowers threateningly, "to deal with you. Pray your answers are to my liking lest I deliver you unto the Knight Inquisitors. They have methods of seeking truth hidden far from God's merciful light."
texts.zh:
"你算个男人，还是只知钻窗逃窜的鼠辈？" Bornanew 怒吼着，把 Pond 整个人拎起来，扔到一张摇摇晃晃的行军床上。那咯吱作响的动静，你分不清是这廉价家具发出来的，还是 Pond 的肋骨在响。

"骑士团派我远道而来，" 他的声音压低，透着威胁的意味，"就是为了收拾你。祈祷你的回答能让我满意吧，否则我就把你交给骑士审判官。他们有的是办法，能挖出那些藏在神明慈悲目光之外的真相。"

options.en: More than worried. He suspects you, Pond. We're going to get answers.
options.zh: 不止是担心。他还怀疑你，Pond。我们得有个答复。

options.en: Easy $global.jethroName. Ulmus only had good intentions I'm sure.
options.zh: 冷静点 $global.jethroName。我相信 Ulmus 只是出于好意。

options.en: Easy $global.jethroName. Ulmus only had good intentions I'm sure.
options.zh: 冷静点 $global.jethroName。我相信 Ulmus 只是出于好意

options.en: Why wait for them? My techs can simply open up his brain...
options.zh: 何必等他们？我的技术人员直接把他的脑子撬开就行...

texts.en:
"A- answers?" Pond's eyes go wider still as he gasps for breath. "I, um, appreciate your concern but I'm fine, here. Nothing is the matter, truly!"

"Look at him, captain," Bornanew says. "He's an innocent. He'd tell us straightaway if some ill-intentioned party were taking advantage of his good nature."
texts.zh:
"什么答案？" Pond 一边急促地喘气，眼睛睁得更大了，"我、呃，谢谢你们关心，我在这儿挺好的。真的，没出任何事！"

"舰长你看，" Bornanew 说道，"他就是个老实人。要是有不怀好意的家伙想利用他这份善良，他肯定会直接跟我们说的。"

options.en: No, I think Ulmus is behind it. We should do an active scan on his brain.
options.zh: 不，我觉得是 Ulmus 在背后搞鬼。我们得对他的大脑做一次主动扫描。

options.en: Perhaps you're right, he does look pretty innocent.
options.zh: 或许你说得对，他看起来一脸无辜。

texts.en:
"Ulmus?" Bornanew looks at you, shocked at the idea.

"...'active' scan?" Ulmus manages to squeak.

"The captain would never," insists Bornanew. "You're a merchant, a middleman. You just wanted to help your friend Menes find a unique object for his collection. Isn't that right?" He gives Ulmus another squeeze.

"Y-yes, that's right," Ulmus says, looking between you and Bornanew. "I, uh, I set up connections. Deals. I help people!"
texts.zh:
"Ulmus？" Bornanew 看向你，这个想法让他面露震惊。

"...'主动' 扫描？" Ulmus 勉强挤出一丝尖细的声音。

"舰长绝不会这么做的。" Bornanew 一口咬定，"你就是个商人，一个中间人而已。你只是想帮你的朋友 Menes 找件稀罕物，充实他的收藏，对吧？" 他又用力捏了下 Ulmus。

"是... 是这样的，没错。" Ulmus 说着，目光在你和 Bornanew 之间游移，"我、呃，我就是牵线搭桥。我只是帮人忙而已！"

options.en: So you admit you 'helped' Menes buy a fake relic from the Pathers!
options.zh: 这么说你承认了，是你 '帮' Menes 从左径分子手里买下了那件假圣物！

texts.en:
"I didn't know they were Pathers!" Pond shouts.

Bornanew pretends shock at the notion, looking at Ulmus and shaking his head.

"Or that it was a fake! I swear, I'm a legitimate entrepreneur! I've been set up. I have enemies, Menes has enemies, they- they must have set me up!"
texts.zh:
"我当时根本不知道他们是左径分子！"Pond 大喊。

Bornanew 闻言，故作震惊地看着 Ulmus，连连摇头。

"我也不知道那东西是假的！我发誓，我就是个正经的生意人！我是被人陷害的。我树敌不少，Menes 也有仇家，一定是他们 —— 一定是他们设计陷害我的！"

options.en: Yet you ran. Right back to your Pather masters on Chalcedon.
options.zh: 可你还是跑了。径直逃回你在 Chalcedon 的左径主子身边去了。

texts.en:
"I-I had no... you don't understand," Ulmus squirms.

Bornanew jumps in to direct Ulmus' narrative. "He must have been threatened," he says. "Blackmail! Of course. You help us find out who's really behind this! We'll make sure you're safe."
texts.zh:
"我...我根本没有...你不明白。" Ulmus 扭动着身体辩解道。

Bornanew 立刻插话，主导着 Ulmus 的陈述走向："他肯定是受到了威胁，" 他说道，"是勒索！没错。你帮我们找出这一切的真正幕后黑手！我们保证会护你周全。"

options.en: If, and only if, $global.jethroName, he helps us. Otherwise he goes to the Inquisitors.
options.zh: $global.jethroName，有且只有一个条件 —— 他必须配合我们。不然的话，就把他交给审判官。

texts.en:
"Surely there is no need to bring them in it," Bornanew puts on a look of saintly compassion.

"I know in my heart that Ulmus wants to confess and be absolved of his sins, of his crimes. He wants to leave this terrible time behind him and live a good life."

Pond's eyes go teary. "Y-yes, yes. I'll confess! I'll do penance, I'll pray! I'll tell you whatever you need. By Ludd, I beg forgiveness!"
texts.zh:
"实在没必要把他们牵扯进来。" Bornanew 摆出一副圣洁悲悯的神情。

"我打心底里清楚，Ulmus 是有心忏悔，赎清自己的罪孽与过错的。他盼着能摆脱这段不堪的过往，好好过完往后的日子。"

Pond 的眼眶泛起了泪光。"是... 是的，没错。我愿意忏悔！我愿意苦修赎罪，我愿意虔诚祷告！你们想知道什么，我都坦白！以卢德之名，我乞求宽恕！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Pond sniffles.

"There was... a Walker of the Path. He asked me to talk to Menes, to, to, to make the offer. He said Menes couldn't resist an artifact of such quality. And- and I was to arrange transport. Then make it appear legitimate. Set the documents straight, make it look correct."

Bornanew draws his cheap datapad from his satchel, the screen already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.
texts.zh:
Pond 吸了吸鼻子。

"当时... 有个左径使者找上门。他让我去游说 Menes，去、去促成这笔交易。他说 Menes 绝对抵挡不住一件如此成色的圣物的诱惑。而且 —— 而且还得由我来安排运输。之后要把整件事做得天衣无缝，把相关文件都伪造得天衣无缝，看起来毫无破绽。"

Bornanew 从挎包里掏出他那台廉价的数据平板，屏幕上已经显示着英仙座星域的星图。

options.en: Show him, Ulmus. It's us or the Inquisitors.
options.zh: 告诉他，Ulmus。要么跟我们合作，要么就等着被交给审判官。

texts.en:
Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew concedes by lowering him back onto the cot.

Gasping and choking, Pond marks a system. It is difficult to make out his words. Something about "pather".

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ulmus' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. Then he looks up and his eyes go wide.

"Sedge!" he rasps.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 的数据平板在 Pond 手中颤抖。除非 Bornanew 松手把他放回那张简陋的床上，否则他根本没法指定任何星系。

Pond 气喘吁吁、喉咙发紧，终于标记了一个星系。他的话含混不清，好像提到了 "左径分子"。

"这个左径分子，Ulmus，" Bornanew 瞥了眼数据平板，随即将其揣进包里，语气里的杀意已然敛去，"告诉我们他的名字。"

泪水从 Ulmus 脸上滑落；这男人形容委顿，如同彻底溃败般。随后他猛然抬头，双目圆睁。

"Sedge！" 他嘶哑地喊道。

texts.en:
Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew concedes by lowering him back onto the cot.

Gasping and choking, Pond marks a system. It is difficult to make out his words. Something about "pather".

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ponds' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. "Sedge," he rasps, finally.

Bornanew shoots a look at you.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 的数据平板在 Pond 手中颤抖。除非 Bornanew 松手把他放回简易床，否则他根本没法指定任何星系。

Pond 气喘吁吁、喉咙发紧，终于标记了一个星系。他的话含混不清，好像提到了 "左径分子"。

"这个左径分子，Ulmus，" Bornanew 瞥了眼数据平板，随即将其揣进包里，语气里的杀意已然敛去，"告诉我们他的名字。"

Pond 泪流满面，整个人瘫软下来，脸上写满了彻底的绝望。"Sedge。" 他最终哑声回答。

Bornanew 猛地转过头来看向你。

texts.en:
Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew holds the pad steady for him.

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. The threat retreats from his voice. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ulmus' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. Then he looks up and his eyes go wide.

"Sedge!"
texts.zh:
Bornanew 的数据平板在 Pond 手中颤抖。直到 Bornanew 帮他稳住数据平板，他才得以指定一个星系。

"这个左径分子，Ulmus，" Bornanew 瞥了眼数据平板，随即将其揣进包里，语气里的杀意已然敛去，"告诉我们他的名字。"

泪水从 Ulmus 脸上滑落；这男人形容委顿，如同彻底溃败般。随后他猛然抬头，双目圆睁。

"Sedge！"

texts.en:
Bornanew's datapad trembles in Pond's hands. He cannot designate a star system until Bornanew holds the pad steady for him. A target.

"This Pather, Ulmus," Bornanew says, glancing at the datapad then placing it in his satchel. The threat retreats from his voice. "Tell us his name."

Tears stream down Ponds' face; the man looks deflated, and absolutely defeated. "Sedge," he says.

Bornanew shoots a look at you.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 的数据平板在 Pond 手中颤抖。直到 Bornanew 帮他稳住数据平板，他才得以指定一个星系。

"这个左径分子，Ulmus，" Bornanew 瞥了眼数据平板，随即将其揣进包里，语气里的杀意已然敛去，"告诉我们他的名字。"

Pond 泪流满面，整个人瘫软下来，脸上写满了彻底的绝望。"Sedge。" 他哑声回答。

Bornanew 猛地转过头来看向你。

options.en: Turn around, slowly
options.zh: 缓缓转身

options.en: Wrestling Sedge. But he's dead.
options.zh: Wrestling Sedge。但是他已经死了。

options.en: I recall handling that problem already.
options.zh: 我记得我已经解决这个问题了。

options.en: Turn around, slowly
options.zh: 缓缓转身

options.en: Wrestling Sedge. But he's dead.
options.zh: Wrestling Sedge。但是他已经死了。

options.en: I recall handling that problem already.
options.zh: 我记得我已经解决这个问题了。

texts.en:
Wrestling Sedge shows you his broken smile.

"Captain $playerFirstName, again. And again the man with too much faith, Bornanew. Jethro Bornanew. See?"

Sedge's pistol is unwavering.

"This time I remember for you."
texts.zh:
Wrestling Sedge 冲你扯出一抹扭曲的笑。

"又是你，$playerFirstName 舰长。还有你这个死脑筋的家伙，Bornanew，Jethro Bornanew。看清楚了吗？"

Sedge 手中的枪稳稳端着，分毫未动。

"这一回，我会替你好好记住。"

texts.en:
Wrestling Sedge shows you his broken smile.

"Captain $playerFirstName! It is good to see you. And again the man with too much faith, Bornanew. Jethro Bornanew. See?"

Sedge's pistol is unwavering.

"This time I remember for you. But," he frowns, "unlucky for me to find you on this path."
texts.zh:
Wrestling Sedge 冲你扯出一抹扭曲的笑。

"$playerFirstName 舰长！真高兴见到你。还有你这个死脑筋的家伙，Bornanew，Jethro Bornanew。看清楚了吗？"

Sedge 手中的枪稳稳端着，分毫未动。

"这一回，我会替你好好记住。只是 ——" 他皱起眉头，"没想到会在这条道途上撞见你，真是晦气。"

options.en: Subvocalize a call to your security team
options.zh: 低声向你的安保小队发送指令

options.en: We were just having a chat with Mister Pond here.
options.zh: 我们刚才正和 Pond 先生在这儿闲谈呢。

options.en: Sedge. I should have shot you when I had the chance.
options.zh: Sedge。当初有机会，我真该一枪崩了你。

options.en: Draw your weapon
options.zh: 拔出武器

options.en: Unlucky? Why?
options.zh: 倒霉？这话怎么说？

options.en: Subvocalize a call to your security team
options.zh: 低声向你的安保小队发送指令

options.en: We were just having a chat with Mister Pond here.
options.zh: 我们刚才正和 Pond 先生在这儿闲聊呢。

options.en: Sedge. I should have shot you when I had the chance.
options.zh: Sedge。当初有机会，我真该一枪崩了你。

options.en: Draw your weapon
options.zh: 拔出武器

texts.en: You and Sedge exchange a look as muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window. He makes a dissatisfied grunt.
texts.zh: 你们和 Sedge 对视一眼，此时周围建筑里传来闷响的枪声与尖叫，声音穿过那块勉强算作窗户的半透明塑料板，顺着采光井发出诡异的回音。他不满地闷哼一声。

texts.en: "The Path cannot bend. Not now," he says gruffly. His gun twitches at Ulmus Pond and makes a grinding shriek like a tool dropped into a rotary engine.
texts.zh: "卢德之道已定，绝无动摇的余地。至少现在不行。" 他语气粗砺地说道。枪口猛地对准了 Ulmus Pond，随即发出一阵刺耳的摩擦声，像是有工具被扔进了旋转的引擎里。

texts.en: Ulmus' blood splatters across the window panel, turning the room a muddy red. In that moment, Bornanew launches himself at Sedge.
texts.zh: Ulmus 的鲜血溅满了整面窗板，整间屋子都被染成了浑浊的暗红色。就在这一刻，Bornanew 猛地朝 Sedge 扑了过去。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The pistol grinds again, catching Bornanew mid-leap.

His massive body, twitching and bleeding, crashes into Sedge's legs, setting the Pather off-balance.
texts.zh:
手枪又一次刺耳地咆哮，射中了飞扑过去的 Bornanew。

Bornanew 血流如注，壮硕的身躯抽搐着撞上了 Sedge 的腿，让他踉跄了一下。

options.en: Draw your weapon and stop Sedge
options.zh: 拿起武器阻止 Sedge

texts.en:
In one smooth motion you draw your sidearm and place a shot in Sedge's head.

With a sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his eyes blank, his expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.
texts.zh:
你流畅地拔出随身武器，一枪击中 Sedge 的头部。

随着一声叹息，他的身体沿着墙壁滑落，双目空洞，面容凝固在茫然的惊愕之中。

texts.en:
In one smooth motion you draw a grenade, sliding a finger along just-so to set yield to minimum, and gently toss it toward Sedge's head. You see the beginning of a confused start on his face before the flash, and a loud clap uncomfortable almost to the point of pain.

Sedge slides back against the wall, his face caught in the eternal surprise of death. Blood begins to trickle from his nose, his eyes, his ears, his mouth. The skin of his face blooms red. It will look like a bloated purple mass in only minutes.
texts.zh:
你流畅地掏出一枚手雷，手指轻划将当量调至最低，随即朝 Sedge 头部轻轻抛去。在爆炸发出闪光前，你看到他脸上才开始浮现出困惑的表情，紧接着是一声令人耳膜刺痛的巨响。

Sedge 沿着墙壁滑落，面容永远凝固在死亡的惊愕中。鲜血开始从他的鼻孔、眼眶、耳道与嘴角渗出。他的面部皮肤迅速泛红，估计不出几分钟就会肿成青紫色的肉团。

texts.en:
In one smooth motion you draw and activate your ceramic vibroknife, sweeping it in an arc which intersects Sedge's throat. There is no resistance.

With a wet sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his face down, his eyes staring blankly up at you, his expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.
texts.zh:
你流畅地抽出陶瓷振动匕首并激活，随即挥出一道弧线划过 Sedge 的咽喉，全程毫无阻力。

随着一声湿漉漉的叹息，他的身体沿着墙壁滑落，脸庞低垂，双眼空洞地朝上瞪视，面容凝固在茫然的惊愕之中。

texts.en:
In one smooth motion you raise your hand and activate the poison spray, angling upward and away from the bleeding body of Bornanew. A misting of the air disappears in a blink as if it were never there.

With a wet cough and a whining, choking sound, Sedge's body slides back against the wall. His eyes blink once at you, expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.
texts.zh:
你流畅地抬手激活毒雾进行喷射，角度向上避开 Bornanew 流血的身躯。一阵雾气在眨眼间消散无踪，仿佛从未存在。

随着一声湿咳与窒息般的呜咽，Sedge 的身体沿着墙壁滑落。他朝你眨了一次眼，面容凝固在茫然的惊愕之中。

texts.en:
In one smooth motion you draw the false fingertip of the monomolecular wire and throw it in an arc which intersects Sedge's neck. There is no resistance.

With a wet sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his head askew. His eyes blink once at you, expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.
texts.zh:
你流畅地弹出单分子线伪装的指尖，随即抛出一道弧线，缠绕割过 Sedge 的脖颈，全程毫无阻力。

随着一声湿漉漉的叹息，他的身体沿着墙壁滑落，脸庞低垂，双眼空洞地朝上瞪视，面容凝固在茫然的惊愕之中。

texts.en:
In one smooth motion you draw your sword and sweep it in an arc intersecting Sedge's throat.

With a wet sigh, his body slides back against the wall, his face down, his eyes staring blankly up at you, his expression caught in a look of dumb surprise.
texts.zh:
你流畅地抽出佩剑，随即挥出一道弧线，剑锋划过 Sedge 的咽喉。

随着一声湿漉漉的叹息，他的身体沿着墙壁滑落，脸庞低垂，双眼空洞地朝上瞪视，面容凝固在茫然的惊愕之中。

texts.en:
In a motion born of long hours of training, your leg snaps toward Sedge at the speed of thought. It meets the center of his head with full force, cracking his head back in a violent jerk.

A single shudder passes through his body, from his thick neck, already purpling from devastated bone and tissue, to his booted feet. His head slumps to the side at an unnatural angle, blood running from what remains of his nose, and his mouth and eyes.
texts.zh:
在经过长久训练的本能驱使下，你的腿电光火石的速度踢向 Sedge。全部力量正中他的头颅中央，使其头部在剧烈的猛颤中向后折断。

一阵战栗自上而下穿过他的身子，从那因骨骼与组织毁损而泛紫的颈部，到包裹着靴子的双脚。他的头颅以不自然的姿态歪向一侧，血液从残破的鼻孔、口腔与眼眶中涌出。
