texts.en:
Bornanew lives, by a thread.

In the moments since the exchange, a time hollowed out by violence and filled with the fleeting intensity of adrenaline, your security team appears.

Finding you unhurt, they attach stabilization packs and trauma strips to the fallen Knight. He's left an incredible pool of blood in the cheap apartment. It drips down the narrow stairs.

The other two bodies lie dead.

It is unclear how fully Ulmus Pond was exploited by or truly believed in the Pather cause, but his loyalty - if he ever had any - died with him.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 还活着，但已命悬一线。

在暴力掏空的短暂时刻里，肾上腺素带来的强烈感知尚未消退，你的安保小队已赶到现场。

确认你没有受伤后，他们为倒地的骑士固定了稳定气囊与创伤贴条。他在廉价公寓里留下了触目惊心的血泊，鲜血正沿着狭窄的楼梯滴落。

另外两具尸体已无生命迹象。

尚不清楚 Ulmus Pond 究竟是被左径事业所利用，还是真心信仰，但他的忠诚 —— 若曾经存在的话 —— 已随其性命一同消逝。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You carry Bornanew's leather satchel to the shuttle. Your team carries his unconscious body.

As it lifts, he is laid across several seats. The designated medic keeps close watch over the small ad-hoc network of medical machines.

Bornanew's datapad opens to your touch, allowing you to access the coordinates given by Ulmus Pond. And a recording of the brief interrogation. $global.jethroName planned for the possibility of his incapacitation, or death. And gave you access to his work.
texts.zh:
你拎着 Bornanew 的皮质挎包登上穿梭机，你的小队抬着他失去意识的身体。

升空时，他被平放在几个座椅上。随行医护紧盯临时搭建的小型医疗设备网络。

Bornanew 的数据平板在你触碰下解锁，允许你访问 Ulmus Pond 提供的坐标，以及那段简短审讯的录音。$global.jethroName 预见到了自己丧失行动能力或死亡的可能性，因而向你开放了他的工作资料。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
A medical team rushes past you, to Bornanew, as you step out onto your flagship.

He'll live, you are assured. But it'll hurt; this is left unsaid by your flagship's chief medical officer.

It is quite clear to you now that this is a Pather conspiracy, and they will kill to keep it from unravelling. Your next step is to the source of the fake relic: a lonely orbit on the fringe of the Persean Sector.

In the $bffi_patherStationSystem.
texts.zh:
医疗队从你身旁冲过，奔向 Bornanew，此时你已踏上旗舰。

他性命无虞，这是你得到的保证。但痛苦在所难免；旗舰医疗主管对此缄口不言。

此刻你已经完全明了，这是左径分子的阴谋，他们将不惜杀戮以掩盖真相。下一步便是前往伪造圣物的源头：位于英仙座星域边缘星区的一处孤寂的轨道。

就在 $bffi_patherStationSystem 星系。

texts.en: Sedge makes a dissatisfied grunt. Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.
texts.zh: Sedge 不满地闷哼一声。周围建筑里传来闷响的枪声与尖叫，声音穿过那块勉强算作窗户的半透明塑料板，顺着采光井发出诡异的回音。

texts.en: Sedge makes a grunt which sounds like agreement. Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.
texts.zh: Sedge 闷哼一声，听着像是表示赞同。周围建筑里传来闷响的枪声与尖叫，声音穿过那块勉强算作窗户的半透明塑料板，顺着采光井发出诡异的回音。

texts.en: As your hand moves toward your belt, Sedge's pistol twitches at your center of mass. He meets your eyes, his gleaming with fearless intensity, and gives a tiny shake of his head. Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.
texts.zh: 你手刚朝腰带伸去，Sedge 的枪口就对准了你的躯干要害。他迎上你的目光，眼神里透着毫无惧色的狠戾，同时轻轻摇了摇头。周围建筑里传来闷响的枪声与尖叫，声音穿过那块勉强算作窗户的半透明塑料板，顺着采光井发出诡异的回音。

texts.en:
"Because I must do this." Sedge's pistol twitches toward your center of mass. "It is the Path."

Muffled pops and screams sound from the surrounding structures, echoing strangely down the lightwell beyond the translucent plastic panel that passes for a window.
texts.zh:
"因为我必须这么做。" Sedge 的枪口猛地对准你的躯干要害，"这就是卢德之道。"

周围建筑里传来闷响的枪声与尖叫，声音穿过那块勉强算作窗户的半透明塑料板，顺着采光井发出诡异的回音。

texts.en:
"This was before," Pond says. "His people are still... they're everywhere. They'll kill me."

He looks at you hopefully. "You've got to help me."
texts.zh:
"之前不是这样，" Pond 说到。"他的人仍然... 他们无处不在。他们会杀了我。"

他满怀期待地看着你，"你得帮帮我。"

texts.en:
"This was before," Pond says. "His people are still... they're everywhere. They'll kill me."

He looks at Bornanew hopefully. "You said you'd keep me safe. As a Knight."

$global.jethroName closes his eyes and sighs.
texts.zh:
"之前不是这样，" Pond 说道，"他的人仍然... 他们无处不在。他们会杀了我。"

他满怀期望的看着 Bornanew。"你说过你会保证我的安全，作为一名骑士。"

$global.jethroName 叹息着闭上了眼。

texts.en:
"This," Pond coughs violently, holding his throat, "-before. Pathers... everywhere. Kill me."

He looks at you fearfully after a glance at Bornanew. "... help me."
texts.zh:
"这，" Pond 剧烈咳嗽着，一边捂住了喉咙，"—— 之前。左径分子...到处都是。杀了我。"

他瞥了一眼 Bornanew 后便惊恐地望向你。"...救救我。"

options.en: Say nothing.
options.zh: 保持沉默。

options.en: Go to Menes. Confess. He's fool enough to forgive you.
options.zh: 去向 Menes 坦白吧。他够蠢，会原谅你的。

options.en: Go to Menes. Confess. He's kind enough to forgive you.
options.zh: 去向 Menes 坦白吧。他够仁慈，会原谅你的。

options.en: $global.jethroName, will the Knights take this man?
options.zh: $global.jethroName，骑士团会收留这家伙吗？

options.en: You did this to yourself. Now deal with it.
options.zh: 这都是你咎由自取的，现在自己收拾残局吧。

texts.en:
Bornanew looks at you, then to Pond. Then speaks.

"I shall bring you to an agent of the Knights of Ludd. You shall confess all your sins, beginning first with that of heresy. They shall assign your penance."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 看了看你，又看向 Pond，随后开口道。

"我将带你面见一位卢德骑士团的代理人。你必须忏悔所有罪孽，首当其冲的便是异端之罪。他们会裁定你的赎罪。"

texts.en:
Bornanew looks at you, then to Pond. Then he speaks.

"I shall bring you to an agent of the Knights of Ludd. You shall confess all your sins, beginning first with that of heresy. They shall assign your penance, and it will be as harsh as you deserve."

"But you will live."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 看了看你，又看向 Pond，随后开口道。

"我将带你面见一位卢德骑士团的代理人。你必须忏悔所有罪孽，首当其冲的便是异端之罪。他们会裁定你的赎罪，其严苛程度将与你犯下的罪过相称。"

"但你会活下来。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Pond nods, tears streaming down his face. He sits slumped like a ragdoll, mouth half-open, until Bornanew pulls him to his feet.

"Move, walker." Bornanew's voice is his own again. "The path of redemption is not easy, but it is as Ludd would ask."

You follow Pond from his cheap apartment, stepping over the ruined door. Bornanew makes a brief comms request, and soon a pair of furtive, hooded figures collect Pond from your custody.
texts.zh:
Pond 点了点头，泪水不住地从脸颊滑落。他像个破败的布偶般瘫坐着，嘴巴半张着，直到 Bornanew 伸手将他拽起身来。

"动起来，循道者。" Bornanew 的语气恢复了惯常的冷硬，"救赎之路向来难行，但这正是卢德的旨意。"

你跟着 Pond 走出他那间廉价公寓，抬脚跨过残破的门板。Bornanew 发出了一条简短的通讯请求，片刻后，两名行踪诡秘、头罩兜帽的人影便现身，将 Pond 从你们手中接走。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew watches him go, then stands with you for a quiet moment. Water drips, and the wind moans a low keen through the top of the settlement.

He taps at his datapad, and yours pings with incoming coordinates.

"I suspect this sect of the Path will not surrender their secrets without a fight," he says. "They have invested much in this conspiracy."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 目送他远去，随即与你并肩静立片刻。雨珠滴答坠落，风穿掠过聚居地的上空，呜咽着发出低沉的哀鸣。

他轻点了几下自己的数据平板，你的终端随即叮的一声收到了一组新的坐标。

"我猜这帮左径分子绝不会轻易透露秘密。" 他开口道，"这场阴谋，他们投入的赌注可不小。"

texts.en: You look at your TriPad, reading the coordinates given up by Ulmus Pond.
texts.zh: 你看向手中的 TriPad ，浏览着 Ulmus Pond 提供的坐标。

options.en: We're going to the $bffi_patherStationSystem.
options.zh: 我们要去 $bffi_patherStationSystem。

texts.en:
"I pray we find our answers," Bornanew says as you return to the shuttle. "And I fear now that the Pathers know that we know their aims."

You secure yourself in your seat as the access hatch seals itself. The shuttle begins to lift toward orbit.
texts.zh:
"但愿我们能找到想要的答案。" 在你们返回穿梭机时，Bornanew 开口说道，"只是我现在有些担心，左径分子可能已经察觉到我们知晓他们的图谋了。"

你系好安全带坐定，舱门随即自动闭合。穿梭机缓缓启动，进入轨道。

options.en: Fear not, $global.jethroName. My $shipOrFleet will be ready.
options.zh: 不必担心，$global.jethroName。我的$shipOrFleet很快就会准备妥当。

options.en: When I end this, $global.jethroName, it is the Path that shall fear me.
options.zh: 等我了结这一切，$global.jethroName，就该是那帮左径分子担心了。

texts.en: Bornanew does not reply.
texts.zh: Bornanew 一言不发。

texts.en: Bornanew does not reply.
texts.zh: Bornanew 一言不发。

texts.en: Pond looks stricken, but he nods. "Yes, I... I'll do that. Menes. He is a kind man."
texts.zh: Pond 面色惨白，但还是点了点头说："好，我...我会去的。Menes，他是个...仁慈的人。"

texts.en: Pond looks stricken, but he nods. "Yes." Another cough. "Menes, kind."
texts.zh: Pond 面色惨白，但还是点了点头说："好的。" 他又咳了一声，"Menes，好人。"

options.en: Get out of here. And if you don't tell Menes, I will.
options.zh: 滚出去。另外，如果你不去告诉 Menes 的话，那就由我来。

options.en: Get out of here. And if you don't tell Menes, I will.
options.zh: 滚出去。另外，如果你不去告诉 Menes 的话，那就由我来。

texts.en:
Pond nods, tears streaming down his face. He sits slumped like a ragdoll, mouth half-open, until Bornanew pulls him to his feet.

"Move, walker." Bornanew's voice is his own again. "The path of redemption is not easy, but it is as Ludd would ask."

You follow Pond from his cheap apartment, stepping over the ruined door. He gives you and Bornanew one last look, his face drained of emotion, then disappears down one of the labyrinthine alleyways of the settlement.
texts.zh:
Pond 点了点头，泪水不住地从脸颊滑落。他像个破败的布偶般瘫坐着，嘴巴半张着，直到 Bornanew 伸手将他拽起身来。

"动起来，循道者。" Bornanew 的语气恢复了惯常的冷硬，"救赎之路向来难行，但这正是卢德的旨意。"

你跟着 Pond 走出他那间廉价的公寓，抬脚跨过残破的门板。他最后看了你和 Bornanew 一眼，脸上木然空洞，了无情绪，随即转身消失在聚居地蛛网般错综复杂的小巷深处。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew watches him go, then stands with you for a quiet moment. Water drips, and the wind moans a low keen through the top of the settlement.

He taps at his datapad, and yours pings with incoming coordinates.

"I suspect this sect of the Path will not surrender their secrets without a fight," he says. "They have invested much in this conspiracy."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 目送他远去，随即与你并肩静立片刻。雨珠滴答坠落，风穿掠过聚居地的上空，呜咽着发出低沉的哀鸣。

他轻点了几下自己的数据平板，你的终端随即叮的一声收到了一组新的坐标。

"我猜这帮左径分子绝不会轻易透露秘密。" 他开口道，"这场阴谋，他们投入的赌注可不小。"

texts.en: Pond looks stricken, but he nods. "Yes, I... I'll do that. Menes will understand why I had to do... what I had to do."
texts.zh: Pond 面色惨白，但还是点了点头说："好，我...我会去的。Menes 会理解我为何不得不...去做那些事。"

texts.en: Pond looks stricken, but he nods. "Yes. Menes." Another cough. "Will understand."
texts.zh: Pond 面色惨白，但还是点了点头说："好的。Menes，" 他又咳了一声，"会理解的。"

options.en: Get out of here. And if you don't tell Menes, I will.
options.zh: 滚出去。另外，如果你不去告诉 Menes 的话，那就由我来。

options.en: Get out of here. And if you don't tell Menes, I will.
options.zh: 滚出去。另外，如果你不去告诉 Menes 的话，那就由我来。

texts.en:
Bornanew looks at you, then to Pond. His expression softens, just a little.

"Captain," he says. "They will kill him for his failure. And not well. Let me turn him over to the Knights. They will offer him a path to redemption, harsh though it may be."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 看了看你，又看向 Pond，他的表情略微缓和下来。

"舰长，" 他说，"他们会因他的失败而处决他，而且手段不会仁慈。请让我将他移交给骑士团，他们会给予他一条赎罪之路，尽管可能十分严苛。"

options.en: As you like, $global.jethroName. Pond is your responsibility.
options.zh: 如你所愿，$global.jethroName，Pond 由你负责。

options.en: No. Pond earned his own fate and I'll have it no other way.
options.zh: 不，Pond 是自食其果，我不会放过他的。

texts.en: Bornanew places his hands together, and turns back to Pond.
texts.zh: Bornanew 双手并拢，然后转身面向 Pond。

options.en: We're done. (leave)
options.zh: 到此为止了。 (离开)

texts.en:
Pond nods, tears streaming down his face. He seems not to know what to do, and simply sits there slumped like a ragdoll, his mouth half-open.

You leave him in his cheap apartment, stepping over the ruined door. Bornanew pauses a moment to lean it against the hollow door frame like an insufficient apology.
texts.zh:
Pond 点了点头，泪水不住地从脸颊滑落。他看起来茫然无措，就那样像个破布娃娃似的瘫坐在原地，嘴巴半张着。

你将他留在这间廉价的公寓里，抬脚跨过那扇残破的门板。Bornanew 驻足片刻，把门板斜靠在空荡荡的门框上，就像一句苍白无力的道歉。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew looks at you, then to Pond.

There's an edge in his expression that you had not seen before.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 看了看你，又看向 Pond。

他神情中透出一种你前所未见的锋芒。

options.en: We're done. (leave)
options.zh: 到此为止了。 (离开)

texts.en:
Bornanew tips his head, giving you a confused look.

"The captain here told me," he pauses to give you a consternated expression, "-he thought you were working for Pathers, to sell Menes a fake relic to cause discord and make off with his credits. The captain told me $playerHeOrShe wanted to test an invasive brain-interfacer $playerHeOrShe found in some ruin on the fringe to discover the truth inside your head."

Pond's eyes go wide at the mention of 'brain-interface'.

"I, for one," Bornanew says reassuringly, "insisted that the plan was crude and unnecessary. Surely you're the victim of a terrible scheme..."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 歪了歪头，一脸困惑地看向你。

"咱们这位舰长告诉我，" 他顿了顿，冲你露出一副忧心忡忡的神情，"—— 他怀疑你在为左径分子效力，故意卖给 Menes 一件假圣物，挑起纷争后卷走他的星币。舰长还说，$playerHeOrShe打算用一台在边缘星区废墟里找到的入侵式的脑部扫描仪做测试，逼你吐露藏在脑子里的真相。"

一听到 "大脑扫描仪"，Pond 顿时双眼圆睁。

"至于我，" Bornanew 语气温和地安抚道，"我一直坚持认为这个计划既拙劣又毫无必要。你显然是陷入了某个歹毒的圈套..."

options.en: Ah... yes, that's right. We really should try the brain-interfacer.
options.zh: 啊... 对，没错。我们确实该试试那个脑部扫描仪。

options.en: 'Brain-interfacer'? What is this nonsense $global.jethroName?
options.zh: '大脑扫描仪'？这都是什么，$global.jethroName？

texts.en:
Bornanew tips his head, giving you a confused look.

"Now's not the time to play coy, captain. Your illegal brain-interfacer," he stresses the words, "which you proposed could 'scientifically prove' Pond's connection to a Pather network with only 'minimal damage'."

Pond looks rapidly between you and Bornanew, both scared and confused. "Minimal da-" he begins, then shifts course to avoid the subject entirely. "I didn't know they were Pathers!" he pleads.

"Or that it was a fake! I swear, I'm a legitimate entrepreneur. There's no need for brain-scans or, or- I've been set up! I have enemies, Menes has enemies, they- they must have set me up!"
texts.zh:
Bornanew 歪了歪头，一脸困惑地看向你。

"现在可不是装糊涂的时候，舰长。你那台非法的脑部扫描仪，" 他特意加重了语气，"就是你说能 '以最小损伤，科学证明' Pond 和左径分子有牵连的那玩意儿。"

Pond 慌忙在你和 Bornanew 之间来回张望，满脸惊恐又茫然。"小损伤 ——" 他刚开口，又立刻岔开了话题，"我当时根本不知道他们是左径分子！"他急切地辩解。

"我也不知道那东西是假的！我发誓，我就是个正经的生意人。根本没必要搞什么脑部扫描，更别提 —— 我是被人陷害的！我树敌不少，Menes 也有仇家，一定是他们 —— 一定是他们设计陷害我的！"

options.en: But you ran, Ulmus. Right back to your Pather masters here on Chalcedon.
options.zh: 但是你还是跑了，Ulmus。径直逃回你在 Chalcedon 的左径主子身边去了。

texts.en:
Bornanew sighs deeply, dropping his previous countenance, and looks at you with almost a sadness in his eyes. "This is not as we agreed. I ask now that you stand aside and allow me to complete this unsavory task."

With that, his face goes blank and he turns, seizing Pond by the neck with one hand and lifting him off the cot with a choked sound.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 重重地叹了口气，敛去了之前的神色，眼神里带着几近悲悯的情绪看向你。"事情的发展偏离了我们的约定。我现在要求你让开，好让我完成这项令人不快的任务。"

话音刚落，他的神情变得面无表情。随即转身，单手扼住 Pond 的脖颈，伴随着一声窒息般的闷响，将他从行军床上拎了起来。

options.en: Um, $global.jethroName?
options.zh: 那个，$global.jethroName？

options.en: $global.jethroName! What are you doing?
options.zh: $global.jethroName！你在干什么？

texts.en:
"Ulmus," he growls and, with his other hand Bornanew lifts his cheap datapad to within reach of Pond's flailing arms. The screen is already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.

"Show us where the glove came from. Then you may breathe."
texts.zh:
"Ulmus，" 他低吼一声，随即 Bornanew 腾出另一只手，将自己那台廉价的数据平板举到 Pond 胡乱挥舞的手臂能够得着的地方。屏幕上早已显示出英仙座星域的星图。

"指给我们看，那只手套是从哪儿来的。说了，你才能活命。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "What, it seems, I must," he says flatly.
texts.zh: "看来，我是非这么做不可了。" 他语气平淡地说道。

texts.en:
Bornanew tips his head, giving you a confused look.

"The good captain here thought someone," he pauses to give you a consternated expression, "-might be taking advantage of Menes. $PlayerHeOrShe wants to eliminate all suspects."

"I, for one, insisted to Menes that you must be the victim of some terrible scheme, and that I would pray for you, and, better yet, as a Knight of Ludd carry out my sworn duty to protect the faithful and innocent alike."

Bornanew gives Pond a squeeze to emphasize how safe he is, now.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 歪了歪头，一脸困惑地看向你。

"咱们这位好心的舰长觉得，有人 ——" 他顿了顿，冲你露出一副忧心忡忡的神情，"—— 可能在利用 Menes。$PlayerHeOrShe打算把所有嫌疑人都一网打尽。"

"至于我，我可是跟 Menes 再三强调，你肯定是陷入了某个歹毒的圈套。我还说会为你祈祷，而且啊，身为一名卢德骑士，我更要履行自己的神圣誓言，守护所有虔诚向善、清白无辜的人。"

Bornanew 用力握了握 Pond 的肩膀，像是在强调他现在已经安全了。

options.en: Ulmus is behind it. We should perform an active scan on his brain.
options.zh: 是 Ulmus 在背后搞鬼。我们得对他的大脑做一次主动扫描。

options.en: On second thought, I don't think Ulmus had anything to do with it.
options.zh: 仔细想了下，我觉得这事跟 Ulmus 一点关系都没有。

texts.en:
Pond's eyes go large and pleading- with his escape closed off, you are his only salvation.

"Yes, yes," he speaks quickly. "The captain has it right! Menes, he wanted something special. I'm just a middleman, a, a communicator. I just make deals!"

He licks his lips, looking between you and Bornanew, "Menes was so pleased, I had no idea it wasn't real. I'm no relic-dealer or, or a curate or- you have to believe me, I'm innocent!"
texts.zh:
Pond 双眼圆睁，眼神里满是哀求 —— 逃生的路已经被堵死，你成了他唯一的救命稻草。

"是是是，" 他语速飞快地说道，"舰长说得没错！是 Menes，他就想要件稀罕玩意儿。我只是个中间人，一个传话的而已。我不过就是牵线搭桥做买卖！"

他舔了舔嘴唇，目光在你和 Bornanew 之间游移不定，"Menes 当时开心得不行，我根本不知道那东西是假的。我可不是什么圣物贩子，也不是什么祭司 —— 你们一定要相信我，我是无辜的！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You confess you knew 'it' was fake," Bornanew growls. "We haven't even told you of what you are accused. You are stained with guilt!"

Pond seems to shrink under Bornanew's accusations.
texts.zh:
"你亲口承认了，你早就知道 '那东西' 是假的。" Bornanew 怒声低吼，"我们甚至都还没告诉你，你被指控的罪名是什么。你身上的罪孽已经昭然若揭！"

在 Bornanew 的厉声指控下，Pond 整个人仿佛都缩成了一团。

options.en: They must have threatened you, Ulmus. You wouldn't hurt anybody.
options.zh: 他们肯定是威胁你了，Ulmus。你不会去伤害别人。

options.en: Knight Bornanew is right. You're guilty and deserve punishment.
options.zh: Bornanew 骑士说得对。你有罪，理应受到惩罚。

texts.en:
"Yes, that's it!" Pond cries, "They said they'd do terrible things if I didn't cooperate! Torture, murder, terrible things. Pathers will do anything!"

"Pather heretics," Bornanew says, his voice icy. "You do know, Ulmus Pond, how we Knights deal with Pather heretics?" Bornanew stands and reaches into his satchel.

Pond goes paler, somehow. "N-no, no. I'll confess! I'll do penance, I'll pray! I'll tell you whatever you want. Tell him!" He looks to you.
texts.zh:
"对，就是这样！" Pond 大喊道，"他们说我要是不配合，就会要我好看！酷刑、谋杀，全是些丧尽天良的勾当。左径分子什么都做得出来！"

"左径异端，" Bornanew 开口，声音冰冷刺骨，"你应该很清楚吧，Ulmus Pond，我们骑士团是怎么处置左径异端的？" Bornanew 站起身，伸手往包里摸索。

Pond 的脸色雪上加霜，白得不能再白了。"不... 不要。我全都招！我愿意苦修赎罪，我愿意虔诚祷告！你们想知道什么，我都坦白！快帮我说句话啊！" 他眼巴巴地看向你。

options.en: We want to help. Tell us who did this to you, Ulmus.
options.zh: 我们想帮你的。告诉我们是谁做了这些，Ulmus。

options.en: The Knights punish heretics. Forgiveness is for God.
options.zh: 骑士团惩戒异端。宽恕与否，唯有神能定夺。

texts.en:
"There was... a Walker of the Path," Pond sputters. "The Luddic Path."

"He told me to talk to Menes, to, to make the offer. He said a Mammonite couldn't resist an object of such unique quality. And- and I was to arrange transport from the Fringe. Make it appear legitimate. Set the documents straight."

Bornanew draws his cheap datapad from his satchel, the screen already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.
texts.zh:
"当时... 有个左径的循道者找上门。" Pond 结结巴巴地说道，"就是卢德左径的人。"

"他让我去游说 Menes，去、去促成这笔交易。他说像他那样的玛门之仆绝对抵挡不住一件如此成色的货物的诱惑。而且 —— 而且还得由我来安排从边缘星区出发的运输。之后要把整件事做得天衣无缝，把相关文件都伪造得天衣无缝。"

Bornanew 从挎包里掏出他那台廉价的数据平板，屏幕上早已显示出英仙座星域的星图。

options.en: Show him, Ulmus. Who's behind this. Where.
options.zh: 指给他看，Ulmus。幕后主使是谁，藏在哪里。

options.en: This is how you make it out of here alive, Ulmus. Show him.
options.zh: 这是你活着离开这儿的唯一办法，Ulmus。指给他看。

texts.en:
Bornanew gives you a warning look. Pond simply deflates, looking utterly lost. "There was... a Walker," he sputters. "Of the Luddic Path."

"He told me to talk to Menes, to, to make the offer. He said a Mammonite couldn't resist an object of such unique quality. And- and I was to arrange transport from the Fringe. Make it appear legitimate. Set the documents straight."

Bornanew draws his cheap datapad from his satchel, the screen already set to a map of the greater Persean Sector.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 向你投来一记警告的眼神。Pond 整个人瞬间蔫了下去，神情茫然无措。"当时... 有个循道者找上门。" 他结结巴巴地说道，"信奉卢德左径的。"

"他让我去游说 Menes，去、去促成这笔交易。他说像他那样的玛门之仆绝对抵挡不住一件如此成色的货物的诱惑。而且 —— 而且还得由我来安排从边缘星区出发的运输。之后要把整件事做得天衣无缝，把相关文件都伪造得天衣无缝。"

Bornanew 从挎包里掏出他那台廉价的数据平板，屏幕上早已显示出英仙座星域的星图。

options.en: Show him, Ulmus. Who's behind this. Where.
options.zh: 指给他看，Ulmus。幕后主使是谁，藏在哪里。

options.en: This is how you make it out of here alive, Ulmus. Show him.
options.zh: 这是你活着离开这儿的唯一办法，Ulmus。指给他看。

texts.en:
Bornanew gives a consternated shake of his head. Pond, terrified, looks between you and Bornanew.

"The Captain," Bornanew says, "wanted to put you into protective custody. Said you wouldn't hurt anyone, you were threatened." Bornanew meets your eyes again and says, deliberately, "I don't believe you."

"But that's it!" Pond cries, "They said they'd- Pathers will do anything!"

"Pathers," Bornanew says, his voice icy. "You do know, Ulmus Pond, how we Knights deal with those heretics." Bornanew reaches into his satchel.

Pond goes paler, somehow. "N-no, no. I'll confess! I'll do penance, I'll pray! Tell him!" He looks to you.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 满脸忧虑地摇了摇头。Pond 吓得魂不守舍，目光在你和 Bornanew 之间来回游移。

"舰长，" Bornanew 开口说道，"本想把你送去保护性羁押，说你本性不坏，只是受人胁迫。" 他再次迎上你的目光，一字一句地沉声说道："我不信你这套说辞。"

"可我说的全是实话啊！" Pond 失声大喊，"他们说要 —— 左径分子是什么事都做得出来的！"

"左径分子，" Bornanew 开口，声音冰冷刺骨，"你应该很清楚吧，Ulmus Pond，我们骑士团是怎么处置左径异端的？" Bornanew 站起身，伸手往包里摸索。

Pond 的脸色白得不能再白了。"不... 不要。我全都招！我愿意苦修赎罪，虔诚祷告！快帮我求求情！" 他眼巴巴地看向你。

options.en: We want to help. Tell us who did this to you, Ulmus.
options.zh: 我们想帮你的。告诉我们是谁做了这些，Ulmus。

options.en: The Knights punish heretics. Forgiveness is for God.
options.zh: 骑士团惩戒异端。宽恕与否，唯有神能定夺。

texts.en:
Pond's eyes go large, his face pale, his breaths coming in sharp gasps.

Bornanew tips his head at Pond and gives you a confused and consternated look.

"No, no," Pond pleads at you, "No, no need for that, I'll- you see, it wasn't me, this is all a misunderstanding. I make deals. I'm a great communicator. Menes will tell you. It was business, just business!"
texts.zh:
Pond 双眼圆睁，脸色煞白，呼吸急促得如同喘息。

Bornanew 冲 Pond 歪了歪头，又转头看向你，脸上满是困惑与忧虑的神情。

"别，别这样，" Pond 向你哀求道，"不，没必要这么做，我... 你要知道，这不是我的错，一切都是误会。我只是个做买卖的，最擅长的就是牵线搭桥。Menes 可以为我作证。这只是一桩生意，纯粹的生意而已！"

options.en: I apologize, Ulmus. It was a joke. I believe you.
options.zh: 我向你道歉，Ulmus。刚刚是开玩笑的，我相信你。

options.en:
$global.jethroName, look, we're going to have to switch this up.
#"Pathetic. How about I just shoot him?" (reach for your sidearm)
options.zh:
$global.jethroName，听着，我们得调整一下计划。"  #"真窝囊。要不我直接崩了他？" (伸手去摸腰间的配枪)  #"Pathetic. How about I just shoot him?" (reach for your sidearm)  #"Pathetic. How about I just shoot him?" (reach for your sidearm)  #"Pathetic. How about I just shoot him?" (reach for your sidearm)  #"Pathetic. How about I just shoot him? (reach for your sidearm)
#"Pathetic. How about I just shoot him?" (reach for your sidearm)

texts.en: "You're sure?" $global.jethroName's voice is flat.
texts.zh: "你确定？" $global.jethroName 的语气平淡无波。

options.en: No. I, uh, believe Ulmus only ever had good intentions. Right?
options.zh: 不。我，呃，觉得 Ulmus 一直都是处于好心，对吧？

options.en: Yes. I'm sure you can handle it.
options.zh: 是啊，我相信你能搞定。

texts.en: "I am," he says.
texts.zh: "明白，" 他答道。

texts.en: Bornanew nods. Perhaps you're imagining it, but you feel like a coldness comes into the set of his eyes.
texts.zh: Bornanew 点了点头。或许只是你的错觉，但你分明察觉到，他的眼神里掠过一丝寒意。

texts.en: Your sensors' officer runs a continuous passive sweep. A certain voluminous and outwardly nondescript station section is putting out a great deal of waste heat. It's not confirmation, but it could suggest an industrial size nanoforge operating at low throughput.
texts.zh: 你的传感器技官持续进行着被动扫描。某个外观普通的庞大空间站区域正释放着大量废热，虽然不能完全肯定，但这可能暗示着一台工业级纳米锻炉正在低负荷运转。

texts.en: Bornanew joins you on your flagship's bridge. Tactical gives him a skeptical look.
texts.zh: Bornanew 登上了你旗舰的舰桥，战术军官向他投去了怀疑的一瞥。

texts.en: Bornanew is conscious, you are told. You chief medical officer warns you against unnecessary stress; the healing process is fragile.
texts.zh: 你被告知 Bornanew 已恢复意识。你的医疗主管提醒你最好避免不必要的压力；康复过程仍十分脆弱。

options.en: Nod acknowledgement
options.zh: 点头示意

options.en: $global.jethroName. I welcome your counsel.
options.zh: $global.jethroName，我欢迎你的建议。

options.en: We're going to break these Pathers wide open.
options.zh: 我们要彻底粉碎这帮左径分子。

options.en: Consult with $global.jethroName
options.zh: 咨询 $global.jethroName

options.en: Handle this one yourself
options.zh: 自行处理此事

texts.en:
"Captain," he says. "We are here to find out who gave the Luddic Path a detailed scan of the original glove." He nods toward the display of the station, "There will be comms buffers and, somewhere, a datacore of the glove scan - with metadata." The display bristles with weapons emplacements highlighted by tactical overlays.

"And we are here to eliminate their ability to produce another false relic." He looks distant, and speaks "'Hammer in one hand, sword in the other, I pray to see it done.'"
texts.zh:
"舰长，" 他说，"我们来此是为了查明谁向卢德左径提供了原版手套的详细扫描数据。" 他朝空间站的全息示意屏点头示意，"通讯缓冲区里会有线索，而某个地方必然存放着手套扫描的数据核心 —— 连同元数据。" 屏幕上布满了被战术覆盖图高亮标注的武器阵列。

"并且，我们也要彻底摧毁他们制造另一件伪造圣物的能力，" 他的目光变得缥缈，一边低声念道，"'一手执锤，一手持剑，唯愿功成。'"

options.en: So, how do you think we should approach this one?
options.zh: 那么，你认为我们该如何应对此事？

options.en: Shall we ask nicely how they did it?
options.zh: 难道我们该客客气气地问他们是怎么做到的？

options.en: These are fanatics. They'd sooner die than talk.
options.zh: 这些都是狂信徒，他们宁死也不会开口的。

options.en: 'Carefully," isn't enough. You suggest we talk to them?
options.zh: '谨慎行事' 可不够，你是建议我们和他们谈判？

options.en: I shall proceed with the operation.
options.zh: 我将按计划展开行动。

options.en: We could simply blast this station apart and sift the wreckage for datastores and prisoners.
options.zh: 我们大可直接将这座空间站炸成碎片，再从残骸里筛找数据存储单元和俘虏。

texts.en:
"Carefully," Bornanew says, turning to you. "As ever. Violence is among the tools of the Knight, but it must be that: a tool, not an end unto itself, 'lest it fill my heart with wrath, my soul with hate, to thereafter leave no home for love of the Creator, nor the Word.'"

Is that part of a credo of the Knights of Ludd? It isn't one you've heard before.
texts.zh:
"谨慎行事，" Bornanew 说道，一边转向你，"就像过去那样。暴力虽然是骑士的手段之一，但它必须仅止于此：仅作为工具，而非目的本身，'以免怒火充斥我心，憎恨浸染我魂，从此再无敬爱造物主与圣言的容身之处。'"

这是卢德骑士团信条的一部分吗？你此前未曾听闻这般教诲。

texts.en:
"Decisively," Bornanew says, turning to you. "You have taught me that much. Violence is among a Knight's tools, and I must not cower from its use."

"A marine raid to seize datastores, comms buffers, and prisoners. Then the nanoforge and all of its support equipment should be destroyed."
texts.zh:
"果断行动，" Bornanew 说道，一边转向你，"你教会了我这一点。暴力是骑士的工具之一，我绝不能畏缩不前。"

"派遣陆战队劫掠夺取数据存储单元、通讯缓冲区及俘虏。随后摧毁纳米锻炉及其全部的辅助设备。"

texts.en:
Bornanew gives you a weary look.

"You may jest, and I understand your need." He turns back to the tactical display. "However I shan't close my eyes to the nature of my duty; you have taught me that much. Violence is among a Knight's tools, and I must not cower from its use."

"Consider: a marine raid to seize datastores, comms buffers, and prisoners. Then, you have demolitions experts? The nanoforge and all of its support equipment must be destroyed."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 向你投来疲惫的一瞥。

"你或许在开玩笑，我也理解你的需求。" 他转回战术界面前，"但我不会对自身职责的本质视而不见；你教会了我这一点。暴力是骑士的工具之一，我绝不能畏缩不前。"

"试想：派遣陆战队劫掠夺取数据存储单元、通讯缓冲区及俘虏。随后，你麾下有爆破专家吧？必须摧毁纳米锻炉及其全部的辅助设备。"

texts.en:
"You cannot truly know until you ask," says Bornanew, choosing to entertain your presumed levity. "The Creator gave even the Path free will, and I would accept peaceable surrender if given."

He turns to you. "And violence is among the tools of a Knight, but it must be that: a tool, not an end unto itself, 'lest it fill my heart with wrath, my soul with hate, to thereafter leave no home for love of the Creator, nor the Word.'"

"Consider: a marine raid to seize datastores and comms buffers. Then," he examines the tactical display, "you have demolitions experts? The nanoforge and all of its support equipment must be destroyed."
texts.zh:
"不问便不得真知，" Bornanew 说道，他选择配合你那份戏谑的语气，"造物主甚至赐予左径自由意志，若对方选择和平投降，我自当接受。"

他转向你，说道："而暴力虽然是骑士的手段之一，但它必须仅止于此：仅作为工具，而非目的本身，'以免怒火充斥我心，憎恨浸染我魂，从此再无敬爱造物主与圣言的容身之处。'"

"试想：派遣陆战队劫掠夺取数据存储单元与通讯缓冲区。随后，" 他审视着战术界面，"你麾下有爆破专家吧？必须摧毁纳米锻炉及其全部的辅助设备。"

texts.en:
"Perhaps," says Bornanew. "But do not let the fearsome reputation sown by the Luddic Path blind you to what they truly are - human. Fearful and fallible as you or I."

"They might be convinced to reveal something. Or if you can acquire comms buffers, they may prove illuminating." He looks at you, "I believe there is a mole, an agent loyal to the Path within the Holy Cathedral of Exodus with access to the vaults. I need to narrow down my list of suspects."

"To say nothing of destroying this nanoforge and any data on the glove held in datacores." He considers a moment, then says "Metadata from the scan of the glove may be useful, also."
texts.zh:
"或许如此，" Bornanew 说道，"但别让 卢德左径 散播的凶名蒙蔽你对其本质的认知 —— 他们也是凡人，与你我一样充满恐惧与过失。"

"或许能说服他们透露些什么。或者如果你能弄到通讯缓冲区，或许会有突破性发现。" 他看着你，"我相信内应是存在的 —— 一个效忠左径、能接触圣库的代理人潜伏在 Exodus 神圣大教堂内。我需要缩小嫌疑人的范围。"

"更不必说必须摧毁这座纳米锻炉及数据核心中所有关于手套的资料。" 他思索片刻，继续补充道，"手套扫描的元数据或许也有用处。

texts.en:
"Of that I admit I have little doubt." Bornanew gives you a weary look.

He turns back to the tactical display. "I shan't close my eyes to the nature of my duty; you have taught me that much. Violence is among a Knight's tools, and I must not cower from its use."

"Consider: a marine raid to seize datastores, comms buffers, and prisoners. Then... you have demolitions experts? The nanoforge and all of its support equipment must be destroyed."
texts.zh:
"这一点我确实毫不怀疑。" Bornanew 向你投来疲惫的一瞥。

他转回战术界面前，"我不会对自身职责的本质视而不见；你教会了我这一点。暴力是骑士的工具之一，我绝不能畏缩不前。"

"试想：派遣陆战队劫掠夺取数据存储单元、通讯缓冲区及俘虏。随后...你麾下有爆破专家吧？必须摧毁纳米锻炉及其全部的辅助设备。"

texts.en:
"I apologize for dissembling," he looks down for a moment, then back to you. "Talk? Perhaps," he says.

"Don't let the fearsome reputation of the Luddic Path blind you to what they are - as human and fallible as you or I. We were given free will, and I would accept peaceable surrender if it were given."

"That is unlikely, however. Consider: a marine raid to seize datastores and comms buffers. Then... you have demolitions experts? The nanoforge itself must be destroyed."
texts.zh:
"我为之前的隐晦致歉，" 他低头片刻，随即又看向你，"谈判？或许可行，" 他说道。

"但别让 卢德左径 散播的凶名蒙蔽你对其本质的认知 —— 他们与你我一样是凡人，也会犯错。我们都被赋予了自由意志，若他们愿意投降，我会接受和平解决。"

"但这可能性微乎其微。试想：派遣陆战队劫掠夺取数据存储单元与通讯缓冲区，随后...你麾下有爆破专家吧？纳米锻炉本身也必须被摧毁。"

texts.en: Bornanew lowers his head for just a moment, mumbling a short prayer to himself, then leaves the bridge to you and your officers.
texts.zh: Bornanew 垂首片刻，喃喃自语着简短的祷词，随后将舰桥留给你和你的军官们。

texts.en:
Bornanew lets out a breath.

"You must not," he looks worried. "Setting aside... objections of the heart, complete destruction would almost certainly destroy the evidence required to identify the agent of the Path who has infiltrated the Cathedral of Holy Exodus."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 长吁一口气。

"你绝不能如此，" 他面露忧色，"暂且不说...内心的抗拒，彻底的摧毁行动几乎必然会销毁指认渗透 Exodus 神圣大教堂的左径内应所需的证据。"

texts.en:
Bornanew takes a long breath. His eyes are dark, reflecting red pinpoints from the display.

"Doubtless such destruction would send an uncompromising message to these heretics who attempt to sew schism in the fields of the Mother Church. But." He raises his hand as if to grasp at his argument. "Total obliteration poses a serious risk of destroying the evidence needed to track down the agent of the Path who has infiltrated the Cathedral of Holy Exodus. We need those data stores."

He pauses, then turns to you. "Find the data first, through a marine raid, or some subterfuge. Then destroy the station. All would be served justice thus."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 深吸一口气。他眼眸深暗，倒映着显示屏上的红色光点。

"如此的毁灭无疑会向那些试图在教会母亲的田园中播撒分裂的异端传递毫不妥协的信息。但是，" 他举起手，仿佛要抓住自己的论点，"彻底的摧毁极有可能销毁追查渗透 Exodus 神圣大教堂的左径内应所需的证据，我们需要那些数据存储单元。"

他停顿片刻，随后转向你，"先通过陆战队劫掠或某种计策夺取数据，再摧毁空间站，如此方可伸张全部的正义。"

options.en: You've given me a lot to think about.
options.zh: 你给了我很多思考的方向。

options.en: You suggest that leniency will prompt cooperation? From Pathers?
options.zh: 你认为宽恕能促成合作？左径分子会配合？

options.en: Archcurate Jaspis seems less forgiving of Pathers than you.
options.zh: 大祭司 Jaspis 对左径分子可似乎没你那么宽容。

options.en: If I do not prove absolute domination of my enemy, they will not fear me.
options.zh: 如果我不能展现对敌人的绝对压制，他们便不会畏惧我

options.en: I shall consider this.
options.zh: 我会考虑这一点的。

options.en: I expected more talk of leniency from you, $global.jethroName.
options.zh: 我还期待你多谈谈宽大处理呢，$global.jethroName。

options.en: I believe that Archcurate Jaspis would approve of this 'message'.
options.zh: 我相信大祭司 Jaspis 会赞同这条 '消息'。

texts.en: He raises an eyebrow at your noncommittal response, but nods acceptance, hands clasped.
texts.zh: 他对你这模棱两可的回答挑了下眉，但还是双手合十，点头应允了。

texts.en: "I do," he says. "They are merely human, as are we all. Despite a history written in blood, I do not find that our species thrives on hatred."
texts.zh: "确实，" 他说道，"他们也只是凡人，与我们无异。尽管我们的历史浸透鲜血，但我并不认为仇恨能促使我们这类生灵的走向繁盛。"

options.en: You've given me a lot to think about.
options.zh: 你给了我很多思考的方向。

options.en: I shall do as you ask - so far as is possible.
options.zh: 我将尽力按你所请行事 —— 在可行的范围内。

options.en: If they force me to, I will do what is necessary.
options.zh: 如果情况迫不得已，我会采取必要的手段。

options.en: Archcurate Jaspis seems less forgiving of Pathers than you.
options.zh: 大祭司 Jaspis 对左径分子可似乎没你那么宽容。

texts.en: He nods acceptance, thankful, with hands clasped.
texts.zh: 他点头接受，神情感激，双手始终合十。

texts.en: He raises a skeptical eyebrow at you, but nods, hands clasped.
texts.zh: 他挑起眉毛，带着几分怀疑看着你，但还是点了点头，双手合十。

texts.en:
"Indeed." He casts his gaze up and far away. "Let not the sins of our mothers..." he says quietly, then looks back to you.

"Take my words not as judgment, but as a personal... a prayer, I suppose. Whatever her words, whatever her actions, she did choose to entrust her support to me in this, my task. And I, for my part, chose to trust you."

"So, captain, the path is yours." He drops his gaze and clasps his hands together.
texts.zh:
"确实如此。" 他抬眼望向远方。"莫让母辈之罪..." 他轻声说着，目光回到你身上。

"请别把我的话当作评判，而是一种私人...祈愿吧。无论她说了什么，做了什么，她确实选择在这件事上支持我。而我，也选择信任你。"

"所以，舰长，道途由你抉择。" 他垂下眼帘，双手合十。

texts.en:
"Perhaps. Though alongside their fear, you will earn their hate, and confirm in their minds all they say of you," he says. "You may well leave eternal enemies in your wake."

"Or corpses, I suppose," he adds grimly.
texts.zh:
"或许如此。不过除了恐惧，你还会受到他们的憎恨，并让他们心中关于你的所有传言都得到印证，" 他说，"或许，你将在身后留下永恒的敌人。"

"又或许，你会留下遍地尸骸，" 他阴沉地补充道。

options.en: You've given me a lot to think about.
options.zh: 你给了我很多思考的方向。

options.en: Archcurate Jaspis seems less forgiving of Pathers than you.
options.zh: 大祭司 Jaspis 对左径分子可似乎没你那么宽容。

options.en: I'll just win the battle without hurting anyone, is that what you want?
options.zh: 你的意思是让我在不伤及任何人的情况下取胜？

options.en: If they force me to, I will do what is necessary.
options.zh: 如果情况迫不得已，我会采取必要的手段。

texts.en:
He raises a skeptical eyebrow at you, but nods, hands clasped.

"I'd like nothing more, captain. Truly."
texts.zh:
他挑起眉毛，带着几分怀疑看着你，但还是点了点头，双手合十。

"我别无所求，舰长。真的。"

texts.en:
"In truth, it is not," he says. "I shan't ask the impossible."

He clasps his hands together. "I trust you will achieve what you must, how you must."
texts.zh:
"事实上，情况不会如此，"他说，"我不会强求不可能的事情。"

他双手合十。"我相信你会以必须的方式，达成必须的目标。"

texts.en:
"Did you?" he asks.

"You have made virtue of using a swift and strong hand in such matters. A Knight must learn to harden his heart when the situation calls for such... efficacy."
texts.zh:
"你真这么想吗？" 他问道。

"你向来擅长在此类事务中展现迅捷而强硬的手腕。一位骑士必须学会铁石心肠，当情势需要这种...效率时，"

texts.en:
"Indeed." He casts his gaze up and far away. "I thought her harsh, before. Cynicism of age. But I see now with the eyes of a man."

"And I, for my part, made the choice to trust you." He looks to you.

"So, captain, the path is yours. I shall follow." He clasps his hands together, bowing his head slightly.
texts.zh:
"确实如此。"他抬眼望向远处，"我曾以为她相当苛刻，有一种年龄滋生的愤世嫉俗。但如今我已经能以成人之眼再度看待。"

"而我，做出了信任你的选择。" 他看向你。

"所以，舰长，道途由你抉择。我自当追随。" 他双手合十，微微颔首。

texts.en: He bows his head, hands clasped.
texts.zh: 他垂下头，双手合十。

texts.en: He raises an eyebrow, then takes in your bridge crew.
texts.zh: 他挑了挑眉，随后打量起你的舰桥船员。

texts.en:
The attending medtech gives you a stern look as you step into the medbay despite the fact that you are the captain of the $shipOrFleet.

Bornanew's face is pale and bloated. His abdomen is covered in bandages and trailing tubes connected to a suite of murmuring autodocs.

"$playerFirstName," he says. "I appear to live." He takes a breath. "And to you I owe thanks. Captain, I mean. Apologies."
texts.zh:
你虽是$shipOrFleet的舰长，但当你踏入医疗舱时，值班医生还是投来一记严厉的目光。

Bornanew 面色苍白浮肿，腹部缠着层层绷带，数根导管从绷带下延伸而出，连接着一旁嗡嗡运转的自动医疗设备。

"$playerFirstName，" 他开口道，"看来我还活着。" 他缓了缓，"这条命，多亏了你。我是说，舰长。抱歉。"

options.en: $global.jethroName. That was a brave thing you did on Chalcedon.
options.zh: $global.jethroName。你在 Chalcedon 的行动真是英勇。

options.en: $global.jethroName. That was a stupid thing you did on Chalcedon.
options.zh: $global.jethroName。你在 Chalcedon 的行动真是愚蠢。

options.en: You should thank the medical team, they're the ones that saved you.
options.zh: 你该好好谢谢医疗团队，是他们救了你。

options.en: We're in the $bffi_patherStationSystem. There's a Pather base.
options.zh: 我们现在在 $bffi_patherStationSystem，这里有一处左径分子的基地。

texts.en:
It looks like he tries to shrug, and fails.

"It was... it was..." he trails off, and closes his eyes. "I was terrified, captain. A coward. And yet, what else could be done?"

He opens his eyes. "It may be that is enough for a Knight." He shifts slightly, under the bandages and tubes. "The machines, drugs. They take the pain away. It still hurts."
texts.zh:
他似乎想耸耸肩，却没能成功。

"那时候... 那时候... " 他的声音渐渐低了下去，缓缓闭上了眼睛，"我吓坏了，舰长。我就是个懦夫。可事到如今，又能有什么别的办法呢？"

他睁开双眼。"或许，这样就足以称得上是一名骑士了。" 他缠满绷带、插着管子的身体微微动了动，"那些仪器，那些药物，确实能止痛。但我仍然感到折磨。"

texts.en: "I have," he says. "And shall again, 'til they tire of it."
texts.zh: "我已经这么做了。" 他说道，"而且我还会继续下去，直到他们厌烦为止。"

texts.en:
"Ah. Then Ulmus told us true." A flicker of a smile crosses Bornanew's face.

"We must... destroy the nanoforge. And find out who the mole is, in the cathedral. Tartessus." He closes his eyes and takes a slow breath.
texts.zh:
"啊哈。这么说 Ulmus 没有骗我们。" 一丝笑意掠过 Bornanew 的脸庞。

"我们必须... 毁掉那台纳米锻炉，还要查出 Tartessus 大教堂里的内应是谁。" 他闭上眼睛，缓缓地吸了一口气。

options.en: I intend to negotiate with the Pather in charge here.
options.zh: 我打算与此地主事的左径分子谈判。

options.en: I intend to send a marine raid. Seize datastores, destroy the forge.
options.zh: 我打算发动陆战队劫掠，夺取数据存储设备，摧毁锻炉。

options.en: I intend to attack directly. Destroy the station.
options.zh: 我打算直接发起进攻，摧毁这座空间站。

texts.en:
"They are... as human and fallible as any of us. To convince them, would be a miracle." He looks at you skeptically.

"If... that fails. Acquire hard data. The scan of the original glove, the metadata may tell us. Comms buffers. Archives. All useful." He looks at you, "I have a list of suspects. A mole in the Holy Cathedral of Exodus. Need evidence. Who to... put to inquisition."

Defensive, he adds, "The rumors... slander. Mostly." His eyes are closed, his breathing shallow. "And... destroy the forge. Must be destroyed."
texts.zh:
"他们... 与所有凡人一样充满过失。要说服他们，无疑是奇迹。" 他将信将疑地看着你。

"如果... 这样行不通，那就去获取实体数据。原版手套的扫描文件、元数据或许能提供线索，通讯缓冲区、档案库，都会有用。" 他注视着你，"我有一份嫌疑人名单，关于 Exodus 神圣大教堂的内应。需要证据，才能决定... 对谁进行审判。"

他戒备地补充道："那些传闻... 大多是诽谤。" 他双目紧闭，呼吸浅促。"还有... 摧毁锻炉。务必彻底销毁。"

texts.en: "$PlayerSirOrMadam." Your chief medical officer appears behind you. "The patient needs rest. I must insist."
texts.zh: "$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 你的医疗主管出现在你身后，"病人需要休息，我必须坚持这一点。"

options.en: Of course.
options.zh: 当然。

options.en: I will decide when he needs rest, doctor.
options.zh: 医生，他何时需要休息由我来决定。

texts.en:
Your med chief's face is crossed by a network of fine wrinkles, evidence of many cycles of service. They say nothing, but turn their head at a small and precise angle.

Bornanew's breathing is slow, regular. His eyes closed. Unconscious.
texts.zh:
你的医疗主管眼角细密的皱纹似乎在讲述着漫长岁月的服役故事。此人一言不发，只是精准地微微侧过头。

Bornanew 呼吸缓慢而规律，双目紧闭，已失去意识。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: You leave Bornanew to the stern care of your chief medical officer.
texts.zh: 你将 Bornanew 交由医疗主管照料。

texts.en:
The expression on your med chief's face doesn't change, but the network of fine wrinkles tells of sufficient cycles of service such that they will stand firm against your overstep of authority.

"Nonetheless," your chief medical officer says, turning their head a small and precise angle.

Bornanew's breathing is slow, regular. His eyes closed. Unconscious.
texts.zh:
你的医疗主管面不改色，眼角细密的皱纹似乎在讲述着漫长岁月的服役故事，绝不会任凭你越权决定。

"话虽如此。" 你的医疗主管微微侧过头，角度拿捏得精准分毫。

Bornanew 呼吸缓慢而规律，双目紧闭，已失去意识。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"The Pathers' reputation... they are as human as any. Not all heretical zealots. Fallible, fearful." He looks at you skeptically.

"I have a list of suspects. A mole in the Holy Cathedral of Exodus. Need evidence. Who to... put to inquisition. Acquire hard data. The scan of the original glove, the metadata may tell us. Comms buffers. Archives. All useful."

He looks at you. "Inquisition... the rumors. Slander. Mostly." His eyes are closed, his breathing shallow. "And... destroy the forge. Must be destroyed."
texts.zh:
"左径分子的名声... 他们终究也是凡人。并非所有异端狂热者都坚不可摧，他们也会犯错，会恐惧。" 他将信将疑地看着你。

"我有一份嫌疑人名单，关于 Exodus 神圣大教堂的内应。需要证据，才能决定...对谁进行审判。去获取实体数据。原版手套的扫描文件、元数据或许能提供线索，通讯缓冲区、档案库，都会有用。"

他戒备地补充道："审判庭... 那些传闻，是诽谤，大多是。" 他双目紧闭，呼吸浅促。"还有... 摧毁锻炉。务必彻底销毁。"

texts.en:
"No!" He speaks a little too forcefully; a blinking light turns yellow.

"Risky... need acquire hard data. Scan of the original glove, the metadata. Comms buffers. Archives." He takes a deep breath then looks at you, "I have a list of suspects. A mole in the Holy Cathedral of Exodus. Need evidence. Who to... put to inquisition."

He pauses, then says, "Inquisitors. The rumors... slander. Mostly." His eyes are closed, his breathing shallow. "And... destroy the forge. Must be destroyed."
texts.zh:
"不！" 他语气略显激烈；一盏指示灯转为黄色。

"太冒险了...去获取实体数据。原版手套的扫描文件、元数据、通讯缓冲区、档案库。" 他深吸一口气，随后看向你，"我有一份嫌疑人名单，关于 Exodus 神圣大教堂的内应。需要证据，才能决定...对谁进行审判。"

他停顿片刻，继续说道："审判庭。那些传闻...大多是诽谤。" 他双目紧闭，呼吸浅促。"还有...摧毁锻炉。务必彻底销毁。"

texts.en:
You decide to let Bornanew rest. You've got this.

All you need to do is beg, trick, or force the Pathers to reveal the source of their scan of the original glove. That glove has somehow remained, presumably untouched, in the vault of the Holy Cathedral of Exodus back on Tartessus this whole time.

Pathers are not known for keeping good digital records, but to nanoforge a copy of the glove, they would have had to. There may be metadata still in the computer systems connected to the nanoforge.

Or someone who simply knows the answers which you seek.
texts.zh:
你决定让 Bornanew 先休息，让这里交给你处理。

你只需设法乞求、哄骗或逼迫左径分子透露他们获取原版手套扫描数据的源头。那副手套始终保存在 Tartessus 的 Exodus 神圣大教堂圣库中，想必一直未被触动。

周所周知，左径分子向来不会妥善保存数字记录，但若要纳米锻造手套的复制品，他们将不得不留存数据。与纳米锻炉相连的计算机系统中或许仍存有元数据。

又或者，你可以直接找到知晓答案的人。

texts.en:
The primary defenses are destroyed, the command and control section holed and venting fiery atmo. The superstructure's own spin is pulling the station apart like slow butchery.

You destroyed the nanoforge, but did not secure the evidence Bornanew needed to find the mole in the Cathedral of Holy Exodus on Tartessus.

"It is the best that could be done," Bornanew says, eyes downcast. His notebook is closed, before him. "I must submit myself to the Excubitor Orbis for judgment. On Hesperus."
texts.zh:
主要防御体系已被摧毁，指挥控制区也被击穿，炽热的大气正喷涌而出。空间站的结构正因自身的旋转而缓缓撕裂，如同缓慢的肢解。

你摧毁了纳米锻炉，却未能获取 Bornanew 所需的证据 —— 那些能在 Tartessus 的 Exodus 神圣大教堂揪出内应的证据。

"这已是所能做到的最好结果了，" Bornanew 垂目低语道。他的笔记本正合着，摆在他的面前。"我必须向行星教卫大人请罪，就在 Hesperus。"

options.en: Assemble your officers to plan a raid to capture the nanoforge
options.zh: 召集你的军官，制定劫掠计划以夺取纳米锻炉。

texts.en:
You convene your officers, and Bornanew, to evaluate the situation.

Pather resistance is expected to be fierce; the core of their militants have a zealous faith, little fear of death, and are often experienced fighters. However they eschew top of the line technology and combat enhancement, whether cybernetic or biochemical.

Bornanew clears his throat and speaks. "Certain classes of combat drugs are accepted among Luddic Path militants. They favor, ah, 'natural' sources." He takes in the confused looks. "Plants," he adds.

Capturing high-value datastores before they're wiped creates exceptional difficulties. The assault must be lightning-quick, and disabling rather than destructive as much as possible.
texts.zh:
你召集麾下的军官与 Bornanew 共同评估局势。

左径分子的抵抗预计将极为激烈；其核心武装分子信仰狂热，悍不畏死，且多为经验丰富的战士。然而他们排斥顶尖科技与战斗强化手段，无论是赛博改造还是生化增强。

Bornanew 清了清嗓子，随后开口说道："某些类别的战斗药剂在卢德左径武装分子中被允许使用。他们偏好，呃，'天然' 的来源。" 他察觉到众人困惑的目光，便继续道，"也就是植物提取物。"

在数据存储单元被清除前夺取高价值目标将带来极大的困难。突击行动必须迅如闪电，并尽可能采用瘫痪手段而非毁灭性打击。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: I've come a long way looking to purchase something... unique. (lie)
options.zh: 我远道而来，是为了买点...特别的东西。 (说谎)

texts.en: "A Mammonite's lie, I expect." $HisOrHer faces twists with contempt. "Look at you, spacer, so far from the light of the Path."
texts.zh: "玛门之仆的谎言罢了。" $hisOrHer的面容因轻蔑而扭曲，"看看你，太空佬，离圣道之光何其遥远。"

options.en: Light or no, I am honest. You sow false relics to cause war among the Faithful.
options.zh: 且不论那什么光明，我所言都句句属实。你散播伪造的圣物，意在挑动信徒间的纷争。

options.en: You speak of sin while you sow false relics to cause war among the Faithful?
options.zh: 你口口声声着罪孽，所作所为却是散播伪造的圣物，挑动信徒间的纷争？

options.en: Blind am I, and faithless? I see you sow false relics to cause war among the Faithful.
options.zh: 我又已盲目，又心怀异念？我分明见你散播伪造的圣物，挑动信徒间的纷争。

options.en: If it is an honest fight you want, then why the false relics scheme?
options.zh: 若你想要一场光明正大的对决，那又何必设下这伪造圣物的阴谋？

options.en: Why are you so willing to violate the tenets of your faith for Wrestling Sedge?
options.zh: 你为何要为了 Wrestling Sedge 而甘愿违背自身信仰的教义？

options.en: Your 'skulduggery' is undone anyway. I found your relic and tracked it to here.
options.zh: 你的 '阴谋诡计' 早已败露。我已经找到了你们的圣物，并一路追踪至此。

options.en: We seek not your death, but to stop a scheme that will itself kill countless Faithful. (explain)
options.zh: 我们并非要取你性命，只是要阻止一场将会葬送无数信徒性命的阴谋。 (解释)

options.en: I can destroy you. Choose to lose all - or make a deal, and lose little. (explain)
options.zh: 我完全可以灭了你。自己选吧，要么失去所有 —— 要么和我做个交易，只要付出一点代价。 (解释)

options.en: You're a hopeless fanatic. There is no reasoning with you.
options.zh: 你就是个无可救药的狂信徒，根本没法跟你讲道理。

options.en: Your heresy has twisted your faith. There is no reasoning with you. (cut the comms)
options.zh: 你的异端邪说已经扭曲了你的信仰，根本没法跟你讲道理。 (切断通讯)

texts.en:
"Question me not!" True anger flashes across $hisOrHer eyes. "What know you of verity? You are blind to God, blind to the Word, you worship only credits and power. This I see full well!"

"Would you have me submit to the creeping decay of the Church's heresy? Submit to the Knight-Inquisitors that I might be tortured into false confession?"

$HeOrShe pauses, breathing heavily for a moment, then more quietly says, "I was not made for such skulduggery. It is a Mammonite's trade." The words come more softly now. "Will you now fight or no? Better to die a martyr than a hypocrite."
texts.zh:
"别想质问我！" $hisOrHer的眼中怒火骤现。"你懂什么？你对神明视而不见，对圣言充耳不闻，一心只崇拜金钱与权力。这些我看得一清二楚！"

"你难道要我屈从于教会异端那蚕食信仰的堕落？屈从于审判骑士，任由他们对我严刑拷打、逼我编造供词不成？"

$HeOrShe顿了顿，粗重地喘息片刻，随后声音低沉下来："我从不是玩弄阴谋诡计的人。这种勾当，本就是玛门之仆的拿手好戏。" 他的话语愈发轻柔，"如今你到底要战还要和？与其做个伪君子，不如殉道而亡。"

texts.en:
"So you accuse me of sin, Molochian?" Anger flashes across $hisOrHer eyes. "What choice have I? Submit to the creeping decay of the Church's heresy? Submit to the Knight-Inquisitors that I be tortured into false confession?"

"Question not my piety, nor devotion. Give me arms, or none, and I shall face you or your brutes of the so-called Knights of Ludd to the end of my blood!"

$HeOrShe pauses a moment, almost overcome, to breathe heavily.

"I was not made for such skulduggery." The words come softly now. "It is a Mammonite's trade. But what choice is given?" $HeOrShe glares at you. "Will you make me a martyr now, or no?"
texts.zh:
"所以你指控我有罪，摩洛克信徒？" $hisOrHer的眼中闪烁着愤怒，"我还有什么选择？屈服于教会异端那缓慢的腐化？还是向骑士审判官低头，受尽折磨后屈打成招？"

"不要质疑我的敬畏，也不要质疑我的虔诚。不管给我武器，还是赤手空拳，我都要与你 —— 或你那些所谓的卢德骑士团的走狗 —— 血战到底！"

$heOrShe停顿片刻，几乎难以自持，沉重地喘息着。

"我生来就抗拒这般阴谋诡计。" 此刻对方话音转轻，"那是玛门之仆的勾当。但谁会给我选择的余地？" $heOrShe怒视着你，"你现在就要让我殉道吗，嗯？"

texts.en:
True anger flashes through  $hisOrHer eyes. "What choice have I? Shall I submit to the creeping decay of the Church's heresy? Submit to the Knight-Inquisitors that I might be tortured into false confession? It is they who slowly tear apart the Faith, not I! It is they who scorn the Word, not I!"

"Question not my piety, nor my devotion! Give me arms, or none, and I shall face you and your brutes of the so-called Knights of Ludd to the end of my blood!" $HeOrShe pauses a moment, almost overcome, to breathe heavily. "I was not made for such skulduggery." The words come more softly now. "It is a Mammonite's trade. But what choice is given? Will you make me a martyr now, or no?"
texts.zh:
$hisOrHer的眼中怒火骤燃。"我又有何选择？难道要我屈从于教会异端那蚕食人心的堕落？难道要我向审判骑士低头，任由他们酷刑逼供，迫使我编造供词？是他们在一步步撕裂信仰，不是我！是他们在亵渎圣言，不是我！"

"休想质疑我的虔诚信仰，更别怀疑我的忠诚信念！无论赐我武器与否，我都会和你，还有你手下那群自诩卢德骑士团的暴徒抗争到底，流尽最后一滴血！" $HeOrShe顿了顿，情绪几近失控，粗重地喘息着。"我从不是玩弄阴谋诡计的人。" 他的声音低沉了许多，"这都是玛门之仆才会做的勾当。可我别无选择，不是吗？如今，你难道要逼我殉道？"

texts.en:
"We're all given our place," $heOrShe says, both annoyed and discouraged. "The Path is not easy, nor does it provide comfort. For that, we were given the Word."

$HisOrHer eyes are searching, $hisOrHer devotion to this aspect of the cause obviously wavering. "Sedge was strong, and many followed him. Besides, he was backed by-" $HeOrShe catches $himOrHerself. "Backed by a better Walker by far, blessed be his Path."

"Well, it's done now, isn't it? That scheme is dead, and you bring here the technology of death."
texts.zh:
"我们都各安其位，" $heOrShe说道，语气里夹杂着恼怒与沮丧，"卢德之道既非坦途，亦无安逸，正因如此，我们才被赐予圣言。"

$hisOrHer眼神游移，对事业的忠诚显然已经开始动摇了。"Sedge 曾是强者，众人追随。何况他背后有 ——" $heOrShe突然压低嗓门，"...有一位远胜于我的循道者所支持，愿他的道途蒙福。"

"如今都结束了，不是吗？那计划已死，而你却将死亡的科技带到此地。"

texts.en:
$HisOrHer eyes narrow. "It doesn't matter now; I hear he was murdered, shot in the back by some spacer mercenary who is more machine than flesh."

"Merciful Providence forgive me," $hisOrHer tone softens slightly, "for to speak ill of the dead, and a martyr to our cause at that, but. The man was a beast and I am better pleased to find him on the other side of the infinite."
texts.zh:
$HisOrHer眯起双眼。"现在说这些也没用了。我听说他已经遇害了，被某个太空佬从背后开枪打死 —— 那家伙早就半人半机器，没多少肉了。"

"愿上天宽恕，" $HisOrHer的语气稍稍缓和了些，"毕竟说死人坏话总归不地道，更何况他还是为我们的事业牺牲的。但我还是要说，那家伙就是个畜生，如今他下了地狱，我心里反倒痛快得很。"

"Merciful Providence forgive me," $hisOrHer tone softens slightly, "for to speak ill of the dead, and a martyr to our cause at that, but. The man was a beast and I am better pleased to find him on the other side of the infinite."
