options.en: Then praise the Path! You're free of the beast and his schemes.
options.zh: 那就赞颂卢德之道吧！你已经摆脱了那野兽和他的阴谋。

options.en: It is I who shot Sedge. Though I'm less machine than you'd hope.
options.zh: 是我射杀了 Sedge，尽管我并非是你期望的那种杀戮机器。

options.en: Then praise the Path! You're free of the beast and his schemes.
options.zh: 那就赞颂卢德之道吧！你已经摆脱了那野兽和他的阴谋。

options.en: It is I who killed Sedge. After he murdered the man I was speaking to.
options.zh: 是我杀了 Sedge，就在他谋杀了正和我交谈的那人之后。

texts.en:
"Mind, do hide your forked tongue." The Pather has a mean smile. "I see your obvious ploy, to turn me from the Path. But as is said by teachers wiser than I, 'the devil will lie by the truth itself'." $HeOrShe makes a show of looking you over through the comms.

"Nonetheless. I do find myself free of his... customs of leadership."
texts.zh:
"留神，收好你的花言巧语。" 这位左径分子脸上挂着一抹不怀好意的笑，"你这点伎俩我看得明明白白，无非就是想诱我背离正道。不过有句先贤留下的话是这么说的 ——'邪魔歪道，亦会借真话行骗'。" $HeOrShe刻意透过通讯画面端详着你。

"话虽如此，摆脱了他那套所谓的领导作风，我倒真是一身轻松。"

texts.en:
"Hah!" The Pather has a mean smile. "An obvious boast, typical of a Molochian." $HeOrShe makes a show of looking at you through the comms, "You couldn't have taken Sedge. He was a greater warrior than you or I, by far."

"Nonetheless, I weep not to be free of his... leadership."
texts.zh:
"哈！" 这名信徒脸上露出一抹不怀好意的笑，"虚张声势，典型的摩洛克信徒作风。" $HeOrShe故意借着通讯器的画面上下打量着你，"你不可能拿下了 Sedge，他远比你我都更加善战。"

"话虽如此，能不用再受他管辖，我可是半点都不觉得惋惜。"

texts.en:
"Hah!" The Pather has a mean smile. "An obvious boast, typical of a Molochian." $HeOrShe makes a show of looking at you through the comms, "You couldn't have taken Sedge... except by cowardly ambush, or some other deception. He was a greater warrior than you or I, by far."

"Nonetheless, I weep not to be free of his... leadership."
texts.zh:
"哈！" 这名信徒脸上露出一抹不怀好意的笑，"虚张声势，典型的摩洛克信徒作风。" $HeOrShe故意借着通讯器的画面上下打量着你，"你不可能拿下了 Sedge... 除非你耍阴的搞伏击，或者用了什么见不得人的诡计。他远比你我都更加善战。"

"话虽如此，能不用再受他管辖，我可是半点都不觉得惋惜。"

texts.en:
"So you have," $heOrShe admits. "I had thought that not possible - and assured it was not by Brother Sedge."

The Pather looks away. "That man would have told me anything to get his way, I think. And if somehow I didn't agree... I give thanks that it did not come to that."
texts.zh:
"你确实做到了。" $heOrShe 坦言，"我本来以为这根本不可能 —— Sedge 修士也跟我打包票说绝无可能。"

这名左径分子移开了视线。"现在想来，那人为了达到目的，什么话都编得出来。当初我要是执意不答应... 还好，总算没走到那一步。"

texts.en:
You explain that no devotion or zealotry, however righteous, can overcome the power of your $shipOrFleet, or the others that would follow if you failed to win the day.

Is $heOrShe so loyal to Sedge's plan that $heOrShe is willing to die for it - even after it's fallen apart? Besides, a schism across the whole of the ecumene of the Luddic faith would lead to a sectarian war which could see millions of Faithful dead. And not even for the cause of the Path, but for a falsehood!

$HeOrShe has a choice, you explain. Call it a Molochian bargain. Either this is a major loss of personnel, materiel, and the station, or it can be a minor loss of certain assets - for a failed barbaric scheme $heOrShe doesn't even really believe in.
texts.zh:
你阐明道，无论多么正义的虔诚或狂热，都无法匹敌你麾下$shipOrFleet的威力，又或是在你失利后那些必将接踵而至的其他力量。

难道$heOrShe对 Sedge 计划的忠诚，竟足以令自己甘愿为之赴死 — —即便该计划早已彻底失败？况且，如果卢德信仰的普世教会陷入分裂，将引发一场可能导致数百万信徒丧生的教派战争，而这甚至并非是为了卢德之道的事业，却只是为了一场骗局！

你解释道，$heOrShe仍有一次选择的机会，不妨称之为恶魔摩洛克式的交易。要么承受人员、物资与空间站的重大损失，要么就仅仅在那个连$heOrShe自己都未必真心认同的阴谋上，付出特定资产的小小代价。

options.en: Propose terms
options.zh: 提出条件

texts.en:
You explain that you will require comms buffers and datastores pertaining to Sedge's scheme. You will need the datastores of the nanoforge, and must be given access in order to destroy it.

No one need be hurt; it can be done quickly, without bloodshed, and without compromising $hisOrHer leadership status if $heOrShe secretly gives you their primary security codes. Blame it on the injection of a semi-sentient computer virus, a 'daemon' of the sort Molochians conjure in their AI-labs.
texts.zh:
你说明自己需要与 Sedge 计划相关的通讯缓冲区和数据存储单元，同时也需要纳米锻炉的数据存储单元，并要求获得访问权限以将其摧毁。

没有人会受伤；若能秘密地提供主安全代码，行动就可以迅速且和平地完成，同时也不会损害$hisOrHer的领导地位。届时完全可以将一切归咎于一种半感知计算机病毒的入侵 —— 那种摩洛克信徒在其 AI 实验室里炮制的 '恶魔' 程序。

options.en: Accept my terms. It is the Path of least harm for all.
options.zh: 接受我的条件，这是对所有人伤害最小的道途。

texts.en: "Why should I trust you to keep your word?" $HeOrShe is clearly unhappy with your terms. "You're no servant of Providence following the holy Word passed to us by Ludd. How can there be light in your heart?"
texts.zh: "我凭什么相信你会信守承诺？" $heOrShe显然对你的条件相当不满。"你并非是上天的仆从，也不曾遵循卢德所传的圣言，你心中怎会有光明？"

texts.en: $HeOrShe looks upon you, face now more open than before, as if almost convinced...
texts.zh: $heOrShe注视着你，神色比先前坦率许多，仿佛已被说动大半...

texts.en:
"Cease, I beg you." $HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer head in $hisOrHer hands. "I pray this is the correct Path, that you are not the monster you appear."

"I must accept your terms," $heOrShe says, "I shall pray for forgiveness. And may any hellfire of this world or the next fall upon myself first and not those I seek to protect."
texts.zh:
"停下，我求你了。" $heOrShe将$hisOrHer的脸埋入自己的掌心，"我祈愿这仍是正确的道途，祈愿你并非表面那般是个狰狞的怪物。"

"我必须接受你的条件，" $heOrShe说道，"我将祈求宽恕。愿现世或来世的任何地狱之火，先降临于我，而非我所求庇护之人。"

options.en: Carry out the ruse to seize datastores and destroy the nanoforge
options.zh: 执行佯攻计划，夺取数据存储单元并摧毁纳米锻炉

options.en: I have given the Path a great gift, and that deal has held.
options.zh: 我曾赠予左径一份大礼，而那项约定至今有效。

options.en: Let's make it easy. I'll give you 50,000 credits to assist your relocation.
options.zh: 不妨让事情简单点。我给你 50,000 星币，帮你换个地方重新开始。

options.en: I have walked the Pilgrim's Path. We may not see eye-to-eye, but I am a fellow walker.
options.zh: 我曾行走于朝圣者之路。我们或许见解不同，但我亦是循道同袍。

options.en: I have walked the Path. I support your cause, in the end, even if you don't believe it.
options.zh: 我曾行走于卢德之道。我终究支持你们的事业，即便你不相信。

options.en: I have been merciful in my actions, whatever you think of my beliefs.
options.zh: 无论你如何看待我的信仰，我的行动始终秉持仁慈。

options.en: Surely my humanitarian reputation precedes me.
options.zh: 想必我人道主义的作风早已传遍这片星域。

options.en: My patience is spent. There can be no deal, and that's on you. (cut comms)
options.zh: 我的耐心已经用完了。现在没有交易可言，要怪就怪你自己吧。 (切断通讯)

options.en: Your heresy has corrupted you too far. I pray the infinite accepts you. (cut comms)
options.zh: 你的异端思想已将你腐蚀至深，但愿无限能接纳你。 (切断通讯)

texts.en: Cowed by your promises of mercy, the Pather leader provides you with security codes and your ops team mounts what appears to be a lightning-raid which catches the defenders completely by surprise.
texts.zh: 慑于你承诺的宽恕，左径头目交出了安全代码。你的行动小组随即发起一场闪电般的劫掠行动，守军被彻底打了个措手不及。

texts.en: Cowed by your promises of mercy - and, perhaps, your credits - the Pather leader provides you with security codes and your ops team mounts what appears to be a lightning-raid which catches the defenders completely by surprise.
texts.zh: 慑于你承诺的宽恕 —— 或许还有星币的缘故 —— 左径头目交出了安全代码。你的行动小组随即发起一场闪电般的劫掠行动，守军被彻底打了个措手不及。

texts.en:
It appears to be "Moloch's own luck," as one captured Pather describes it in the aftermath.

Your teams seize comms buffers, datastores, and a demolitions squad reduces the nanoforge to only so much glowing rubble, spilling jets of atmo and feed-gases into space which occasionally ignite in floral bursts amidst the debris.
texts.zh:
这似乎是 "恶魔摩洛克的眷顾"，一名被俘的左径分子在事后如是说。

你的小队控制了通讯缓冲区与数据存储单元，而爆破组已将纳米锻炉化为一片炽热的废墟，大气层与燃料气体喷涌着进入太空，在残骸间不时迸发出花朵般的火焰。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The prize, turned over to your Tech officer's analysis team by a crew of sweating salvors, is a largely uncorrupted backup archive. Standard Domain tech, it hardly looks like the Pathers even knew it was quietly doing its job behind a thin access panel.

The technicians descend upon it with a suite of interfacers, passing every scrap of data to the analysts working in an isolated computing environment to reconstruct the system, starting with comms buffers and metadata.
texts.zh:
这份战利品被一群大汗淋漓的打捞员移交至你的技术军官的分析团队手中 —— 那是一个基本完好的备份档案库。标准的 人之领 科技，而且似乎左径分子甚至未曾察觉到，它就藏在一块薄薄的检修板后默默运作着。

技术团队带着全套接口设备蜂拥而上，将每一点数据碎片传递至隔离计算环境中的分析员手中，从通讯缓冲区和元数据开始，着手重建整个系统。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
A cloud of icons, sigils, words forms. Names, front companies, ships, codewords, and references to theological agitprop. Bornanew follows closely, his hands not nearly as deft with the interface as your dedicated techs.

You can see in his body language the exact moment that he finds something he recognizes.
texts.zh:
图标、徽记、文字如层云般涌现 —— 姓名、空壳公司、舰船、密码，以及神学煽动宣传的引述。Bornanew 目不转睛，虽然他操作界面的手法远不如你的专职技术员娴熟。

你能从他身体语言中精准捕捉到他认出某条信息的瞬间。

texts.en:
A cloud of icons, sigils, words forms. Names, front companies, ships, codewords, and references to theological agitprop. Your tech officer's hands blur as they manipulate an interface invisible to you; his subtle cybermods blink rapidly. And then stop, steady.

"Captain, we may have something."

Their eyes refocus on the real world again, taking a moment to adapt to mundanity. "Something for your, ah, consultant. The Knight."
texts.zh:
图标、徽记、文字如层云般涌现 —— 姓名、空壳公司、舰船、密码，以及神学煽动宣传的引述。你的技术军官的双手在不可见的界面上飞速操作，他那精密的赛博改造体闪烁着高速的光点。随后停顿，归于稳定。

"舰长，我们可能有所发现。"

他的目光重新聚焦回现实世界，稍作适应后才继续说。"有些信息或许适合你的，呃，顾问。就是那位骑士。"

options.en: $global.jethroName. What is it?
options.zh: $global.jethroName，那是什么？

options.en: What have you found?
options.zh: 你有何发现？

texts.en:
"Keepfaith," Bornanew says. Fumbling with his datapad, the shared workspace highlights all references to that string of letters, then focuses, arranging comms logs and metadata into blocks, compressing everything else down into unobtrusive corners.

He leans back, his eyes darting around some internal catalogue. His paper notebook appears in his hands and he flips to a page as if to check something.
texts.zh:
"Keepfaith，" Bornanew 说道。他笨拙地操作着数据平板，共享工作区随即高亮显示了所有包含该字串的引用，继而聚焦排列出通讯日志与元数据区块，将其余内容压缩至不显眼的角落。

他向后靠去，目光快速扫视着某种内部目录。纸质笔记本突然出现在他手中，他翻动书页，仿佛在核对着什么。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Cedra Keepfaith," he explains. "A subcurate of the Holy Cathedral of Exodus on Tartessus, in the Eos Exodus system. She has authority over the scriptorium."

He sees your look, then explains. "Books. They repair and reproduce books for the library. And," his voice drops, "the vaults. She would have access."
texts.zh:
"Cedra Keepfaith，" 他解释道，"Tartessus Exodus 神圣大教堂的助理祭司，隶属于 Eos Exodus 星系，她掌管着文书院。"

他观察着你的神色，一边继续说明："书籍，他们为图书馆修复和复刻典籍。而且，" 他压低声音，"包括圣库，她具备进入的权限。"

options.en: So this Keepfaith is your Pather mole?
options.zh: 所以这个 Keepfaith 就是你们那儿的左径内应？

texts.en:
"She would fit," he says, thinking. "My impression was that her ambitions in the Church have not been satisfied for many years, be that fair or no. She was not humble upon our meeting."

"These logs appear to reference correspondence with her. She turned down credits, it appears. Would gratification of spite be payment enough?"

He turns to you, done with speculation. "Certainly she did not act alone, but this connects her to the act. She must be arrested and taken to the Inquisitors for investigation and judgment."
texts.zh:
"她很符合，" 他沉吟道，"我的印象是她在教会中的抱负多年来未得满足，不论这是否公平。她既不谦逊，也不愿妥协。"

"这些日志似乎提及了与她的通信往来。她拒绝了金钱报酬，难道她只想满足自己的怨恨吗？"

他转向你，结束了推测。"她绝非单独行动，但这些证据足以证明她已参与其中。必须逮捕她，并将她移交给审判官进行调查与审判。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
A junior officer pokes their head into the briefing room, "$PlayerSirOrMadam, my apologies. The chief thought you'd want to see this."

Two burly salvors, still in their sweaty suit-liners, haul a crate and set it on the deckplates with a solid thump. With an impish grin, one of them looses the catches and together they pull the top-cover away.

It's filled with work-gloves. All of like chirality.
texts.zh:
一名下级军官探头进入简报室，"$PlayerSirOrMadam，抱歉打扰，但长官认为您会想看看这个的。"

两名身材魁梧、还穿着汗湿内衬服的打捞员拖着一个板条箱，将它 "咚" 地一声搁在甲板上。其中一人带着顽劣的笑容松开搭扣，两人随即一同掀开了顶盖。

箱子里装满了工作手套，全部像是从同一只手上摘下来的一样。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew lets out a breath.

"I ought to have anticipated this." He sounds annoyed with himself. "Costs no more to run a batch of one than of..." He reaches in, picking up a glove, then pressing into the cargo container to feel for density. "Five-twelve?" He turns to you. "Perhaps five hundred eleven, without our other hard-won specimen?"

He wipes his hands, as if something unpleasant had got on them. "These will need to be destroyed."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 呼出一口气。

"我早该料到这点。" 他的语气里带着自责，"生产单只手套的成本基本等同于批量生产..." 他伸手取出一只手套，又探进货柜里按了按以感知密度。"512 只？" 他转向你，"或许是 511 只，除去我们费尽心思缴获的那份样本之外？"

他擦了擦手，仿佛沾上了什么不洁之物一般。"这些必须全部销毁。"

options.en: Order it done
options.zh: 下令执行

texts.en:
It is done with swift enthusiasm by a crew monitored by your ops chief.

The last step is the capture of Bornanew's mole on Tartessus.
texts.zh:
在你的行动长官的监督下，船员们以迅猛的热情完成了任务。

最后一步是前往 Tartessus 逮捕 Bornanew 所指认的内应。

texts.en:
"A word. Maybe a code? A name? It comes up several times, relating to Tartessus and the template they fed into the forge."

"The word is 'Keepfaith'. One word. Maybe it means something special to the Ludd... ics?"
texts.zh:
"一个单词。或许是暗号？人名？它多次出现，与 Tartessus 和他们输入锻炉的模板数据都有所关联。"

"这个词是 'Keepfaith'。一个单词，可能对卢德...教徒有特殊的含义？"

options.en: Clean up some representative samples for me.
options.zh: 替我理出一些代表性的样本。

texts.en:
"Aye, $playerSirOrMadam," they reply, and their eyes become unfocused, face slack, cybermods blinking rapidly once more.

You turn, bracing yourself for a negotiation with your medical chief to allow a brief conversation with Bornanew.
texts.zh:
"遵命，$playerSirOrMadam，" 他们回应道，随即目光再次涣散，面容也松弛下来，赛博改造体重新开始高速闪烁。

你转过身，准备与医疗主管交涉，争取与 Bornanew 进行简短对话的机会。

options.en: Go to the medbay
options.zh: 前往医疗舱

texts.en:
"Keepfaith," Bornanew says, repeating the last word of your question.

He leans back in his bed, his eyes darting around some internal catalogue. His notebook appears in his hands - it is impressive to have snuck an outside object past the wary eye of your senior medical officer - and he flips to a page to check something.

"Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith. Authority over the scriptorium of the Holy Cathedral of Exodus, on Tartessus, in the Eos Exodus system."
texts.zh:
"Keepfaith，" Bornanew 重复着你问题中的最后一个词。

他向后靠在病床上，目光快速扫视着某种内部目录。笔记本突然出现在他的手中 —— 能避开你资深医疗官的警觉视线将外部物品带进来可实属不易 —— 他翻动书页核对内容。

"助理祭司 Cedra Keepfaith，她掌管着 Eos Exodus 星系 Tartessus Exodus 神圣大教堂的文书院。"

options.en: Over the what?
options.zh: 掌管着什么？

texts.en: "Apologies," he says, closing the notebook, then tapping its cover. "Books. They repair and reproduce books for the library. And," his voice drops, "the vaults. She would have access."
texts.zh: "抱歉，" 他合上笔记本，一边轻敲着封面，一边说道，"是书籍，他们为图书馆修复和复刻典籍。而且，" 他压低声音道，"也包括圣库，她具备进入的权限。"

options.en: So this Keepfaith is your Pather mole.
options.zh: 所以这个 Keepfaith 就是你们那儿的左径内应？

texts.en:
"She would fit," he says, thinking. "Her ambitions... were great, and unfulfilled."

"These logs show correspondence. She turned down a payment of credits from the Path." He takes several slow breaths. "Would spite be payment enough for her?"

"Didn't act alone." His eyes close, his breaths coming roughly now. "But she was their access. Must be arrested. Taken to the Inquisitors."

The distinct sound of your chief medical officer clearing their throat sounds from the doorway.
texts.zh:
"她很符合，" 他沉吟道，"她的抱负...曾很宏大，却未得实现。"

"这些日志显示他们存在通信往来，而她拒绝了左径的金钱报酬。" 他缓缓吸了几口气，"难道她只想满足自己的怨恨吗？"

"这并非是单独的行动。" 他闭上眼睛，呼吸也变得粗重，"但她是他们的接触点，必须逮捕她，移交审判官。"

门口不远处传来医疗主管清晰的清嗓声。

options.en: Get some rest. We're going to Tartessus.
options.zh: 抓紧休息吧，我们得去一趟 Tartessus。

texts.en:
"I admit, I have heard word of the one with whom this deal was struck." $HisOrHer brow furrows. "I cannot say I fully understand it, but we are... requested not to harm you, if it is so possible."

The Pather looks up and away for a moment. "This is a strange Path I find myself walking," $heOrShe says, as if to some greater power. "I pray that its truth may be revealed before long..."
texts.zh:
"我承认，我听说过与你达成交易的那个人的名号。" $hisOrHer眉头紧锁，"虽然不能说完全理解，但我们...被要求尽可能避免伤害你。"

左径分子抬眼望向远处片刻。"我正行走在一条奇特的道途上，" $heOrShe说道，仿佛在向某种更高力量诉说，"我祈愿其中的真理能早日昭示..."

texts.en:
"Your lucre..." A troubled look crosses $hisOrHer face, as if $hisOrHer heart isn't in this condemnation.

"You cannot simply buy your path away from perdition. Many a Mammonite has tried before, and they- they are still judged."
texts.zh:
"你的肮脏钱财..." 一抹困扰的神色掠过$hisOrHer的脸庞，仿佛$hisOrHer的谴责并非发自真心。

"你无法靠钱财从永恒的惩罚中买通出路。多少玛门之仆曾尝试过，而他们 —— 他们终将受审。"

texts.en: $HeOrShe nods, frowning. "Be that as it may, the corrupt seed of heresy lies in your heart. It is no simple matter to remove such a thing. Your path will take you through blood and pain before it can be pure."
texts.zh: $heOrShe点点头，眉头紧锁着说："即便如此，异端的腐化种子已经埋藏在你的心中。要拔除这样的东西绝非易事，你的道路必将历经鲜血与痛苦，才能重归纯净。"

texts.en: "So it is known," $heOrShe says with a sigh. "You... confound me. Your cooperation with a goon of the Knights, a bully and torturer of a false light... I try to see some greater Plan in it, but I cannot."
texts.zh: "这确实人尽皆知，" $heOrShe叹道，"你...令我困惑。你竟与骑士团的打手合作，那些虚假之光之下的暴徒与施虐者...我试图从中窥见某种更宏大的计划，却无能为力。"

texts.en:
"Yours is a path of blood, but there are those who say your soul is not lost to Perdition."

$HeOrShe glares at you sullenly.

"I did not say I was amongst them."
texts.zh:
"你的道路浸透鲜血，但也有人认为你的灵魂尚未堕入永恒的惩罚。"

$heOrShe阴沉地瞪着你。

"但我可没说过我是其中之一。"

texts.en: "How lost you are, and how far from the light." $HeOrShe shakes $hisOrHer head, "If the rumors are true, then perhaps some part of you hears a whisper of the Word. That can be the only explanation."
texts.zh: "你迷失得有多深，离光明又有多远。" $heOrShe摇着头说，"如果传闻属实，或许你心中某个角落仍能听见圣言的微语，这是唯一的解释。"

texts.en:
The Pather's face twists with anger. "Then burn with the rest, Molochian!" $HeOrShe disappears in a haze of compression artifacts.

The link plays a crackling buzz of a suppressed electronic warfare signal for a moment before your comms officer, considerately, shuts it off for you.
texts.zh:
左径分子的脸庞因愤怒而扭曲变形。"那就和其他家伙一起化为灰烬吧，摩洛克信徒！"$HeOrShe 的身影在一阵压缩失真的噪点干扰中消失无踪。

通讯链接发出了一阵电子战压制信号产生的蜂鸣爆音，你的通讯军官随即贴心地帮你切断了连接。

texts.en:
The Pather's face twists with anger.  "Then burn with the rest, Molochian!" $heOrShe says, then disappears in a haze of compression artifacts.

The link plays a crackling buzz of a suppressed electronic warfare signal for a moment before your comms officer, considerately, shuts it off for you.
texts.zh:
左径分子的脸庞因愤怒而扭曲变形。"那就和其他家伙一起化为灰烬吧，摩洛克信徒！"$heOrShe说道，随后在一阵压缩失真的噪点干扰中消失无踪。

通讯链接中响起一阵短促的、压抑的电子战信号杂音，刺耳地噼啪作响，随即你的通讯军官便贴心地帮你切断了连接。

texts.en:
You explain that there's one way that this is going to go, no devotion or zealotry can overcome the truth of the power of your $shipOrFleet - all ends result in $hisOrHer annihilation, and that of $hisOrHer followers, and of the station.

$HeOrShe has a choice, you explain. Call it a Molochian bargain, if it makes them feel better. Either this is a major loss of personnel, materiel, and the station, or it can be a minor loss of certain assets for a scheme $heOrShe doesn't even really believe in.

Is $heOrShe so loyal to Sedge's sect that $heOrShe is willing to die for it - even after it's already falling apart?
texts.zh:
你阐明这件事只有一种结局，任何虔诚或狂热都无法与你的$shipOrFleet所代表的真实实力相抗衡 —— 所有结果终将导向$hisOrHer及其追随者，连同这座空间站的一并消亡。

你解释道，$heOrShe仍有一次选择的机会，不妨称之为恶魔摩洛克式的交易，如果这么说能令他们好受些。要么承受人员、物资与空间站的重大损失，要么就仅仅在那个连$heOrShe自己都未必真心认同的阴谋上，付出特定资产的小小代价。

难道$heOrShe对 Sedge 势力的忠诚，竟足以令其甘愿为之赴死 —— 即便该势力早已分崩离析？

options.en: Propose terms
options.zh: 提出条件

texts.en:
You explain that you will require comms buffers and datastores pertaining to Sedge's scheme. You will need the datastores of the nanoforge as well, and must be given access in order to destroy it.

Few need be hurt, if they cooperate; it can be done quickly and without compromising $hisOrHer leadership status if $heOrShe secretly gives you their primary security codes. Blame it on the injection of a semi-sentient computer virus, a 'daemon' of the sort Molochians conjure in their AI-labs.
texts.zh:
你说明自己需要与 Sedge 计划相关的通讯缓冲区和数据存储单元，同时也需要纳米锻炉的数据存储单元，并要求获得访问权限以将其摧毁。

若他们配合，则几乎无人会受伤；若能秘密地提供主安全代码，行动就可以迅速完成，且不会损害$hisOrHer的领导地位。届时完全可以将一切归咎于一种半感知计算机病毒的入侵 —— 那种摩洛克信徒在其 AI 实验室里炮制的 '恶魔' 程序。

options.en: Those are the terms. My wrath is great and won't be long contained.
options.zh: 这些就是条件，我现在火很大，可忍不了太久。

texts.en:
"Why should I trust you - you, who threaten me so?"

$HeOrShe is clearly unhappy with your terms. "You're a slave of not only Mammon and Moloch, but Wrath itself. Suffering is your daily bread."
texts.zh:
"我凭什么信任你 —— 在你如此威胁于我之后？"

$heOrShe显然对你的条件相当不满。"你不仅是恶魔玛门与恶魔摩洛克的奴隶，更是暴怒本身的奴仆。苦难是你的日常食粮。"

texts.en: $HisOrHer eyes are watering, $hisOrHer hands wringing. Just one more push should convince $himOrHer...
texts.zh: $hisOrHer眼眶湿润，双手紧绞。只需再推一把，就能彻底说服$himOrHer...

texts.en:
"Cease your threats!" $HeOrShe puts $hisOrHer head in $hisOrHer hands. "You are a monster out of Hell, and surely that is where I shall find myself for making this deal... but this has gone on long enough. I must protect my people."

"I must accept your terms," $heOrShe says, defeated. "I pray this is the Path."
texts.zh:
"住口，别再威胁了！" $heOrShe将$hisOrHer的脸埋入自己的掌心，"你简直就是从地狱里爬出的怪物，而与你交易的我也终将坠入深渊...但这场闹剧该结束了，我必须保护我的人。"

"我...必须接受你的条件，" $heOrShe颓然道，"愿这仍是卢德之道所指。"

options.en: Carry out the ruse to seize datastores and destroy the nanoforge
options.zh: 执行佯攻计划，夺取数据存储单元并摧毁纳米锻炉

options.en: My capital ships will break your station apart. You have no chance of victory.
options.zh: 我的主力舰会将你们的空间站撕成碎片，你们毫无胜算。

options.en: I killed Wrestling Sedge, and I would kill you without remorse. The choice is yours.
options.zh: 我已经杀了 Wrestling Sedge，并且我在杀你的时候也不会有半分犹豫，自己选吧。

options.en: You know of me. My reputation for ruthlessness precedes me.
options.zh: 你知道我的名声，我冷酷无情的作风早已传遍这片星域。

options.en: I am a great enemy known to all Pathers. How could you doubt my threat?
options.zh: 我是所有左径分子皆知的大敌，你怎敢质疑我的威胁？

options.en: Trust that I am mercenary. I'm avoiding a fight to save credits.
options.zh: 你要相信我是个唯利是图之人，而我避免这场战斗也是为了节省星币。

options.en: My patience with you is spent. (cut comms)
options.zh: 我对你的耐心已经用完了。 (切断通讯)

options.en: I cannot deal with a mad heretic. Pray now for a quick death. (cut comms)
options.zh: 我无法与疯狂的异端交易，即刻祈祷以求个痛快了断吧。 (切断通讯)

texts.en: Cowed by your brutal posturing, the Pather leader provides you with security codes and your ops team mounts what appears to be a lightning-raid which catches the defenders completely by surprise.
texts.zh: 慑于你凶残的威吓，左径头目交出了安全代码。你的行动小组随即发起一场闪电般的劫掠行动，守军被彻底打了个措手不及。

texts.en:
"Your brutality will only prove how far you are from the Word! Our... our deaths will be as martyrs."

You feel as though $hisOrHer heart isn't quite in it, somehow.
texts.zh:
"你的暴行只会证明你离圣言何等遥远！我们...我们的牺牲将成为殉道。"

你却隐约感到$hisOrHer的信念并非那么坚定。

texts.en:
"You persist with that, with that lie," $heOrShe examines you uncertainly.

"Of course, they do say he was shot in the back by a spacer. Maybe the low cunning of your kind makes you capable of such cold-blooded murder."
texts.zh:
"你还在坚持，坚持那个谎言，" $heOrShe将信将疑地审视着你。

"不过，据他们所言，他就是被一名太空佬从背后射杀的。也许你们这类人卑劣狡诈的本性真能让你们使出如此冷血的谋杀手段。"

texts.en:
The Pather frowns. "An obvious boast, typical of a Molochian." $HeOrShe makes a show of looking at you through the comms, "You couldn't have taken Sedge. He was a greater warrior than you or I, by far."

"They do say he was shot in the back by a spacer. The low cunning of you people does suggest your capacity for cold-blooded murder."
texts.zh:
左径分子皱起眉头。"虚张声势，典型的摩洛克信徒作风。" $heOrShe刻意透过通讯画面端详着你，"你不可能拿下了 Sedge，他远比你我都更加善战。"

"据说他是被一名太空佬从背后射杀的。你们这些人卑劣狡诈的本性，确实体现出你们冷血谋杀的能力。"

texts.en: "It is true," $heOrShe says ruefully. "Your name is a curse upon the sector. A harbinger of suffering."
texts.zh: "确实如此，" $heOrShe懊丧地说，"你的名字是这片星域的诅咒，是苦难的先兆。"

texts.en:
"So it is you," $heOrShe says, brow furrowed. "I had thought... surely not... why, pray, would Providence set such evil upon my Path?"

If anything, $heOrShe looks sad rather than defiant.
texts.zh:
"原来是你，" $heOrShe眉头紧锁，"我还以为...绝不可能是...为何天意将如此邪恶降临于我道？"

若要说有什么变化，$heOrShe此刻的神情更像是悲伤而非反抗。

texts.en:
And despite your fearsome reputation, you'll let them in on a little secret: it's cheaper, you explain, to accomplish your mission parameters without a fight. Thus the credits you gain, that Mammonite lucre, is ever greater than before.

"I knew it," $heOrShe smirks righteously. "It's always credits in the end with your kind, isn't it."
texts.zh:
尽管你声名可怖，但你却向他们透露了一个小秘密：你解释说，达成任务目标的同时避免战斗会让成本更低。因此你获得的星币 —— 那些玛门之仆的肮脏钱财 —— 将比以往更多。

"我早料到了，" $heOrShe正义凛然地讥笑道，"你们这种人最终总是为了星币，不是吗。"

options.en: Your nanoforge assembled a very interesting item. I have questions.
options.zh: 你们的纳米锻炉组装了一件非常有趣的物品，而我有些疑问。

texts.en: "Questions?" $HeOrShe smirks, eyes scanning some intel report. "What questions might a Molochian have? How to more completely suborn the human soul? How to extract ever increasing lucre from sin?"
texts.zh: "疑问？" $heOrShe露出讥笑，一边扫视着情报报告，"恶魔摩洛克的信徒能有什么疑问？如何更彻底地腐化人类的灵魂？如何从罪孽中榨取更多肮脏的钱财？"

options.en: I come as fellow-walker of the Faith... I have grave concerns.
options.zh: 我以循道同袍的身份前来此地... 我深感忧虑。

texts.en:
"A walker, so you claim. Aye, you are known to us. A minion of the so-called 'Church' which is naught but a shadow of the domain wearing a mask of twisted piety."

$HeOrShe almost looks pitying. "Are you so far gone, so blind to the light, that you cannot see it?"
texts.zh:
"循道者，你自称如此。不错，我们早有耳闻。所谓 '教会' 的爪牙，不过是 人之领 投下的阴影，披着扭曲虔诚的面具。"

$heOrShe几乎露出怜悯之色，"你是否已堕落到如此地步，对光明盲目至此，竟无法看清真相？"

texts.en: Your comms request is denied with a burst of obsolete EW malware.
texts.zh: 你的通讯请求被一股过时的电子战恶意软件的爆发所阻断。

options.en: Shuttle down to the cathedral with $global.jethroName
options.zh: 与 $global.jethroName 一同乘坐穿梭机前往大教堂

texts.en:
Bornanew's credentials - in truth, those of Archcurate Jaspis - fell the meddling traffic control bureaucrats who stand in your way, one after another.

A Knight-novice, of equal rank but rather lesser age than $global.jethroName, puts on a grimace as he is forced to reassign the shuttle-slot of some curate from the landing pad nearest to the Cathedral of Holy Exodus.

Nearest is a relative term. On Tartessus, the Church of Galactic Redemption takes the view that spaceborn traffic is a shameful act to be hidden away from the eyes of land-dwellers. As your shuttle lands, Bornanew observes that the cathedral is somewhat over the horizon.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 出示的证件实际上就是大祭司 Jaspis 的，这让那些从中作梗、挡路的交通管制官员们一个个乖乖放行。

一名与 $global.jethroName 级别相同但是年轻些的见习骑士，带着不情愿的苦相，被迫将某位神职人员的穿梭机停机位，从原本靠近 Exodus 神圣大教堂的停机坪重新调配到别处。

靠近 本就是个相对概念。在 Tartessus 星球上，银河救赎教会 秉持着这样一种观点：太空飞行器的往来是种不光彩的行为，应当避开地面居民的视线。当你们的穿梭机降落时，Bornanew 注意到，大教堂其实还在视线尽头的地平线之外。

options.en: Board what passes for transport on Tartessus
options.zh: 登上 Tartessus 上那台勉强能算作交通工具的设备

texts.en:
* * *

You step off the rickety bus, a boxy thing of agriplastic and mold-pressed wood scrap hiding a battery and motor, with a crowd of day-laborers and pilgrims.

This is not one of the major shrines of the Pilgrim's Path, of course, but the Cathedral of Holy Exodus is held in high esteem in the local system and beyond.
texts.zh:
* * *

你从吱呀作响的巴士上踏下，这辆方方正正的交通工具由农用塑料和模压木屑制成，内部藏着电池与发动机，在你身旁则是一群零工与朝圣者。

这里虽然并非是朝圣之路上的主要圣地，但 Exodus 神圣大教堂在本星系乃至更远的星区都备受尊崇。

texts.en:
* * *

You step off the rickety bus, a boxy thing of agriplastic and mold-pressed wood scrap hiding a battery and motor, with a crowd of sweating day-laborers and pilgrims. Bornanew, still shaky on his feet as he recovers from his injuries, takes your arm as he steps down to the road.

This is not one of the major shrines of the Pilgrim's Path, of course, but the Cathedral of Holy Exodus is held in high esteem in the local system and beyond.
texts.zh:
* * *

你从吱呀作响的巴士上踏下，这辆方方正正的交通工具由农用塑料和模压木屑制成，内部藏着电池与发动机，在你身旁则是一群零工与朝圣者，而伤势未愈、步履不稳的 Bornanew 则在下车时扶住了你的手臂。

这里虽然并非是朝圣之路上的主要圣地，但 Exodus 神圣大教堂在本星系乃至更远的星区都备受尊崇。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"And it is the seat of not more than a few 'divergent' notions of doctrine," Bornanew tells you in a low voice.

"At least according to the 'Ineffablist' school backed by the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis, among others. Here, though a minority of the Church ecumene, there is a local majority of so-called 'Mundanians'. Do not misunderstand me; they are not schismatics." He lets a moment of silence pass.

"Nonetheless."
texts.zh:
"恐怕这里也滋生了不少 '分歧' 的学派。" Bornanew 压低声音对你说。

"至少在那些支持宗师大人的 '不可言传派' 信徒看来是这样。不过，在当地 —— 尽管在整个教区中占少数 —— 所谓的 '世俗派' 却占了多数。别误会我的意思，他们并非是分裂教派。" 他停顿了片刻，陷入沉默。

"但话虽如此。"

texts.en:
"And it is the seat of not more than a few heretical notions of doctrine, I'm afraid," Bornanew tells you in a low voice.

"At least according to the 'Ineffablist' school backed by the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis, among others. Here, though a minority of the Church ecumene, there is a local majority of so-called 'Mundanians'. Do not misunderstand me, they are not schismatics. Yet." He lets a moment of silence pass.

"Nonetheless."
texts.zh:
"恐怕这里也滋生了不少异端。" Bornanew 压低声音对你说。

"至少在那些支持宗师大人的 '不可言传派' 信徒看来是这样。不过，在当地 —— 尽管在整个教区中占少数 —— 所谓的 '世俗派' 却占了多数。别误会我的意思，他们目前还不算分裂教派。" 他停顿了片刻，陷入沉默。

"但话虽如此。"

options.en: Are you telling me there is going to be trouble?
options.zh: 你的意思是会有麻烦发生吗？

options.en: So what's wrong with the 'Mundanians'?
options.zh: 那 '世俗派' 有什么问题吗？

options.en: What distinguishes the Ineffablist doctrine?
options.zh: '不可言传派' 的教义有何独特之处？

options.en: 'Idolators', huh. And what do they call you?
options.zh: '偶像崇拜派' 啊。那他们又怎么称呼你呢？

options.en: You fight over this? It sounds interminable.
options.zh: 你们就为这事争执不休？简直没完没了。

texts.en:
Bornanew halts for a moment, his breathing heavy.

"I beg you spare a moment, captain," he says self-consciously. "It... has taken much of me."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 停滞了一下，他的呼吸很粗。

"我请求你给我一点时间，舰长，"他下意识地说道。"这... 对我来说太多了。"

texts.en:
He takes one more deep breath, then replies calmly, eyes on the path ahead.

"There was... passive opposition to my investigation. I intend to arrest Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith. Opposition may become... less passive."
texts.zh:
他又深吸了一口气，然后冷静地回复道，眼睛看向道路前方。

"我的调查遭遇了一些...消极的抵制。我打算逮捕助理祭司 Cedra Keepfaith。这样抵制或许会变得...不那么消极了。"

texts.en:
He replies calmly, eyes on the path ahead.

"There was... passive opposition to my investigation. I intend to arrest Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith. Opposition may become... less passive."
texts.zh:
他冷静地回复道，眼睛看向道路前方。

"我的调查遭遇了一些...消极的抵制。我打算逮捕助理祭司 Cedra Keepfaith。这样抵制或许会变得...不那么消极了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: So you're just going to walk in, unarmed, and make an arrest?
options.zh: 所以你打算就这么赤手空拳走进去，然后实施逮捕？

options.en: You mention this now? We should have prepared.
options.zh: 你怎么现在才提这事？我们本该早作准备的。

options.en: Opposition? Shall I call in a squad of marines?
options.zh: 抵制？需要我调一支陆战队过来吗？

options.en: Not to worry. I'm prepared. (pat your weapon)
options.zh: 别担心，我已经准备好了。 (轻拍你的武器)

options.en: With your injury... you're sure you want to do this?
options.zh: 以你现在的伤势...你确定要这么做？

options.en: So you're just going to walk in, unarmed, to arrest a curate?
options.zh: 所以你打算就这么赤手空拳走进去，要逮捕一名祭司？

options.en: Opposition? Shall I call in a squad of marines?
options.zh: 抵制？需要我调一支陆战队过来吗？

options.en: Not to worry. I'm prepared. (pat your weapon)
options.zh: 别担心，我已经准备好了。 (轻拍你的武器)

texts.en:
"I suppose I am," he says, turning to smile and give a bow, hands together, to a group of elderly pilgrims resting under a tree.

"This must be done as Ludd would, with open hands and heart."
texts.zh:
"差不多算是吧，" 他说道，一边转过身来微笑着向一群在树下休息的老年朝圣者鞠躬致意，双手合十。

"必须像卢德那样做，敞开双手，敞开心扉。"

texts.en:
"I am," he says, turning give a bow, hands together, to a group of elderly pilgrims resting under a tree. "This must be done as Ludd would, with open hands."

"Besides," he adds with a wry smile, "you've seen fit to remain armed."
texts.zh:
"没错，" 他说道，一边转过身来微笑着向一群在树下休息的老年朝圣者鞠躬致意，双手合十，"必须像卢德那样做，敞开双手。"

"不过，" 他讽刺地笑着补充道，"你看起来似乎更适合带着枪。"

options.en: I'll, um, follow your lead.
options.zh: 我... 呃，听你的。

options.en: Must it? You're putting a lot of faith in others choosing to cooperate.
options.zh: 非得这样吗？你这也太指望其他人的配合了。

options.en: I'll protect the two of us, then. If it comes to it.
options.zh: 那我会保护好我们俩的。如果真到那一步的话。

options.en: I mean no offense, but you're a bit crazy, you know that?
options.zh: 我没有冒犯的意思，但你知道这有点疯狂吗？

options.en: I'll follow your lead.
options.zh: 我听你的。

options.en: I'll protect the two of us, then.
options.zh: 那我会保护好我们俩的。

options.en: I mean no offense, but you're a bit crazy, you know that?
options.zh: 我没有冒犯的意思，但你知道这有点疯狂吗？

texts.en: "Your trust is ever a welcome gift," he says, quite earnest.
texts.zh: "你的信任永远是一份受欢迎的礼物，" 他非常真诚地说。

texts.en:
You stand together at last in the plaza under the huge archway of the cathedral's entrance. Bornanew meets a uniformed though unarmored Knight to exchange a few words. Bornanew shows the Knight something in his hand which he returns to pocket in his robes.

The Knight steps aside, and allows you to enter, bypassing the lines of pilgrims awaiting the mid-morning prayer.
texts.zh:
你们终于一同站在了大教堂巨大入口拱门下的广场上。Bornanew 走向一名身着制服却未披铠甲的骑士，两人交谈了几句。Bornanew 向骑士展示了手中的某样东西，随后便将其收回了长袍的口袋。

骑士侧身让开道路，准许你们进入，无需排队等候，径直绕过那些在等待正午祈祷仪式的朝圣者队伍。

options.en: Enter the Cathedral of Holy Exodus
options.zh: 进入 Exodus 神圣大教堂

texts.en:
You enter the great nave of the Cathedral of Holy Exodus.

Among towering columns are affixed recovered landing pods of the early Luddic refugee ships, now integrated into the vaults, painted with gilt and green, bedecked with candles and hanging glass ornaments which break the beams of the sun - filtered through ranks of high windows - into thousands of rainbow shards, endlessly refracting.

It is an ecstasy of light, a galaxy unto itself.

Bornanew pauses beside you, looking upward. Could one old work-glove and a lie tip all of this down to shatter upon the ground?
texts.zh:
你走进 Exodus 神圣大教堂的宏伟中殿。

高耸的立柱之间，固定着早年卢德派难民船中回收的登陆舱 —— 如今这些登陆舱已被整合进拱顶建筑结构中，周身涂有鎏金与绿色的彩绘，还装饰着蜡烛与悬挂的玻璃饰品。阳光穿过一排排高耸的窗户洒落，经这些饰品折射后，化作无数道彩虹碎片，光影交错，不断折射。

这是一场光影的狂欢，自成一片星河。

Bornanew 在你身旁驻足，抬头仰望。一只破旧的工作手套，一句谎言，真能让眼前这一切轰然倒塌，碎落满地吗？

texts.en:
You enter the great nave of the Cathedral of Holy Exodus.

Among towering columns are affixed recovered landing pods of the early Luddic refugee ships, now integrated into the vaults, painted with gilt and green, bedecked with candles and hanging glass ornament which break the beams of the sun - filtered through ranks of high windows - into thousands of rainbow shards endlessly refracting.

It is an ecstasy of light, a galaxy unto itself.

Bornanew pauses beside you, catching his breath, looking upward. Could one old work-glove and a lie tip all of this down to shatter upon the ground?
texts.zh:
你走进 Exodus 神圣大教堂的宏伟中殿。

高耸的立柱之间，固定着早年卢德派难民船中回收的登陆舱 —— 如今这些登陆舱已被整合进拱顶建筑结构中，周身涂有鎏金与绿色的彩绘，还装饰着蜡烛与悬挂的玻璃饰品。阳光穿过一排排高耸的窗户洒落，经这些饰品折射后，化作无数道彩虹碎片，光影交错，不断折射。

这是一场光影的狂欢，自成一片星河。

Bornanew 在你身旁驻足，屏住呼吸，抬头仰望。一只破旧的工作手套，一句谎言，真能让眼前这一切轰然倒塌，碎落满地吗？

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He leads you to a small alcove, invisible at the foot of the luminous architectural forest of cut stone and carved wood. And there, after exchanging words with an attendant, a door is revealed in the ornately carved wall.

You follow Bornanew's lead, stepping out of the glory of light into a cool, dark space. Your eyes take a moment to adjust to the dimness and relatively mundane - though still ornately hand-wrought - decor.
texts.zh:
他带你步入一片由切割石材与雕花木材构筑的璀璨建筑群落脚下，来到一处隐秘的小壁龛面前。在与一名侍从交谈几句后，雕花繁复的墙壁上，一扇门缓缓显现出来。

你跟着 Bornanew 的脚步，从绚烂的光影中走出，踏入一片凉爽昏暗的空间。你的眼睛需要片刻时间，才能适应这里的微光，以及相对朴素 —— 但依旧由手工精雕细琢 —— 的装饰。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
There are halls and offices here, lit not by candles but humble glowplates belched legion from Asher's nanoforge. The walls of cut stone are trimmed with alternating panels and mouldings of wood.

Bornanew's words and the token, presumably provided by the Archcurate Jaspis, clear a path through frowning oblate-secretaries and young Knight-novices on guard duty.

Not all are so dour; one or two initiates, scurrying by with armloads of books, greet Bornanew by name.
texts.zh:
这里遍布着厅堂与办公室，照明并非来自蜡烛，而是无数块 Asher 上纳米锻炉批量生产的不起眼发光板。切割石材砌成的墙壁边缘，装饰着交替排列的木板与木饰线。

Bornanew 的话语，再加上那枚想必是由大祭司 Jaspis 提供的信物，为你们扫清了前路，沿途那些面带不悦的修道院文书，以及值岗的年轻见习骑士，都未加阻拦。

并非所有人都这般阴沉：有一两位见习修士抱着成摞的书匆匆走过，路过时与 Bornanew 问好。

options.en: Follow
options.zh: 跟上

texts.en:
You follow Bornanew into a long room, a gallery of columns intermingled with bookcases; cleverly designed lightwells - and, surely, a series of mirrors - provide shafts of sunlight, motes dancing with little concern in their small world within this analog archive.

Heads turn to follow your progress past desks stacked with paper books, writing implements, and even the occasional low-fidelity interface terminal.

Your tactical sense notes the figures at side-doors who disappear purposefully, clearly headed off to spread this news and summon gawkers - or allies.

Your weapon-hand twitches.
texts.zh:
你跟着 Bornanew 走进一间狭长的厅堂，这里立柱林立，书架错落摆放。采光井装有设计精巧的镜片，将阳光引入室内，形成一道道光柱；在这座仿古的档案馆里，光柱中的微尘在自己的小世界里肆意舞动，无忧无虑。

你们走过一张张办公桌时，周围人的目光纷纷投来，紧随你们的脚步。桌上堆着纸质书籍、书写工具，偶尔还能看到几台低分辨率的交互终端。

你的战术直觉留意到，侧门处有几个人影神色匆匆地离开，显然是要去散播消息，或是召集看热闹的人；也可能是召集帮手。

你握枪的那只手微微一动。

options.en: Steady...
options.zh: 镇定...

texts.en:
Bornanew approaches a proud figure all in holy vestments at the head of the room.

"Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith." $global.jethroName's voice is confident.

The figure turns, finally. "Novice," she replies, tone intent on the gradient of authority. "Why have you returned to my scriptorium? Have you been assigned additional penitential duties?"

A mocking smile flits upon her lip.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 走向房间尽头一位身着神圣法衣、神态庄重的人。

"助理祭司 Cedra Keepfaith。" $global.jethroName 的语气十分笃定。

那人终于转过身来。"见习修士，" 她回应道，语气中带着鲜明的自上而下的权威感，"你为何回到我的文书室？是又被指派了额外的赎罪任务吗？"

一抹嘲讽的笑容在她唇边一闪而过。

options.en: Watch him work
options.zh: 静观其变

texts.en:
"It was you," Bornanew says with perfect earnestness.

"You scanned the glove said to be of Ludd. You did this in the vault of this cathedral, and you knowingly passed that scan data to an agent of the heretics called the Luddic Path. Their aim, and yours, was to sow discord within the Church of Galactic Redemption. This I shall prove before the judgement of the Inquisitors."

"For these crimes," he raises his voice against the growing murmurs, "against the Holy Church, by the authority of the Reverend Archcurate Sophronia Jaspis, as a Knight of Ludd, I do now place you under arrest."
texts.zh:
"是你干的，" Bornanew 神情郑重地说道。

"你扫描了那只据称属于卢德的手套。你在这座大教堂的地窖里做了这件事，而且你明知故犯，把扫描数据传给了异端组织 '卢德左径' 的一名成员。他们的目的 —— 也是你的 —— 就是在 银河救赎教会 内部制造分裂。我将在审判官的面前证明这一切。"

"鉴于这些罪行，" 他提高声音，盖过越来越响的议论声，"这些针对神圣教会的罪行，以 Sophronia Jaspis 宗师之名，我将履行卢德骑士的职责，在此将你正式逮捕。"

texts.en:
"It was you," Bornanew says with perfect earnestness. "Traitor."

"You scanned the glove said to be of Ludd. You did this in the vault of this cathedral, and you knowingly passed that scan data to an agent of the heretics called the Luddic Path. Their aim, and yours, was to sow discord within the Church of Galactic Redemption. This I know, and this truth the Inquisitors shall pull from you!"

"For these crimes," he raises his voice against the growing murmurs, "against the Holy Church, by the authority of the Reverend Archcurate Sophronia Jaspis, as a Knight of Ludd, I do now place you under arrest."
texts.zh:
"是你干的，" Bornanew 神情郑重地说道，"叛徒。"

"扫描了那只据称属于卢德的手套。你在这座大教堂的地窖里做了这件事，而且你明知故犯，把扫描数据传给了异端组织 '卢德左径' 的一名成员。他们的目的 —— 也是你的 —— 就是在 银河救赎教会 内部制造分裂。这些我心知肚明，而审判官也一定会从你口中逼问出这个真相！"

"鉴于这些罪行，" 他提高声音，盖过越来越响的议论声，"这些针对神圣教会的罪行，以 Sophronia Jaspis 宗师之名，我将履行卢德骑士的职责，在此将你正式逮捕。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
There are gasps, and a muffled clatter as some initiate drops their work. Keepfaith's gaze, already chilly, turns poisonous upon Bornanew.

"Blind Jaspis has no power here," she says. "And you, a mere novice of a Knight, making ungodly accusations against a superior? I shall assign you further penance if a full apology is not made... instantly!"
texts.zh:
周围响起一片倒吸冷气的声音，还有一名见习修士失手掉落手中活计时发出的闷响。Keepfaith 的目光本就冰冷，此刻投向 Bornanew 时更添了几分恶毒。

"失明的 Jaspis 在这儿可没什么权力，" 她说道，"而你，区区一个新晋骑士，竟敢对上级提出这般亵渎神明的指控？立刻向我道歉，否则我定会给你安排更多赎罪任务...立刻！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Brother Bornanew," a Knight-Captain appears behind the angry subcurate.

He attempts a comradely tone, his carbine slung at his side.

"Please," he says. "Let us go together to resolve this misunderstanding with the archcurate of this cathedral. There is no need to herein bear the hammer and the sword-"
texts.zh:
"Bornanew 修士，" 一名骑士长出现在怒气冲冲的助理祭司身后。

他试图用亲切的语气开口，那把卡宾枪斜挎在身侧。

"拜托了，" 他说道，"咱们一起去找这座大教堂的大祭司把这场误会解开吧。没必要在这里动刀动枪 ——"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"There is no misunderstanding, brother," Bornanew cuts off the Knight-Captain's words, keeping his eyes on Keepfaith. "I bear my quest not lightly, and seek to fulfill my duty sworn to the Excubitor Orbis."

He reaches into his robes.

"Knight-Captain," says Keepfaith, drawing her breath. "Arrest your novice! He's to be punished for irreverence toward the authority of the Church and, and for these wild accusations!"
texts.zh:
"没有误会，修士，" Bornanew 打断了骑士长的话，目光始终锁定着 Keepfaith，"我肩负的使命绝非儿戏，我一定要履行对行星教卫立下的誓言。"

他伸手探进自己的长袍。

"骑士长，" Keepfaith 深吸一口气说道，"逮捕你的新晋骑士！他必须为因对教会权威的不敬，还有这些荒唐的指控，而接受惩罚！"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Bornanew steps forward, prompting the Knight-Captain to raise the carbine he had held at his side. A hint of victory settles into Keepfaith's eyes.

"You dare assault a curate in this holy place?" she says, projecting her voice to all corners of the room, ringing harshly. "Is there no low to which this too-old novice won't sink?"
texts.zh:
Bornanew 迈步向前，骑士长举起了一直握在身侧的卡宾枪。Keepfaith 的眼中闪过一丝胜券在握的光彩。

"你竟敢在这圣地袭击一名神职人员？" 她高声叫喊，声音传遍房间的每个角落，带着刺耳的回响，"这个一把年纪的新丁，还有什么卑劣事做不出来？"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He steps forward again, pushing the barrel of the Knight-Captain's carbine into his chest. The Knight-Captain looks desperately uncomfortable. "Brother," he says again, pleading.

"Do your duty, Knight-Captain!" shouts Keepfaith.

Bornanew takes another step, bodily pushing back the Knight-Captain, still cradling the carbine. Finger on the trigger.
texts.zh:
他再次向前迈步，将骑士长那把卡宾枪的枪管顶在自己胸口。骑士长脸上露出极度不安的神情。"修士弟兄，" 他再次开口，语气中满是恳求。

"履行你的职责，骑士长！" Keepfaith 高声喊道。

Bornanew 又向前走了一步，身体压迫着骑士长后退，而卡宾枪的枪管仍抵在他胸口。他的手指扣在了扳机上。

options.en: Make no sudden movements
options.zh: 保持镇定

options.en: Draw your own weapon
options.zh: 拔出武器

options.en: Push Bornanew aside
options.zh: 把 Bornanew 推开

texts.en:
Keepfaith lunges for the carbine. A pathetic struggle ensues, her hands locked around the Knight-Captain's, who struggles to keep the weapon under his control.

Bornanew simply watches until, finally, both Curate and Knight-captain tumble into a workdesk, sending papers and tools flying.
texts.zh:
一场狼狈的缠斗随即爆发：Keepfaith 的双手死死攥住骑士长的手，而骑士长则竭力稳住武器。

Bornanew 只是冷眼相看，直到最后，祭司与骑士长双双撞向一张办公桌，桌上的文件与工具瞬间散落一地。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Expressions among the apprentices range from appalled second-hand embarrassment to impish delight.

Red-faced, the Knight-Captain, regains his feet with Subcurate Keepfaith restrained in his arms. There is little dignity remaining for either.

Bornanew, meanwhile, remains standing in a stray beam of sunlight - a product of the clever arrangement of lightwells. The effect places him as the glowing centerpiece to an instructive tableau.

This can't have been happenstance; Bornanew's insistence on pushing forward, toward the light...
texts.zh:
学徒们脸上的表情各异：有人因这场尴尬的闹剧而面露震惊，仿佛自己也置身窘境；有人则带着顽童般的窃喜，看得津津有味。

骑士长涨红了脸，重新站起身来，怀里还紧紧制住助理祭司 Keepfaith。此刻两人早已没了半分体面。

与此同时，Bornanew 仍站在一束散落的阳光中 —— 这束光是采光井精妙设计的杰作。光影效果之下，他宛如一幅宗教画作中熠熠生辉的核心角色。

Bornanew 执意步步向前，朝着光亮处行进的举动绝非偶然...

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Coincidence or performance, the invisible consensus is irrevocably turned against Keepfaith.

"It was under control!" she screams. "It would never have been necessary if you Knights attended your duties. You're lax, lax and blind!"

"Come now, sister," says the Knight-Captain, leading her away. "Be not careless with your words, for the Inquisitors shall hear all..."
texts.zh:
无论这是巧合还是一场精心安排的 "表演"，大势已不可逆转地倒向了反对 Keepfaith 的一边。

"局势本来尽在掌握！" 她尖叫道，"要不是你们这些骑士玩忽职守，根本就不需要这样做！你们如此懈怠，懈怠又盲目！"

"好了，修女，" 骑士长一边说着，一边将她带离，"说话别这么轻率，因为审判官会知晓一切..."

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
* * *

The cadre of Luddic Knights guarding the Cathedral of Holy Exodus defer to Bornanew's authority.

Keepfaith is delivered to your shuttle, restrained, and now - away from her small kingdom - is timid but glowering.

"I will be absolved," she says. "You shall witness my righteousness before the end."

Bornanew shakes his head but does not reply. One of your guards switches on the dampening field so that you will not be troubled by Keepfaith's words.
texts.zh:
* * *

守卫 Exodus 神圣大教堂的那群卢德骑士对 Bornanew 的权威表示服从。

Keepfaith 被押送到了你们的穿梭机旁。如今离开了她的小地盘，她虽面露怯色，却仍满脸怒容。

"我会得到赦免，" 她说，"你们终将见证我的清白。"

Bornanew 摇了摇头，没有回应。你们的一名卫兵启动了消音力场，这样 Keepfaith 就没法打扰到你们了。

options.en: Return to your $shipOrFleet
options.zh: 回到你的$shipOrFleet里

texts.en: You return to your $shipOrFleet. After the rogue subcurate is placed in the brig you meet with Bornanew in a briefing room.
texts.zh: 你回到了自己的$shipOrFleet。在那名叛变的助理祭司被关进禁闭室后，你与 Bornanew 在简报室会面。

options.en: What now?
options.zh: 现在怎么办？

texts.en:
"We must take her to Hesperus," he says. "To the Knight Inquisitors and their justice."

He stares out at a display of starry space, subdued.

"I shall submit my evidence, then the Inquisitors will question her before a quorum of authority determined by the severity of her crime. I suspect more than one archcurate shall be required."
texts.zh:
"我们必须把她带去 Hesperus，" 他说道，"交给骑士审判官，让他们施以公正裁决。"

他凝视着显示着繁星宇宙的屏幕，神情凝重。

"我会提交证据，之后审判官们会对她进行讯问。讯问将由一个权威议事小组主持，小组的规格取决于她罪行的严重程度。我估计，至少有一位大祭司会参与。"

options.en: Are you not pleased? Won't your penance be complete?
options.zh: 你不满意吗？你的赎罪还没完成吗？

options.en: Leave him to his thoughts
options.zh: 让他独自静思

texts.en:
He turns to you.

"Pleased? That is difficult. What we have uncovered is deeply concerning. As for my penance," he grimaces. "You have not met the Excubitor Orbis of Hesperus."

He turns back to the stars.
texts.zh:
他转向你。

"满意？这很难说。我们揭露的情况令人深感忧虑。至于我的赎罪，" 他面露难色，"你还没见过 Hesperus 的行星教卫呢。"

他再次将目光投向星辰。

texts.en:
He turns to you.

"Pleased? That is difficult. What we have uncovered is deeply concerning. As for my penance," he grimaces. "The Excubitor Orbis of Hesperus would have me punished for the sins he imagines of the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis, and others who do not fully agree with him besides, I am sure. There will be little wordly relief within his domain. But to there I must return."

He turns back to the stars.
texts.zh:
他转向你。

"满意？这很难说。我们揭露的情况实在令人忧心。至于我的赎罪，" 他面露难色，"Hesperus 的行星教卫，定会因他臆想中宗师大人 Jaspis 犯下的罪孽而惩罚我；而且我敢肯定，那些并非完全认同他的人，也会遭此对待。在他的管辖范围内，人世间的宽慰恐怕是少之又少。但我终究还是得回到那里去。"

他再次将目光投向星辰。

texts.en:
He turns to you.

"Pleased? That is difficult. What we have uncovered is deeply concerning. As for my penance," he grimaces. "You have met Excubitor Orbis Oak, yes?"
texts.zh:
他转向你。

"满意？这很难说。我们揭露的情况令人深感忧虑。至于我的赎罪，" 他面露难色，"你见过行星教卫 Oak 了，对吧？"

options.en: Leave him to his thoughts
options.zh: 让他安静思考

options.en: Leave him to his thoughts
options.zh: 让他安静思考

options.en: Yes. I understand your concern.
options.zh: 是的，我理解你的担忧。

options.en: Maybe he'll be in a forgiving mood after you deliver a traitor and the false relic.
options.zh: 或许在你交出叛徒和伪造的圣物后，他会心怀宽恕。

texts.en: You dream of stars, but they flit and dance in the tapestry of the night to music you can't quite hear.
texts.zh: 你梦想着星辰，可它们却只在夜幕这幅织锦上翩跹舞动，伴着一曲你始终未能听清的旋律。

texts.en: He nods, then turns back to the stars.
texts.zh: 他点点头，随后再次将目光投向星辰。

options.en: Leave $global.jethroName to his thoughts
options.zh: 让 $global.jethroName 安静思考

texts.en: "Maybe," he says. He is quiet for a moment, nods, then turns back to the stars.
texts.zh: "或许吧，" 他说道。他沉默了片刻，点了点头，随后再次将目光投向星辰。

options.en: Leave $global.jethroName to his thoughts
options.zh: 让 $global.jethroName 安静思考

texts.en:
The Knight-Captain's eyes go wide, taking in your action.

A shot erupts from the carbine and you are anointed by a spray of blood.
texts.zh:
骑士长的双眼骤然睁大，目光紧紧锁定着你的动作。

卡宾枪突然喷出火光，一声枪响划破空气 —— 溅起的鲜血染红了你的身体。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Horrified, the Knight-Captain shoves Subcurate Keepfaith aside and safeties his weapon. She crashes into a workdesk, papers and tools and dignity scattered all around.

There are screams. Is there a doctor? Orders are shouted. The Knight-Captain is tearing his robe, holding a piece of cloth to Bornanew's wound. The red bubbles up into the white.
texts.zh:
骑士长惊恐不已，一把将助理祭司 Keepfaith 推到一旁，同时给武器上了保险。Keepfaith 重重撞在一张工作桌上，文件、工具散落一地，体面也荡然无存。

尖叫声四起。有医生吗？人们高声呼喊着指令。骑士长扯破自己的长袍，取下一块布按在 Bornanew 的伤口上。红色的鲜血不断渗进那块白色的布料里。

options.en: Help Bornanew
options.zh: 帮助 Bornanew

options.en: Restrain the subcurate
options.zh: 控制住助理祭司

texts.en:
Ignoring the chaos surrounding, you rush to Bornanew's aid, assisting the Knight-Captain in attempting to staunch the flow of blood.

The Knight-Captain appears trained for this, working with grim determination, directing you without hesitation as needed.
texts.zh:
你没有理会周围的混乱，立刻冲过去协助 Bornanew，与骑士长一同努力止血。

骑士长似乎接受过相关训练，此刻神情凝重却意志坚定地忙碌着，需要时会毫不犹豫地指挥你配合。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
It is a close thing, that line between life and death. Like the thin line of atmo when looking down upon a breathing planet; nothing more than a razor's edge from the deathly black.

You notice the Knight-Captain's arms are red up to his elbows. And yours, too, as you assist.

There are shouts, and running footsteps. A doctor arrives, with assistent, who shoves you and the Knight-Captain aside after only the briefest exchange.
texts.zh:
生死之间的界限，本就近在咫尺。就像俯瞰一颗生机盎然的星球时，那层薄薄的大气层 —— 与死寂的黑暗之间，不过是一道锋利如剃刀的间隙。

你注意到骑士长的双臂直到肘部都染成了红色。而你自己的手臂，也同样沾着血 —— 方才你一直在帮忙。

四周满是呼喊声与奔跑的脚步声。一名医生带着助手赶来了，只简短说了几句话，便将你和骑士长推到了一旁。

texts.en:
The rogue subcurate's shouts are quelled by the horrified faces of her apprentices.

"I had it under control!" she says, not quite pleading. "It would never have been necessary if the Knights attended their duties. They're lax, lax and blind!"

Shouts, and running steps. A doctor arrives to take over from the Knight-Captain, who, shaken, stands back from the bloody scene illuminated in a ray of sunlight. Shocked apprentices are recruited to help carry Bornanew elsewhere; some kind of on-site infirmary.
texts.zh:
那名叛离的助理祭司的叫嚷，被她学徒们满是惊恐的表情压了下去。

"局势本来尽在掌握！" 她说道，语气中带着恳求。"要不是你们这些骑士玩忽职守，根本就不需要这样做！你们如此懈怠，懈怠又盲目！"

呼喊声、奔跑声交织在一起。一名医生赶来接替骑士长 —— 后者神色恍惚，从那片被一缕阳光照亮的血腥现场旁退了开来。惊魂未定的学徒们被叫来帮忙，将 Bornanew 抬往某处临时设立的医务室。

texts.en:
You know it is over when the Knight-Captain goes quiet and still. His forearms are red with blood. Everywhere, blood, alit by the shaft of sunlight. Pale faces of apprentices look on, horrified.

Bornanew's body, weakened by Sedge's brutal attack, simply cannot hold out. In a matter of seconds, his life is spilled out of him onto the floor of the scriptorium.

"I had it under control," Keepfaith says, not quite pleading now. "It would never have been necessary if the Knights attended their duties. They're lax, lax and blind!"

No one is listening.
texts.zh:
当骑士长陷入沉寂、一动不动时，你便知道一切都结束了。他的前臂沾满鲜血，红得刺眼。放眼望去，到处都是血 —— 一缕阳光照射下来，让血迹泛着微光。学徒们脸色惨白，惊恐地注视着眼前的一切。

Bornanew 的身体本就因 Sedge 的残忍袭击而虚弱不堪，此刻已支撑不住。短短几秒钟内，他的生命便随着鲜血一同流逝，洒在了抄经室的地面上。

"局势本来尽在掌握！" 她说道，此刻语气已完全没有了之前的恳求意味，"要不是你们这些骑士玩忽职守，根本就不需要这样做！你们如此懈怠，懈怠又盲目！"

可没人在听她说话。

texts.en:
You know it is over when the Knight-Captain goes quiet and still. His forearms are red with blood. Everywhere, blood, alit by the shaft of sunlight. Pale faces of apprentices look on, horrified.

Bornanew's body, weakened by Sedge's brutal attack, simply cannot hold out. In a matter of seconds, his life is spilled out of him onto the floor of the scriptorium.

Distant calls and shouts - a doctor arrives, too late.

Subcurate Keepfaith is nowhere to be seen.
texts.zh:
当骑士长陷入沉寂、一动不动时，你便知道一切都结束了。他的前臂沾满鲜血，红得刺眼。放眼望去，到处都是血 —— 一缕阳光照射下来，让血迹泛着微光。学徒们脸色惨白，惊恐地注视着眼前的一切。

Bornanew 的身体本就因 Sedge 的残忍袭击而虚弱不堪，此刻已支撑不住。短短几秒钟内，他的生命便随着鲜血一同流逝，洒在了抄经室的地面上。

远处传来呼喊声与叫嚷声 —— 一名医生赶来了，却已为时过晚。

助理祭司 Keepfaith 早已不见踪影。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You stand back, dripping. The Knight-Captain is shaken, and, with a despairing look, fully removes the magazine of his carbine.

The bloody scene is illuminated by a ray of sunlight, a violent tableau. Shocked apprentices are recruited to help carry Bornanew elsewhere. Some kind of on-site infirmary.

You and the Knight-Captain turn toward one another to exchange a look. His eyes are wide.

Subcurate Keepfaith has disappeared.
texts.zh:
你向后退开，身上的液体不断滴落。骑士长神情恍惚，他带着绝望的神色，将卡宾枪的弹匣完全退了出来。

一缕阳光照亮了这片血腥的场景，构成一幅惨烈的画面。惊魂未定的学徒们被叫来帮忙，将 Bornanew 抬往某个临时设立的医务室。

你和骑士长转过身，对视了一眼。他的双眼睁得很大。

助理祭司 Keepfaith 已经不见了踪影。

options.en: Find her!
options.zh: 找到她！

texts.en:
You are of little use in the search, being unfamiliar with the cathedral. The Knight-Captain whose name you almost forgot to ask - "Larix," he said, "Knight-Captain Dejan Larix" before shouting orders to a hastily assembled squad of Knight-Novices, all obviously far younger than Bornanew.

Bornanew, for one, is stabilized in the infirmary, part of the sprawling church infrastructure spilling from the cathedral.
texts.zh:
由于你对大教堂并不熟悉，在搜寻工作中帮不上什么忙。你险些忘了询问那位骑士长的名字 —— 他答道："Larix，骑士长 Dejan Larix。" 话音刚落，他便向一支临时召集起来的见习骑士小队下达命令，这些见习骑士显然都比 Bornanew 年轻得多。

而 Bornanew 此刻已在医务室得到了稳定救治。这处医务室隶属于庞大的教会基础设施，这些设施从大教堂延伸开来，遍布各处。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The resident physician is more practical than traditional, and sees fit to consult with your own chief medical officer. A patient transfer is arranged, and even a special dispensation (granted by the embarrassed archcurate) to land a shuttle on a field near to the Cathedral of Holy Exodus.

The implicit use of technologies which would be awkward to employ on Church grounds to save Bornanew's life is left unsaid.
texts.zh:
这里的驻院医师思想更务实，不拘泥于传统，他认为有必要与你的医疗主管商议。双方随即安排了患者转运，甚至还获得了一项特殊许可 —— 由那位面露窘色的大祭司批准 —— 允许一架穿梭机降落在 Exodus 神圣大教堂附近的一片空地上。

至于要借助某些在教会领地使用会显得十分不妥的技术来挽救 Bornanew 的生命，这件事大家心照不宣，并未明说。

options.en: Return to your $shipOrFleet in orbit
options.zh: 返回你在轨道上的 $shipOrFleet

texts.en:
The cadre of Luddic Knights guarding the Cathedral of Holy Exodus defer to Bornanew's authority, despite his unconsciousness.

Keepfaith, just Cedra now that her subcurateship has been summarily revoked by order of the archcurate, is delivered to you flagship. She is restrained, and now - away from her small kingdom - timid, though still glowering.

"I will be absolved," she says hoarsely. "You shall witness my righteousness before the end."

One of your guards closes the brig door, its weight silent.
texts.zh:
驻守 Exodus 神圣大教堂的卢德骑士团骨干成员，即便在 Bornanew 失去意识的情况下，依然遵从他的权威。

Keepfaith —— 如今她的助理祭司头衔已奉大祭司之命被即刻撤销，只剩 "Cedra" 这个名字 —— 被押送至你的旗舰。她戴着手铐脚镣，此刻离开了自己的小地盘，显得有些胆怯，尽管眼神里仍带着怒视。

"我会得到赦免的，" 她声音嘶哑，"你们终将见证我的清白。"

你的一名卫兵关上了禁闭室的门，沉重的门板在落下时并未发出声响。

texts.en:
The cadre of Luddic Knights guarding the Cathedral of Holy Exodus defer to Bornanew's authority, despite his unconsciousness.

Keepfaith, just Cedra now that her subcurateship has been summarily revoked by order of the archcurate, is nowhere to be found. You can only speculate that she called upon her Pather contacts for assistance.
texts.zh:
驻守 Exodus 神圣大教堂的卢德骑士团骨干成员，即便在 Bornanew 失去意识的情况下，依然遵从他的权威。

Keepfaith —— 如今她的助理祭司头衔已奉大祭司之命被即刻撤销，只剩 "Cedra" 这个名字 —— 却已不知所踪。你只能推测，她在向自己的左径接头人寻求帮助了。

options.en: Check on Bornanew
options.zh: 查看 Bornanew 的状态

options.en: Check on Bornanew
options.zh: 查看 Bornanew 的状态

texts.en:
It is some time before Bornanew regains consciousness.

Your chief medical officer hovers nearby, giving you a stern look. You know you will not be allowed to overtrouble their patient.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 过了好一会儿才恢复意识。

你的医疗主管在一旁徘徊，神色严肃地看了你一眼。你很清楚，此人不会允许你过多打扰这位病人。

options.en: What now?
options.zh: 现在怎么办？

texts.en:
Bornanew is pale, his breathing shallow. "To Hesperus," he says. "To the Knights of Ludd."

"Inquisitors," he whispers, then carefully turns his head toward a display of starry space and the orb of Tartessus. "Justice."

He closes his eyes. Mouth open, still breathing.

You feel a movement in the air. Your chief medical officer hovers meaningfully, waiting for you to choose to leave, now.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 面色苍白，呼吸微弱。"去 Hesperus，" 他说道，"去找卢德骑士团。"

"审判官们，" 他轻声呢喃，随后缓缓转头望向显示着璀璨星空与 Tartessus 星球的屏幕。"会伸张正义。"

他闭上了眼睛。嘴巴微张，呼吸仍在继续。

你察觉到空气中的动静。你的医疗主管在一旁徘徊着，沉默地催促你离开。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
It is some time before Bornanew regains consciousness.

Your chief medical officer hovers nearby, giving you a stern look. You know you will not be allowed to overtrouble their patient.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 过了好一会儿才恢复意识。

你的医疗主管在一旁徘徊，神色严肃地看了你一眼。你很清楚，此人不会允许你过多打扰这位病人。

options.en: What now?
options.zh: 现在怎么办？

texts.en:
The Knight-Captain spots you, finally, and approaches. His arms are red to the elbows, his robes turn and spattered with the blood of his brother Knight.

"Come now, sister," he says coldly. "Be not careless with your words, for the Inquisitors shall hear all of it. All of it."
texts.zh:
骑士长终于看到了你，随即朝你走来。他的双臂直到肘部都沾满了鲜血，身上的长袍也被他那位骑士兄弟的血浸透、溅得斑斑点点。

"过来，修女，" 他语气冰冷地说，"说话别这么轻率，因为审判官会听到你说的每一句话。每一句。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
* * *

You are nearly forgotten in the chaos. Before long, a meek apprentice directs you to the offices of the Luddic Knights where you make a statement and discuss the incident with the Knight-Captain. You only just remember to ask him his name.

"Larix," he says, "Knight-Captain Dejan Larix" before shouting orders to a hastily assembled squad of Knight-novices, all obviously far younger than Bornanew.

Who, for one, is stabilized in the infirmary, part of the sprawling church infrastructure spilling from the cathedral.
texts.zh:
* * *

在一片混乱中，几乎没人注意到你。没过多久，一个怯懦的学徒指引你前往卢德骑士团的办公室。你在那里做了陈述，并与骑士长讨论了这起事件。你险些忘了询问他的名字。

"Larix，" 他说道，"骑士长 Dejan Larix。" 话音刚落，他便向一支临时召集起来的见习骑士小队下达命令 —— 这些见习骑士显然都比 Bornanew 年轻得多。

而 Bornanew 此刻已在医务室得到了稳定救治。这处医务室隶属于庞大的教会基础设施，而这些设施从大教堂延伸开来，遍布各处。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Later, back on your flagship in orbit, you find instructions on Bornanew's cheap datapad.

"If you hear these words, then I am returned to the arms of Providence," it begins.

You are to take his mortal remains to Hesperus, to the Knights of Ludd, so that it may rest with the fellow-walkers he knew for only a short time.
texts.zh:
回到你在轨道上的旗舰后，你在 Bornanew 那台廉价的数据平板上发现了一条指示。

"若你能看到这些，那便意味着我已魂归天堂。" 指示开篇写道。

你需将他的遗体送往 Hesperus，交给卢德骑士团，好让他能与那些虽相识不久、却志同道合的同伴们长眠在一起。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
* * *

You are nearly forgotten in the chaos. Before long, a meek apprentice directs you to the offices of the Luddic Knights where you make a statement and discuss the incident with the Knight-Captain. You only just remember to ask him his name.

"Larix," he says, "Knight-Captain Dejan Larix" before shouting orders to a hastily assembled squad of Knight-novices, all obviously far younger than Bornanew is.

Than Bornanew was.
texts.zh:
* * *

在一片混乱中，几乎没人注意到你。没过多久，一个怯懦的学徒指引你前往卢德骑士团的办公室。你在那里做了陈述，并与骑士长讨论了这起事件。你险些忘了询问他的名字。

"Larix，" 他说道，"骑士长 Dejan Larix。" 话音刚落，他便向一支临时召集起来的见习骑士小队下达命令 —— 这些见习骑士显然都比 Bornanew 年轻得多。

如果 Bornanew 还在世的话。

texts.en:
The Knight-Captain helped organize a search for Keepfaith.

You had almost forgotten to ask his name - "Larix," he said, drained of emotion. "Dejan Larix."

"For the small moment I knew him, I knew he was a good man. A good Knight. Damned but that it had to be my hand..." he trailed off then, hiding his eyes.

You left him to return to your shuttle.
texts.zh:
骑士长协助组织了对 Keepfaith 的搜寻行动。

你险些忘了问他的名字 ——"Larix，" 他语气平淡，"Dejan Larix。"

"我认识他的时间不长，但我清楚他是个好人，一名优秀的骑士。该死的是，动手的偏偏是我..." 他话说到一半便停住了，随即垂下眼睛，避开他人目光。

你留他独自待着，转身返回了自己的穿梭机。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The Pather plot is foiled, perhaps, for now.

Cedra Keepfaith, a murderer before a score of witnesses, was stripped of her rank before the set of the sun by Archcurate Bywater of the Cathedral of Holy Exodus.

The Knight-Inquisitors will pursue their brand of justice against her, you are assured.

Bornanew's quest is over.
texts.zh:
左径分子的阴谋或许暂时被挫败了。

Cedra Keepfaith —— 一名当着数十名目击者面犯下谋杀罪的凶手 —— 在日落之前，被 Exodus 神圣大教堂的大祭司 Bywater 剥夺了头衔。

你得到保证，审判骑士将以他们特有的方式对她执行正义。

Bornanew 的使命到此结束。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
Pulling your eyes away from the bloody scene, you see Subcurate Keepfaith realizing that the chaos she has caused presents her with the perfect opportunity to slip away.

It takes just two long strides and you catch her arm. Bornanew's blood is slick on your hand, and she pulls, hard, screaming admonitions but does not manage escape.
texts.zh:
你强行将目光从血腥的现场移开，赫然发现助理祭司 Keepfaith 也意识到了她自己引发的这场混乱恰好给了她一个溜走的绝佳机会。

你两大步便追上了她，一把抓住她的胳膊。面对你沾满了 Bornanew 鲜血的手，她拼命地挣扎、尖叫和呵斥，却没能挣脱开来。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
You shove into Bornanew, your speed making up for his mass, tumbling him away from the barrel of the gun.

A shot erupts from the carbine.

Later, you watch a recording of the incident and see your blood anoint an arc of junior assistants of the scriptoria. A fine rain of droplets stains their papers and books.

In the moment, however, the world has become indistinct. A feeling like the familiar drift of zero-g overcomes you.
texts.zh:
你猛地撞向 Bornanew，你的速度抵过了他体型的优势，将他从枪口前撞得踉跄倒地。

卡宾枪随即响起一声枪响。

之后，你回看事件录像时，看到自己的鲜血溅成一道弧线，落在抄经室几名年轻助手身上。细密的血滴像雨点般洒下，弄脏了他们手中的文稿与书籍。

然而在当时那个瞬间，周遭的一切都变得模糊不清。一种熟悉的失重感涌上心头，就像在零重力环境中那样漂浮不定。

options.en: Float upward
options.zh: 向上浮动

texts.en:
You fall back, ears buzzing, your eyes brought into line with the mural on the ceiling. Painted clouds and stars dance above you, attached to interlocking toothed wheels. The turning spheres of creation, the orbits and movements of celestial mechanics given literal form.

It's funny to you, the spacer, but you cannot laugh.

Your body is not responding to your commands. Your ship is adrift. Fluxed out. Vent.

Darkness.
texts.zh:
你向后倒去，耳边嗡嗡作响，视线恰好与天花板上的壁画对齐。彩绘的云朵与星辰在你头顶 "舞动" —— 它们依附在相互咬合的齿轮上。那是包罗了万千造物的天球在缓缓转动，天体运行的轨迹与规律，在此以具象化的形式呈现。

身为宇宙民，你只觉得这景象有些滑稽，却笑不出来。

你的身体已经不再响应你发出的指令。就像是你的座舰失去动力。幅能过载。强制排幅。

眼前只有黑暗。

options.en: Sleep dreamless and cold
options.zh: 意识坠入无梦的寒渊

texts.en:
* * *

You awake to the familiar hum of your flagship, in orbit.

For a moment, your mind drifts without context. A machine chirps helpfully somewhere.

Your vision is a blur, slowly resolving like a bad comm-link signal running poorly-adjusted inference algorithms.

There's a human-shaped blob. The details come rushing back.
texts.zh:
* * *

你在旗舰熟悉的轰鸣声中醒来，仍位于轨道上。

有那么一瞬间，你的思绪毫无头绪地飘散着。某处传来一台机器友好的蜂鸣声。

你的视线一片模糊，缓慢聚焦的过程，就像信号糟糕的通讯链接在运行参数失调的推理算法。

视野里出现一个人形轮廓。记忆的细节随即涌上心头。

options.en: $global.jethroName?
options.zh: $global.jethroName?

options.en: I feel like I've been shot.
options.zh: 我感觉自己挨了一枪。

options.en: ...did you catch her?
options.zh: ... 你们抓到她了吗？

options.en: ...Arroyo?
options.zh: ...Arroyo?

texts.en:
The shape leans forward and turns into Bornanew.

"Yes, captain," he says. "And you are alive, thank Providence. And your medical team, of course."
texts.zh:
那道身影俯身走上前来，是 Bornanew。

"是的，舰长，" 他说道，"你还活着，感谢上天。当然，也少不了您医疗团队的功劳。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Knight-Captain Larix applied first aid to you." Bornanew speaks softly. "I do think he saved your life."

He leans back. "And I, I managed to catch Keepfaith before she could flee. She's in the brig, now. And no longer a subcurate. The Reverend Archcurate of the Cathedral of Holy Exodus - Bywater, his name is - was quite distraught about the shooting. He revoked her curateship."

He pauses a moment to let everything sink in.
texts.zh:
"骑士长 Larix 对你进行了急救。" Bornanew 轻声说道，"我认为他确实救了你一命。"

他向后靠了靠，继续说道："至于我，我总算在 Keepfaith 逃跑前拦住了她。她现在被关在禁闭室里，而且已经不再是助理祭司 了。Exodus 神圣大教堂的大祭司 —— 他叫 Bywater —— 对这次枪击事件相当痛心。是他撤销了 Keepfaith 的神职。"

他停顿了片刻，好让这些信息都被你消化理解。

options.en: Attempt to speak
options.zh: 尝试出声

texts.en:
"Please, not yet," he says. "Be at ease."

"Keepfaith should be given over to the Knight-Inquisitors, on Hesperus. She still must be investigated for her crimes and put before a quorum of appropriate authority for judgement." He pauses. "Her other crimes, I mean. We have a score of witnesses for the shooting, and..."

He trails off, knowing little need be said of that just now. Another voice speaks, from outside the room - the medical recovery bay.
texts.zh:
"现在还不行，" 他说道，"放心。"

"Keepfaith 应当被移交给 Hesperus 的审判骑士。针对她的罪行，仍需展开调查，并由相关主管机构组成审议团对其进行审判。" 他顿了顿，补充道，"我指的是她的其他罪行。枪击事件已有数十名目击者可以作证，而且..."

他没有继续说下去 —— 他清楚，眼下关于这件事已无需多言。这时，另一个声音从屋外传来，那是医疗康复舱所在的方向。

options.en: Do not attempt to speak
options.zh: 保持沉默

texts.en:
Bornanew nods at some instruction then, standing up, looks back to you.

"Thank you, captain. For my life, again."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 听完某项指示后点了点头，随后站起身，回头看向你。

"谢谢你，舰长。又一次救了我的命。"

options.en: Sleep for a while
options.zh: 小睡一会

texts.en:
At least, that's what you try to say. What leaves your mouth is an indeterminate mush of phonemes.

The shape leans forward and turns into Bornanew.

"You've been shot," he says. "Try not to move."
texts.zh:
你想说些什么。可从你嘴里出来的，只有一堆含混不清、无法分辨的音节。

那道身影俯身走上前来，是 Bornanew。

"你中枪了，" 他说道，"尽量别动。"

options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
At least, that's what you try to say. What leaves your mouth is an indetermine mush of phonemes.

The shape leans forward and turns into Bornanew.

"Good morning, captain," he says. "By local reference, anyway."
texts.zh:
你想说些什么。可从你嘴里出来的，只有一堆含混不清、无法分辨的音节。

那道身影俯身走上前来，是 Bornanew。

"早上好，舰长。" 他说道，"按当地时间算的话。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
The shape leans forward and turns into Bornanew.

"It's just me. Jethro," he says. "Good morning captain. By ah, local reference, anyway."
texts.zh:
那道身影俯身走上前来，是 Bornanew。

"是我，Jethro。" 他说道，"早上好，舰长。哦，按当地时间算的话。"

texts.en:
The shape leans forward and turns into Bornanew.

"It's just me. Jeth... um, Jeff," he says. "Good morning captain. By ah, local reference, anyway."
texts.zh:
那道身影俯身走上前来，是 Bornanew。

"是我，Jeth...嗯，Jeff。" 他说道，"早上好，舰长。哦，按当地时间算的话。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"I am," he says with a laugh, "aren't I."

His expression grows serious after a moment. "And yes, it must."
texts.zh:
"是的，" 他笑着说，"不是吗。"

过了一会儿，他的表情变得严肃起来。"是的，必须如此。"

texts.en: He simply nods, eyes forward.
texts.zh: 他点了点头，眼睛看向前方。

texts.en: "As you will," he says. "Just... I beg you follow my lead."
texts.zh: "如你所愿，" 他说。"只是...我恳求你听从我的引领。"

texts.en: He laughs. "Boldly spoken from yourself, captain."
texts.zh: 他笑了。"舰长，你这话说得倒是大胆。"

texts.en:
"I am prepared," he says, turning to smile and give a bow, hands together, to a group of elderly pilgrims resting under a tree.

"This must be done as Ludd would, with open hands and heart."
texts.zh:
"我已经准备好了，"他说道，一边转过身来微笑着向一群在树下休息的老年朝圣者鞠躬致意，双手合十。

"必须像卢德那样做，敞开双手，敞开心扉。"

texts.en:
"I am prepared," he says, turning to give a bow, hands together, to a group of elderly pilgrims resting under a tree. "This must be done as Ludd would, with open hands."

"Besides," he adds with a wry smile, "you've seen fit to remain armed."
texts.zh:
"我已经准备好了，" 他说道，一边转过身来微笑着向一群在树下休息的老年朝圣者鞠躬致意，双手合十，"必须像卢德那样做，敞开双手。"

"不过，" 他苦笑着补充道，"你看起来似乎更适合带着枪。"

texts.en:
"That will not be necessary," he says, turning to smile and give a bow, hands together, to a group of elderly pilgrims resting under a tree.

"In fact, that is the worst thing we could do. This must be done as Ludd would, with open hands and heart."
texts.zh:
"没这个必要，" 他说道，一边转过身来微笑着向一群在树下休息的老年朝圣者鞠躬致意，双手合十。

"实际上，这是最糟糕的做法。必须像卢德那样做，敞开双手，敞开心扉。"

texts.en:
"That will not be necessary," he says, turning to give a bow, hands together, to a group of elderly pilgrims resting under a tree.

"My fellow Knights guard the Cathedral. I do trust that, whatever minor heresy they might be steeped in, they would not injure their brother without very good reason. This must be done as Ludd would, with open hands."

"Besides," he adds with a wry smile, "you've seen fit to remain armed."
texts.zh:
"没这个必要，" 他说道，一边转过身来微笑着向一群在树下休息的老年朝圣者鞠躬致意，双手合十。

"我的骑士同袍守卫着大教堂。我相信，无论他们沉浸在什么少数异端中，他们都不会无缘无故地伤害他们的修士弟兄。必须像卢德那样做，敞开双手。"

"不过，" 他苦笑着补充道，"你看起来似乎更适合带着枪。"

texts.en:
"That will not be necessary," he says, turning to smile and give a bow, hands together, to a group of elderly pilgrims resting under a tree.

"I urge you to maintain a restrained composure, captain. Even possessing a weapon in the cathedral is generally forbidden, though I have claimed your presence under the authority of the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis." He gives you a quick look to make sure he's getting through.

"This must be done as Ludd would, with open hands and heart."
texts.zh:
"没这个必要，" 他说道，一边转过身来微笑着向一群在树下休息的老年朝圣者鞠躬致意，双手合十。

"我劝你保持冷静克制，舰长。即使我已经声称你拥有着宗师大人 Jaspis 的授权，但一般情况下在大教堂里连持有武器都是禁止行为。" 他快速地扫了你一眼，确定自己传达到位。

"必须像卢德那样做，敞开双手，敞开心扉。"

texts.en:
"'...With hammer and sword'" he says, turning to give a bow, hands together, to a group of elderly pilgrims resting under a tree.

"Possessing a weapon in the cathedral is generally forbidden, though I have claimed your presence under the authority of the Reverend Archcurate Jaspis." He gives you a quick look to make sure he's getting through.

"This must be done as Ludd would, with open hands. But," he adds with a wry smile, "Ludd was not impractical when it served Providence, I think."
texts.zh:
"'... 以锤与剑之名'" 他说道，一边转过身来微笑着向一群在树下休息的老年朝圣者鞠躬致意，双手合十。

"我已经声称你拥有着宗师大人 Jaspis 的授权，但一般情况下在大教堂里连持有武器都是禁止行为。" 他快速地扫了你一眼，确定自己传达到位。

"必须像卢德那样做，敞开双手，敞开心扉。不过，" 他苦笑着补充道，"卢德也不会在侍奉上天时过于不切实际。"

texts.en:
"It is necessary that I do this," he says, then turns to smile and give a bow, hands together, to a group of elderly pilgrims who are walking past him.

"The spirit is willing. This must be done as Ludd would, with open hands and heart."
texts.zh:
"我有必要这样做，" 他说道，一边转过身来微笑着向一群在树下休息的老年朝圣者鞠躬致意，双手合十。

"我在精神上愿意。必须像卢德那样做，敞开双手，敞开心扉。"

texts.en:
"It is necessary," he says, then turns to give a bow, hands together, to a group of elderly pilgrims who are walking past. "My spirit is willing. This must be done as Ludd would, with open hands."

"Besides," he adds with a wry smile, "you've seen fit to remain armed. Even Ludd was not impractical when it served Providence, I think."
texts.zh:
"这是必要的。" 他说道，一边转过身来微笑着向一群在树下休息的老年朝圣者鞠躬致意，双手合十。"我在精神上愿意这样做。必须像卢德那样做，敞开双手。"

"不过，" 他苦笑着补充道，"你看起来似乎更适合带着枪。我认为，即使卢德也不会在侍奉上天时过于不切实际。"

texts.en:
"The Mundanians," he continues, "hold that Ludd's individual humanity provides a... spiritual focus. A manner of relation, a holy sympathy. Physical objects said to be associated with Ludd may play a role, hence the practice of veneration through - not of - relics. At least that is how they would describe it."

"The ban on venerating the worldly individual of Ludd is clear, but what of proximal objects? The Word is not so definitive."
texts.zh:
"世俗派，" 他继续说道，"认为卢德个体的人性提供了一种... 灵性焦点。也就是一种关联方式，一种神圣共鸣。据说与卢德相关的实体物品可能扮演着某种角色，因而产生了通过遗物 —— 而非崇拜遗物本身 —— 进行敬奉的习俗。至少他们是如此描述的。"

"对作为世俗个体的卢德进行崇拜是被明确禁止的，但那些具有关联性的物品呢？圣言对此并未给出定论。"

texts.en:
"Mundanians," he continues, "hold that Ludd's individual humanity provides a... spiritual focus. A manner of relation, a holy sympathy. Physical objects said to be associated with Ludd may play a role, hence the practice of veneration through - not of - relics. At least that is how they would describe such heresy. It is the apologia of Idolators."

"The ban on venerating the worldly individual of Ludd is clear, but the Word is less direct on the matter of proximal objects."
texts.zh:
"世俗派，" 他继续说道，"认为卢德个体的人性提供了一种... 灵性焦点。也就是一种关联方式，一种神圣共鸣。据说与卢德相关的实体物品可能扮演着某种角色，因而产生了通过遗物 —— 而非崇拜遗物本身 —— 进行敬奉的习俗。至少他们是如此描述这类异端的，但这实则是偶像崇拜者的辩解。"

"对作为世俗个体的卢德进行崇拜存在明确的禁止，但圣言对关联物品的问题则不甚直接。"

texts.en:
"We consider the conscious unknowing of Ludd's secular individuality a sign of devotion and a functional virtue."

He gives you a look. "Meaning we view the veneration of relics as idolatry. Some amongst us call the Mundanians 'Idolators' for their views. There are other... conflicts of practice, as well."
texts.zh:
"有意识地抗拒世俗个体的卢德，被我们视为一种虔诚的标志和一种实用的美德。"

他看向你，解释道："也就是说，我们认为崇敬圣物属于偶像崇拜。我们中的一些人正因 '世俗派' 的这类观点，称他们为 '偶像崇拜派'。此外，在践行信仰的方式上，双方还存在其他分歧。"

texts.en:
"We consider the conscious unknowing of Ludd's secular individuality a sign of devotion and a functional virtue. This is as the Word tells it."

He gives you a look. "Meaning we view the veneration of relics as idolatry. Some amongst us call the Mundanians 'Idolators' for their views, and not without justification."
texts.zh:
"有意识地抗拒世俗个体的卢德，被我们视为一种虔诚的标志和一种实用的美德。这正是圣言所教导我们的。"

他看向你，解释道："也就是说，我们认为崇敬圣物属于偶像崇拜。我们中的一些人正因 '世俗派' 的这类观点，称他们为 '偶像崇拜派'。而这并非没有依据。"

texts.en:
"Ah." Bornanew looks a little embarrassed.

"They call us 'Ignorants'. For we choose to wallow in our own ignorance. From a certain point of view."
texts.zh:
"啊。" Bornanew 看起来有些尴尬。

"他们叫我们 '愚昧派'。因为我们选择沉溺在自己的愚昧中。至少从某些角度来看是这样。"

texts.en:
"You were saying... boring, yes. I suppose it is," he says diplomatically.

"I shan't belabor the point. I tell you this now because there may be opposition to my investigation, and to my arrest of Cedra Keepfaith."
texts.zh:
"你刚才说这事很乏味，好吧，我想确实如此。" 他圆滑地说道。

"我就不再赘述了。现在把这件事告诉你，是因为我的调查工作，还有我对 Cedra Keepfaith 的逮捕行动，可能会遭到反对。"

texts.en:
"I suppose it is," he says diplomatically.

"I shan't belabor the point. I tell you this now because there may be opposition to my investigation, and to my arrest of Cedra Keepfaith."
texts.zh:
"我想确实如此。" 他圆滑地说道。

"我就不再赘述了。现在把这件事告诉你，是因为我的调查工作，还有我对 Cedra Keepfaith 的逮捕行动，可能会遭到反对。"

options.en: I have Subcurate Cedra Keepfaith aboard my $shipOrFleet.
options.zh: 助理祭司 Cedra Keepfaith 就在我的 $shipOrFleet 上。

texts.en:
The expression of the Excubitor Orbis does not change. Nonetheless, a coldness seems to have come over him, as if transformed into a statue.

The moment draws out and you think he might not respond, then he speaks. "She is expected."

He remains stone-faced.
texts.zh:
行星教卫的神情没有丝毫变化。尽管如此，一股寒意却仿佛笼罩了他，整个人宛如化作了一尊雕像。

时间仿佛在这一刻凝固，你甚至以为他不会回应了，他却开口说道："这在她的预料之中。"

他依旧面无表情。

options.en: Deliver Cedra Keepfaith into custody of the Knights of Ludd.
options.zh: 将 Cedra Keepfaith 移交给卢德骑士团。

options.zh: 将 Bornanew 带至卢德骑士团。

texts.en: The Excubitor Orbis seems uninclined to make further conversation, so you close the link and order your comms officer to handle the details while a shuttle is prepared.
texts.zh: 行星教卫 似乎无意再继续交谈，于是你切断了通讯链路，一边下令让通讯军官处理后续细节，一边安排人员准备穿梭机。

options.en: Board a shuttle
options.zh: 登上穿梭机

texts.en: Your officers make arrangements with the local authorities, requesting permission and receiving a flight path to shuttle down to one of the Knights' facilities on the surface of Hesperus.
texts.zh: 你的军官们与当地当局进行了协调，一方面申请许可，另一方面也获取了飞往 Hesperus 星球表面某座骑士团设施的航线。

texts.en: Bornanew joins you on the shuttle, his expression closed.
texts.zh: Bornanew 登上了你的穿梭机，神色冷淡疏离。

texts.en: Bornanew joins you on the shuttle. A muted and restrained Cedra Keepfaith is brought, as well.
texts.zh: Bornanew 登上了你的穿梭机。神情沉默举止克制的 Cedra Keepfaith 也被带了上来。

texts.en: The simple spacer's coffin holding Bornanew's body is loaded onto the shuttle. One of the spacers briefly puts their hands together, head bowed, after setting it down. A small sign of Luddic devotion.
texts.zh: 安放着 Bornanew 遗体的简易船员灵柩被装上了穿梭机。一名船员将灵柩放好后，短暂地双手合十、低下头 —— 这是卢德信仰的一个小小礼仪。

texts.en: A muted Cedra Keepfaith is led aboard by your guards. She does not look at the simple spacer coffin which holds Bornanew's body.
texts.zh: Cedra Keepfaith 一言不发地被你的卫兵带领着登上飞船。她没有看向那具盛放着 Bornanew 遗体的简易船员灵柩。

texts.en:
Your shuttle approaches an almost floral arrangement of pads set in the midst of a former mine pit.

Heavy doors open from the rockface inviting your landing party into the dimly lit hangar beyond.

A score of armored Knights march forth - like small, segmented dolls compared with the scale of the door, but as you approach you note their height. They must be the tallest farm-fed children of Gilead and Tartessus, all aclad in polished white armor, half-capes slack in the near-vacuum.

They turn precisely aside, weapons held vertical.
texts.zh:
你的穿梭机正接近一片坐落在四散的废弃矿井中央的停机坪。

岩壁上厚重的大门开启，邀请你的登陆小队进入后方那间光线昏暗的机库。

二十名身着铠甲的骑士列队迎上前来 —— 与大门的尺寸相比，他们乍一看像一个个分段拼接的小玩偶，但当你靠近时，才会注意到他们的身高。他们一定是来自 Gilead 和 Tartessus 的良家子，全都身披锃亮的白色铠甲，短斗篷在近乎真空的环境中松垂着。

他们精准地向一旁转身，武器竖直持握。

options.en: Enter the hangar
options.zh: 进入机库

texts.en:
You enter, the guards reverse their process, and the hangar is pressurized.

A far door cracks open, casting a long wedge of light. Spots snap on, converted shuttles and fightercraft loom in all corners.

The Excubitor Orbis enters.

Gideon Oak is a brick of a man, squat but powerful. Perhaps the product of a forgotten high-G world. He is accompanied by a weedy clerk.
texts.zh:
你进入机库后，守卫们启动了反向操作流程，机库内开始充压。

远处的一扇门裂开一道缝隙，一道细长的光线投射进来。照明射灯骤然亮起，改造过的穿梭机与战斗机在各个角落赫然矗立，轮廓庞大。

行星教卫走了进来。

Gideon Oak 身形如砖石般敦实，个子不高却孔武有力 —— 他或许来自某个早已被遗忘的高重力星球。陪在他身边的，是一位身形瘦弱的文书。

options.en: Simply nod
options.zh: 轻轻点头

options.en: Excubitor Orbis.
options.zh: 行星教卫。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName," the Excubitor Orbis nods, his voice gravelly.

His dark eyes take in the spacer's coffin carried by your entourage. You turn to give them a nod, and they set the coffin on the floor of the hangar.

"Novice Bornanew," he says.
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。" 行星教卫点了点头，声音沙哑。

他深色的目光落在你的随行人员抬着的船员灵柩上。你转身向他们点头示意，他们便将灵柩放在了机库的地面上。

"见习修士 Bornanew。" 他说道。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName," the Excubitor Orbis nods, his voice gravelly.

His dark eyes take in the spacer's coffin carried by your entourage. You turn to give them a nod, and they set the coffin on the floor of the hangar.

"Novice Bornanew," he says.

He seems to be ignoring Keepfaith entirely. For now.

"$playerName 舰长。" 行星教卫点了点头，声音沙哑。

"见习修士 Bornanew。" 他说道。

他看起来似乎完全没注意到 Keepfaith。

texts.en:
"Captain $playerName," the Excubitor Orbis nods, his voice gravelly.

His dark eyes take in Knight-Novice Bornanew beside you. He wears a light vac suit and bears his small satchel of possessions in one hand and the sample case with the false relic glove in the other. He insisted that he needed no help with it.

"Novice Bornanew," Oak says.
texts.zh:
"$playerName 舰长。" 行星教卫点了点头，声音沙哑。

他深色的目光投向你身旁的见习修士 Bornanew。他穿着一身轻便的真空服，一只手拎着自己的小行李袋，另一只手拿着则提着装有假圣物手套的样品箱。他坚持说自己不需要帮忙。

"见习修士 Bornanew。" Oak 说道。

texts.en:
Gideon Oak shifts his stony gaze to you.

"Tell me how," he says.
texts.zh:
Gideon Oak 将他那如磐石般冷峻的目光投向你。

"告诉我事情的经过，" 他说道。

options.en: He died bravely. Confronting the traitor in the cathedral.
options.zh: 他是在大教堂里与叛徒对峙时英勇牺牲的。

options.en: One of your Knight-Captains lost control of his weapon.
options.zh: 你们的一位骑士长走火了。

options.en: If we'd done it my way, he'd still be alive.
options.zh: 要是当初按我的办法来，他现在还活着。

texts.en:
Keepfaith inhales as if she might speak, some righteous outburst, but falters. Her eyes fall back toward the ground.

The Excubitor Orbis takes in your comment, his face impassive as the stone this hangar was blasted from. His clerk's eyes are downcast.
texts.zh:
Keepfaith 吸了口气，似乎想说些什么，或许是一番义正词严的辩解，但最终还是没能说出口。她的目光又落回了地面。

行星教卫听完你的话，面无表情，就像机库外面包裹的岩石一样冰冷坚硬。他身旁文书的双眼始终低垂。

texts.en:
The Excubitor Orbis takes in your comment, his face impassive as the stone this hangar was blasted from.

His clerk's eyes are downcast.
texts.zh:
行星教卫对你的话面无表情，如同这座机库外面包裹的岩石一般。

他身边文书的双眼低垂着。

texts.en: A quartet of armored Knights take this as their cue to approach Bornanew's coffin. Together, without needing a signal, they lift as one and bear him toward the door at the far end of the hangar. Their silhouettes make long shadows in the wedge of warm light.
texts.zh: 四名身着铠甲的骑士见状，立刻走向 Bornanew 的灵柩。无需任何信号，他们默契地一同将灵柩抬起，朝着机库远端的那扇门走去。在那道温暖的楔形光束中，他们的身体投下了长长的影子。
