texts.en:
Bornanew looks almost surprised at your words. He does not pray, or thank Providence. He simply looks directly at you through the waver of the comm-link.

"Thank you, captain. Against all odds, you've cast a light upon my path toward redemption."

Perhaps apologetic for the moment of earnestness, he quickly adds, "I am prepared to leave when you are ready for me. I shall await word of your shuttle."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 似乎对你的话感到惊讶。他没有祈祷，也没有感谢上天。他只是透过通讯链接的网纹直视着你。

"谢谢你，舰长。在困难重重之时，你为我的救赎之路投下了光芒。"

也许是为这片刻的真诚感到有些不好意思，他很快补充道，"我已经可以出发了，就看你什么时候准备好让我登船。我会等着你安排的穿梭机的消息。"

texts.en: Traffic control is mercifully efficient when arranging transport for a Knight of Ludd.
texts.zh: 在为一位卢德骑士安排通行路线时，交通管制的效率高得令人欣慰。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Before long, Novice Bornanew steps aboard your flagship carrying only a small satchel of his possessions.

Your TriPad pings acknowledgement of a funds transfer from the Church of Galactic Redemption.
texts.zh:
没过多久，见习修士 Bornanew 登上了你的旗舰，只带着一个小挎包，里面装着他的随身物品。

你的 TriPad 发出提示音，确认收到了来自 银河救赎教会 的转账。

options.en: I've ordered an officer's stateroom cleared for you.
options.zh: 我已经下令为你清理了一间军官舱室。

options.en: You'll be given a berth, like any member of the crew.
options.zh: 你会分到一个床位，和其他船员一样。

options.en: You'll be given a berth, like any member of the crew. Penance is penance.
options.zh: 你会分到一个床位，和其他船员一样。苦修就是苦修。

texts.en: "You have my thanks, captain," he says. "That will serve my needs most adequately."
texts.zh: "感谢你，舰长，"他说。"那完全能满足我的需求。"

texts.en: "Of course, captain," he says. "That will serve my needs most adequately."
texts.zh: "当然了，舰长，" 他说。"那完全能满足我的需求。"

texts.en: "Such extravagance is not necessary for a mere novice, captain," he says uncomfortably.
texts.zh: "对区区一个见习修士来说，没必要这么铺张，舰长，" 他不安地说道。

options.en: A private workspace will allow you to best perform your duties.
options.zh: 私人的工作空间能让你更好地履行职责。

options.en: Nonsense. You're my guest and I'll treat you as such.
options.zh: 别胡说了。你是我的客人，而我也自会以礼相待。

options.en: If you wish, you will be given a crew-berth.
options.zh: 如果你愿意，我可以给你安排一个普通船员的床位。

texts.en: Bornanew nods, not quite a bow. "You are right, of course."
texts.zh: Bornanew 点了点头，还称不上是鞠躬。"当然，你说得对。"

texts.en: Bornanew nods, not quite a bow. "My apologies, I did not intend to spurn your hospitality. It is a virtue."
texts.zh: Bornanew 点了点头，还称不上是鞠躬。"抱歉，我无意拒绝你的款待。这是一种美德。"

texts.en: "If you would, please," Bornanew says with a nod that isn't quite a bow. "It would be most appropriate for my service of penance."
texts.zh: "如果可以的话，拜托了，" Bornanew 点头说道，姿态还算不上鞠躬，"那最适合我履行赎罪的职责。"

texts.en: You have Bornanew's luggage taken to his quarters by a couple crew who clearly expected heavier lifting, then have him meet you in a debriefing room to plan your next move.
texts.zh: 你让几个船员把 Bornanew 的行李送到他的住处，他们显然没想到行李这么轻。然后，你让 Bornanew 到任务简报室与你会面，计划下一步行动。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Novice Bornanew speaks from the head of the table on which he has placed a paper notebook. He seems disinclined to use the shared workspace of the holo visualization suite; you're not even sure he brought a datapad.

"...collector who now possesses this duplicate relic is a man by the name Menes Yaribay, a minor member of Gens Yaribay of Kazeron," he looks to you for a sign of recognition.
texts.zh:
见习修士 Bornanew 在桌首发言，面前放着一本纸质笔记本。他似乎不太愿意使用全息可视化套件的共享工作区；你甚至不确定他有没有带数据平板。

"...现在拥有这件复制圣物的收藏家名叫{Menes Yaribay}，是 Kazeron 上 Yaribay 氏族的一个小角色，" 说到这，他用眼神询问了一下你是否认识这个人。

texts.en:
Of course you know the Yaribays. You were given Horus Yaribay's diplomatic credentials to arrange a meeting with High Hegemon Daud.

Horus Yaribay might owe you a favor, depending on how he views the situation.
texts.zh:
你当然知道 Yaribay 氏族。你曾从 Horus Yaribay 那里得到他的外交凭证，用以安排与至高霸主 Daud 的会面。

Horus Yaribay 或许欠你一个人情，但这取决于他如何看待这件事。

options.en: Explain this to $global.jethroName
options.zh: 向 $global.jethroName 说明这一点

texts.en:
Of course you know the Yaribays. You were given Horus Yaribay's diplomatic credentials to arrange a meeting with High Hegemon Daud and have, on at least one occasion, used those credentials to call a favor on account of Gens Yaribay's prestige.

Hopefully he didn't find out.
texts.zh:
你当然知道 Yaribay 氏族。你曾从 Horus Yaribay 那里得到他的外交凭证，用以安排与至高霸主 Daud 的会面，而且你利用凭证和 Yaribay 氏族的声望来至少谋取过一次私利。

希望他没有发现。

options.en: Explain everything to $global.jethroName
options.zh: 向 $global.jethroName 说明一切

options.en: Explain, but leave out the abuse of credentials part
options.zh: 进行说明，但略去滥用凭证的部分

texts.en:
Of course you know the Yaribays. You were given Horus Yaribay's diplomatic credentials to arrange a meeting with High Hegemon Daud. During that meeting, you handed over the key required for an encrypted channel between Horus Yaribay and Baikal Daud.

Horus Yaribay might owe you a favor, depending on how he views the situation.
texts.zh:
你当然知道 Yaribay 氏族。你曾从 Horus Yaribay 那里得到他的外交凭证，用以安排与至高霸主 Daud 的会面。在那次会面中，你交出了 Horus Yaribay 和 Baikal Daud 建立加密通讯所需的密钥。

Horus Yaribay 或许欠你一个人情，但这取决于他如何看待这件事。

options.en: Explain this to $global.jethroName
options.zh: 向 $global.jethroName 说明这一点

texts.en: You know of Gens Yaribay of Kazeron, one of the three dominant ruling family-corporations. Theirs is most inclined toward rapprochement with the Hegemony, focusing less on heavy military industry and more on interfactional ventures.
texts.zh: 你知道 Yaribay 氏族，那是 Kazeron 三大统治级的家族企业之一。他们最倾向于与 霸主 和解，对军事重工业的投入较少，而更多地聚焦于势力间的合资企业。

options.en: Yes, I've heard of the Yaribays.
options.zh: 是的，我听说过 Yaribay 氏族。

texts.en:
Bornanew looks concerned as you describe your dealings. "Your conscience, your soul, is between you and- well, I am not your judge or confessor."

"From a practical standpoint, I would advise caution in asking too much of Horus of Gens Yaribay, to his face or behind it. He may know but choose not to act on your transgression."
texts.zh:
在你描述你的所作所为时，Bornanew 显得很担忧。"你的良心，你的灵魂，是你和 —— 好吧，我不是你的审判官或告解神父。"

"从务实的角度来说，我建议你谨慎一些，无论是在当面还是背后，都不要对 Yaribay 氏族的 Horus 索取太多。他可能知道你的越轨行为，但选择不采取行动。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: A brief look of concern crosses Bornanew's face, and he pauses as if composing an awkward question. He puts his hand back down on the table, seeming to dismiss the notion, and responds in a different tone.
texts.zh: Bornanew 脸上的担忧一闪而过，他停顿了一下，好像在为一个尴尬的问题组织语言。然后他把手放回桌上，似乎打消了这个念头，换了一种语气回应。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: "This is providential," he says, nodding. "Your previous dealings with Horus Yaribay could open an easier path to resolving the Church's problem."
texts.zh: "这是天意，" 他点着头说。"你之前和 Horus Yaribay 的交集，或许能为解决教会的问题开辟一条更简单的道路。"

options.en: My, uh, thoughts exactly.
options.zh: 我，呃，正是这么想的。

texts.en: He nods and proceeds.
texts.zh: 他点点头，继续说着。

texts.en:
"The question, then, is how Horus Yaribay, the nominal gens leader, views Menes Yaribay's recent interest in religious artifacts."

Bornanew flips through his paper book, not really taking the time to read the dense notes therein. He runs a finger across lists of names.

"Not long ago Menes Yaribay was assigned the office of demarch, in essence the executive administrator, of Olinadu in the Kumari Kandam system. It is not a prestigious post. Olinadu is a small mining colony and the system is rife with Luddic Path activity. It is a dangerous, corrupt place."

Bornanew eye's return to you. "This is why I need your help."
texts.zh:
"那么，问题就在于，名义上的氏族领袖 Horus Yaribay 如何看待 Menes Yaribay 最近对宗教圣物的兴趣。"

Bornanew 翻着他的纸质本子，但并没有花太长时间去读里面密密麻麻的笔记。他的手指划过一列列名字。

"不久前，Menes Yaribay 被指派到 Kumari Kandam 星系的 Olinadu 担任统领，实际上就是行政总管。这不算是个显赫的职位。Olinadu 是一个小型矿业殖民地，而且那个星系里 卢德左径 活动猖獗。是个危险、腐败的地方。"

Bornanew 的目光回到你身上。"这就是我需要你帮助的原因。"

texts.en:
"Indeed I was." He's steady. "You know of this. There I met Wrestling Sedge of the Luddic Path, and there I left my vows. For a time."

A pause. "You followed my path, and spoke with the man Sedge. He told you where I went from there, Mazalot, where you found me."
texts.zh:
"我确实到过那里。" 他很镇定，"你知道这事。我在那里遇到了 卢德左径 的 Wrestling Sedge，也在那里放弃了我的誓言，暂时放弃。"

他停顿了片刻。"你跟随着我的足迹，和那个叫 Sedge 的人谈过。他告诉你我离开之后去了哪，Mazalot，也就是你找到我的地方。"

texts.en:
"Indeed I was." He's steady as he speaks. "You know of this. There I met Wrestling Sedge of the Luddic Path, and there I left my vows. For a time."

A pause. "And you killed the man Sedge," he says. "The Path will have no love for you there, but I trust that you will be prepared for... that."
texts.zh:
"我确实到过那里。" 他开口时很镇定，"你知道这事。我在那里遇到了 卢德左径 的 Wrestling Sedge，也在那里放弃了我的誓言，暂时放弃。"

他停顿了片刻。"而你杀了那个 Sedge，" 他说。"那里的左径分子不会想看到你的，但我相信你已经为...那种情况做好了准备。"

texts.en:
"Certain tawdry media outlets in the outer League worlds and beyond report rumor and gossip about affairs, social vendettas, and... how shall I put this... decadent festivities undertaken by Menes. More so in his younger years, at least." Bornanew turns pages in his notebook, not reading, but recalling as he goes through the motions with his hands.

"His enthusiasm for such pursuits has waned from the cycles of his youth, and his interests have shifted. At heart, I suspect Menes is still a man who wishes for all to hear his name, and for all who hear it to be very impressed."
texts.zh:
"联盟外围世界和其他地方的某些低俗媒体，报道过关于 Menes 的风流韵事、社交仇杀以及...我该怎么说呢...放纵派对的谣言和八卦。至少在他年轻的时候更是如此。" Bornanew 翻动笔记本，他没在阅读，而是伴随翻书的动作进行着回忆。

"他对这类追求的热情，已经随着青春的流逝而减退，他的兴趣也发生了转移。我猜，Menes 骨子里依然希望所有人都听到他的名字，并且让听到的人都对他印象深刻。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Unfortunately for his ambition, he is a natural dilettante in all pursuits. He avoids challenge, seeking instead flattery and the appearance of success which may be purchased with credits." Bornanew reports this without obvious outward judgment, as if discussing the results of a gravimetric survey.

"To his gens, Menes has given only scandal and debt. I suspect he was placed in the Olinadu administration to limit his ability to further damage their reputation."

Bornanew smiles grimly now. "It is some irony that he has potentially stumbled into more trouble than ever."
texts.zh:
"可惜他的野心终究无法实现，因为他在所有的追求上都半途而废。他不愿直面挑战，而偏爱用星币买来的成功表象和奉承之语。" Bornanew 的讲述并未掺杂明显的个人评判，就好像在讨论重力勘测的结果。

"而对于他的氏族，Menes 只带来了丑闻和债务。我怀疑，氏族之所以要把他安排进 Olinadu 的行政部门，就是为了防止他进一步损害氏族的声誉。"

说到这，Bornanew 露出了可怕的笑容。"说来有些讽刺，他现在可能陷入了前所未有的大麻烦。"

texts.en:
"Gens Yaribay has a controlling interest in the military corporation which exercises the monopoly of violence for the polity of Olinadu. The Pathers are an ever-present threat, so those who don't cooperate... well, that is the stick which compels. The carrot, on the other hand, is a stream of investment credits facilitated by Gens Yaribay brokers."

"The locals cooperate with this arrangement, and agreed to vote Menes Yaribay to an executive position, perhaps understanding that he'd play the role as a figurehead rather than a serious administrator. Olinadu receives investment and safety while, from all accounts, Menes Yaribay simply wants to be liked."

"Compared to the alternatives," says Bornanew, "he is an ideal overlord."
texts.zh:
"Yaribay 氏族在一家军事公司中拥有控股权，而这军事公司垄断着 Olinadu 政体中暴力手段的行使权。在左径分子的长久威胁下，对于那些不合作的人...嗯，这就是强迫的大棒。而胡萝卜，则是由 Yaribay 氏族经纪人促成的一系列星币投资。"

"当地人配合这项安排，并同意投票选举 Menes Yaribay 担任行政职位，也许他们明白他会扮演一个傀儡，而不是严肃的管理者。Olinadu 获得了投资和安全，而从各方面来看，Menes Yaribay 只是想被人喜欢。"

"与其他选择相比，" Bornanew 说道，"他是一个理想的统治者。"

texts.en:
"Yes, the... artifact." Bornanew looks down, clasping his hands together, then taking them apart and setting them deliberately on the table.

"Ludd's right-hand glove," an abashed smile appears.

"A standard work-glove of Domain manufacture. Light vac-suit compatible. The story is that Ludd removed it to touch the ground of Gilead."
texts.zh:
"好，那件... 遗物。" Bornanew 低下头，双手紧握然后松开，接着小心翼翼地把手放到桌子上。

"卢德的右手手套，" 他露出了尴尬的微笑。

"一件人之领制造的标准工作手套。兼容轻型真空服。据故事中记载，卢德摘下它是为了触摸 Gilead 的土地。"

options.en: And you don't think it's real? The original, I mean.
options.zh: 而你不认为它是真的？我是说，原本的那个。

options.en: Seems like a lot to get worked up about.
options.zh: 听起来这摊子事确实够让人头疼。

options.en: What's Ludd going to do with two right-hand gloves?
options.zh: 卢德要两只右手手套干嘛？

texts.en:
"It's a real glove," he says, "That much is true."

"It's just a work glove, one of many designs prevalent through the immediate pre- and post-Collapse Persean Sector."
texts.zh:
"那是真的手套，" 他说，"这一点毋庸置疑。"

"它不过是只工作手套，在 大崩塌前后 的英仙座星域流行的众多设计之一。"

texts.en: "I think," he begins, "it is a matter of seeking a physical connection with the sacred."
texts.zh: "我想，" 他开始道，"这是个寻求与神圣事物建立物理联系的问题。"

texts.en: Bornanew laughs. "Yes, exactly."
texts.zh: Bornanew 笑了。"对，没错。"

texts.en: "My objection is that the glove, even if it is the glove, is not important. What is important is Ludd's message, Ludd's sacrifice; it is the act of a divine moral force touching the soul of humanity with supreme grace."
texts.zh: "我的反对意见是，这只手套，即使它真的是那只手套，也并不重要。重要的是卢德所留的信息，卢德付出的牺牲；那是神圣的道德之力以无上恩典触动人类灵魂的过程。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"What is a glove to the light of Revelation?" The words come out forcefully.

"Even if it were Ludd's glove - and that we can't, and should not, be sure of - would God love you more for possessing it? Touching, looking upon, and worshipping it?"

His brow furrows. "Then some would try to extract DNA from the glove. Clone Ludd, they say, to re-open a connection to God." He shakes his head furiously, "As if you could fool God with the twin of the prophet's body!"

"Or the glove that body might have worn."
texts.zh:
"在启示之光面前，一只手套算得了什么？" 他的话语掷地有声。

"就算那是卢德的手套 —— 我们没法确认，也不应该去确认 —— 神难道会更爱你吗？就因为你拥有了它？或是触摸了它，注视着它，崇拜着它？"

他眉头紧锁。"然后有些人就会试图从手套中提取 DNA。他们会说，这是为了克隆卢德，来重新建立与神的联系。" 他愤怒地摇着头，"好像你能用先知身体的复制品来欺骗神一样！"

"或者哪怕用先知可能戴过的那个手套。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"It's the fool's logic of 'magic' of the lowest kind, the heretical notion that humanity might manipulate the Divine to our own ends. Creation turned on its head!"

You've never seen Bornanew like this, his voice like a river; his physical size giving power to his words. Seeing you see this, he realizes it himself.

"I apologize for my outburst, captain," he says, looking down.
texts.zh:
"这是最劣等 '魔法' 的那套愚蠢逻辑，是人类为了私心或许能操弄神物的异端邪说。造物秩序都被颠倒了！"

你从未见过 Bornanew 的这副模样，他的声音如洪流；魁梧的体格为他的话语赋予了力量。看到你发现这一点，他自己也反应了过来。

"我为我的失态道歉，舰长，" 他说着，目光下移。

options.en: Let's try to focus on the matter, ah, at hand.
options.zh: 我们还是，呃，专注于手头上的事情吧。

options.en: No need to apologize. I can't help but agree.
options.zh: 不必道歉。我完全同意你的看法。

options.en: But magic isn't real. So what harm is focusing on a glove, fake relic or not?
options.zh: 但魔法不是真的。所以关注一只手套，无论它是不是假的圣物，又有什么害处呢？

texts.en: He nods, suppressing a smile, looking down at his notebook. He puts his hands together again.
texts.zh: 他点点头，压住了自己的微笑，一边低头看着笔记本。接着又把双手合拢。

texts.en: He meets your gaze. "I shall interpret your words as forgiveness. It is nonetheless unseemly for a Knight to let uncontrolled passion rule their actions."
texts.zh: 他与你对视。"我将把你的话理解为原谅。尽管如此，让不受控制的激情支配自己的行为，对一位骑士来说很不得体。"

texts.en:
"Of course, of course." He rubs his chin, calmer now.

"The problem is not that it might work, but that such self-trickery will lead the Faithful astray from the Word. And if we don't follow the Word, then what use have we for revelation? Are we to simply discard God's gifts?"

He sits, looking into the distance somewhere. "Ludd chose the revealed path not because it was easy, and not because it was without suffering. Ludd chose because it was Good."
texts.zh:
"当然，当然。" 他摸着下巴，变得平静多了。

"问题不在于魔法是否能奏效，而在于这种自欺欺人的行为会让信徒们偏离圣言。如果我们不遵循圣言，那启示对我们又有什么用呢？我们难道要就此抛弃神的恩赐吗？"

他坐下来，望着远方的某个地方。" 卢德选择了那条被启示的道路，不是因为它轻松，也不是因为它没有痛苦。卢德选择它，是因为那是善的。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He glances at you with a fleeting grimace of self-reflection.

"With further apology for the ramble through theology, captain; the matter of the false relic should be our focus."
texts.zh:
他瞥了你一眼，脸上闪过自我反省的苦笑。

"再次为这段神学漫谈道歉，舰长；假圣物的事情才应该是我们的重点。"

texts.en:
Mention of Cotton dims Bornanew's expression. "He's read the Word, too, of course. In his way."

He sighs, deeply. "Let his crimes, worldly and spiritual, serve as bloody warning of the path those... that those uncertain of their faith might be compelled to follow. I pray it weren't so."

"Which, with apologies for the ramble through theology, brings us back to the false relic."
texts.zh:
提到 Cotton 让 Bornanew 的表情黯淡下来。"当然，他也读过圣言，以他自己的方式。"

他深深地叹了口气。"让他那些物质上和精神上的罪行，作为血淋淋的警告，警示那些... 那些信仰不坚定的人可能会被迫走上的道路。我祈祷事实并非如此。"

"那么，再次为这段神学漫谈道歉，我们还是回到假圣物的问题上来吧。"

texts.en:
Bornanew gives you a look.

"It's a tedious story. And unimportant."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 看了你一眼。

"那是个冗长的故事。而且不重要。"

texts.en:
Bornanew closes his book of notes.

"It has been made clear to me that the Church would like this problem, this false idol, to quietly disappear," he says. "It can only tear open old rifts within the Church which would weaken the resolve of the Faithful. It would turn walker against walker in troubling times which promise naught but more trouble."

"I am prepared to ask nicely, but I do not believe Menes will agree to give someone like myself his glove."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 合上了他的笔记本。

"我已经清楚地了解到，教会希望这个麻烦，这个虚假圣物，能悄无声息地消失，" 他说。"它只会在教会内撕开旧伤，削弱信徒们的信念。在动荡的时期，它会让循道者们自相残杀，而这只会带来更多麻烦。"

"我准备好了客客气气地去请求，但我不觉得 Menes 会愿意把他的手套交给像我这样的人。"

options.en: But you think he might listen to someone like me.
options.zh: 但你觉得他可能会听从像我这样的人。

options.en: We could offer to buy it.
options.zh: 我们可以提出要买下它。

options.en: We could steal it.
options.zh: 我们可以偷走它。

options.en: I could talk to Horus Yaribay. He leads his gens, presumably.
options.zh: 我可以和 Horus Yaribay 谈谈。他应该是他们氏族的领袖。

texts.en: "Yes," he says with the hint of a smile.
texts.zh: "是的，" 他微笑着说。

texts.en: "Interesting." Bornanew rubs his chin. "If you believe Horus will be receptive to you bearing this... news. I wonder if it may be as simple as that."
texts.zh: "有意思。" Bornanew 摸着下巴。"如果你认为 Horus 会愿意听你带来的这个...消息。我在想事情是不是真的那么简单。"

texts.en: "It is... yes, that is possible," he says begrudgingly. "I would like to know more before we act, however. I pray this may prove simpler than could be hoped."
texts.zh: "这...对，可能可以，" 他不情愿地说，"不管怎样，在行动之前，我想了解更多细节。我祈祷这件事能比预想的更简单。"

texts.en: "You could." Bornanew emphasizes 'you'. "The Church refuses to acknowledge the false relic."
texts.zh: "你可以这么做。" Bornanew 强调了 '你' 这个字。"教会拒绝承认这件假圣物。"

texts.en:
"I propose you contact Menes directly. If you show interest in his pursuits, I believe he will be well-disposed toward someone of your... repute. He could provide us with information to plan our next move."

Bornanew shuts his notebook.
texts.zh:
"我建议你直接联系 Menes。如果你对他的追求表现出兴趣，我相信他会对像你这样...有声望的人抱有好感。他可能会提供我们计划下一步行动所需的信息。"

Bornanew 合上了他的笔记本。

options.en: To Olinadu, then.
options.zh: 那么，动身去 Olinadu 吧。

options.en: My repute?
options.zh: 我的声望？

texts.en: "Your repute. As you well know," he says rather definitively. "And so will Menes."
texts.zh: "你的声望。你自己很清楚，" 他相当肯定地说。"Menes 也会有所了解的。"

texts.en:
"I propose you contact Menes directly. If you show interest in his pursuits, I believe he will be well-disposed toward someone of your... repute. He could provide us with information to plan our next move."

Bornanew shuts his notebook.
texts.zh:
"我建议你直接联系 Menes。如果你对他的追求表现出兴趣，我相信他会对像你这样...有声望的人抱有好感。他可能会提供我们计划下一步行动所需的信息。"

Bornanew 合上了他的笔记本。

options.en: Just one problem- the League wants me shot on sight.
options.zh: 还有个问题 —— 联盟的人见到我就会开火。

texts.en:
Bornanew opens his notebook.

He stands for a moment, eyes closed. "It is not ideal," he says.

"You will have to approach Olinadu with your transponder off. But I believe Menes will consider your official outsider status... interesting. Adventurous. It might even provide a sense of 'roguish charm'."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 打开了他的笔记本。

他站了一会儿，闭着眼睛。"情况很不理想，" 他说。

"你得关闭应答器才能接近 Olinadu。但我相信 Menes 会认为你的局外人身份...很有趣。富有冒险精神。甚至可能有一种 '流氓魅力'。"

options.en: It won't be a problem.
options.zh: 小事一桩。

options.en: It might be a problem.
options.zh: 可能会有点麻烦。

options.en: 'Roguish charm', huh?
options.zh: '流氓魅力' 是吧？

texts.en: He meets your look. "I know," he says with a hint of smile.
texts.zh: 他迎上了你的目光。"我知道，" 他微笑着说。

texts.en: He meets your look. "You have my faith," he says with a hint of smile.
texts.zh: 他迎上了你的目光。"我相信你，" 他微笑着说。

texts.en:
He gives you a look. "My speculation on behalf of his character, captain."

Bornanew shuts his notebook somewhat more forcefully than the first time.
texts.zh:
他看了你一眼。"这是我对他人格的推测，舰长。"

Bornanew 合上笔记本的动作比上一次更用力了些。

options.en: To Olinadu, then.
options.zh: 那么，动身去 Olinadu 吧。

texts.en: Bornanew shuts his notebook again.
texts.zh: Bornanew 再次合上了他的笔记本。

options.en: To Olinadu, then.
options.zh: 那么，动身去 Olinadu 吧。

texts.en: "A snoop?" Bornanew asks, "Is this some sort of hack? Would that even be possible? One presumes that the administrator of a Persean League polity can afford the best computer security."
texts.zh: "窃听器？" Bornanew 问道，"这算某种黑客攻击吗？这能行得通吗？可想而知，英仙座联盟 政体的管理员能付得起最好的计算机安全方案。"

texts.en:
* * *

It is a feat of diplomacy that you manage to extract yourself and Bornanew as quickly as you are able.

A faked containment failure alert from your chief engineer merely opens the door. Passing through requires shaking everyone's hand, exchanging pleasant words, and going through the motions of good-byes several times over - then each time the ritual is interrupted by some tangent or anecdote from Menes, he ensures that it is begun against from the start.

At last you find yourself back in your shuttle, a half-full glass still in your hand.
texts.zh:
* * *

你能这么快就带着 Bornanew 脱身，实属一项外交壮举。

你的总工程师伪造的收容失效警报只是为你打开了脱身的门。要穿过它，还得和每个人都握手，说些客套话，一遍又一遍地走完告别的流程 —— 然后每当这个仪式被 Menes 讲的题外话或趣闻打断，他都要让仪式从头再来。

最后你终于回到了自己的穿梭机上，手里还拿着半杯酒。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en: Menes is blathering on about something or other while Bornanew pretends to listen.
texts.zh: Menes 喋喋不休地讲着什么，Bornanew 则假装在听。

texts.en:
This isn't working. It's a good thing you prepared a backup plan.

You'll simply call in a marine raid while keeping Menes distracted. You give a grim nod to Bornanew and with only a small pause he follows your lead, asking Menes an insightful question about another item in his collection.
texts.zh:
这招行不通。幸好你有备用计划。

你决定在拖住 Menes 的同时直接呼叫陆战队劫掠。你严肃地向 Bornanew 点了点头，他愣了片刻，便领会了你的意思，向 Menes 提出了关于他另一件收藏品的深刻问题。

texts.en:
Menes is describing another of his expensive acquisitions when the lights cut out.

A moment passes in absolute darkness, the crushing weight of silence falling as the ventilation whirs to a stop. This is the terrible abyss of spacers' death; a reminder that you exist by the whim of machines caught in deadly vacuum, in a precarious balance of temperature and artificial atmosphere.

The subdued red emergency lighting strips flicker to life. Menes produces a nervous smile, "I'm sure it's just, um, a glitch." He mumbles something into his cuff, then gives it a confused shake.

Comms down. By the plan.
texts.zh:
当 Menes 正在介绍他的另一件昂贵藏品时，灯突然灭了。

四周陷入了绝对的黑暗，通风系统的嗡鸣戛然而止，令人窒息的沉寂随之降临。这便是太空船员葬身的恐怖深渊；它提醒着你，你的存续全仰仗着机器的恩赐 —— 在致命的真空中，是它们维系着温度与人造大气之间的脆弱平衡。

昏暗的红色应急灯带闪烁起来。Menes 挤出紧张的微笑："这肯定只是，呃，只是个小故障。" 他对着袖口咕哝了些什么，然后困惑地摇了摇手腕。

通讯系统挂掉了，一切都在计划中。

texts.en:
"It's probably- I'm certain- I, I," Menes stutters, "The power will come back soon. Those rad-addled Olinadu contractors," he attempts a nervous laugh.

You feel the dull thuds, nearly subsonic, through the armored mass of the vault. Breaching charges for the first layer of defense. You know the big one will come soon, and where.

Menes is in a growing panic.
texts.zh:
"可能是 —— 我敢肯定 —— 我，我，" Menes 结巴道，"电力很快就会恢复的。都怪那些脑子被辐射照坏的 Olinadu 承包商。" 他试图挤出个紧张的笑容。

你感觉到，近乎次声波般低沉的撞击声透过保险库厚重的装甲传来。这是突破第一道保护层的爆破炸药。你知道更大的冲击就要来了，也知道会从哪里来。

Menes 越来越惊慌失措。

options.en: Perhaps, Menes, we should take cover...
options.zh: Menes，也许我们应该找个地方躲起来...

texts.en:
When the marines finally breach the vault proper, it is with overwhelming force of sound and light. No unprotected human can withstand this assault on the senses; you are blinded, shocked, and rendered immobile. All you can do is cling to the kernel of self at the center of a storm of pain.

* * *

The return is slow, an awakening from a terrible and drugged sleep to emergency medical personnel and Menes' somewhat tardy security teams in their gleaming armor.

You and Bornanew leave the compound among the other victims. Bandaged, bruised, head aching, ears ringing.
texts.zh:
当陆战队员最终攻破保险库本体时，随之而来的是排山倒海般的强光与巨响。没有未穿戴防护的人类能承受这种感官冲击；你瞬间被致盲，意识被震慑，动弹不得。在这场席卷一切的痛苦风暴中，你唯一能做的，就是死守住那一点残存的意识。

* * *

意识的回归很缓慢，仿佛从一场可怕的药物昏睡中醒来。你看到了急救人员和 Menes 那些姗姗来迟、身穿闪亮盔甲的安保团队。

你和 Bornanew 混在其他受害者中离开了庄园。他们身上缠满绷带，遍体鳞伤，头痛欲裂，耳鸣不止。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Hours later, after a series of transfers to obscure your movements from the heightened official surveillance, you step back onto your own shuttle - and the attentions of your personal medical team.

A chime on your TriPad confirms that the operation was a success. A holo of the simple work-glove that human beings fought and died over rotates mockingly.

"Evidence," Bornanew says, tired but alert. His eyes are alarmingly bloodshot. "The seed of schism and war. Now whence did this come?"
texts.zh:
几个小时后，你通过一系列转乘摆脱官方加强的监视，回到了自己的穿梭机上 —— 也回到了你私人医疗团队的照料下。

你的 TriPad 上响起一声提示音，确认行动成功。那个人类曾为之战斗、牺牲的，普通工作手套的全息影像嘲弄般地旋转着。

"证据，" Bornanew说道，他虽然疲惫但很警觉。他的眼睛布满了血丝，看起来很吓人。"分裂与战争的种子。这东西是从哪来的？"

options.en: I don't suppose we could ask Menes.
options.zh: 我们大概没法去问 Menes。

options.en: What did you make of that Ulmus Pond?
options.zh: 你对那个 Ulmus Pond 有什么看法？

texts.en:
"No," he manages a smile for just a moment. "I would suppose not."

He looks back down at the holo.
texts.zh:
"是啊，" 他勉强挤出一丝微笑。"我也这么想。"

他低头看向全息影像。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"A nanoforge engineer could tell us much of this object," he says. "Who made it. When, and where. By the truths found in the false glove, we may judge answers we receive from those we... ask." His last word is muted by the shuttle's maneuverings.

"The Church's nanoforge is on Asher. Canaan system. The techs there will submit to the authority I bear. Our inquiry will be secret."

He pauses, and looks away. "So far as anything is, in the Church."
texts.zh:
"纳米锻炉工程师可以告诉我们这东西的信息，" 他说。"像谁造的。什么时候造的，在哪造的。看看这只假手套里藏着什么真相，我们也许就能判断出我们从那些...被问过的人那里得到的答案信不信得过了。" 他说 "问过" 时，声音被穿梭机的颠簸声盖了过去。

"教会的纳米锻炉在 Canaan 星系的 Asher 上。那里的技术人员会服从我所代表的授权。我们的调查会被保密。"

他顿了一下，移开了视线。"至少，在教会所能做到的范围内保密。"

options.en: We should confirm our hard evidence before Menes puts the pieces together here.
options.zh: 我们得在 Menes 搞清楚发生了什么之前，把事情实锤了。

texts.en:
Bornanew nods agreement.

The shuttle approaches your flagship and prepares to dock.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 点头同意。

穿梭机靠近了你的旗舰，准备停泊。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Your comms officer intercepts you on the way to the medbay looking determined but apologetic.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. The local security authority has issued a blanket order for all fleets to stay in orbit pending an investigation into an, ah, attack against the demarchon of Olinadu."
texts.zh:
在去医务室的路上，你的通讯军官拦住了你，表情坚定但带着歉意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。本地安全部门发布了全面指令，要求所有舰队留在轨道上，等待对 Olinadu 统领遭遇的，呃，袭击事件的调查。"

options.en: We're not registered with traffic control, correct?
options.zh: 我们没有在交通管制那边登记过，对吧？

texts.en: "Affirmative, $playerSirOrMadam," they reply. "However we can assume that the present higher state of alert will detect the $shipOrFleet's de-orbit burn."
texts.zh: "是的，$playerSirOrMadam，" 对方回答。"但是可想而知，在这样的高度戒备状态下，$shipOrFleet 进行离轨机动很容易被侦测到。"

options.en: Then we'd better go fast when we go.
options.zh: 那我们最好跑快点。

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam." They salute and step back so the med tech can finish waving a scanner - the high-pitched hum just inside your hearing - in search of broken bones. $global.jethroName undergoes a similar procedure in the next bay.

Before the hour you are discharged with a smart stimpack strapped to your side, under your uniform jacket, to control the pain and keep you alert.

You're not out yet. You can easily see that the local authorities don't discover Menes' trinket if your $shipOrFleet is searched, but that search would waste valuable time and disrupt operations.
texts.zh:
"是，$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 他们敬了个礼，退后一步，好让医疗技师继续挥舞扫描仪检查是否有骨折 —— 那高频的嗡嗡声刚好在你的听力范围内。$global.jethroName 正在隔壁的隔间接受类似的检查。

在你出院前，他们给你在制服夹克内侧绑上了一个智能兴奋剂包，用来控制疼痛并保持清醒。

事情还没结束。你很清楚，就算你的$shipOrFleet被搜查，当局也找不到 Menes 的小玩意，但搜查会浪费宝贵的时间并干扰接下来的行动。

options.en: Break orbit
options.zh: 脱离轨道

texts.en:
"A Pather agent," he says conclusively.

"We spoke briefly," he says. "In the aftermath. He insisted the medical team check him. Wasn't hurt."

Bornanew takes a deep breath, wincing. "But he slipped up. Heretical theology. Devil in the details. You can tell where one learned the Word, or, rather, a corruption of the Word, from the details."

"He may be connected, but first we should ask the glove." He looks back down at the holo.
texts.zh:
"一个左径特工。" 他断言道。

"事后我们简单聊了几句，" 他说。"他坚持要医疗队检查他。他根本没受伤。"

Bornanew 深吸一口气，厌恶般开口道。"但他露馅了。异端神学。魔鬼就藏在细节中。你可以从细节中分辨出一个人是在哪里学来的 圣言，或者说，学来的腐化版 圣言。"

"他可能和这事有关，但我们得先查查这只手套。" 他又低头看向全息影像。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
When the marines finally breach the vault proper, it is with overwhelming force of sound and light. No unprotected human can withstand this assault on the senses; you are blinded, shocked, and rendered immobile. All you can do is cling to the kernel of self at the center of a storm of pain.

* * *

The return is slow, an awakening from a terrible and drugged sleep to emergency medical personnel and Menes' somewhat tardy security teams in their gleaming armor.

You and Bornanew leave the compound among the other victims. Bandaged, bruised, head aching, ears ringing.
texts.zh:
当陆战队员最终攻破保险库本体时，随之而来的是排山倒海般的强光与巨响。没有未穿戴防护的人类能承受这种感官冲击；你瞬间被致盲，意识被震慑，动弹不得。在这场席卷一切的痛苦风暴中，你唯一能做的，就是死守住那一点残存的意识。

* * *

意识的回归很缓慢，仿佛从一场可怕的药物昏睡中醒来。你看到了急救人员和 Menes 那些姗姗来迟、身穿闪亮盔甲的安保团队。

你和 Bornanew 混在其他受害者中离开了庄园。他们身上缠满绷带，遍体鳞伤，头痛欲裂，耳鸣不止。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Hours later, after a series of transfers to obscure your movements from the heightened official surveillance, you step back onto your own shuttle - and the attentions of your personal medical team.

A chime on your TriPad confirms that the operation was a success. A holo of the simple work-glove that human beings fought and died over rotates mockingly.

"Evidence," Bornanew says, tired but alert. His eyes are alarmingly bloodshot. "The seed of schism and war. Now whence did this come?"
texts.zh:
几个小时后，你通过一系列转乘摆脱官方加强的监视，回到了自己的穿梭机上 —— 也回到了你私人医疗团队的照料下。

你的 TriPad 上响起一声提示音，确认行动成功。那个人类曾为之战斗、牺牲的，普通工作手套的全息影像嘲弄般地旋转着。

"证据，" Bornanew说道，他虽然疲惫但很警觉。他的眼睛布满了血丝，看起来很吓人。"分裂与战争的种子。这东西是从哪来的？"

options.en: I don't suppose we could ask Menes.
options.zh: 我们大概没法去问 Menes。

options.en: What did you make of that Ulmus Pond?
options.zh: 你对那个 Ulmus Pond 有什么看法？

texts.en:
"No," he manages a smile for just a moment. "I would suppose not."

He looks back down at the holo.
texts.zh:
"是啊，" 他勉强挤出一丝微笑。"我也这么想。"

他低头看向全息影像。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"A Pather agent," he says conclusively.

"We spoke briefly," he says. "In the aftermath. He insisted the medical team check him. Wasn't hurt."

Bornanew takes a deep breath, wincing. "But he slipped up. Heretical theology. Devil in the details. You can tell where one learned the Word, or, rather, a corruption of the Word, from the details."

"He may be connected, but first we should ask the glove." He looks back down at the holo.
texts.zh:
"一个左径特工。" 他断言道。

"事后我们简单聊了几句，" 他说。"他坚持要医疗队检查他。他根本没受伤。"

Bornanew 深吸一口气，厌恶般开口道。"但他露馅了。异端神学。魔鬼就藏在细节中。你可以从细节中分辨出一个人是在哪里学来的 圣言，或者说，学来的腐化版 圣言。"

"他可能和这事有关，但我们得先查查这只手套。" 他又低头看向全息影像。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"A nanoforge engineer could tell us much of this object," he says. "Who made it. When, and where. By the truths found in the false glove, we may judge answers we receive from those we... ask." His last word is muted by the shuttle's maneuverings.

"The Church's nanoforge is on Asher. Canaan system. The techs there will submit to the authority I bear. Our inquiry will be secret."

He pauses, and looks away. "So far as anything is, in the Church."
texts.zh:
"纳米锻炉工程师可以告诉我们这东西的信息，" 他说。"像谁造的。什么时候造的，在哪造的。看看这只假手套里藏着什么真相，我们也许就能判断出我们从那些...被问过的人那里得到的答案信不信得过了。" 他说 "问过" 时，声音被穿梭机的颠簸声盖了过去。

"教会的纳米锻炉在 Canaan 星系的 Asher 上。那里的技术人员会服从我所代表的授权。我们的调查会被保密。"

他顿了一下，移开了视线。"至少，在教会所能做到的范围内保密。"

options.en: We should confirm our hard evidence before Menes puts the pieces together here.
options.zh: 我们得在 Menes 搞清楚发生了什么之前，把事情实锤了。

texts.en:
Bornanew nods agreement.

The shuttle approaches your flagship and prepares to dock.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 点头同意。

穿梭机靠近了你的旗舰，准备停泊。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
Your comms officer intercepts you on the way to the medbay looking determined but apologetic.

"$PlayerSirOrMadam. The local security authority has issued a blanket order for all fleets to stay in orbit pending an investigation into an, ah, attack against the demarchon of Olinadu."
texts.zh:
在去医务室的路上，你的通讯军官拦住了你，表情坚定但带着歉意。

"$PlayerSirOrMadam。本地安全部门发布了全面指令，要求所有舰队留在轨道上，等待对 Olinadu 统领遭遇的，呃，袭击事件的调查。"

options.en: We're not registered with traffic control, correct?
options.zh: 我们没有在交通管制那边登记过，对吧？

texts.en: "Affirmative, $playerSirOrMadam," they reply. "However we can assume that the present higher state of alert will detect the $shipOrFleet's de-orbit burn."
texts.zh: "是的，$playerSirOrMadam，" 对方回答。"但是可想而知，在这样的高度戒备状态下，$shipOrFleet 进行离轨机动很容易被侦测到。"

options.en: Then we'd better go fast when we go.
options.zh: 那我们最好跑快点。

texts.en:
"$PlayerSirOrMadam." They salute and step back so the med tech can finish waving a scanner - the high-pitched hum just inside your hearing - in search of broken bones. $global.jethroName undergoes a similar procedure in the next bay.

Before the hour you are discharged with a smart stimpack strapped to your side, under your uniform jacket, to control the pain and keep you alert.

You're not out yet. You can easily see that the local authorities don't discover Menes' trinket if your $shipOrFleet is searched, but that search would waste valuable time and disrupt operations.
texts.zh:
"是，$PlayerSirOrMadam。" 他们敬了个礼，退后一步，好让医疗技师继续挥舞扫描仪检查是否有骨折 —— 那高频的嗡嗡声刚好在你的听力范围内。$global.jethroName 正在隔壁的隔间接受类似的检查。

在你出院前，他们给你在制服夹克内侧绑上了一个智能兴奋剂包，用来控制疼痛并保持清醒。

事情还没结束。你很清楚，就算你的$shipOrFleet被搜查，当局也找不到 Menes 的小玩意，但搜查会浪费宝贵的时间并干扰接下来的行动。

options.en: Break orbit
options.zh: 脱离轨道

texts.en:
He thinks for a moment.

"I pray it is so. It would require some exceptional ruse or the charisma of a pr- no, let me not blaspheme by saying it. But you understand that it is, as I believe spacers say, 'a long shot'."
texts.zh:
他沉吟片刻。

"我祈愿如此。但这需要非凡的计策，又或是感召力能够堪比先 —— 不，恕我僭越，不当妄言。但你也明白，用太空行话来说，这件事 '希望渺茫'。"

texts.en:
He thinks for a moment, a dark look threatening to grow.

"I pray it is so. But these are heretics, poisoned by a false Word and a dark Path. It would require some exceptional ruse or the charisma of a pr- no, let me not blaspheme by saying it. But you understand that it is, as I believe spacers say, 'a long shot'."

He contemplates the tactical display for a moment. "As well, there is something to be said for the element of surprise."
texts.zh:
他沉思片刻，阴郁之色逐渐浮现。

"我祈愿如此。但这些是异端，被虚假的圣言与黑暗之道所毒害。这需要非凡的计策，又或是感召力能够堪比先 —— 不，恕我僭越，不当妄言。但你也明白，用太空行话来说，这件事 '希望渺茫'。"

他凝视战术界面片刻，又说道："况且，突袭本身也有其战术价值。"

texts.en: "Well," Bornanew says from beside you. "Let it not be said that you did not attempt diplomacy."
texts.zh: "也罢，" Bornanew 在你身旁说道，"至少没有人能指责你未曾尝试过外交的手段。"

options.en: Say nothing
options.zh: 保持沉默

options.en: I truly hoped that would have gone better.
options.zh: 我真希望刚才的谈话能更顺利些。

options.en: Good. Now we can do this my way.
options.zh: 很好，现在我们可以按我的方式来处理了。

texts.en: He nods, awaiting your next decision.
texts.zh: 他点点头，等待你的下一步决定。

texts.en: He nods, awaiting your next decision.
texts.zh: 他点点头，等待你的下一步决定。

texts.en: Set $global.bornanewWasShotBySedge to true.
texts.zh: Set $global.bornanewWasShotBySedge to true.

texts.en:
"And, ah," Bornanew's brow furrows. "Mind your use of such nomenclature. It would be inconvenient to cause offense at some inopportune moment."

"Besides, name-calling is unseemly for a Knight who ought hold himself to higher standards. I am sworn to face conflict directly by the truth of the path illuminated by faith."
texts.zh:
"还有，呃，" Bornanew 眉头微皱，"请注意你对此类称谓的使用，若在不当的时机冒犯了他人，那可就麻烦了。"

"况且，对于一位理应恪守更高标准的骑士而言，辱骂行为有失体统。我曾立誓要凭着信仰照亮的真理之路而直面冲突。"

texts.en: "Best not to cast such words about thoughtlessly."
texts.zh: "最好不要轻率地说出这类言辞。"

texts.en:
Bornanew halts for a moment, his breathing heavy.

"I beg you spare a moment, captain," he says self-consciously. "It... has taken much of me."
texts.zh:
Bornanew 停滞了一下，他的呼吸很粗。

"我请求你给我一点时间，舰长，"他下意识地说道。"这... 对我来说太多了。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
He steps forward again, pushing the barrel of the Knight-Captain's carbine into his chest. The Knight-Captain looks desperately uncomfortable. "Brother," he says again, pleading.

"Do your duty, Knight-Captain!" shouts Keepfaith.

Bornanew takes another step, bodily pushing back the Knight-Captain, still cradling the carbine. Finger on the trigger.
texts.zh:
他再次向前迈步，将骑士长那把卡宾枪的枪管顶在自己胸口。骑士长脸上露出极度不安的神情。"修士弟兄，" 他再次开口，语气中满是恳求。

"履行你的职责，骑士长！" Keepfaith 高声喊道。

Bornanew 又向前走了一步，身体压迫着骑士长后退，而卡宾枪的枪管仍抵在他胸口。他的手指扣在了扳机上。

options.en: Draw your own weapon
options.zh: 拔出武器

options.en: Push Bornanew aside
options.zh: 把 Bornanew 推开

options.en: Make no sudden movements
options.zh: 保持镇定

texts.en:
Bornanew is pale, his breathing shallow. "To Hesperus," he says. "To the Knights of Ludd."

"Excubitor Orbis," he whispers, then carefully turns his head toward a display of starry space and the orb of Tartessus. "Penance."

He closes his eyes. Mouth open, still breathing.

You feel a movement in the air. Your chief medical officer hovers meaningfully, waiting for you to choose to leave, now.
texts.zh:
Bornanew 面色苍白，呼吸微弱。"去 Hesperus，" 他说道，"去找卢德骑士团。"

"行星教卫，" 他轻声呢喃，随后缓缓转头望向显示着璀璨星空与 Tartessus 星球的屏幕。"赎罪。"

他闭上了眼睛。嘴巴微张，呼吸仍在继续。

你察觉到空气中的动静。你的医疗主管在一旁徘徊着，沉默地催促你离开。

options.en: Leave
options.zh: 离开

texts.en:
"Ah, it comes to me now. A recent member, are you not?"

Then he frowns.

"And I recall now, you had some involvement in... you are an associate of my cousin Menes, I believe."
texts.zh:
"啊，我现在想起来了。你是新近加入的成员，对吗？"

随即他皱起眉头。

"我现在记起来了，你曾牵涉到...我想你是我表弟 Menes 的合作伙伴。"

options.en: I wouldn't say I'm an associate. We had only a passing acquaintance.
options.zh: 谈不上是合作伙伴，我们只有一面之缘。

options.en: I cleaned up the mess he made with the Church, yes. Someone had to.
options.zh: 我确实收拾了他在教会留下的烂摊子，总得有人去处理。

options.en: I'm here on behalf of Provost Baird, in fact.
options.zh: 事实上，我是代表 Baird 院长而来。

texts.en:
"Passing. I see." He re-examines you. "To your credit."

"Allow me to wish you welcome to the Persean League. Do you come to me regarding some matter to be raised in the League Council?"
texts.zh:
"一面之缘，我明白了。" 他重新审视着你，"值得称道。"

"请允许我欢迎你加入英仙座联盟。你来找我是为了在联盟理事会上提出某项议题吗？"

texts.en:
"Of course." He blinks.

Horus quite intentionally leaves it at that. No apology, no thanks.
texts.zh:
"当然。" 他眨了眨眼。

Horus 刻意就此打住。没有歉意，也没有谢意。

texts.en:
"Provost... oh." His face falls.

"This must be about- I mean, tell me, whatever is this about?"

Now you've got his full attention.
texts.zh:
"院长... 哦。" 他的脸色沉了下来。

"这一定是关于... 呃，不如你告诉我，来和我谈话是为了什么？"

他的注意力现在完全回到你身上了。

options.en: I need diplomatic credentials from you. I need to talk to High Hegemon Daud.
options.zh: 我需要你的外交证件，我要和至高霸主 Daud 谈谈。

options.en: The provost has a message, if you're ready to hear it.
options.zh: 院长让我带了一封口信，不知你是否准备好听了。

texts.en:
"What?" he says, incredulous. "The High Hegemon? Why should- oh, the... situation. I see."

Ah, now there's that look of resignation you've come to expect from those being blackmailed by the provost.

"Yes, of course. Provost Baird," he says. "I expect she's provided you with a message for me?"
texts.zh:
"什么？" 他难以置信。"和至高霸主本人？为什么是我 —— 哦，是因为... 那件事。我明白了。"

啊，现在你终于看到了那种认命般的表情，你已经习惯在那些被院长敲诈的人脸上看到这样的表情了。

"是啊，当然了。那 Baird 院长，" 他说。"我猜她应该给了你一条转交给我的口信吧？"

options.en: Send Baird's recorded message
options.zh: 发送 Baird 录制的信息

texts.en:
The comm line clicks to a holding pattern displaying the crest of Gens Yaribay, an elegant piscine motif echoing the Persean League's colors.

You watch Kazeron commodity futures scroll through the bottom of the display. After a couple of minutes catching up on bulk non-ferrous projections, the comm display chimes.

Horus reappears, looking somewhat more collected.

"Captain. $playerName, was it? Yes of course. Provost Baird explained her proposal and I do believe that we may arrive at a mutually beneficial arrangement."
texts.zh:
通讯线路被切换至等候界面，显示出 Yaribay 氏族的徽标，那是一枚优雅的鱼形纹样，呼应着英仙座联盟的代表色。

屏幕下方滚动着的是 Kazeron 的期货行情。你看了好几分钟的大宗有色金属走势预测后，通讯器响了起来。

Horus 重新出现在显示屏上，神色看起来比刚才镇定了几分。"舰长 $playerName，是吗？没错，正是。Baird 院长解释了她的提案，我认为我们可以达成一次对双方都有利的安排。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"You shall receive Yaribay diplomatic credentials," he says.

"Mind yourself well with these, captain. If you were to commit some untoward scheme using the good name of Gens Yaribay, we would declare the cryptokey stolen. And then, well, it need not be said that any decent authority would treat with you... appropriately."

Horus clears his throat, keen to move on from the topic.
texts.zh:
"我会给你你想要的 Yaribay 外交证件，" 他说道。

"但你最好用在正途上，舰长。要是你敢打着 Yaribay 氏族的名号搞些小动作，我们会宣布你持有的密钥是偷来的，之后任何正当机构都会知道该如何... 妥善处治你。"

Horus 清了清嗓子，意在换个更愉快的话题。

options.en: Of course. You have nothing to worry about.
options.zh: 当然了。你没有什么可担心的。

options.en: I don't need to be reminded to follow the rules.
options.zh: 用不着你提醒我遵守规矩。

texts.en: Horus looks as if he is about to speak, but holds himself for a second, then thinks better of it.
texts.zh: Horus 像是话到嘴边，却顿了一瞬，转念又咽了回去。

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"Naturally." He looks around uncomfortably. "I trust Baird's... good judgment. Naturally."

"Now, I know not what ruse the provost is pursuing. But if indeed you establish a line of communication directly and privately to the High Hegemon," a small smile appears on Horus' face, "That would be splendid."

"For my half of this arrangement requires the delivery of comms encryption codes to our friend Baikal Daud. One mustn't have COMINT snooping on important negotiations, yes? So do see that done."
texts.zh:
"那是自然。" Horus 局促不安地环顾四周。"我相信 Baird 看人... 不会看错。自然如此。"

"眼下，我不知道院长在打什么如意算盘。但如果你真能成功和至高霸主本人建立一条直接而私人的联络渠道，" Horus 的脸上浮现出一丝微笑，"那就再好不过了。"

"因为我的那一半安排的要求，就是把通讯加密代码交到我们的朋友，Baikal Daud 的手上。毕竟，重要的谈判可不能让 COMINT 偷听，对吧？所以务必把这事办妥。"

options.en: How can you be sure the High Hegemon wants to talk to you?
options.zh: 你怎么能如此确定至高霸主会想和你谈话？

options.en: Do you really believe the League can reconcile with the Hegemony?
options.zh: 你真的相信联盟能和霸主和解吗？

options.en: I don't imagine the Yaribay outlook is popular on Kazeron.
options.zh: 我猜 Yaribay 氏族的意向在 Kazeron 上应该不怎么受欢迎吧。

options.en: I'm off to see the High Hegemon.
options.zh: 我该去见见至高霸主了。

texts.en:
"He'd be a fool not to," Horus says.

"We offer a peaceful solution to the League-Hegemony conflict that would profit all. Daud may be hive-scum, but he's clever. Practical. To pull himself out of that hole on Chicomoztoc he must be a man who understands the compromises one must make to survive."

"In fact, I admire the man," says Horus Yaribay, seeming to surprise himself. "Despite his beginnings. I believe he will accept a compromise that allows us to keep what makes our League great. What does it matter the flag we live under?"
texts.zh:
"他不会傻到拒绝的，"Horus 轻蔑地说。

"我们针对联盟-霸主双边冲突提出的和平解决方案对双方都有好处。Daud 或许只是个巢区混混，但至少他很聪明。老实说，既然能从 Chicomoztoc 的贫民窟走到现在的地位，他一定也懂得人必须作出妥协才能求得生存的道理。"

"其实我还挺欣赏这个人的，"Horus Yaribay 说道，好像自己吃了一惊似的。"虽然他的出身并不显赫。我相信他会接受这个妥协，它能让 英仙座联盟 不至于失去那些让我们变得伟大的东西。我们高举的是谁的旗帜，又有什么关系呢？"

options.en: I'll be sure to put in a good word for you with the Hegemon.
options.zh: 我一定会为你说几句好话的。

options.en: It seems to matter to lots of people. Otherwise we wouldn't have flags.
options.zh: 看起来对不少人来说还是有关系的。不然我们就用不着旗帜了。

options.en: Does this compromise involve you retaining the wealth of gens Yaribay?
options.zh: Yaribay 氏族将会保留自己的财富，也是这项妥协的一部分吗？

texts.en: Horus smiles. "Excellent. I thank you."
texts.zh: Horus 微笑，"很好。谢谢你。"

texts.en:
"I appreciate the offer, captain. Truly I do."

Horus smiles somewhat uncomfortably.

"But given your history with the Hegemony... I'm not certain Daud will accept your, ah, good word in quite the spirit that we might hope for."
texts.zh:
"多谢你的好意，舰长。真心实意的。"

Horus 笑得有些不自在。

"只是你和霸主那段旧账摆在那儿... 我拿不准 Daud 会不会照咱们盼的那个意思，领你这份，呃，美言。"

texts.en:
Horus looks aside, considering.

"I suppose. But the masses can be swayed. They are fickle. And, ultimately, they will do what they must."
texts.zh: Horus 低头沉思。"大概吧。但是群众可以被操控。他们很善变。而且，到头来，他们只能被迫接受。"

texts.en:
Horus narrows his eyes.

"Indeed. And by necessity. The permission of the elite is essential for peaceful political change. I need not justify my position to you; the argument is one of practicality, and it stands self-evident."
texts.zh: Horus 眯起眼，"的确是。而且有这个必要。精英阶层的同意对和平的政治演变来说是必不可少的。我不用向你证明我的立场，这是基于实际情况的论断，而且也确实站得住脚。"

texts.en:
"Assimilation of the League worlds is Hegemony policy and an obvious condition of their reconstruction of the Domain, to say nothing of the foundation of their claim to legitimacy."

You get the sense that he is repeating an argument he has made many times before.

"Publicly the Hegemony's demand is 'unconditional'. How can they ask that, after Mayasura? They must compromise."

"But I understand their position. They maintain a hard face to buoy support from the masses and lower officers. And," he shakes his head once, "The Luddic Church, in its way."
texts.zh:
"对联盟管辖的星球进行同化是霸主的政策之一，也是他们重建人之领的计划中不可或缺的一环，不过他们合法性的基石就另当别论了。"

Horus 看向一边，你感觉到他是在重复某个之前多次提出的论点，"公开的说法是，霸主 的要求是 '无条件的'。在 Mayasura 的事情之后，他们还能继续这样做吗？他们必须妥协。"

"但我能理解他们为什么这样做。他们维持着坚强的外表，以赢得群众和下级军官的支持，再加上，" 他摇了一下头，"卢德教会也有自己的考量。"

options.en: Continue
options.zh: 继续

texts.en:
"The top leaders of the Hegemony, particularly High Hegemon Baikal Daud must see things more clearly than they let on. They understand that they must hold the banner high and speak of iron resolve to the bloody end - right up until the moment they can present their people with a great victory: peaceful reconciliation. Victory without war. Imagine!"

He looks suddenly self-conscious. "I apologize, captain. My eldest does tell me I have a way of carrying on, and it is not untrue."
texts.zh:
"霸主的高级领导人，尤其是至高霸主 Baikal Daud，看待问题的眼光一定比他们明面上的表现更加透彻。他们心里清楚，他们必须高举旗帜，宣称要以钢铁般的决心血战到底 —— 直到他们能为自己的人民献上一场伟大胜利的那一刻：和平和解。不战而胜。想想吧！"

他好像突然意识到了自己在说什么。"我向你抱歉，舰长。我的长子总说我止不住长篇大论，他说的确实不假。"

texts.en:
"Perhaps not. Not yet among the great gens of Kazeron, where it matters. Gens Hannan would have us head an empire, another Sindria. Meanwhile Gens Kato attempts to build bridges with the other League worlds. While I respect their accomplishments, they take anti-Luddic sentiment down to the level of rabble-rousing fanaticism."

"Besides, what other world in the League can match the might of Kazeron? Our stable of allies is anemic. Were it to come to total war, stars forbid, I think the Hegemony would prevail." He looks troubled, "And then the jackals would tear our vulnerable worlds apart. I fear the Persean Sector could not recover from a second Collapse."

"This is the only way. I hope you agree, captain."
texts.zh:
"也许你是对的。至少和 Kazeron 的几大氏族相比来说不受欢迎，这才是最关键的。Hannan 氏族会领着我们走向帝国之路，变成第二个辛达。而 Kato 氏族则注重与其他英仙座联盟的星球增进关系。虽然我很敬佩他们的成就，但他们将反卢德情绪推向了煽动暴民式的狂热。"

"另一方面，联盟里的哪个世界能比肩 Kazeron 的力量？我们稳定的盟友屈指可数。如果事态演变成全面战争的话，群星在上啊，我觉得霸主一定会获胜。" 他看起来心烦意乱，"然后这些恶狼会把我们弱不禁风的世界们一个个撕碎的。若真是那样，恐怕英仙座星域是没法从另一次 '大崩塌' 中恢复过来了。"

"这是唯一的办法。我希望你也是这么想的，舰长。"

options.en: I try not to get involved in local politics.
options.zh: 我希望尽量避免掺和进你们的政治。

options.en: Certainly. It's a noble goal.
options.zh: 的确。这是个崇高的目标。

options.en: This Sector hasn't done much for me lately.
options.zh: 我最近就没在这片星域里过过几天好日子。

texts.en: "You can't stand on the line forever, captain," he says. "Someday you'll have to choose."
texts.zh: "你不可能一直骑墙来左右逢源，舰长，" 他说道。"总有一天你要选边站的。"

texts.en: "I'm glad to hear that, captain," he says. "Maybe you can do some good- beginning with High Hegemon Daud."
texts.zh: "很高兴听到你这么说，舰长，" 他说道，"也许你也可以出一份力 —— 就从至高霸主 Daud 开始吧。"

texts.en: "I am sorry to hear that, captain," he says. "I hope whatever comes of your mission, whatever it is, it changes your mind on the matter."
texts.zh: "很遗憾听到你这么说，舰长，" 他说。"我希望你这次任务的回报，不论它到底是什么，能够改变你的看法。"

texts.en:
He thinks about it.

That look of resignation you've come to know from those being blackmailed by the provost comes across his face, and you know it's already worked.

"Send it," he says softly.
texts.zh:
他开始沉思。

你已经习惯在那些被院长敲诈的人脸上看到那种认命般的表情了，而这种表情正浮现在他的脸上，你就知道这招管用了。

"发过来吧，" 他轻声说道。
